14.15: Nanso wɔde wo abɛto ɔda mu,amoa donkudonku ase tɔnn.
14.16: Wɔn a wuhu wo no hwɛ wo haw,wodwen nea ato wo no ho bisa se,“Ɛnyɛ ɔbarima a ɔwosow asasena ɔmaa ahenni ho popoe,
14.17: ɔbarima a ɔmaa wiase dan nweatam,nea ɔdan ne nkuropɔn butuwiina wamma ne nneduafo ankɔ wɔn nkyi no ni?”
14.18: Amanaman ahemfo no nyinaa wɔadeda wɔnobiara wɔ ne da mu.
14.19: Nanso wɔapam wo afi wo da mute sɛ dubaa a wɔapo;wɔde wɔn a wɔatotɔ akata wo so,wɔn a wɔtɔɔ wɔ afoa ano,wɔn a wosian kɔ abo amoa mu,te sɛ funu a wɔatiatia so,
14.20: Wɔrensie wo nka wɔn ho,efisɛ woasɛe wʼasasena wakunkum wo nkurɔfo.Otirimɔdenfo asefo nowɔrenkae wɔn bio. Wo babarima renni wʼade sɛ ɔhene.
14.21: Siesie faako a wobekunkum ne mmabarimawɔ wɔn agyanom bɔne nti;ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔsɔre di asase no sona wɔde wɔn nkuropɔn pete so.
14.22: “Mɛsɔre atia wɔn,”Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.“Metwa ne din ne ne nkae,ne mma ne ne nenanom afi Babilonia ho,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
14.23: “Mɛdan no ayɛ faako a mpatu wɔne ɔwora;mede ɔsɛeprae bɛpra no,”sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
14.24: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia AsiriaAsafo Awurade aka ntam se,“Nokware, sɛnea mahyehyɛ no, saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ,na sɛnea masusuw no, ɛrensesa.
14.25: Mɛsɛe Asiria pasaa wɔ mʼasase so;metiatia no so me mmepɔw so.Obeyi ne konnua afi me nkurɔfo so,na nʼadesoa nso afi wɔn so.”
14.26: Eyi ne nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama wiase nyinaa;eyi ne nsa a wɔateɛ wɔ aman nyinaa so.
14.27: Na sɛ Asafo Awurade ayɛ nʼadwene a hena na obesiw no kwan?Na sɛ wateɛ ne nsa, hena na obesianka no?
14.28: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia FilistifoSaa adehu yi baa afe a ɔhene Ahas wui no:
14.29: Munnni ahurusi, mo Filistifo,sɛ abaa a ɛbɔɔ mo no mu abubu;saa ɔwɔ no ase na ahurutoa befi aba,na nʼaba bɛyɛ ɔwɔ a ne ho yɛ hare na nʼano wɔ bɔre.
14.30: Ahiafo mu hiani benya didibea,na mmɔborɔni bɛda asomdwoe mu.Nanso wʼasefo de, mede ɔkɔm bɛtɔre wɔn ase;ebekunkum wo nkae no.
14.31: Twa adwo, kurow pon! Su teɛ mu kuropɔn!munguan, mo Filistifo!Wusiw kumɔnn bi fi atifi fam reba,na obiara ntwentwɛn ne nan ase wɔ wɔn mu.
14.32: Mmuae bɛn na wɔde bɛmasaa ɔman no ananmusifo?“Awurade de Sion atim hɔ,ne mu na nʼamanehunufo benya guankɔbea.”

15.1: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia MoabAdehu a ɛfa Moab ho:Wɔasɛe Ar a ɛwɔ MoabDa koro anadwo bi,wɔasɛe Kir a ɛwɔ Moabda koro anadwo bi!
15.2: Dibon foro kɔ nʼasɔredan mu,ɔkɔ ne sorɔnsorɔmmea kosu;Moab twa adwo wɔ Nebo ne Medeba ho.Wɔayi eti biara so nwina abogyesɛ biara nso wɔatwitwa.
15.3: Wofurafura atweaatam wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔ adan atifi ne ɔman ahyiaewɔn nyinaa retwa adwo,wɔdeda fam na wosu.
15.4: Hesbon ne Eleale teɛ mu su,wɔte wɔn nne kodu Yahas nohɔ.Enti Moab mmarima akofo teɛ mu su,na wɔbotobotow.
15.5: Midi Moab ho awerɛhow wɔ me koma mu;nʼaguanfo guan kodu Soar,ne Eglat Selisiya.Wɔforo kɔ Luhit,wɔrekɔ nyinaa na wɔresu;Horonaim kwan so nsowodi wɔn sɛe ho awerɛhow.
15.6: Nimrim nsuwansuwa ayoyowna sare no ahyewafifide nyinaa ayerana ɛnkaa wura biara a ɛyɛ amono.
15.7: Enti ahonyade a wɔapɛ agu hɔ nowɔsoa de kotwa mpampuro bon.
15.8: Wɔn nkekawmu gyigye wɔ Moab ahye so;wɔn agyaadwotwa kodu Eglaimna wɔn abubuwbɔ kodu Beer Elim.
15.9: Dimon nsu ayɛ mogya nko arananso mɛkɔ so ne no adigyata bɛba Moab aguanfo sone wɔn a wɔbɛka asase no so no so.

29.1: Nnome Nka Dawid KuropɔnDue wo Ariel,Ariel, kuropɔn a Dawid tenaa mu!Fa afe ka afe hona ma wo mfirihyia mu afahyɛ ahorow no nkɔ so.
29.2: Nanso metua Ariel ano;obedi awerɛhow na wato kwadwom,ɔbɛyɛ sɛ afɔremuka so gya.
29.3: Mede dɔm betwa wo ho ahyia;mesisi abantenten atwa wo ho ahyiana madi ntuano dwuma atia wo.
29.4: Wɔasie wo no, wobɛkasa afi asase mu;wo kasa a mu ntew no befi mfutuma mu aba.Wo nne befi asase no mu aba te sɛ ɔsaman de;wo kasa befi mfutuma mu aka asomsɛm.
29.5: Nanso wʼatamfo bebrebe no bɛyɛ sɛ mfutuma muhumuhu,na atirimɔdenfo bebrebe no ayɛ sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa abɔ.Ɛbɛba prɛko pɛ, amono mu hɔ ara.
29.6: Asafo Awurade bɛba.Ɔde aprannaa ne asasewosow ne huuyɛ kɛse,mframahweam ne ahum ne ogyaframa a ɛhyew ade bɛba.
29.7: Afei amanaman bebrebe a wotu Ariel so sa nyinaa,wɔn a wɔtow hyɛ ɔne nʼaban so na wotua nʼano no,ɛbɛyɛ wɔn sɛ adaeso,anaa anadwo mu anisoadehu.
29.8: Sɛnea obi a ɔkɔm de no so dae sɛ ɔredidi,na sɛ onyan a ɔte sɛ ɔkɔm de no no;sɛnea obi a osukɔm de no so dae sɛ ɔrenom nsu,nanso onyan a na watɔ beraw, na osukɔm de no ara no.Saa ara na ɛbɛyɛ ama amanaman dodow awɔko tia Bepɔw Sion no.
29.9: Mo ho nnwiriw mo na ɛnyɛ mo nwonwa,mo ani mfura a munhu ade;mommobow a emfi nsa,montotɔ ntintan a emfi bobesa.
29.10: Awurade de nnahɔɔ ato mo so:Wakata mo ani (adiyifo no);wakata mo ti so (adehufo no).
29.11: Mo de, saa anisoadehu yi nyinaa nka hwee mma mo, ɛte sɛ nsɛm a wɔasɔw ano wɔ nhoma mmobɔwee mu. Sɛ mode nhoma mmobɔwee no ma obi a, otumi kenkan, na moka kyerɛ no se, “Mesrɛ wo kenkan eyi” a, obebua se, “Merentumi, efisɛ wɔasɔw ano.”
29.12: Sɛ nso, mode nhoma mmobɔwee no ma nea onnim akenkan, na moka kyerɛ no se, “Mesrɛ wo kenkan eyi” a, obebua se, “Minnim akenkan.”
29.13: Awurade ka se,“Saa nnipa yi de anohunu twiw bɛn mena wɔde wɔn anofafa hyɛ me anuonyam,nanso wɔn koma mmɛn me.Som a wɔsom me noyɛ mmara a nnipa akyerɛ wɔn no nko ara.
29.14: Enti mɛma nnipa yi ho adwiriw wɔn biomede anwonwade ntoatoaso bɛyɛ;mɛsɛe anyansafo nyansa,na mɛma nimdefo adenim ayɛ ɔkwa.”
29.15: Wonnue, wɔn a wɔyɛ biribiara sɛwɔde wɔn atirimpɔw behintaw Awurade,wɔn a wɔyɛ wɔn nnwuma wɔ sum ase na wosusuw sɛ,“Hena na ohu yɛn? Hena na ɔbɛte ase?”
29.16: Musisi nneɛma ti ase,sɛnea modwene sɛ ɔnwemfo te sɛ dɔte no!Nea wayɛ betumi aka akyerɛ nea ɔyɛe no se,“Ɛnyɛ wo na woyɛɛ me ana”?Kuku betumi aka afa ɔnwemfo ho se“Onnim hwee ana”?
29.17: Ɛrenkyɛ koraa, wɔrennan Lebanon nyɛ no asaseberena asasebere no nso nyɛ sɛ kwae ana?
29.18: Saa da no, ɔsotifo bɛte nsɛm a ɛwɔ nhoma mmobɔwee no muna kusuuyɛ ne esum mu mpoonifuraefo ani behu ade.
29.19: Ahobrɛasefo bedi ahurusi wɔ Awurade mu bio;ahiafo ho bɛsɛpɛw wɔn wɔ Israel Ɔkronkronni no mu.
29.20: Atutuwpɛfo bɛyera,wɔrenhu fɛwdifo bio,na wɔn a wodwen bɔne nyinaa, wobetwa wɔn agu,
29.21: wɔn a wɔka asɛm baako ma obi di fɔ,wɔn a wosum nea ɔreyi ne ho ano afiri wɔ asenniina wodi adansekurum ma wobu nea odi bem no fɔ no nso wobetwa wɔn agu.
29.22: Enti sɛɛ na Awurade a ogyee Abraham nkwa noka kyerɛ Yakob fifo:“Yakob anim rengu ase bio;wɔn anim rehoa bio.
29.23: Sɛ wohu wɔn mma wɔ wɔn mu,wɔn a wɔyɛ me nsa ano adwuma no awɔbɛyɛ me din no kronkron;wobegye Yakob ɔkronkronni no kronkronyɛ ato mu,na wɔde fɛre agyina Israel Nyankopɔn no anim.
29.24: Wɔn a wɔfom kwan wɔ honhom mu benya ntease;wɔn a wonwiinwii nso begye nkyerɛkyerɛ ato mu.”

17.1: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia DamaskoNkɔmhyɛ a ɛfa Damasko ho:“Hwɛ, Damasko renyɛ kuropɔn bioɛbɛdan ayɛ nnwiriwii siw.
17.2: Aroer nkuropɔn bɛdan amamfona wɔagyaw ama nguankuw ama wɔadeda hɔ,a obiara renyi wɔn hu.
17.3: Kuropɔn a wɔabɔ ho ban bɛyera wɔ Efraim,adehyetumi nso befi Damasko;Aram nkae bɛyɛIsraelfo anuonyam,”Sɛnea Asafo Awurade se ni.
17.4: “Da no Yakob anuonyam bɛpa;na ne mu srade bɛsa.
17.5: Ɛbɛyɛ sɛnea nnɔbaetwafo twa aburow a egyina afuw sona ɔde ne nsa penpan,sɛ bere a obi redi mpɛpɛwawɔ Refaim Bon mu.
17.6: Nanso mpɛpɛwa no mu bi bɛka,sɛnea wɔwosow ngodua a ɛyɛ no,ɛka aba no abien anaa abiɛsa wɔ atifi mman no so,ne anan anaa anum wɔ mman a ɛso no so,”sɛnea Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se ni.
17.7: Saa da no, nnipa de wɔn ani bɛto wɔn Yɛfo sona wɔadan wɔn ani ahwɛ Israel Ɔkronkronni no.
17.8: Wɔremfa wɔn ho nto afɔremuka aɛyɛ wɔn nsa ano adwuma no so,na wobebu Asera nnua ne nnuhuam afɔremukaa wɔde wɔn nsateaa ayɛ no animtiaa.
17.9: Da no wɔn nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ dennen, a Israelfo nti wogyaw hɔ no, bɛyɛ sɛ mmeaemmeae a wɔagyaw ama nnɔtɔ ne nwura. Ne nyinaa bɛda mpan.
17.10: Mo werɛ afi Onyankopɔn, mo Agyenkwa,na monkaee Ɔbotan no, mo abandennen no.Enti ɛwɔ mu sɛ mopɛ nnua papana mudua bobe a moatɔ afi amannɔne,
17.11: ɛwɔ mu, da a muduae no, moma enyiniianɔpa a muduae no, moma eguu nhwiren,nanso otwa no renyɛ hwee sɛɔyare ne ɔyaw a wontumi nsa.
17.12: Nnome nka aman dodow a wohuru so no,wohuru so te sɛ po a ɛrebɔ asorɔkye!Nnome nka nnipa dodow a wɔworo so,wɔworo so sɛ asu akɛse!
17.13: Ɛwɔ mu, nnipa dodow woro so te sɛ, asu a ɛresen mmirika so,sɛ ɔka wɔn anim a woguan kɔ akyirikyiri,te sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu wɔ bepɔw sote sɛ nweatam so nwura a mframaden rebɔ no.
17.14: Anwummere, wɔbɔ yɛn hu awerɛfiri muansa na ade bɛkyɛ no na wɔkɔ dedaw!wɔn a wɔfow yɛn nneɛma,ne wɔn a wɔbɔ yɛn korɔn kyɛfa ni.

16.1: Momfa nguantenmma sɛ sonkahirinkɔma asase no sodifo,efi Sela fa nweatam no so,kɔka Ɔbabea Sion bepɔw no so.
16.2: Te sɛ nnomaa a wɔaka wɔn afi berebuw muna wotu nenam wim nosaa na Moabfo mmea tewɔ Arnon asutwabea.
16.3: Moab ka se, “Munsi mo adwene pi,monna mo gyinaesi adi.Monyɛ mo sunsuma sɛ anadwo,awia ketee.Momfa aguanfo no nhintawmunnyi atubrafo no mma.
16.4: Momma Moabfo aguanfo no ne mo ntena;monyɛ wɔn bammɔ wɔ ɔsɛefo no ho.”Ɔhyɛsoni no bɛba nʼawiena adesɛe to betwa;opoobɔfo no bɛyera wɔ asase no so.
16.5: Ɔdɔ mu na Onyankopɔn besi ahengua bi;ɔbarima bi de nokwaredi bɛtena so,obi a ofi Dawid fi,nea atemmu mu no ɔpɛ atɛntreneena ɔntwentwɛn adetreneeyɛ ho.
16.6: Yɛate Moab ahantan a ɔyɛ,nʼani a atra ne ntɔn mmoroso,nʼahomaso ne nʼasoɔdennanso hwee nni nʼahomaso no mu.
16.7: Enti Moabfo twa adwo,wɔbɔ mu su ma Moab.Wodi awerɛhow na wɔbɔ abubuw,ma Kir Hereset bobe aba ɔfam.
16.8: Hesbon mfuw no hyew,Sibma bobe mfuw nso saa ara.Aman sodifo no atiatia bobe papa no so,nea kan na wɔde kɔ Yaserna ɛtrɛtrɛw kɔ nweatam so no.Wɔn mman trɛtrɛw kɔka mpoano pɛɛ.
16.9: Enti misu sɛnea Yaser su,de ma Sibma bobe mfuw.Hesbon ne Eleale,mede misu fɔw mo!Mo aduaba a abere ho ahurusine otwabere de no aka.
16.10: Ahosɛpɛw ne anigye nni mfikyifuw no mu;obiara nto dwom, na ɔnteɛteɛ mu wɔ bobeturo mu;obiara nkyi nsa wɔ nsakyiamoa so,efisɛ mede nteɛteɛmu aba nʼawiei.
16.11: Misi apini wɔ me koma mu wɔ Moab hote sɛ sankuten so kwadwom;na me yam hyehye me ma Kir Hereset.
16.12: Sɛ Moab kɔ ne sorɔnsorɔmmea aɔhaw ne ho kwa;sɛ ɔkɔ nʼabosonnan mu kɔbɔ mpae a,ɛrenkosi hwee.
16.13: Eyi ne asɛm a Awurade aka dedaw afa Moab ho.
16.14: Nanso mprempren Awurade ka se, “Mfe abiɛsa mu, sɛnea akoa a nhyehyɛe kyekyere no no bebu nna no, wobebu Moab anuonyam ne ne nkurɔfo dodow no nyinaa animtiaa, na ne nkae no bɛyɛ kakraa bi a wonni ahoɔden.”

12.1: Ayeyi NnwomSaa da no, wobɛka se:“Mɛkamfo wo, Awurade!Ɛwɔ mu wo bo fuw me de,nanso afei wʼabufuw ano adwo.Na woakyekye me werɛ.
12.2: Nokware, Onyankopɔn ne mʼagyenkwa;mede me ho bɛto no so, na merensuro.Awurade, Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne me dwom;na wabɛyɛ me nkwagye.”
12.3: Wode anigye bɛsaw nsuafi nkwagye mmura mu.
12.4: Saa da no wobɛka se,“Da Awurade ase, bɔ ne dinma amanaman nhu nea wayɛ,na pae mu ka se wɔama ne din so.
12.5: To dwom ma Awurade, efisɛ, wayɛ nea ɛwɔ anuonyam bebree.Da eyi adi kyerɛ wiase nyinaa.
12.6: Momma mo nne so nto dwom anigye somo a mowɔ Sion,efisɛ Israel Kronkronni a ɔte mo mu no yɛ ɔkɛse.”

13.1: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia BabiloniaAmos babarima Yesaia adehu a ɛfa Babilonia ho ni:
13.2: Ma frankaa so wɔ bepɔw a hwee nni so no atifi,teɛ mu frɛ wɔn:nyama wɔnma wɔnhyɛn atitiriw no apon mu.
13.3: Mahyɛ mʼahotewfo;mafrɛ mʼakofo sɛ wɔnna mʼabufuwhyew adi,wɔn a wodi me nkonimdi ho ahurusi.
13.4: Tie huuyɛ bi a ɛwɔ mmepɔw no sote sɛ dɔm kɛse bi de!Tie akasakasa a ɛwɔ ahenni ahorow mu,te sɛ amanaman a wɔreboaboa wɔn ho ano!Asafo Awurade reboa dɔm ano akɔ ɔko.
13.5: Wofifi akyirikyiri aman so,wofifi ɔsoro ahye so,Awurade ne nʼakode a ɛyɛ nʼabufuwhyew;bɛsɛe ɔman no nyinaa.
13.6: Twa adwo, na Awurade da no abɛn;ɛbɛba te sɛ ɔsɛe a efi Otumfo no.
13.7: Eyi nti, nsa nyinaa bedwudwo,obiara koma bɛbotow.
13.8: Wɔbɛbɔ hu,ɔyaw ne apinisi bekita wɔn;wobebubu wɔn mu te sɛ ɔbea a awo aka no.Wɔde ahodwiriw bɛhwɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho anim,a wɔn ani asosɔ gya.
13.9: Hwɛ, Awurade da no rebada bɔne a abufuw ne abufuwhyew wɔ mu,ɛrebɛsɛe asase nona asɛe abɔnefo a wɔte so no.
13.10: Ɔsoro nsoromma ne wɔn akuw renhyerɛn.Sum beduru owia a ɛrepuena ɔsram nso renhyerɛn.
13.11: Mɛtwe wiase aso, ne bɔne nti,ne amumɔyɛfo wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.Metwa ahantanfo ahomaso somɛbrɛ nea odi awurukasɛm no ahantan ase.
13.12: Mɛma onipa ho ayɛ na asen sika kɔkɔɔ ankasaɔbɛsen Ofir sikakɔkɔɔ.
13.13: Enti mɛma ɔsoro awosow;na asase ahinhim wɔ ne sibeawɔ Asafo Awurade abufuwhyew anonʼabufuwhyewda no.
13.14: Te sɛ ɔwansan a ɔbɔmmɔfo rehwehwɛ no akum no,te sɛ nguan a wonni ɔhwɛfo,obiara bɛkɔ ne nkurɔfo mu,obiara beguan akɔ nʼasase so.
13.15: Obiara a wɔbɛfa no dedua no, wobehwirew no afoa akum no;wɔn a wɔbɛkyere wɔn no nyinaa bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano.
13.16: Wɔbɛtotow nkokoaa ahwehwe fam wɔ wɔn anim:wɔbɛfom wɔn afi mu nneɛma na wɔato wɔn yerenom mmonnaa.
13.17: Hwɛ mɛhwanyan Mediafo atia wɔn,wɔn na wɔmfa dwetɛ nyɛ hweena wɔn ani nnye sikakɔkɔɔ ho.
13.18: Wɔn tadua bɛbobɔ mmerante ahwehwe fam;wɔrenhu nkokoaa mmɔbɔna wɔrennya ayamhyehye mma mmofra.
13.19: Babilonia, ahenni ahorow mu ɔbohemaa,anuonyam a Babiloniafo de hoahoa wɔn ho noOnyankopɔn bɛdan abutuwte sɛ Sodom ne Gomora.
13.20: Nnipa rentena hɔ bioawo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu;Arabni biara rensi ne ntamadan wɔ hɔoguanhwɛfo biara remfa ne nguan nkɔhome wɔ hɔ.
13.21: Nanso sare so mmoa bɛda hɔ.Sakraman bɛyɛ nʼafi no mu ma;hɔ na mpatu bɛtena,hɔ na wura mu mmirekyi nso bedi agoru.
13.22: Mpataku bɛtena nʼabandennen mu,adompo bɛyɛ nʼahemfi fɛfɛ no mu ma.Ne bere aso,na wɔrentwe ne nna mu.

11.1: Yisai Ase DubaaDua foforo bi befifi wɔ Yisai dunsin ho;efi ne ntin mu na Dubaa bi bɛsow aba.
11.2: Awurade Honhom bɛtena ne so,nyansa ne ntease Honhom,afotu ne tumi Honhom,nimdeɛ ne Awurade suro Honhom,
11.3: Na nʼani begye wɔ Awurade suro mu.Ɛnyɛ nea ɔde nʼani hu so na obegyina abu atɛn,anaa nea ɔde nʼaso bɛte so na obegyina asi gyinae;
11.4: na mmom ɔde trenee bebu mmɔborɔfo atɛn,ɔde atɛntrenee besi gyinae ama asase so ahiafo.Ɔde nʼano abaa na ɛbɛbɔ asase;ɔde nʼanofafa home bekunkum amumɔyɛfo.
11.5: Trenee bɛyɛ nʼabɔsona nokwaredi ayɛ nʼabɔso.
11.6: Pataku ne oguamma bɛtena,ɔsebɔ ne abirekyi bɛda,nantwi ba ne gyata ne ne ba bɛbɔ mu;na abofra ketewa bi adi wɔn anim.
11.7: Nantwi ne sisi bɛbɔ mu adidi,wɔn mma bɛdeda faako,na gyata bɛwe wura te sɛ nantwi.
11.8: Akokoaa bedi agoru abɛn ɔprammiri amoa ano,na abofra ketewa de ne nsa ahyɛ ahurutoa bon mu.
11.9: Wɔrenyɛ obi bɔne na wɔrensɛe adewɔ me bepɔw Kronkron nyinaa so,na Awurade ho nimdeɛ bɛyɛ asase so masɛnea nsu ayɛ po ma no.
11.10: Na da no, Yisai aseni bɛsɔre; nea ɔbɛsɔre abedi aman aman no so; ɔno na wɔn ani bɛda ne so, na nʼahomegyebea benya anuonyam.
11.11: Saa da no, Awurade bɛma ne nsa so ne mprenu so de agye ne nkurɔfo a wɔaka afi Asiria, Misraim anafo fam, Misraim atifi fam, Kus, Elam, Babilonia, Hamat ne Po so asupɔw.
11.12: Ɔbɛma frankaa so ama aman nona wɔaboaboa Israelfo a wɔatwa wɔn asu no ano;Ɔbɛboaboa Yudafo a wɔahwete no anoafi asase ntwea anan no so.
11.13: Efraim anibere betu ayera,na wɔbɛsɛe Yuda atamfo.Efraim ani remmere Yuda bio,na Yuda nso rentan Efraim ani.
11.14: Wobetwiw afa Filistia asiansian ahorow no so akɔ atɔe fam;na wɔbɛbɔ mu afow nnipa akɔ apuei fam.Wɔbɛfa Edom ne Moab,na Amonfo bɛhyɛ wɔn ase.
11.15: Awurade bɛma nsua ɛwɔ Misraim Po no mu ayow korakora;ɔbɛma ne nsa mu mframa a mu yɛ hyewabɔ afa Asubɔnten Eufrate so.Ɔbɛpaapae mu ayɛ no nsuwansuwa asonsɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obiara betumi ahyɛ mpaboa atwa.
11.16: Ɔtempɔn bi bɛda hɔ ama ne nkurɔfo nkaea wɔaka Asiria,sɛnea bi daa hɔ maa Israelbere a wofi Misraim bae no.

39.1: Asomafo A Wofi BabiloniaSaa bere no Merodak-Baladan a ɔyɛ Babiloniahene Baladan babarima soma ma wɔde krataa ne akyɛde kɔmaa Hesekia, efisɛ na wate sɛ wayare ama ne ho atɔ no.
39.2: Hesekia gyee asomafo no fɛw so, na afei ɔde nea ɔwɔ wɔ ne adekoradan mu kyerɛɛ wɔn; dwetɛ, sikakɔkɔɔ, nnuhuam, ngohuam, nʼakode akorae ne biribiara a ɛka nʼademude ho. Biribiara nni nʼahemfi ne nʼahenni mu a Hesekia amfa ankyerɛ wɔn.
39.3: Afei Odiyifo Yesaia kɔɔ ɔhene Hesekia nkyɛn, kobisaa no se, “Asɛm bɛn na saa mmarima no kae na he na wofi bae?”Hesekia buae se, “Wofi akyirikyiri asase bi so. Wofi Babilonia, na wɔbaa me nkyɛn.”
39.4: Odiyifo no bisae se, “Dɛn na wohuu wɔ wʼahemfi hɔ?”Hesekia buae se, “Wohuu biribiara a ɛwɔ mʼahemfi ha. Biribiara nni mʼademude mu a mamfa ankyerɛ wɔn.”
39.5: Afei Yesaia ka kyerɛɛ Hesekia se, “Tie asɛm a efi Asafo Awurade nkyɛn:
39.6: Nokware, bere bi bɛba a, wɔbɛsoa biribiara a ɛwɔ wʼahemfi ne agyapade a wʼagyanom akora de abedu nnɛ no akɔ Babilonia. Biribiara renka, sɛɛ na Awurade se.
39.7: Wʼankasa wʼasefo bi mpo, wɔbɛfa wɔn nnommum. Wɔbɛyɛ piamfo a wɔbɛsom wɔ Babiloniahene ahemfi.”
39.8: Na Hesekia ka kyerɛɛ Yesaia se, “Saa asɛm yi a efi Awurade nkyɛn a woaka akyerɛ me yi yɛ asɛm papa.” Nanso na ɔhene no redwene sɛ, ne bere so de, obenya asomdwoe ne bammɔ.

8.1: Asiria, Awurade Nsa Mu DadeAwurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Fa nhoma mmobɔwee kɛse no na fa kyerɛwdua biara kyerɛw so.
8.2: Na mɛfrɛ ɔsɔfo Uria ne Yeberekia babarima Sakaria sɛ me dansefo nokwafo aba.”
8.3: Afei mekɔɔ nkɔmhyɛnibea no ho, na onyinsɛnee, woo ɔbabarima. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Frɛ no Maher-Salal-Has-Bas.
8.4: Ansa na abarimaa no betumi aka, ‘Mʼagya’ anaasɛ ‘me na’ no, Asiriahene bɛba abɛfa Damasko ahode ne Samaria asade nyinaa akɔ.”
8.5: Awurade kasa kyerɛɛ me bio se,
8.6: “Esiane sɛ saa nkurɔfo yi apoSiloa nsu a ɛsen brɛoona wodi ahurusi wɔ Resinne Remalia babarima no ho nti,
8.7: Awurade reyɛ de Asubɔnten noyiri kɛse no atia wɔn,Asiriahene ne ne kɛseyɛ nyinaa.Ebeyiri afa nʼabon nyinaa mu,na abu afa ne konkɔn so
8.8: na apra abɛfa Yuda, akɔntɔn afa ho,ateɛ afa mu abɛdeda kɔn mu.Na atrɛtrɛw akata asase no nyinaa soImmanuel.”
8.9: Momma ɔko nteɛmu so, mo aman na wɔnnwerɛw mo!Muntie mo akyirikyiri aman.Munsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔnnwerɛw mo!Munsiesie mo ho mma ɔko, na wɔnnwerɛw mo!
8.10: Hwehwɛ ɔkwan a wobɛfa so, nanso wɔbɛsɛe no;da wo nsusuwii adi, nanso ɛrennyina,efisɛ Onyankopɔn ne yɛn wɔ hɔ.
8.11: Suro OnyankopɔnAwurade de ne nsa dennen no too me so, ka kyerɛ me, bɔɔ me kɔkɔ se mennantew saa nkurɔfo yi kwan so. Ɔkae se,
8.12: “Mommfrɛ no tirisopambiribiara a saa nkurɔfo yi frɛ no tirisopam no;Munnsuro nea wosuro,na momma ɛmmɔ mo hu.
8.13: Asafo Awurade nko ara na ɛsɛ sɛ wubu no ɔkronkron,ɔno na ɛsɛ sɛ wusuro no,ɔno na ne ho yɛ hu,
8.14: ɔbɛyɛ kronkronbea:nanso Israel ne Yuda de,ɔbɛyɛ hintibone ɔbotan a ɛma wɔhwe ase.Na ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Yerusalem de,ɔbɛyɛ afiri a ebeyi wɔn.
8.15: Wɔn mu bebree bɛwatiri;wɔbɛhwe ase a wɔrensɔre bio,wobesum wɔn afiri na ayi wɔn.”
8.16: Kyekyere kɔkɔbɔ adanse nosɔw mmara no ano ma mʼasuafo.
8.17: Mɛtwɛn Awuradea wayi nʼani afi Yakobfi somede me werɛ bɛhyɛ ne mu.
8.18: Me ne mma a Awurade de wɔn ama me no ni. Yɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ne agyiraehyɛde wɔ Israel, na yefi Asafo Awurade a ɔte Sion Bepɔw so no nkyɛn.
8.19: Sɛ nnipa tu mo fo sɛ monkohu samanfrɛfo ne nnunsifo a wɔkasa aso mu na emu ntew a, adɛn nti na wommmisa wɔn Nyankopɔn? Adɛn nti na mubisa ade wɔ awufo nkyɛn ma ateasefo?
8.20: Sɛ wɔannyina mmara ne adanse yi so anka asɛm yi a, wunni adekyee mu hann.
8.21: Wɔde ahohiahia ne ɔkɔm bɛnantenantew asase no so; na sɛ wɔtɔ beraw a, wɔn bo befuw na wɔbɛma wɔn ani so adome wɔn hene ne wɔn Nyankopɔn.
8.22: Afei wɔbɛhwɛ asase no so, na wubehu ahohiahia ne sum a ɛyɛ hu, na wɔde wɔn bɛhyɛn sum kabii mu.

38.1: Hesekia YareSaa nna no mu no, Hesekia yaree owuyare, na Amos babarima Odiyifo Yesaia kɔɔ ne nkyɛn kɔkae se, “Sɛnea Awurade se ni: Toto wʼakwan yiye, efisɛ worebewu; na wo ho renyɛ wo den bio.”
38.2: Bere a Hesekia tee asɛm yi, otwaa nʼani hwɛɛ ɔfasu, bɔɔ Awurade mpae se,
38.3: “Kae, Awurade, sɛnea manantew wʼanim nokware mu na mede me koma ayɛ nea ɛfata wɔ wʼanim.” Na Hesekia suu bebree.
38.4: Na saa asɛm yi fii Awurade nkyɛn kɔɔ Yesaia hɔ se,
38.5: “San kɔ Hesekia nkyɛn, na kɔka kyerɛ no se, ‘Sɛɛ na Awurade, wʼagya Dawid Nyankopɔn, ka: Mate wo mpaebɔ no, na mahu wo nisu. Mede mfe dunum bɛka wo nkwanna ho.
38.6: Na megye wo ne kuropɔn yi afi Asiriahene nsam. Mɛbɔ kuropɔn yi ho ban.
38.7: “ ‘Na eyi ne nsɛnkyerɛnne a Awurade bɛyɛ de adi ho adanse sɛ, obedi ne bɔhyɛ so:
38.8: Mɛma owia ano sunsuma atwe akɔ nʼakyi anammɔn du wɔ Ahas antweri so.’ ” Ɛno nti, owiahyerɛn no kɔɔ nʼakyi anammɔn du.
38.9: Nea Yudahene Hesekia kyerɛw wɔ ne yare ne nʼayaresa akyi ni:
38.10: Mekae se, “Mʼasetena mu nnapa yi muɛsɛ sɛ mefa owu apon muna wogye me mfe a aka yi ana?”
38.11: Mekae se, “Merenhu Awurade Nyankopɔn bioAwurade a ɔwɔ ateasefo asase so.Merenhu adesamma bio,anaa merenka wɔn a wɔte wiase yi ho bio.
38.12: Wɔadwiriw me fi agu agye afi me nsam,te sɛ, oguanhwɛfo ntamadan.Matwa me nkwa so sɛnea ɔnwemfotwa me fi asadua so;awia ne anadwo wutwaa me nkwa so.
38.13: Mede ntoboase twɛn kosii ahemadakye,nanso wɔbobɔɔ me nnompe mu te sɛ gyata;awia ne anadwo wutwaa me nkwa so.
38.14: Misuu sɛ asomfena anaa asukɔnkɔn;mitwaa adwo sɛ, aborɔnoma a ɔredi awerɛhow.Mʼani yɛɛ siamoo bere a mehwɛɛ soro.Mewɔ ɔhaw mu, Awurade, bra bɛboa me!”
38.15: Na dɛn na metumi aka?Wakasa akyerɛ me, na ɔno ankasa na wayɛ eyi.Mede ahobrɛase bɛnantew mʼasetena nyinaa mume kra ahoyeraw yi nti.
38.16: Awurade, ɛnam saa nneɛma yi so na nnipa nya nkwana me honhom nso nya nkwa wɔ mu.Wode mʼakwahosan asan ama menam so ama manya nkwa.
38.17: Yiw, ɛyɛ me yiyeyɛ ntina mekɔɔ saa ahoyeraw yi mu.Wo dɔ nti, wode me sieina mankɔ ɔsɛe amoa mu;na wode me bɔne nyinaa akyɛ me.
38.18: Ɔda rentumi nkamfo wo;owu rentumi nto wo ayeyi nnwom;wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu norentumi nnya anidaso wɔ wo nokware mu bio.
38.19: Ateasefo nko na wobetumi akamfo wo,sɛnea mereyɛ nnɛ yi;agyanom ka wo nokwaredi ho asɛmkyerɛ wɔn mma.
38.20: Awurade begye me nkwa,na yɛde asanku bɛto nnwomyɛn nkwanna nyinaawɔ Awurade fi.
38.21: Na Yesaia kae se, “Momfa borɔdɔma nyɛ nku mfa nsra pɔmpɔ no so, na ne ho bɛtɔ no.”
38.22: Na Hesekia bisae se, “Dɛn nsɛnkyerɛnne na ɛbɛda no adi sɛ, mɛkɔ Awurade asɔredan mu?”

9.1: Wɔawo Akokoaa Ama YɛnNanso wɔn a na wɔwɔ ahohiahia mu no renni awerɛhow bio. Kan no ɔbrɛɛ Sebulon ne Naftali nsase no ase, nanso daakye bi ɔbɛhyɛ Galilea a ɛyɛ amanamanmufo man na ne kwan da Yordan ne po ntam no anuonyam.
9.2: Nnipa a wɔnam sum muahu Hann kɛse;wɔn a wɔte asase a so sum kabii no,hann bi apue wɔn so.
9.3: Woatrɛw ɔman no muwoama wɔn ani agye mmorosowodi ahurusi wɔ wʼanimsɛnea nnipa di ahurusi otwabere,sɛnea nnipa ho sɛpɛw wɔnwɔ bere a wɔrekyɛ asade no.
9.4: Te sɛ da a Midian dii nkogu no,woadwerɛw konnua a ɛda wɔn so no,abaa a ɛda wɔn mmati,wɔn nhyɛsofo pema.
9.5: Ɔkofo mpaboa a wɔhyɛ de kɔ sane atade biara a mogya akeka mu,wobegyaw agu hɔ na wɔahyew;ɛbɛyɛ nea ɛma ogya dɛw.
9.6: Na wɔawo akokoaa ama yɛn,wɔama yɛn ɔbabarima,na amammui no bɛda ne mmati so.Na wɔbɛfrɛ noƆfotufo Nwonwani, Otumfo Nyankopɔn,Daa Agya, Asomdwoe Wura.
9.7: Nʼamammui no nkɔso ne Nʼasomdwoebɛtena hɔ daa.Ɔbɛtena Dawid ahengua soabu Nʼahenni,Ɔde atɛntrenee ne treneeyɛbefi ase na wama atimafi saa bere no akosi daa apem.Asafo Awurade mmɔdemmɔbɛyɛ eyi.
9.8: Awurade Abufuw A Etia IsraelAwurade ama Yakob nkra a etia no,na ɛbɛka Israel.
9.9: Nnipa no nyinaa behu,Efraim ne wɔn a wɔtete Samariaa wɔde ahohoahoane ahomaso koma kasa no,
9.10: “Ntayaa no abubu agu famnanso yɛde abo a wɔatwa bɛto bio.Wɔabubu borɔdɔma nnua nonanso yɛde sida besi anan mu.”
9.11: Nanso Awurade ahyɛ Resin atamfo den atia wɔn,na ɔhyɛ wɔn atamfo no nkuran.
9.12: Aramfo a wofi apuei fam,Filistifo a wofi atɔe fam,abue wɔn anom amene Israel.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
9.13: Nanso nnipa no nsan nkɔɔ nea ɔtwee wɔn aso no nkyɛn,na wɔnhwehwɛɛ Asafo Awurade no akyi kwan nso.
9.14: Enti Awurade betwa eti ne dua afi Israel hona berɛw ne demmire nso, ɔde da koro pɛ;
9.15: mpanyimfo ne akunini no ne eti no,na atoro adiyifo no ne dua no.
9.16: Wɔn a wɔkyerɛ nnipa yi kwan no, nkyerɛ wɔn ɔkwan pa,na wɔn a wonya akwankyerɛ no nso, fom kwan.
9.17: Enti Awurade ani rennye mmerante no ho,na ɔrenhu ayisaa ne akunafo mmɔbɔefisɛ, obiara nni nyamesu na wɔyɛ amumɔyɛfo,ano biara ka ahuhusɛm.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
9.18: Nokware, atirimɔden hye te sɛ ogya;ɛhyew nnɛnkyɛnse ne nsɔe,ɛde ogya to kwaeberentuw mu hyew no,na ɛnam wusiw kumɔnn mu foro kɔ soro.
9.19: Ɛnam Asafo Awurade abufuw so,asase no bɛkyenna nnipa bɛyɛ mmabaa ama ogya no;na obiara remfa ne nua ho nkyɛ no.
9.20: Nifa so, wɔbɛfom aduan adi,nanso ɔkɔm bɛde wɔn;benkum so wobedidi,nanso wɔremmee.Obiara bɛwe ne ba nam.
9.21: Manase bɛdan Efraim na Efraim adan Manasena wɔbɛbɔ mu atia Yuda.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.

10.1: Wonnue, wɔn a wɔhyɛ mmara a ɛmfa ne kwan mu,wɔn a wɔhyɛ mmara dennen a ɛde nhyɛso ba,
10.2: de siw ahiafo ahofadi ho kwan,de atɛntrenee bɔ me nkurɔfo a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no atirimɔden.Wɔma akunafo yɛ amanehunufona wɔbɔ ayisaa korɔn.
10.3: Dɛn na mobɛyɛ wɔ akontaabu da no,bere a amanehunu fi akyirikyiri reba?Hena nkyɛn na mubeguan akɔpɛ mmoa?Ɛhefa na mubegyaw mo ahode?
10.4: Ɛrenka mo hwee sɛ mobɛfra nneduafo muanaasɛ mobɛtotɔ wɔ atɔfo mu.Nanso eyinom nyinaa akyi no ne bo nnwoo ɛ,na ne nsa da so wɔ soro.
10.5: Asiria Atemmu A Efi Onyankopɔn“Nnome nka Asiriani no, mʼabufuw abaa,nea okura mʼabufuwhyew pema no!
10.6: Mesoma no akɔ ɔman a wonnim Onyankopɔn somigya no kwan ma wakɔ nnipa a wɔhyɛ me abufuw sosɛ wonkogye akorɔnne abran so na wonhuam afowde,na wontiatia wɔn so sɛ dɔte wɔ mmɔnten so.
10.7: Nanso ɛnyɛ eyi ne nea ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛnyɛ eyi ne nea ɛwɔ nʼadwene mu;ne botae ne sɛ ɔbɛsɛe,sɛ ɔde aman bebree bɛba wɔn awiei.
10.8: Na obisa se, ‘Ahemfo nyinaa nyɛ mʼasahene ana?
10.9: Kalno nyɛɛ sɛ Karkemis ana?Hamat nte sɛ Arpadna Samaria nte sɛ Damasko ana?
10.10: Sɛnea migyee ahoni ahenni ahorow abran so,ahenni a wɔn nsɛsode sen nea ɛwɔ Yerusalem ne Samaria no.
10.11: Merentumi ne Yerusalem ne ne nsɛsode nni,sɛnea me ne Samaria ne nʼahoni dii no?’ ”
10.12: Sɛ Awurade wie nʼadwuma a etia Bepɔw Sion ne Yerusalem nyinaa a, ɔbɛka se, “Mɛtwe Asiriahene aso wɔ ne komapirim ne nʼani a ɛnsɔ ade no ho.
10.13: Efisɛ ɔka se,“ ‘Mede mʼahoɔden na ayɛ eyi,na mifi me nyansa mu, efisɛ mewɔ nimdeɛ.Mesɛee aman aman ahye,mefow wɔn ademude;mebrɛɛ wɔn ahemfo ase te sɛ ɔbran.
10.14: Sɛnea obi teɛ ne nsa hyɛ berebuw mu no,saa ara nso na mɛteɛ me nsa wɔ amanaman no ahonyade so;sɛnea wɔtase nkesua a wɔagyaw hɔ no,saa ara na mɛboaboa amanaman no nyinaa ano;obiara ammɔ ne ntaban mu,na wammue nʼano ansu.’ ”
10.15: Abonnua ma ne ho so tra nea ɔtow,anaasɛ ɔwan hoahoa ne ho kyɛn nea ɔde no yɛ adwuma ana?Ayɛ te sɛnea abaa tumi dannan nea ɔmaa no so,anaasɛ poribaa tumi hinhim nea ɔnyɛ dua!
10.16: Afei Awurade, Asafo Awurade,de ɔyaredɔm bɛbɔ nʼakofo ahoɔdenfo no;ne kɛseyɛ mu wobefita ogya mu ama adɛwte sɛ gyaframa.
10.17: Israel Hann no bɛdan ogya.Wɔn Kronkronni no bɛyɛ ogya a ɛdɛw;ɔde da koro bɛhyew na wasɛene nsɔe ne nnɛnkyɛnse.
10.18: Ne kwae ne nʼasasebere anuonyam no,ɛbɛsɛe pasapasate sɛ ɔyarefo a ɔrefɔn.
10.19: Nnua a ɛbɛka wɔ ne kwae mu bɛyɛ kakraa bia abofra betumi akyerɛ ne dodow.
10.20: Israel NkaefoDa no, Israel nkae,Yakob fifo a wɔbɛka no,remfa wɔn ho nto no so bionea ɔbɔɔ wɔn hwee fam no;na mmom wɔde wɔn ho bɛto Awurade so nokware mu,Israel Kronkronni no.
10.21: Nkae bi bɛsan aba, Yakob nkae bibɛsan aba Otumfo Onyankopɔn no nkyɛn.
10.22: Israel, ɛwɔ mu sɛ wo nkurɔfo dɔɔso sɛ mpoano nwea de,nanso nkae bi pɛ na wɔbɛsan.Wɔahyɛ ɔsɛe ho mmara dennena ebebunkam so na ɛteɛ.
10.23: Awurade, Asafo Awurade de ɔsɛea wɔahyɛ ho mmara ketee na ɛbɛba asase no so nyinaa.
10.24: Enti sɛɛ na Awurade, Asafo Awurade se,“Me nkurɔfo a mote Sion,munnsuro Asiriafo no,wɔn a wɔde mmaa hwe mona wɔma kontibaa so tia mo, sɛnea Misraim yɛe no.
10.25: Ɛrenkyɛ koraa mʼabufuw a etia mo no ano bedwona mʼanibere bɛkɔ wɔn sɛe so.”
10.26: Asafo Awurade de mpire bɛhwe wɔn,sɛnea ɔbɔɔ Midian hwee fam wɔ Oreb Ɔbotan ho no;na ɔbɛteɛ ne pema wɔ nsu no so,sɛnea ɔyɛɛ wɔ Misraim no.
10.27: Da no wobeyi wɔn adesoa no afi wɔn mmati sowɔn konnua afi wo kɔn mu;wobubu konnua noefisɛ woayɛ ɔbran yiye.
10.28: Wɔhyɛn Ayat;wɔfa Migron;na wɔkora wɔn nneɛma wɔ Mikmas.
10.29: Wɔfaa ɔtempɔn no so, na wɔka se,“Yɛbɛwɛn wɔ Geba anadwo yi.”Rama ho popo;Saulo kurow Gibea nso guan.
10.30: Teɛ mu, Galim Babea!Tie, Laisa!Anatot Mmɔborɔni!
10.32: Nnɛ ara wobegyina wɔ Nob;wobehim wɔn nsawɔ Ɔbabea Sion bepɔw no so,wɔ Yerusalem koko no so.
10.33: Hwɛ, Awurade, Asafo Awurade no,ɔde tumi kɛse betwitwa dua mman no.Wobebubu nnua atenten no agu famnea ɛwowaree no bɛba fam.
10.34: Ɔde abonnua betwitwa kwaedɔtɔ agu famLebanon bɛhwe ase wɔ Ɔkɛse no anim.

63.1: Onyankopɔn Aweretɔ Ne Ogye Da NoHena ne oyi a ofi Edom reba,nea ofi Bosra a nkekae kɔkɔɔ wɔ nʼatade mu yi?Hena ne oyi a wɔahyehyɛ no kɔsɔɔ yi,a ɔde nʼahoɔden kɛse retutu taataa yi?“Ɛyɛ me a, mekasa wɔ trenee mu,nea otumi gye nkwa no.”
63.2: Adɛn nti na mo ntade bere kɔɔ,te sɛ obi a ɔretiatia nsakyiamoa so de yi?
63.3: “Me nko ara atiatia nsakyiamoa so,na amanaman no mu obiara anka me ho.Mitiatia wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuw muna mimiaa wɔn so wɔ mʼabufuwhyew mu;wɔn mogya bɔ petee me ntade mu,maa nkekae yɛɛ mʼadurade nyinaa mu.
63.4: Na aweretɔda wɔ me koma muna me gye afe aba.
63.5: Mehwɛe, nanso na ɔboafo biara nni hɔ,ɛyɛɛ me ahodwiriw sɛ obiara anso me mu;enti mʼankasa abasa yɛɛ nkwagyedwuma maa me,na mʼabufuw wowaw me.
63.6: Mitiatiaa amanaman no so wɔ mʼabufuw mu;mema wɔbobowee wɔ mʼabufuwhyew muna mihwiee wɔn mogya guu fam.”
63.7: Ayeyi Ne MpaebɔMɛka Awurade ayamye ho asɛm,ne nneyɛe a enti ɔsɛ ayeyi,wɔ nea Awurade ayɛ ama yɛn nyinaa hoYiw, wɔ nneɛma pa bebree a wayɛama Israelfifo.Wɔ nʼayamhyehye ne ne mmɔborɔhunu a ɛdɔɔso no nti.
63.8: Ɔkae se, “Ampa ara wɔyɛ me nkurɔfo,mmabarima a wɔrenni me huammɔ;”ɛno nti ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn Agyenkwa.
63.9: Wɔn amanehunu nyinaa mu, ɔno nso huu amane,na ɔbɔfo a ɔka ne ho no nso gyee wɔn.Ne dɔ ne ne mmɔborɔhunu mu, ogyee wɔn;ɔmaa wɔn so na ɔsoaa wɔnmfe a atwa mu no nyinaa mu.
63.10: Nanso wɔtew atuade how ne Honhom Kronkron werɛ.Enti ɔbɛyɛɛ wɔn tamfona ɔno ankasa ko tiaa wɔn.
63.11: Afei ne nkurɔfo kae tete nna no,Mose ne ne nkurɔfo nna no.Ɛhe na nea ɔde wɔn faa po mu no wɔ?Ɔne ne nguan no hwɛfo no?Ɛhe na nea ɔmaa ne Honhom Kronkron notenaa wɔn mu no wɔ,
63.12: nea ɔsomaa nʼanuonyam basa a ɛwɔ tumisɛ ommegyina Mose nsa nifa so no,nea ɔpaee asu no mu wɔ wɔn anim,de gyee din maa ne ho afebɔɔ no,
63.13: nea odii wɔn anim faa bun musɛnea ɔpɔnkɔ fa asase tamaa so,wɔanhintiw;
63.14: te sɛ anantwi a wɔkɔ sare so,Awurade Honhom ma wɔhomee.Sɛnea wokyerɛɛ wo nkurɔfo kwande gyee anuonyam abodin maa wo ho ni.
63.15: Brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ famfi wʼahengua a ɛkorɔn, ɛyɛ kronkron na ho wɔ nyam no so.Mo mmɔdemmɔ ne mo ahoɔden wɔ he?Wɔayi wʼayamhyehye ne wʼahummɔbɔ afi yɛn so.
63.16: Nanso wo ara wo ne yɛn Agyaɛwɔ mu, Abraham nnim yɛnna Israel nso nnye yɛn nto mu de;nanso wo, Awurade, wo ne yɛn Agya;efi tete, wo din ne; Yɛn Gyefo.
63.17: Adɛn, Awurade, na woma yɛkwati wʼakwanna wupirim yɛn koma enti ɛmma yenni wo ni?San bra, esiane wʼasomfo,mmusuakuw a wɔyɛ wʼagyapade no nti.
63.18: Bere tiaa bi mu wo nkurɔfo faa wo kronkronbeananso mprempren yɛn atamfo atiatia so.
63.19: Enti yɛyɛ wo de fi tete,nanso wɔn de, wunnii wɔn so henena wɔmmɔɔ wo din mfrɛɛ wɔn da.

62.1: Sion Din FoforoSion nti, merenyɛ komm,Yerusalem nti, merenyɛ dinn,kosi sɛ ne trenee bɛhyerɛn sɛ adekyee,na ne nkwagye adɛw sɛ ogyatɛn.
62.2: Amanaman no behu wo trenee,na ahemfo nyinaa ahu wʼanuonyam;wɔbɛfrɛ wo din foforoa Awurade de bɛto wo no.
62.3: Wobɛyɛ anuonyam ahenkyɛw wɔ Awurade nsam,ne adehye anuonyam abotiri wɔ wo Nyankopɔn nsam.
62.4: Wɔremfrɛ wo amamfo bio,anaa wʼasase sɛ amamfo.Na mmom wɔbɛfrɛ wo Hefsiba anaa anisɔ Kuropɔnne wʼasase sɛ Beula anaa ɔwarefoefisɛ Awurade ani begye wo ho,na ɔbɛware wʼasase.
62.5: Sɛnea aberante ware ababaa no,saa ara na wo mmabarima bɛware wo;sɛ ayeforokunu ani gye nʼayeforo ho no,saa ara na wo Nyankopɔn ani begye wo ho.
62.6: Mede awɛmfo agyinagyina wʼafasu so, Yerusalem;wɔremmua wɔn ano awia anaa anadwo.Mo a musu frɛ Awurade no,monnhome koraa,
62.7: na mommma onnye nʼahome kosi sɛ, ɔbɛma Yerusalem atimna wayɛ no nea asase nyinaa bɛkamfo.
62.8: Awurade de ne basa nifa aka ntamne basa a ɛyɛ den no se,“Meremfa mo awimma mo atamfo sɛ wɔn aduan bio,na ananafo rennom nsa foforoa moabrɛ ho no bio;
62.9: wɔn a wotwa no na wobedina wɔakamfo Awurade,na wɔn a wɔboaboa bobe ano no bɛnomwɔ me kronkronbea adiwo.”
62.10: Momfa mu, momfa kuropɔn apon no mu!Munsiesie ɔkwan no mma nkurɔfo no.Mompae, mompae ɔtempɔn no!Munyiyi so abo no.Munsi frankaa mma amanaman no.
62.11: Awurade abɔ no dawuruakosi nsase ano se,“Monka nkyerɛ Ɔbabea Sion se,‘Hwɛ, wo Agyenkwa reba!Hwɛ nʼakatua ka ne ho,na nʼanamuhyɛde nso ka ne ho.’ ”
62.12: Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn Nnipa Kronkron,wɔn a Awurade Agye Wɔn;na wɔbɛfrɛ wo Nea Wɔrehwehwɛ Nʼakyi Kwan,Kuropɔn a Ɛrenyɛ Amamfo Bio.

48.1: Israel Ɔsoɔdenfo“Muntie eyi, Yakobfifomo a wɔde Israel din frɛ mo,na moyɛ Yuda asefo,mo a mobɔ Awurade din ka ntam,na mofrɛ Israel Nyankopɔn,nanso ɛnyɛ nokware anaa trenee mu,
48.2: mo a mofrɛ mo ho kurow kronkron no mmana mode mo ho to Israel Nyankopɔn so,Asafo Awurade ne ne din.
48.3: Mehyɛɛ nneɛma a atwa mu no ho nkɔm dedaada,mebɔɔ nkae, na medaa no adi;afei mpofirim mekekaa me ho na ɛbaa mu.
48.4: Na minim sɛnea moyɛ asoɔden famo kɔn ho ntin yɛ dadena mo moma yɛ kɔbere mfrafrae.
48.5: Enti, mekaa saa nsɛm yi kyerɛɛ mo dedaadaansa na ɛrebesisi no, mebɔɔ mo nkaesɛnea morentumi nka se,‘Mʼahoni na wɔyɛe:me dua nsɛsode ne me dade nyame na ɔhyɛe.’
48.6: Moate eyinom nyinaa; monhwɛ wɔn nyinaa.Morennye wɔn nto mu ana?“Efi saa bere yi de rekɔ mɛka nsɛm foforo akyerɛ mo,ɛfa nneɛma a ahintaw a munnim ho.
48.7: Afei na wɔayɛ koraa, ɛnkyɛe;ebesi nnɛ no na anka montee ho hwee.Enti morentumi nka se,‘Yiw na minim dedaw!’
48.8: Wontee, na wontee ase;efi tete nyinaa wʼaso asiw.Na minim sɛ woyɛ ɔfatwafo;wɔfrɛɛ wo otuatewfo fi ɔyafunu mu.
48.9: Me din nti metwentwɛn mʼabufuw so;mʼayeyi nti miyi fi wo so,sɛnea merensɛe wo koraa.
48.10: Hwɛ mahoa mo ho, ɛnyɛ sɛnea wɔnan dwetɛ ho;mmom, masɔ wo ahwɛ wɔ amanehunu fononoo mu.
48.11: Me nti, me nti, na meyɛ eyi.Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ mema ho kwan na wɔsɛe me din?Memma obi nnye mʼanuonyam.
48.12: Israel Ahofadi“Tie me, Yakob,Israel a mafrɛ no;Me ne no;Me ne odikanfo ne okyikafo.
48.13: Me ara me nsa na ɛtoo asase fapem,na me nsa na ɛtrɛw ɔsorosoro mu;sɛ mefrɛ wɔn a,wɔn nyinaa bɔ mu sɔre.
48.14: “Mo nyinaa mommɔ mu mmra mmetie:ahoni no mu nea ɔwɔ he na waka saa nsɛm yi dedaw?Awurade boafo a wapaw nobɛma nʼatirimpɔw a etia Babilonia aba mu;ne basa betia Babiloniafo.
48.15: Me, me na makasa.Yiw, mafrɛ no.Mede no bɛba,na obewie nʼadwuma nkonimdi so.
48.16: “Montwiw mmɛn me na muntie eyi:“Efi nkaebɔ a edi kan no, menkasaa wɔ kokoa mu;bere biara a ebesi no, na mewɔ hɔ.”Na afei Asafo Awuradede ne Honhom asoma me.
48.17: Sɛɛ na Awurade se,mo gyefo, Israel Kronkronni no:“Mene Awurade mo Nyankopɔn,nea ɔkyerɛ mo nea eye ma mo,na ɔkyerɛ mo ɔkwan a ɛsɛ sɛ mofa so.
48.18: Sɛ mudii mʼahyɛde so a,anka mo asomdwoe ayɛ sɛ asubɔnten,na mo trenee ayɛ sɛ po asorɔkye.
48.19: Anka mo asefo ayɛ sɛ nwea,na mo mma ayɛ sɛ ne mmosea a wontumi nkan;wɔn din rempepa dawɔrensɛe mfi mʼanim.”
48.20: Mumfi Babilonia,munguan mfi Babiloniafo nkyɛn!Momfa osebɔ nteɛmu mmɔ nkaena mompae mu nka eyi.Momfa nkɔ nsase ano;monka se, “Awurade abegye ne somfo Yakob.”
48.21: Osukɔm anne wɔn bere a odii wɔn anim, wɔ nweatam ahorow so no,ɔmaa nsu fii ɔbotan mu ba maa wɔn;ɔpaee ɔbotan no mu, maa nsu tue fii mu.
48.22: “Asomdwoe nni hɔ mma amumɔyɛfo.” Sɛɛ na Awurade se.

60.1: Sion Anuonyam“Sɔre, hyerɛn, na wo hann aba,na Awurade anuonyam apue wo so.
60.2: Hwɛ, sum akata asase sona sum kabii akata aman no so,nanso Awurade apue wo sona nʼanuonyam ada adi wɔ wo so.
60.3: Amanaman bɛba wo hann no mu,na Ahemfo bɛba wo adekyee hann no mu.
60.4: “Ma wʼani so na hwɛ wo ho hyia:wɔn nyinaa aboa wɔn ho ano reba wo nkyɛn;wo mmabarima fifi akyirikyiri,na wokura wo mmabea wɔ abasa so.
60.5: Afei wobɛhwɛ na wʼanim atew,wo koma bɛbɔ na anigye ahyɛ no ma;ahonya a ɛwɔ po so, wɔde bɛbrɛ wo,na amanaman no ahode nso bɛba wo nkyɛn.
60.6: Yoma akuwakuw bɛyɛ wʼasase so ma,yomaforo a wufi Midian ne Efa.Na wɔn a wofi Seba nyinaa bɛba,wɔsoso sika kɔkɔɔ ne nnuhuamna wɔpae mu ka Awurade ayeyi.
60.7: Wɔbɛboaboa Kedar nguankuw nyinaa ano abrɛ wo,Nebaiot adwennini bɛsom wo;wobegye wɔn sɛ afɔrebɔde wɔ mʼafɔremuka so,na mɛhyɛ mʼasɔredan kronkron no anuonyam.
60.8: “Henanom ne eyinom a wotu sɛ omununkum,te sɛ mmorɔnoma a wɔrekɔ wɔn berebuw mu yi?
60.9: Ampa ara asupɔw no ani da me so;Tarsis ahyɛn na wodi anim,wɔde wo mmabarima fifi akyirikyiri reba,wɔsoso wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sikakɔkɔɔ,de rebɛhyɛ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn anuonyam,Israel Kronkronni No,efisɛ wahyɛ wo anuonyam.
60.10: “Ananafo bɛto wʼafasu no bio,na wɔn ahemfo bɛsom wo.Ɛwɔ mu, mede abufuw asɛe wo de,nanso menam adom so behu wo mmɔbɔ.
60.11: Wo apon ano bɛdeda hɔ bere biara,wɔrentoto mu awia anaa anadwo,sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nkurɔfo de amanaman no ahonya bɛbrɛ wo,wɔn ahemfo dii nkonimdi santen no anim.
60.12: Na ɔman anaa ahenni a wɔrensom wo no bɛyera,wɔbɛsɛe no pasaa.
60.13: “Lebanon anuonyam bɛba wo nkyɛn,ɔpepaw, ɔsɛsɛ ne kwabɔhɔre bɛbɔ mu,abesiesie me kronkronbea hɔ;na mɛhyɛ beae a me nan sisi no anuonyam.
60.14: Wo nhyɛsofo mmabarima bɛba abɛkotow wo;wɔn a wobu wo animtiaa nyinaa bɛkotow wʼanan asena wɔbɛfrɛ wo Awurade Kuropɔn,Israel Kronkronni, Sion.
60.15: “Ɛwɔ mu, wɔapa wʼakyi atan wo,a obiara ntu kwan mfa wo mu,nanso mɛyɛ wo ahohoahoade a ɛte hɔ daane awo ntoatoaso nyinaa anigyede.
60.16: Wobɛnom amanaman nufusu nona woanum adehye nufu.Afei wubehu sɛ me Awurade, me ne wo Agyenkwa,wo gyefo, Yakob Tumfo no.
60.17: Mede sikakɔkɔɔ besi kɔbere anan mu abrɛ wo,na dwetɛ asi dade anan mu.Mede kɔbere besi dua anan mu abrɛ wo,na dade asi abo anan mu.Mede asomdwoe bɛyɛ wo so amradona trenee ayɛ wo sodifo.
60.18: Wɔrente awurukasɛm wɔ wʼasase so bio,anaa nnwiriwii ne ɔsɛe wɔ wʼahye sommom wobɛfrɛ wʼafasu se Nkwagyene wʼapon se Ayeyi.
60.19: Owia renyɛ wo hann adekyee mu biona ɔsram hann renhyerɛn wo so,efisɛ Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,na wo Nyankopɔn bɛyɛ wo anuonyam.
60.20: Wo wia rentɔ bio,wo sram rennum bio,Awurade bɛyɛ wo daapem hann,na wʼawerɛhownna to betwa.
60.21: Na afei wo nkurɔfo nyinaa bɛyɛ atreneefona wɔbɛfa asase no adi so afebɔɔ.Wɔyɛ ade a madua na afefɛwme nsa ano adwuma aɛbɛda mʼanuonyam adi.
60.22: Mo mu akumaa koraa bɛdɔ ayɛ apem,na aketewa no ayɛ ɔman kɛse.Mene Awurade;na ne bere mu, mɛyɛ eyi ntɛm so.”

61.1: Awurade Adom AfeOtumfo Awurade Honhom wɔ me so,efisɛ, wɔafrɛ mesɛ memmɛka asɛmpa nkyerɛ ahiafo.Wasoma me se, menkɔkyekye wɔn a wɔn koma abubu werɛ,se mempae mu nka ahofadi nkyerɛ nnommumna wonyi nneduafo mfi sum mu,
61.2: se mempae mu nka Awurade adom no ho asɛm,ne yɛn Nyankopɔn aweretɔ da.Wasoma me se, menkyekye wɔn a wodi awerɛhow nyinaa werɛ,
61.3: na memma wɔn a wodi awerɛhow wɔ Sion no nea wohia,na menhyɛ wɔn ahenkyɛw fɛfɛnsi nsõ anan mu,anigye ngonsi awerɛhowdi anan mu,ayeyi atadensi abasamtu honhom anan mu.Wɔbɛfrɛ wɔn trenee adumnea Awurade aduade ada nʼanuonyam adi.
61.4: Wobesi tete mmubui no bio,na wɔasiesie mmeaemmeae a asɛe dedaada no;wɔbɛyɛ nkuropɔn a asɛe no foforonea asɛe awo ntoatoaso bebree no.
61.5: Ananafo bɛhwɛ mo nguankuw;ahɔho bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mo mfuw ne bobeturo mu.
61.6: Na wɔbɛfrɛ mo Awurade asɔfo,wɔbɛto mo din sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn asomfo.Amanaman no ahonya no na mubedina wɔn ahode na mode bɛhoahoa mo ho.
61.7: Wɔn animguase anan mume nkurɔfo benya anuonyam mmɔho,na ahohora anan muwɔbɛsɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ wɔn adedi mu;ne saa nti wɔn asase no so kyɛfa bɛyɛ mmɔho,na anigye a enni awiei bɛyɛ wɔn dea.
61.8: “Na me Awurade, mepɛ atɛntrenee.Mikyi korɔn ne nnebɔne.Me nokware mu, mɛbɔ wɔn aba sona me ne wɔn ayɛ apam a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa.
61.9: Wɔn asefo begye din wɔ amanaman no mune wɔn mma wɔ nkurɔfo no mu.Wɔn a wohu wɔn nyinaa begye ato mu sɛwɔyɛ nnipa a Awurade ahyira wɔn.”
61.10: Awurade mu na me ho sɛpɛw me mmoroso,me Nyankopɔn mu na me kra di ahurusi.Efisɛ, ɔde nkwagye ntama afura mena ɔde trenee atade yuu awura me,sɛnea ayeforokunu siesie me ti so sɛ ɔsɔfo,ne sɛnea ayeforo de nnwinne hyehyɛ ne ho no.
61.11: Na sɛnea asase ma afifide puena turo nso ma aba nyin no,saa ara na Otumfo Awurade bɛma trenee ne ayeyiapue wɔ amanaman anim.

49.1: Awurade Somfo NoMuntie me, mo mpoano aman;monyɛ aso mo akyirikyiri amanansa na wɔrebɛwo me no, Awurade frɛɛ meɔbɔɔ me din ansa na wɔrewo me.
49.2: Ɔyɛɛ mʼano sɛ afoa nnamnam,Ɔde me hintaw ne nsa ase nwini mu;ɔde me yɛɛ agyan a ano yɛ nnamna ɔde me hyɛɛ ne boha mu.
49.3: Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woyɛ me somfo,Israel, wo mu na mɛda mʼanuonyam adi.”
49.4: Nanso mekae se, “Mabrɛ agumasɛe mʼahoɔden kwa, mannya mu hweenanso nea ɛwɔ me wɔ Awurade nsamna mʼakatua wɔ me Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.”
49.5: Na afei, Awurade kasa se,nea ɔnwen me wɔ awotwaa mu sɛ memmɛyɛ ne somfosɛ memfa Yakob nsan mmra ne nkyɛnna me mmoaboa Israel ano mma no no,wahyɛ me anuonyam wɔ Awurade ani sona me Nyankopɔn ayɛ mʼahoɔden.
49.6: Ɔka se,“Ɛyɛ ade ketewa bi ma wo sɛ wobɛyɛ me somfosɛ wode Yakob mmusuakuw bɛsan abana wode Israelfo a mede wɔn asie bɛsan aba.Mɛma moayɛ amanamanmufo nyinaa kanea,ɛnam mo so na wobegye wiasefo nyinaa nkwa.”
49.7: Sɛɛ na Awurade se,Ogyefo ne Israel ɔkronkronni node kɔma nea aman buu no animtiaa na wokyii no,ahemfo somfo no;“Ahene behu wo na wɔasɔreahenemma behu wo na wɔakotow woesiane Awurade a ɔyɛ ɔnokwafo,Israel ɔkronkronni a wayi wo no nti.”
49.8: Israel Si Ne Dedaw MuSɛɛ na Awurade se:“Bere a ɛsɛ mu no, mebua wo,na nkwagyeda no, mɛboa wo;mɛkora wo na mede wo ayɛapam ama nkurɔfo no,de agye asase no asi hɔakyekyɛ agyapade ahorow a asɛe no bio,
49.9: wobɛka akyerɛ nneduafo se, ‘Mumfi mmra!’ne wɔn a wɔwɔ sum mu se, ‘Momfa mo ho nni!’“Wobedidi wɔ akwan howobenya adidibea wɔ koko kesee biara so.
49.10: Ɔkɔm renne wɔn na osukɔm nso renne wɔn;nweatam so hyew ne owia ano hyew renka wɔn,nea ɔwɔ ayamhyehye ma wɔn no bɛkyerɛ wɔn kwanna ɔde wɔn akɔ nsuaniwa ho.
49.11: Mɛyɛ me mmepɔw nyinaa akwan,na mʼatempɔn nso mɛma akrɔn.
49.12: Hwɛ, wufi akyirikyiri bɛbaebinom befi atifi fam, ebinom befi atɔe famebinom nso befi Sinin mantam mu.”
49.13: Momfa anigye nteɛ mu, ɔsoro;di ahurusi, asase;mompae mu nnwonto mu, mmepɔw!Na Awurade kyekye ne nkurɔfo werɛ,na obehu nʼamanehunufo mmɔbɔ.
49.14: Nanso Sion kae se, “Awurade agyaw me hɔ,Awurade werɛ afi me.”
49.15: “Ɛna werɛ betumi afi ne ba a otua nufu anoa ɔrennya ayamhyehye mma ɔba a waturu no no ana?Ebia ne werɛ befi,na me werɛ remfi wo!
49.16: Hwɛ, makurukyerɛw wo din agu me nsa yamwʼafasu wɔ mʼani so daa.
49.17: Mo mmabarima resan aba ntɛm so;na wɔn a wɔsɛe mo no refi mo nkyɛn akɔ.
49.18: Momma mo ani so nhwɛ mo ho nhyia;mo mmabarima nyinaa reboa wɔn ho ano aba mo nkyɛn.Sɛ mete ase yi” sɛnea Awurade se,“mode wɔn bɛyɛ ahyehyɛde ama mo homubefura wɔn sɛ ayeforokunu.
49.19: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ wɔsɛee mo yɛɛ mo pasaamaa mo asase daa mpan,afei nnipa bɛhyɛ wo so ma, ama aboro wo so,na wɔn a wɔsɛee wo no bɛkɔ akyirikyiri.
49.20: Mmofra a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ mo nna bɔne mu nobɛka ama moate sɛ,‘Ɛha sua ma yɛn dodo;momma yɛn asase no bi nka ho na yɛntena so.’
49.21: Na wobɛka wɔ wo koma mu se,‘Hena na ɔwoo eyinom maa me?Na meyɛ ɔwerɛhowni ne obonin;wotuu me kɔɔ asase foforo so na wɔpoo me.Hena na ɔtetew eyinom?Wogyaw me nko arana eyinom, he na wofi bae?’ ”
49.22: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Hwɛ, menyama amanamanmufo,mɛma me frankaa no so akyerɛ nkurɔfo nowobeturu wo mmabarima wɔ wɔn nsa so abana wɔbɛsoa wo mmabea wɔ wɔn mmati so.
49.23: Ahemfo bɛyɛ mo agyanom nsiananmu,na wɔn ahemmea ayɛ ɛnanom a wɔbɛhwɛ mo.Wɔbɛkotow mo a wɔn anim butubutuw fam;wɔbɛtaforo mo nan ase mfutuma.Afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade.Wɔn a wɔn ani da me so no, merenni wɔn huammɔ.”
49.24: Wobetumi agye asade afi akofo nsam;anaa wobetumi agye nnommumfo afi otirimɔdenfo nsam?
49.25: Nanso, sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Yiw, wobegye nnommumfo afi akofo nsamna wɔagye asade afi otirimɔdenfo nsam;me ne wɔn a wɔne wo nya no benyana megye wo mma nkwa.
49.26: Mema wɔn a wɔhyɛ wo so no awe wɔn ankasa honam;wɔn mogya bɛbow wɔn sɛnea wɔanom nsa.Afei adesamma nyinaa behusɛ me, Awurade, me ne wʼAgyenkwa no,wo Gyefo, Yakob Tumfo No.”

65.1: Atemmu Ne Nkwagye“Medaa me ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔammisa mʼase;wɔn a wɔnhwehwɛ me no huu me.Ɔman a wonsu mfrɛ me no,meka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, ‘Mini, Mini.’
65.2: Da mu nyinaa, matrɛw me nsa mu amannipa a wɔyɛ asoɔden ne nyiyiano,a wɔnenam akwammɔne so,na wodi wɔn ankasa nsusuwii akyi.
65.3: Nnipa a daa no woyi me ahiwɔ mʼanim pɛɛ,wɔbɔ afɔre wɔ nturo muna wɔhyew nnuhuam wɔ ntayaa afɔremuka so;
65.4: wɔn a wɔtenatena nna sona anadwo wosii pɛ kokoa mu;wɔwe mprakonamna wɔn nkutu mu wɔ nkwan a wɔde nam a ɛho ntew ayɛ;
65.5: wɔka se, ‘Mumfi ha; mommmɛn me,efisɛ me ho tew dodo ma mo!’Saa nnipa yi yɛ wusiw wɔ me hwenem,ogya a ɛkɔ so hyew da mu nyinaa.
65.6: “Hwɛ; wɔakyerɛw ato hɔ wɔ mʼanim se,merenyɛ komm, metua so ka pɛpɛɛpɛ;metua so ka agu wɔn asrɛ so,
65.7: mo ne mo agyanom bɔne nti,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.“Esiane sɛ wɔhyew afɔrebɔde wɔ mmepɔw sona wotwirii me wɔ nkoko so ntimesusuw bɔne a wɔyɛɛ kan no so akatua pɛpɛɛpɛagu wɔn asrɛ so.”
65.8: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Sɛnea wonya nsu fi bobe kasiaw mu,na nnipa ka se, ‘Monnsɛe no,efisɛ ade pa bi da so wɔ mu’ nosaa ara na mʼasomfo no nti mɛyɛ.Merensɛe wɔn nyinaa.
65.9: Mede Yakob asefo bɛba,na me mmepɔw no sodifo afi Yuda aba;me nkurɔfo a mapaw wɔn no bedi wɔn ade,na hɔ na mʼasomfo bɛtena.
65.10: Saron bɛyɛ nguankuw adidibea,na Akor bon no ayɛ anantwikuw homebeaama me nkurɔfo a wɔhwehwɛ me.
65.11: “Na mo a mo de mugyaw Awuradena mo werɛ fi ne bepɔw kronkron no,mo a moto pon ma Ahonyana mohyɛ afrasa wɔ nkuruwa mu ma Nkrabea no,
65.12: mede mo bɛto afoa ano,na mo nyinaa akotow ama wɔakum mo;efisɛ mefrɛe nanso moannye so,mekasae nanso moantie.Moyɛɛ nea ɛyɛ mʼani so bɔnena moyɛɛ nea mempɛ.”
65.13: Enti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“Mʼasomfo bedidi,nanso ɔkɔm bɛde mo,mʼasomfo bɛnom,nanso osukɔm bɛde mo;mʼasomfo ani begye,nanso mo anim begu ase.
65.14: Mʼasomfo bɛto nnwomafi koma mu anigye muna mobɛteɛ mu asuafi mo koma ahoyeraw mu,na mubetwa adwo afi honhom a ayɛ mmrɛw mu.
65.15: Wubegyaw din bi a ɛbɛyɛ mmusuama wɔn a mapaw wɔn;Otumfo Awurade bekum wona nʼasomfo de, mɛma wɔn din foforo.
65.16: Obiara a ɔsrɛ nhyira wɔ asase no so no,bɛyɛ wɔ nokware Nyankopɔn koro no mu;obiara a ɔka ntam wɔ asase no sobɛka no wɔ nokware Nyankopɔn koro no mu.Na ɔhaw a atwa mu no wɔn werɛ befina wɔde behintaw me.
65.17: “Hwɛ! Mɛbɔɔsorosoro foforo ne asase foforo.Wɔrenkae nneɛma a atwam no bio,na ɛremma adwene mu nso.
65.18: Nanso momma mo ani nnye na munni ahurusi afebɔɔwɔ nea merebɛbɔ ho,efisɛ mɛbɔ Yerusalem ama ayɛ anigye,na mu nnipa ayɛ anigye farebae.
65.19: Mɛsɛpɛw me ho wɔ Yerusalem mu,na madi ahurusi wɔ me nkurɔfo ho.Na wɔrente agyaadwo ne osu nnyigyeiwɔ mu bio.
65.20: “Ɛrensi bio wɔ muabofra a ne nkwanna yɛ kakraa bi,anaa akwakoraa a onni ne mfe nwie;nea odi mfe ɔha na owu nowɔbɛfa no sɛ ɔbabun bi kɛkɛ;na nea wannya mfe ɔha nowɔbɛfa no sɛ wɔadome no.
65.21: Wobesisi afi na wɔatena mu,wɔbɛyɛ bobe nturo na wɔadi mu aba.
65.22: Wɔrensisi afi mma afoforo mmɛtena mu bio,na wɔrennua mma afoforo mmedi.Na nna a dua di no,saa ara na me nkurɔfo nna bɛyɛ;me nkurɔfo a mapaw wɔn no bediwɔn nsa ano adwuma so aba akyɛ.
65.23: Wɔremmrɛ nguna wɔrenwo mma a wɔn nkrabea nye;efisɛ wɔbɛyɛ nnipa a Awurade ahyira wɔn,wɔne wɔn asefo.
65.24: Mebua wɔn ansa, mpo, na wɔafrɛ me.Bere a wogu so rekasa no metie.
65.25: Pataku ne oguamma bedidi abɔ mugyata bɛwe sare sɛ nantwi,nanso mfutuma bɛyɛ ɔwɔ aduan.Wɔrempira obi anaa wɔrensɛe obiwɔ me bepɔw kronkron so nyinaa,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.

59.1: Bɔne, Bɔneka Ne OgyeAmpa ara Awurade nsa nyɛ tiaa sɛ ɛrennye nkwa,na nʼasom nyɛ den sɛ ɛrente asɛm.
59.2: Nanso mo amumɔyɛ na atetewmo ne mo Nyankopɔn ntam;mo bɔne ama nʼanim ahintaw mo,a enti ɔrente.
59.3: Na mogya akeka mo nsa ho,afɔdi asra mo nsateaa ho.Mo ano akeka atosɛm,mo tɛkrɛma de amumɔyɛsɛm di nseku.
59.4: Obiara nhwehwɛ atɛntrenee;obiara mfa nokwaredi mmɔ ne nkurow.Wɔde wɔn ho to nsɛnhuhuw so na wotwa nkontompo;wonyinsɛn ɔhaw na wɔwo bɔne.
59.5: Wosow nhurutoa nkesuana wɔnwen ananse ntontan.Nea odi wɔn nkesua biara bewu,mu baako nso bɔ a, ɛpae ahurutoa.
59.6: Wɔn ntontan nye mma adurade;wɔrentumi mfa nea wɔyɛ nkata wɔn ho.Wɔn nneyɛe yɛ nneyɛe bɔne,na wodi akakabensɛm.
59.7: Wotu mmirika kɔyɛ bɔne;wɔnkyɛ opira ne awudi ho.Baabiara a wɔbɛkɔ no, wɔsɛe hɔ pasaa.
59.8: Asomdwoe kwan no, wonnim;atɛntrenee nni wɔn akwan so.Wɔadan wɔn akwan kɔntɔnkyeobiara a ɔnantew so no rennya asomdwoe.
59.9: Enti atɛntrenee ne yɛn ntam aware,na adetrenee mmɛn yɛn.Yɛhwehwɛ hann, nanso ne nyinaa yɛ sum;nea ɛhyerɛn, nanso yɛnam sum kabii mu.
59.10: Te sɛ anifuraefo no, yɛkeka wɔ afasu hohwehwɛ ɔkwan te sɛ nnipa a wonni ani.Owigyinae no yehintihintiw sɛnea onwini adwo;yedu ahoɔdenfo mu a yɛte sɛ awufo.
59.11: Yɛn nyinaa woro so te sɛ sisi;yɛde awerɛhow kurum sɛ mmorɔnoma.Yɛhwehwɛ atɛntrenee nso yenhu bi;ogye, nanso ɛwɔ akyirikyiri.
59.12: Efisɛ, yɛn mfomso adɔɔso wɔ wʼani so,na yɛn bɔne di adanse tia yɛn.Yɛn mfomso da yɛn anim daa,na yegye yɛn amumɔyɛ to mu:
59.13: atuatew ne nkontompo a etia Awurade,yɛn akyi a yɛdan kyerɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn,nhyɛso ne atuatew a yɛfoa so,atosɛm a efi koma mu a yɛka.
59.14: Enti wɔapam atɛntrenee kɔ nʼakyi,na adetrenee akogyina baabi;nokware ahwe ase wɔ mmɔnten sonokwaredi ntumi mma mu.
59.15: Nokware nni baabiara,obiara a ɔtwe ne ho fi bɔne ho no bɛyɛ ɔtamfo.Awurade hwɛe na ansɔ nʼanisɛ atɛntrenee nni hɔ.
59.16: Ohuu sɛ obiara nni hɔ,ɛyɛɛ no nwonwa sɛ obiara nni hɔ a ɔbɛpata;enti ɔno ankasa basa dii nkwagye ho dwuma maa no,na ne trenee wowaw no.
59.17: Ɔhyɛɛ trenee sɛ nkatabo,ne nkwagye dadekyɛw wɔ ne ti so.Ɔhyɛɛ aweretɔ ntadena ofuraa mmɔdemmɔ sɛ ntama.
59.18: Obegyina nea wɔayɛ soatua so kanʼatamfo benya nʼabufuwhyewwɔn a wɔne no ayɛ dɔm benya so akatua;nsupɔw no nso obetua wɔn ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.
59.19: Efi atɔe fam, nnipa besuro Awurade dinna efi apuei, wɔde nidi bɛma nʼanuonyam.Na ɔbɛba sɛ asu a ayiri tɛnnna Awurade ahomegu repia no.
59.20: “Ogyefo no bɛba Sion,na obeyi amumɔyɛsɛm nyinaa afi Yakob asefo mu,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.
59.21: “Me de, eyi yɛ me ne wɔn apam,” sɛnea Awurade se ni. “Me Honhom a ɔwɔ mo so, ne me nsɛm a mede ahyɛ mo anom, remfi mo anom, anaa mo mma, ne mo mma asefo anom, efi saa bere yi kosi daa apem,” sɛɛ na Awurade se.

58.1: Nokware Mmuadadi“Monteɛ mu dennen, monnnyae.Momma mo nne so sɛ torobɛnto.Mompae mu nka me nkurɔfo atuatew nkyerɛ wɔnna monka Yakobfi nso nnebɔne nkyerɛ no.
58.2: Da biara da wɔhwehwɛ me;ayɛ sɛ wɔpere sɛ wobehu mʼakwan,te sɛ wɔyɛ ɔman a wɔyɛ nea ɛteɛna wɔmpoo ne Nyankopɔn ahyɛde.Wobisa me hɔ gyinae a ɛteɛna ayɛ sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn bɛn wɔn.
58.3: Wɔka se, ‘Adɛn nti na yɛadi mmuadana woanhu yi?Adɛn nti na yɛabrɛ yɛn ho ase,na woanhwɛ yi?’“Nanso mo mmuada da no, moyɛ nea mopɛna musisi mo adwumayɛfo nyinaa.
58.4: Ntɔkwaw ne akasakasa na mode wie mo mmuadadi,ne akuturuku a mode bobɔ mo ho.Morentumi nni mmuada sɛnea moyɛ no nnɛ yina moahwɛ anim sɛ wɔbɛte mo nne wɔ ɔsoro.
58.5: Eyi ne mmuadadi a mepɛ ana?Da koro pɛ a onipa de brɛ ne ho ase no ana?Ɛne sɛ obi si ne ti ase te sɛ mfeana ɔtena atweaatam so ne nsõ mu nko ara ana?Eyi na mofrɛ no mmuadadi,da a ɛsɔ Awurade ani yi ni ana?
58.6: “Saa mmuadadi yi na mepɛ:sɛ mubeyiyi ntɛnkyew nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔnna moasan konnua ahama,sɛ mubegyaa wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn sona moabubu konnua biara.
58.7: So ɛnsɛ sɛ mo ne wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔn kyɛ mo aduanna moma ohiani a ɔnenam no baabi tena;na muhu nea ɔda adagyaw a mumfura no ntamana munnyi mo ani mfi mo ankasa mo nkurɔfo ne mo abusuafo so ana?
58.8: Ɛno na mo hann bepue te sɛ ahemadakye,na mo ayaresa aba ntɛm so;afei mo trenee bedi mo anim,na Awurade anuonyam bɛbɔ mo kyidɔm.
58.9: Afei mobɛfrɛ, na Awurade begye mo so;mobɛteɛ mu ahwehwɛ mmoa, na ɔbɛka se: Mini.“Sɛ muyi nhyɛso konnua,nsa a moteɛ wɔ nnipa so ne ntwatoso fi hɔ,
58.10: na sɛ mohaw mo ho ma wɔn a ɔkɔm de wɔnna moma wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no nea ehia wɔn a,ɛno de, mo akanea bɛhyerɛn wɔ sum mu,na mo anadwo bɛyɛ sɛ owigyinae.
58.11: Awurade bɛkyerɛ mo kwan bere biara;ɔbɛma mo nea ehia mo wɔ asase wosee sona ɔbɛhyɛ mo nipadua den.Mobɛyɛ sɛ turo a wogugu so nsu yiye,sɛ asuwa a mu nsu nyow da.
58.12: Mo nkurɔfo bɛsan asi teteete nnwiriwii no,na wɔato fapem a akyɛ no;wɔbɛfrɛ mo Nea Osiesie Afasu a Abubu no,Nea Ogye Atenae Si Hɔ.
58.13: “Sɛ mohwɛ mo anammɔntu so yiye Homedana moanyɛ nea mopɛ wɔ me da kronkron no,sɛ mofrɛ Homeda no anigye dana mudi Awurade da kronkron no nina moamfa mo ara mo akwan sona moanyɛ nea mopɛ anaa moanka nsɛnhunu a,
58.14: ɛno de mubenya anigye wɔ Awurade muna mɛma mo anantew asase no sorɔnsorɔmmea sona moato pon wɔ mo agya Yakob agyapade so.”Awurade na waka.

64.1: Ao, sɛ anka wubesunsuane ɔsorosoro mu, asian aba fam a,ɛno na anka mmepɔw no ho bɛpopo wɔ wʼanim!
64.2: Sɛnea ogya ma mmabaa dɛwna ɛma nsu huru no,sian bra fam na ma wʼatamfo nhu wo din,na ma amanaman no ho mpopo wɔ wʼanim!
64.3: Na bere a woyɛɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa a yɛanhwɛ anim no,wusian baa fam na mmepɔw no ho popoo wɔ wʼanim.
64.4: Efi teteete obiara ntee,entwaa obiara aso mu,ani biara nhuu Onyankopɔn bi sɛ wo,nea odi dwuma ma wɔn a wɔtwɛn no no.
64.5: Woboa wɔn a wɔde anigye yɛ nea ɛteɛ,wɔn a wɔkae wʼakwan.Nanso yɛkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa wɔn no,wo bo fuwii.Na afei ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woagye yɛn nkwa?
64.6: Yɛn nyinaa ayɛ sɛ obi a ne ho ntew,na yɛn trenee nneyɛe nyinaa te sɛ ntamagow fi;yɛn nyinaa akisa te sɛ ahaban,na yɛn bɔne pra yɛn kɔ te sɛ mframa.
64.7: Obiara mmɔ wo din,na obiara mpere sɛ obeso wo mu;efisɛ wode wʼanim ahintaw yɛnna yɛn bɔne nti woama yɛasɛe.
64.8: Nanso wo, Awurade, ne yɛn Agya.Yɛyɛ dɔte, na wo ne ɔnwemfo no;yɛn nyinaa yɛ wo nsa ano adwuma.
64.9: Mma wo bo mfuw ntra so, Awurade;nkae yɛn bɔne da biara da.Ao, brɛ wʼani ase hwɛ yɛn, yɛsrɛ wo,efisɛ yɛn nyinaa yɛ wo nkurɔfo.
64.10: Wo nkuropɔn kronkron no adan nweatam;Sion mpo ayɛ nweatam, Yerusalem ada mpan.
64.11: Yɛn asɔredan kronkron a ɛwɔ anuonyam, faako a yɛn nenanom yii wo ayɛ no,wɔde ogya ahyew,na nea ɛsom bo ma yɛn no, abubu.
64.12: Eyi nyinaa akyi, Awurade, wode wo ho bɛkame yɛn ana?Wobɛkɔ so ayɛ komm atwe yɛn aso aboro so ana?

66.1: Atemmu Ne AnidasoSɛɛ na Awurade se:“Ɔsoro yɛ mʼahengua,na asase yɛ me nan ntiaso.Ofi a wubesi ama me no wɔ he?Ɛhe na ɛbɛyɛ me homebea?
66.2: Ɛnyɛ me nsa na ɛyɛɛ eyinom nyinaa,na ɛma ɛbae ana?”Awurade na ose.“Obi a mʼani sɔ no ni:nea ɔwɔ ahobrɛase ne ahonu honhom,na ne ho popo wɔ mʼasɛm ho.
66.3: Nanso obi a ɔde nantwinini bɔ afɔre nosaa onipa no ara kum nnipa,na nea ɔma oguamma no,saa onipa no ara bu ɔkraman kɔn mu;nea ɔbɔ aduan afɔre nosaa onipa no ara de prako mogya bɔ afɔre,nea ɔhyew nnuhuam a ɛwɔ din nosaa onipa no ara som ɔbosom.Wɔafa wɔn ankasa akwanna wɔn akra ani gye wɔn akyiwade ho;
66.4: enti me nso mɛpɛ ayayade ayɛ wɔnna mede nea wosuro bɛba wɔn so.Efisɛ mefrɛe no, obiara annye so,mekasae no, obiara antie.Wɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ mʼani sona wɔyɛɛ nea mempɛ.”
66.5: Muntie Awurade asɛm,mo a mote nʼasɛm a mo ho popo:“Mo nuanom mmarima a wɔtan mo,na me din nti wotwa mo gyaw no, aka se,‘Momma wɔnhyɛ Awurade anuonyam,na yɛahu mo anigye!’Nanso wɔn anim begu ase.
66.6: Muntie huuyɛ a efi kuropɔn no mu,muntie gyegyeegye a efi asɔredan no mu!Ɛyɛ Awurade nnyigyeia ɔde retua nʼatamfo ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.
66.7: “Ansa na ɔbea bɛkyem no,ɔwo;ansa na ɔbɛte awoyaw noɔwo ɔbabarima.
66.8: Hena na wate biribi sɛɛ ho asɛm pɛn?Hena na wahu biribi sɛɛ pɛn?Wobetumi de da koro akyekyere ɔmansin,anaa ɔman mu, bere sin bi mu ana?Nanso awo ka Sion ara pɛ aɔwo ne mma.
66.9: Mede obi bedu awoko ano amemma no nwo ana?” Sɛnea Awurade se ni.“Misiw awotwaa anobere a awo adu so ana?” Wo Nyankopɔn na ose.
66.10: Mo ne Yerusalem ani nnye na munni ahurusi mma no,mo a modɔ no nyinaa;mo ne no nsɛpɛw mo ho yiye,mo a mudi ne ho awerɛhow nyinaa.
66.11: Mubenum nʼawerɛkyekye nufuno amee;mobɛnom aboro sona mo ani begye nea abu so atra so no ho.
66.12: Na sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Mede asomdwoe bɛma no sɛ asubɔnten,ne amanaman no ahonya nso sɛ asuten a ayiri.Mubenum na waturu mo wɔ ne basa sona obegyigye mo agoru wɔ nʼanankoroma so.
66.13: Sɛnea ɛna kyekye ne ba werɛ nosaa ara na mɛkyekye mo werɛ;na mubenya awerɛkyekye wɔ Yerusalem.”
66.14: Sɛ muhu eyi a, mo koma ani begyena mobɛyɛ frɔmfrɔm sɛ sare;wobehu Awurade nsa wɔ ne nkoa so,nanso wobehu nʼabufuwhyew wɔ nʼatamfo so.
66.15: Hwɛ, Awurade de ogya reba,na ne nteaseɛnam te sɛ mfɛtɛ;ɔde nʼabufuw bɛba wɔ anibere so,na ɔde gyaframa ayɛ nʼanimka.
66.16: Ogya ne nʼafoa,na Awurade de bebu nnipa nyinaa atɛn,na wɔn a wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ Awurade nsa ano bɛyɛ bebree.
66.17: “Wɔn a wɔtew wɔn ho na wodwira wɔn ho de kɔ nturo mu, na wodi ɔbaako a ɔfra wɔn a wɔwe mprakonam ne akisi ne nneɛma a ɛyɛ akyiwade akyi no, wɔbɛbɔ mu ahu wɔn awiei,” sɛnea Awurade se ni.
66.18: “Esiane wɔn nneyɛe ne wɔn nsusuwii nti, Me, mereba abɛboaboa amanaman ne ɔkasa ahorow ano, na wɔbɛba abehu mʼanuonyam.
66.19: “Na mɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne bi wɔ wɔn mu, na mede nkae no mu bi bɛkɔ amanaman no mu: Tarsis, Libiafo ne Lidiafo (wɔn a wɔagye din wɔ agyantow mu), Tubal ne Helafo, ne asupɔw a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a wɔntee me din a ahyeta na wonhuu mʼanuonyam no. Wɔbɛpae mu aka mʼanuonyam wɔ amanaman mu.
66.20: Na wɔde mo nuabarimanom nyinaa befi amanaman nyinaa so bɛba me bepɔw kronkron a ɛwɔ Yerusalem no so sɛ, afɔrebɔde ama Awurade. Wɔtete apɔnkɔ so ne nteaseɛnam mu ne asako mu ne mfurumpɔnkɔ ne yoma so bɛba,” sɛɛ na Awurade se. “Wɔde wɔn bɛba sɛnea Israelfo de wɔn aduan afɔre kɔ Awurade asɔredan mu, wɔ afahyɛ nkuruwa a ho tew mu.
66.21: Na meyi wɔn mu bi ayɛ asɔfo ne Lewifo,” Awurade, na ose!
66.22: “Sɛnea ɔsorosoro foforo ne asase foforo bɛtena hɔ no, saa ara na mo din ne mo asefo bɛtena hɔ,” sɛnea Awurade se ni.
66.23: “Efi Ɔsram Foforo baako kɔpem foforo, efi Homeda baako kosi foforo no, adesamma nyinaa bɛba abɛkotow me,” sɛnea Awurade se ni.
66.24: “Na wobefi adi akohu wɔn a wɔtew atua tiaa me no afunu; wɔn asunson renwu, na wɔn gya nso rennum, na wɔn ho bɛyɛ adesamma nyinaa nwini.”

9.1: Israel AsotweNni ahurusi, Israel;nsɛpɛw wo ho te sɛ aman a aka no.Efisɛ woanni wo Nyankopɔn nokware,wʼani gye aguamammɔ howɔ awiporowbea nyinaa so.
9.2: Awiporowbea ne nsakyiamoa rentumi mma nnipa no aduan;nsa foforo nso bɛbɔ wɔn.
9.3: Wɔrentena Awurade asase no so bio;Efraim bɛsan akɔ Misraimna wadi aduan a ɛho ntew wɔ Asiria.
9.4: Wɔremmɔ ahwiesa afɔre mma Awurade,na wɔn afɔrebɔ nso nsɔ nʼani.Saa afɔrebɔ yi bɛyɛ sɛ asufo brodo de ama wɔn;wɔn a wodi nyinaa ho begu fi.Saa aduan no bɛyɛ wɔn ankasa deana wɔrentumi mmfa nkɔ Awurade asɔredan mu.
9.5: Dɛn na mobɛyɛ wɔ mo aponto da none Awurade afahyɛnna no nso?
9.6: Mpo sɛ woguan fi ɔsɛe mu aMisraim bɛboaboa wɔn ano,na Memfis besie wɔn.Wɔn dwetɛ ahonyade befuw wura,na wɔn ntamadan adan nsɔe.
9.7: Asotwe nna no reba,akontaabu nna no adu;ma Israel nhu eyi.Esiane mo bɔne bebrebene mo akokoakoko a adɔɔso ntimofa no sɛ odiyifo yɛ kwasea,na nea honhom akanyan no no yɛ ɔbɔdamfo.
9.8: Odiyifo no ne me Nyankopɔnyɛ Efraim so wɛmfo,nanso wɔasum no afiri wɔ nʼakwan nyinaa so,na ɔtan ahyɛ ne Nyankopɔn fi ma.
9.9: Wɔadu porɔwee bun mu,sɛnea na ɛte wɔ Gibea nna no mu.Onyankopɔn bɛkae wɔn atirimɔdenna watwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho.
9.10: “Bere a mihuu Israel no,na ɛte sɛ nea mahu bobe wɔ nweatam so;bere a mihuu mo agyanom no,na ɛte sɛ nea mahu borɔdɔma aba a edi kan wɔ ne dua so.Nanso bere a wɔbaa Baal-Peor nkyɛn nowodwiraa wɔn ho maa ohoni nimguaseni no.Wɔn ho yɛɛ nwini te sɛ ohoni a wɔdɔ no no ara.
9.11: Efraim anuonyam betu akɔ sɛ anomaa,nyinsɛn ne awo nni ne mu.
9.12: Mpo sɛ wɔtetew mmofra a,mɛma mmofra no awuwu wɔ wɔn nsa mu.Wonnue,sɛ miyi mʼani fi wɔn so a!
9.13: Mahu Efraim te sɛ Tiro,a ɛda baabi a eye.Nanso Efraim de ne mmabɛbrɛ okumfo no.”
9.14: Fa ma wɔn, Awurade,dɛn na wode bɛma wɔn?Ma wɔn ɔyafunu a ɛpɔnne nufu a nufusu nni mu.
9.15: “Wɔn atirimɔdensɛm nyinaa a wodii wɔ Gilgal nti,mefaa wɔn ho tan wɔ hɔ.Wɔn nnebɔne ntimɛpam wɔn afi me fi.Merennɔ wɔn bio;efisɛ wɔn ntuanofo nyinaa yɛ atuatewfo.
9.16: Efraim agyigya,wɔn ntin akisa,nti wɔnsow aba.Sɛ wɔwo mma mpo a,mekunkum wɔn mma a wɔdɔ wɔn no.”
9.17: Me Nyankopɔn bɛpo wɔn,efisɛ, wɔanyɛ osetie amma no;Wobekyinkyin aman no mu.

11.1: Onyankopɔn Dɔ A Ɔdɔ Israel“Bere a Israel yɛ abofra no, na medɔ no,na Misraim na mefrɛɛ me babarima fii.
11.2: Nanso mpɛn dodow a mefrɛɛ Israel no,saa ara na woguan fii me nkyɛn.Wɔbɔɔ afɔre maa Baal ahoni,na wɔhyew nnuhuam maa nsɛsode.
11.3: Me na migyigyee Efraim taataa,turuu wɔn wɔ me basa so;nanso wɔnkae sɛme na mesaa wɔn yare.
11.4: Me de ayamye hamane ɔdɔ dii wɔn anim;miyii konnua no fii wɔn kɔn muna mekotow maa wɔn aduan dii.
11.5: “Wɔbɛsan akɔ Misraim,na Asiria adi wɔn so,esiane sɛ wɔannu wɔn ho nti.
11.6: Afoa bedi ahim wɔ wɔn kuropɔn muna ɛbɛsɛe wɔn apon akyi adabanna wɔn nhyehyɛe to betwa.
11.7: Me nkurɔfo asi no pi sɛ wɔbɛtwe wɔn ho afi me nkyɛn.Sɛ mpo wosu frɛ me Onyankopɔn Ɔsorosoroni no mpo ameremma wɔn so ɔkwan biara so.
11.8: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na meyi wo ama, Efraim?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn ma meyi wo ama, Israel?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mɛyɛ wo sɛ Adma?Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na mɛyɛ wo sɛ Seboim?Me koma asakra wɔ me mu;na mʼahummɔbɔ ahwanyan.
11.9: Merenyɛ mʼabufuwhyew so ade,na merennan me ho nsɛe Efraim bio.Meyɛ Onyankopɔn na menyɛ onipa.Meyɛ Ɔkronkronni a ɔwɔ mo mu.Meremma wɔ abufuw mu.
11.10: Wobedi Awurade akyi.Ɔbɛbobɔ mu te sɛ gyata.Na sɛ ɔbobɔ mu a,ne mma de ahopopo befi atɔe aba.
11.11: Wɔde ahopopo bɛbate sɛ nnomaa a wofi Misraim,te sɛ mmorɔnoma a wofi Asiria.Mɛbɔ wɔn atenase wɔ wɔn afi mu,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
11.12: Israel BɔneEfraim de atoro atwa me ho ahyia,Israelfi nso wɔde nnaadaa.Yuda abɔ Onyankopɔn so kompo ɔde tia Ɔkronkronni nokwafo no.

10.1: Israel yɛɛ bobe a ɛtrɛtrɛw;ɔsow aba maa ne ho.Bere a nʼaba redɔɔso no,osisii afɔremuka bebree;nʼasase rekɔ so yɛ yiye noosiesie nʼabosom dum kronkron no.
10.2: Nnaadaasɛm wɔ wɔn koma mu,nti ɛsɛ sɛ wonya wɔn afɔdi so asotwe.Awurade bebubu wɔn afɔremuka,na wasɛe wɔn abosom dum kronkron no.
10.3: Afei, wɔbɛka se, “Yenni ɔhene,efisɛ, yɛamfa nidi amma Awurade.Mpo sɛ na yɛwɔ ɔhene koraa a,dɛn na anka obetumi ayɛ ama yɛn?”
10.4: Wɔhyɛ bɔ ahorow bebree,wɔka ntamhununa wɔyɛ apam ahorow;ɛno nti mansotwe sɔresɔrete sɛ wura a bɔre wɔ mua afifi asase a wɔafuntum so so.
10.5: Nnipa a wɔte Samaria no suro maBet-Awen nantwi ba ohoni no.Ne nkurɔfo besu.Saa ara na nʼakɔmfo nso bɛyɛ,wɔn a wogyee wɔn ani wɔ nʼanuonyam ho no.Efisɛ wɔafa no afi wɔn nkyɛn kɔ nnommum mu.
10.6: Wɔde no bɛkɔ Asiria,de akɔhyɛ ɔhene kɛse no anuonyam.Ebegu Efraim anim ase;na Israel ani bewu wɔ ne nnua ahoni ho.
10.7: Samaria na ne hene bɛsen akɔte sɛ abaa a ɛtɛn nsu ani.
10.8: Wɔbɛsɛe abosonnan a wodi awurukasɛm ne bɔne wɔ mu no.Nsɔe ne nnɛnkyɛnse befifi hɔ,na akata wɔn afɔremuka so.Afei wɔbɛka akyerɛ mmepɔw se, “Mommɛkata yɛn so!”na wase nkoko se, “Munnwiriw ngu yɛn so!”
10.9: “Efi Gibea bere so, woayɛ bɔne, Israel,na hɔ na woaka.Na ɔko rentwiw amfaamumɔyɛfo a wɔwɔ Gibea no so ana?
10.10: Bere a mepɛ no, mɛtwe wɔn aso;aman bɛboaboa wɔn ho ano atia wɔn.Wɔde mpokyerɛ begu wɔn wɔ wɔn bɔne dodow ho.
10.11: Efraim yɛ nantwi ba a wɔayɛn no,a ɔpɛ awiporowbea adwuma,enti mede konnuabɛto ne kɔn fɛɛfɛ mu.Mɛkyerɛ Efraim ɔkwan,ɛsɛ sɛ Yuda funtum asase no,na Yakob nso siesie so.
10.12: Dua trenee aba ma wo ho,twa ɔdɔ aba a ɛtena hɔ daa,siesie wʼasase a womfuntumii so no;na bere adu sɛ wohwehwɛ Awurade,kosi sɛ ɔbɛbaabɛpete trenee agu wo so.
10.13: Nanso woadua atirimɔden aba,na woatwa aba bɔne.Woadi nnaadaa aba.Efisɛ wode wo ho ato wʼahoɔdenne wʼakofo bebrebe no so,
10.14: ɔko mu huuyɛ bɛsɔre atia wo nkurɔfo,na wʼaban nyinaa bɛsɛe,sɛnea Salman sɛee Bet Arbel ɔko da no,da a wɔde ɛnanom ne wɔn mma hwehwee fam no.
10.15: Saa ara na ɛbɛba wo so, Bet-El,efisɛ wʼatirimɔdensɛm no dɔɔso.Sɛ da no du a,Wɔbɛsɛe Israelhene no koraa.

8.1: Israel Betwa Mfɛtɛ Aba“Monhyɛn torobɛnto!Ɔkɔre bi wɔ Awurade fifo soefisɛ nnipa no abu mʼapam sona wɔasɔre atia me mmara.
8.2: Afei Israel su frɛ me se,‘Yɛn Nyankopɔn, yegye wo to mu!’
8.3: Nanso Israel apo nea eye;ɔtamfo bɛtaa no.
8.4: Wosisi ahemfo a minnim ho hwee,wɔpaw ahenemma wɔ bere a mempenee so ɛ.Wɔde wɔn dwetɛ ne wɔn sikakɔkɔɔ yɛ ahoni ma wɔn hode sɛe wɔn ankasa ho.
8.5: Tow wo nantwi ba ohoni no kyene, Samaria!Mʼabufuwhyew reba wɔn so.Wɔbɛtena nea ɛho ntew mu akosi da bɛn?
8.6: Wofi Israel!Saa nantwi ba yi, odwumfo bi na osenii;ɛnyɛ Onyankopɔn!Wobebubu mu asinasin,saa Samaria nantwi ba no.
8.7: “Wodua mframana wotwa mfɛtɛ.Awi a egyina hɔ no nni ti;nti wɔrennya siam mfi mu.Sɛ ɛsow aduan mpo a,ahɔho na wobedi.
8.8: Wɔamene Israel;afei ɔfra aman no mute sɛ ade a so nni mfaso biara.
8.9: Na wɔakɔ Asiriate sɛ wuram afurum a ɔno nko ara nenam.Efraim nso atɔn ne ho ama adɔfo.
8.10: Ɛwɔ mu, wɔatɔn wɔn ho wɔ amanaman no mu de,nanso mɛboaboa wɔn ano.Wɔn so befi ase atewwɔ ɔhene kɛse bi nhyɛso ase.
8.11: “Ɛwɔ mu sɛ Efraim sisii afɔremuka bebree a wɔbɔ bɔnefakyɛ afɔre wɔ so de,ɛno nti abɛyɛ afɔremuka a wɔyɛ bɔne wɔ so.
8.12: Mekyerɛw me mmara a ɛfa nneɛma bebree ho maa wɔn,nanso wɔfaa no sɛ ananafo ade.
8.13: Wɔde mʼayɛyɛde bɔ afɔrena wɔwe nam no,nanso wɔnsɔ Awurade ani.Afei ɔbɛkae wɔn atirimɔdensɛmna wɔatwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho:Wɔbɛsan akɔ Misraim.
8.14: Israel werɛ afi ne yɛfona wasisi ahemfi akɛseakɛse;Yuda abɔ nkurow bebree ho ban.Nanso mɛto ne nkuropɔn mu gyaa ɛbɛhyew wɔn aban.”

12.1: Efraim de mframa ayɛ aduan;odi apuei mframa akyi daana odi atoro yɛ akakabensɛm bebree.Ɔne Asiria yɛ apamna ɔde ngo kɔ Misraim.
12.2: Awurade wɔ sobo de bɔ Yuda;ɔbɛtwe Yakob aso wɔ nʼakwan hona watua no ne nneyɛe so ka.
12.3: Ɔyafunu mu na osoo ne nua nantin;onyinii no, ɔne Onyankopɔn peperee so.
12.4: Ɔne ɔbɔfo tentam dii ne so nkonim;ɔde nusu srɛɛ ne nkyɛn adom.Ohuu no wɔ Bet-Elne no kasaa wɔ hɔ.
12.5: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn,Awurade ne ne din a ahyeta!
12.6: Ɛsɛ sɛ wosan kɔ wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Tena ɔdɔ ne trenee mu,na twɛn wo Nyankopɔn daa.
12.7: Oguadini de asisi nsania yɛ nʼadwuma;nʼani gye asisi ho.
12.8: Efraim hoahoa ne ho sɛ,“Meyɛ ɔdefo; manya me ho.Mʼahonya nyinaa mu wɔrenhuamumɔyɛ biara wɔ me ho.”
12.9: “Mene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn,a miyii wo fii Misraim.Mɛma woakɔtena ntamadan mu biosɛnea na woyɛ wɔ wʼaponto afahyɛ nna mu no.
12.10: Mekasa kyerɛɛ adiyifo,memaa wɔn anisoadehu bebreena mefaa wɔn so kaa mmebusɛm.”
12.11: Gilead yɛ otirimɔdenfo ana?Emu nnipa no yɛ ahuhufo!Wɔde anantwi bɔ afɔre wɔ Gilgal ana?Wɔn afɔremuka bɛyɛ te sɛ aboa wɔahɔre no siw wɔ asase a wɔafuntum so.
12.12: Yakob guan kɔɔ Aramfo asase so;Israel som de nyaa ɔyere,ɔhwɛɛ nguan de tuaa ti nsa.
12.13: Awurade nam odiyifo soyii Israel fii Misraim,ɔnam odiyifo so hwɛɛ no.
12.14: Nanso Efraim ahyɛ no abufuw yayaayaw;nʼAwurade bɛma ne mogyahwiegu ho afɔdi ada no sona obetua nʼanimtiaabu no so ka.

13.1: Awurade Abufuw A Etia IsraelSɛ Efraim kasa a, na nnipa ho popo;wɔma no so wɔ Israelman mu.Nanso Baalsom nti, onyaa afɔbu na owui.
13.2: Afei wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne ara;wɔde wɔn dwetɛ yɛ ahoni ma wɔn ho,nsɛsode no nyinaa no.Adwumfo no nam nyansakwan so na ayeyɛ.Wɔka nnipa yi ho asɛm se,“Wɔde nnipa bɔ afɔrena wofew nantwimma ahoni ano.”
13.3: Ɛno nti, wɔbɛyɛ sɛ anɔpa omununkumsɛ anɔpa bosu a etu yera,sɛ ntɛtɛ a ehuw fi awiporowbeasɛ wusiw a ɛfa mfɛnsere mu kɔ.
13.4: “Nanso mene Awurade wo Nyankopɔn,a miyii wo fii Misraim.Nnye Onyankopɔn biara nto mu sɛ me,anaa Ogyefo biara sɛ me.
13.5: Mehwɛɛ wo wɔ nweatam so,asase a so yɛ hyew yiye no so.
13.6: Memaa wɔn aduan no, wodi mee;wɔmee no, wɔyɛɛ ahantan;na wɔn werɛ fii me.
13.7: Enti mɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so sɛ gyata,mɛtɛw wɔn wɔ akwan ho sɛ ɔsebɔ.
13.8: Mɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so na matetew wɔn mute sɛ sisi bi a wɔawia ne mma.Mɛwe wɔn te sɛ gyata;wuram aboa besunsuan wɔn mu.
13.9: “Wɔasɛe wo, Israel,efisɛ woasɔre atia me,me a meyɛ wo boafo.
13.10: Wo hene wɔ he na wabegye wo?Wo sodifo a wɔwɔ wo nkurow nyinaa so no wɔ he,wɔn a wokaa faa wɔn ho se,‘Ma me ɔhene ne ahenemma’ no?
13.11: Enti mʼabufuw mu, memaa wo ɔhene,na mʼanibere mu no, miyii no hɔ.
13.12: Efraim afɔdi no wɔaboaboa anowɔakyerɛw ne bɔne agu hɔ.
13.13: Ɔbɛte ɔyaw te sɛ ɔbea a ɔreko awo,na abofra no nnim nyansa nti;sɛ bere no du a,ɔmma awotwaa no ano.
13.14: “Mɛpata agye wɔn afi ɔda tumi mu.Megye wɔn afi owu nsam.Owu, wo nwowɔe wɔ he?Asaman, wo sɛe wɔ he?“Merennya ayamhyehye biara,
13.15: mpo sɛ ɔyɛ yiye wɔ ne nuanom mu a.Apuei mframa a efi Awurade hɔ bɛba,ɛbɛbɔ afi nweatam so;osu rentɔ asusowberena nʼabura bɛyow.Wɔbɛfom ne koradan mu nneɛmanea ɛsom bo no nyinaa.
13.16: Ɛsɛ sɛ nnipa a wɔwɔ Samaria gye wɔn afɔdi to mu,efisɛ wɔayɛ dɔm atia wɔn Nyankopɔn.Wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano;wɔbɛtotow wɔn mmofra ahwehwe fam,wɔn mmaa a wɔanyinsɛn nso wɔbɛpaapae wɔn mu.”

14.1: Ahonu De Nhyira BaIsrael, san wʼakyi kɔ Awurade wo Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Wʼasehwe fi wo bɔne!
14.2: Fa wo nsɛm a wowɔsan kɔ Awurade nkyɛn.Ka kyerɛ no se,“Fa yɛn bɔne nyinaa kyɛ yɛn,na fa ahummɔbɔ gye yɛn,na yɛatumi ayi wo ayɛ.
14.3: Asiria rentumi nnye yɛn;yɛrentena akofo apɔnkɔ so.Yɛrenka bio da se, ‘Yɛn anyame’nkyerɛ nea yɛn ara de yɛn nsa ayɛ,na wo mu na ayisaa nya mmɔborɔhunu.”
14.4: “Mɛsa wɔn asoɔden yare.Mefi me koma mu adɔ wɔn,efisɛ mʼabufuw nni wɔn so bio.
14.5: Mɛyɛ sɛ obosu ama Israel.Ɔbɛfefɛw ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ sukooko.Te sɛ Lebanon sida no,ɔde ne ntin betim fam;
14.6: ne mman bɛdennan.Nʼahoɔfɛ bɛyɛ sɛ ngodua,na ne hua ayɛ sɛ Lebanon sida.
14.7: Nnipa bɛtena ne nwini ase bio.Obenyin ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ aburow.Ɔbɛfefɛw ayɛ frɔmfrɔm te sɛ bobe,na ne din a ahyeta bɛyɛ sɛ nsa a efi Lebanon.
14.8: Efraim dɛn na me ne ahoni wɔ yɛ bio?Megye no so na mʼani aku ne ho.Mete sɛ dua a nʼahaban mpo;sɛ wobɛsow aba a, egyina me so.”
14.9: Hena ne onyansafo? Obehu eyinom mu.Hena na ɔwɔ nhumu? Ɔbɛte eyinom ase.Awurade akwan teɛ.Atreneefo nantew so,nanso asoɔdenfo hintiw wɔ mu.

1.1: Bere a Usia, Yotam, Ahas ne Hesekia yɛ ahemfo wɔ Yuda, na Yoas babarima Yeroboam di hene wɔ Israel no, Awurade de saa nsɛm yi baa Beeri babarima Hosea nkyɛn.
1.2: Hosea Yere Ne Ne MmaBere a Awurade dii kan kasa faa Hosea so no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Kɔware oguamanfo, na wo ne no nwo, efisɛ ɔman no di aguamammɔ ho fɔ na wɔnam so atetew wɔne Onyankopɔn ntam.”
1.3: Enti, ɔwaree Diblaim babea Gomer, na onyinsɛn woo ɔbabarima maa no.
1.4: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ no se, “To ne din Yesreel, efisɛ, merebɛtwe ɔhene Yehufi aso, de atua awu a odii wɔ Yesreel no so ka. Na mede Israel ahenni bɛba awiei.
1.5: Saa da no, mebubu Israel tadua wɔ Yesreel bon no mu.”
1.6: Gomer nyinsɛnee bio, na ɔwoo ɔbabea. Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ Hosea se, “To ne din Lo-ruhama efisɛ, merenna me dɔ adi nkyerɛ Israelfo bio, na meremfa wɔn ho nkyɛ wɔn koraa.
1.7: Nanso meyi me dɔ akyerɛ Yudafo. Me Awurade wɔn Nyankopɔn, mede me tumi begye wɔn afi wɔn atamfo nsam a meremfa tadua, afoa anaa ɔko anaa apɔnkɔ ne apɔnkɔsotefo.”
1.8: Bere a Gomer twaa Lo-ruhama nufu akyi no, ɔwoo ɔba barima foforo.
1.9: Na Awurade kae se, “To ne din Lo-ami, efisɛ monnyɛ me nkurɔfo na mennyɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
1.10: “Nanso Israelfo bɛyɛ sɛ mpoano nwea a wontumi nkan wɔn. Faako a wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, ‘Monnyɛ me nkurɔfo’ no, wɔbɛka se, ‘Moyɛ Onyankopɔn teasefo no mma.’
1.11: Na Yudafo ne Israelfo bɛka abɔ mu bio, na wobeyi ɔkwankyerɛfo baako ama wɔn, na wɔn nyinaa bɛsan afi nnommum no mu aba. Saa da no bɛyɛ da kɛse ama Yesreel.”

3.1: Hosea Ne Ne Yere NkabomNa Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Kɔ na kɔfa wo yere no bio. Fa no san bra wo nkyɛn, na dɔ no. Ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔfoforo bi dɔ no anaa sɛ ɔyɛ ɔwaresɛefo. Dɔ no, sɛnea Awurade da so dɔ Israel, a mpo, nnipa no dan wɔn ho kɔ anyame afoforo nkyɛn, na wɔma wɔn bobe aba tetare no.”
3.2: Enti mede gram ɔha aduoson baako () ne atoko lita ɔha aduɔwɔtwe abien () ne atoko lita aduɔkron baako kɔpataa no.
3.3: Na meka kyerɛɛ no se, “Ɛsɛ sɛ wo ne me tena nna bebree, na wugyae wʼaguamammɔ no; wo ne ɔbarima biara nyɛ nnamfo. Me ne wo bɛtena, nanso me ne wo renna.”
3.4: Na ɔman Israel bɛwɔ hɔ nna tenten bi a ɔhene anaa ɔheneba nni mu, na wɔremmɔ afɔre. Wɔrenhu ɔbosom dum anaa asɔfotade anaa ahoni nso wɔ hɔ.
3.5: Akyiri yi, Israelfo bɛsan akɔhwehwɛ Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn, ne Dawid a ɔyɛ wɔn hene no. Wɔde ahopopo bɛba Awurade nkyɛn na wobenya ne nhyira wɔ nna a edi akyiri no mu.

2.1: “Frɛ wo nuabarimanom, ‘Me nkurɔfo’ na frɛ wo nuabeanom, ‘Mʼadɔfo.’ ”
2.2: Wɔtwe Israel Aso, Gye No To Mu Bio“Ka wo na anim, ka nʼanim,na ɔnyɛ me yerena menyɛ ne kunu.Ma ɔnsesa nʼanim a ayɛ aguaman anim nona onnyae awaresɛe a ɔde ne nufu yɛ no.
2.3: Anyɛ saa a mɛpa ne ho ntamana wada adagyaw te sɛ da a wɔwoo no no;mɛma wayɛ sɛ nweatam,mɛdan no asase a awo woseena mama osukɔm akum no.
2.4: Merennɔ ne mma,efisɛ wɔyɛ aguaman mma.
2.5: Wɔn na anyɛ ɔnokwafona onyinsɛnee wɔn wɔ animguase mu.Ɔkae se, ‘Medi mʼadɔfo akyi,wɔn a wɔma me aduan ne nsu,ne kuntu ne nwera, ngo ne nsa.’
2.6: Eyi nti, mede nsɔe besiw no kwan;mɛto ɔfasu afa ne ho, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔrenhu kwan.
2.7: Obetiw nʼadɔfo, nanso ɔrento wɔn;ɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso ɔrenhu wɔn.Afei, ɔbɛka se,‘Mɛsan akɔ me kunu nkyɛn, te sɛ kan no,efisɛ, saa bere no na eye ma me sen mprempren.’
2.8: Ɔnkae sɛ me namemaa no aduan, nsa foforo ne ngo,nea ɔmaa sikakɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ buu no soma wɔde kɔsom Baal no.
2.9: “Enti sɛ mʼaduan no du twabere a mɛfa mʼade,ne me nsa foforo no nso saa ara.Megye me kuntu ne me nwera,a anka mepɛ sɛ ɔde kata nʼadagyaw so no.
2.10: Enti afei mɛbɔ no adagyawwɔ nʼadɔfo anim;obiara rentumi nnye no mfi me nsam.
2.11: Metwa nʼafahyɛ nyinaa so:nʼafirihyia afahyɛ, Ɔsram Foforo afahyɛHomeda afahyɛ ne nʼafahyɛ ahorow nyinaa.
2.12: Mɛsɛe ne bobe ne borɔdɔma nnua,nea ɔka se nʼadɔfo de tuaa no ka no;mɛyɛ ne nyinaa nkyɛkyerɛ,ama wuram mmoa awe.
2.13: Mɛtwe nʼaso wɔ nna aɔhyew aduhuam maa Baal no ho;ɔde nkaa ne agude hyehyɛɛ ne ho,tu dii nʼadɔfo akyi,me de, ne werɛ fii me,”nea Awurade se ni.
2.14: “Enti merekɔdaadaa no;mede no bɛkɔ nweatam sona makasa bɔkɔɔ akyerɛ no wɔ hɔ.
2.15: Mɛsan de ne bobe mfuw ama no.Mɛyɛ no Sɛkyɛ Bon,anidaso pon.Ɛhɔ na ɔbɛto dwom sɛnea na ɔyɛ ne mmabun bere mu none bere a ofii Misraim no.
2.16: “Saa da no,” sɛɛ na Awurade se,“Wobɛfrɛ me ‘me kunu’;na woremfrɛ me ‘me wura’ bio.
2.17: Meyi Baal ahorow din no afi nʼano;na ɔrenkankye wɔ wɔn din mu bio.
2.18: Saa da no, mɛyɛ apam ama wɔn,wɔne wuram mmoa ne wim nnomaane mmoa a wɔwea wɔ asase so.Tadua, mpeaw ne ɔko,mɛbra wɔ asase no so,sɛnea wɔn nyinaa bɛtena ase asomdwoe mu.
2.19: Mɛware wo afebɔɔ;mɛda trenee ne atɛntrenee,ahummɔbɔ ne ayamhyehye adi akyerɛ wo.
2.20: Mɛware wo nokware mu,ama woahu Awurade.
2.21: “Saa da no, megye wo so,”nea Awurade se ni.“Megye ɔsoro so,na ɔsoro de osu begye asase so,
2.22: na asase nso begye nnɔbae so:bobe foforo ne ngodua,na wɔn nso agye so se ‘Yesreel’, ‘Onyankopɔn na wadua.’
2.23: Mede Israel bedua asase no so ama me ho;mɛda me dɔ adi akyerɛ nea mekae se, ‘wonyɛ me dɔfo’ no.Mɛka akyerɛ wɔn a misee wɔn sɛ ‘monyɛ me nkurɔfo’ no se‘moyɛ me nkurɔfo,’na wɔn nso aka se, ‘Wone me Nyankopɔn.’”

6.1: Israel Nni Ahonu“Mommra, momma yɛnsan nkɔ Awurade nkyɛn.Watetew yɛn mu asinasinnanso ɔbɛsa yɛn yare.Wapirapira yɛnnanso ɔbɛkyekyere yɛn apirakuru.
6.2: Nnaanu akyi, ɔbɛma yɛanya ahoɔden;nansa so, ɔde yɛn besi yɛn sibeana yɛanya nkwa wɔ nʼanim.
6.3: Momma yennye Awurade nto mu;momma yɛnkɔ so nnye no nto mu.Sɛnea owia pue da biara no, obepue;ɔbɛba yɛn nkyɛn te sɛ osu a ɛtɔ awɔwbere muanaa asusow bere mu su a ɛfɔw asase.”
6.4: “Dɛn na metumi de wo ayɛ, Efraim?Dɛn na metumi de wo ayɛ, Yuda?Mo dɔ te sɛ anɔpa bɔ,ɛte sɛ anɔpa bosu a etu yera.
6.5: Mede mʼadiyifo twitwaa mo mu asinasin,mede mʼanom nsɛm kunkum mo;mʼatemmu baa mo so sɛ anyinam.
6.6: Mepɛ ahummɔbɔ na ɛnyɛ afɔrebɔ,mepɛ Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ sen ɔhyew afɔre.
6.7: Wɔabu apam no so sɛnea Adam yɛe.Wɔanni me nokware wɔ hɔ.
6.8: Gilead yɛ atirimɔdenfo kuropɔna mogya anammɔn akeka hɔ.
6.9: Sɛnea akwamukafo ka kwan mu nosaa ara na asɔfokuw no nso yɛ;wodi awu wɔ Sekem tempɔn so,yɛ nnebɔne a ɛyɛ animguase.
6.10: Mahu ahodwiriwde wɔ Israelfi.Ɛhɔ, Efraim kɔ aguamammɔ muIsrael gu ne ho fi.
6.11: “Na wo Yuda nso,wɔahyɛ otwa bere ama wo.“Bere biara a mede me nkurɔfo siade bɛsan ama wɔn no,

7.1: bere biara a mɛsa Israel yare no,Efraim nnebɔne da adi.Samaria awurukasɛm nso da adi.Wɔyɛ nnaadaafoakorɔmfo a wobubu adan ani kɔ afi mu,ne akwamukafo a wɔbɔ korɔn wɔ mmɔnten so.
7.2: Na wonhu sɛmekae wɔn nnebɔne nyinaa.Wɔn bɔne bunkam wɔn so;egu mʼanim bere biara.
7.3: “Wɔde atirimɔdensɛm gyigye ɔhene no ani,na wɔde atoro nso gyigye ahenemma no ani.
7.4: Wɔn nyinaa yɛ aguamammɔfoa akɔnnɔ redɛw wɔ wɔn mu.Wɔte sɛ fononoo a wɔasɔ mu gyabere a brodotofo ahyɛ ase refɔtɔw nʼasikresiam.
7.5: Da a ɔhene rehyɛ fa noahenemma bow nsa,na ɔhene no fɛwdifo ne wɔn bɔ mu goru.
7.6: Wɔn koma te sɛ fononoo;wɔde atirimpɔw bɔne kɔ ɔhene anim.Wɔn nsusuwii bɔne no dɛɛdɛɛ anadwo mu nyinaa;anɔpa, ɛdɛw te sɛ ogyatannaa.
7.7: Wɔn nyinaa ayɛ hyew sɛ fononoo.Wokunkum wɔn sodifo.Wɔn ahemfo nyinaa hwehwe asena wɔn mu biara nsu mfrɛ me.
7.8: “Efraim ne aman no adi afra;Efraim yɛ ɔfam a anyinya a wonkisae.
7.9: Ananafo twe nʼahoɔden,nanso onhu.Dwen aba ne ti so,nanso nʼani mmaa so ɛ.
7.10: Israel ahantan di adanse tia no,nanso eyi nyinaa akyi noɔnnsan nkɔ Awurade ne Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,na ɔnhwehwɛ no nso.
7.11: “Efraim te sɛ aborɔnoma,wotumi daadaa no na onni adwene.Ɔfrɛ Misraim,na wadan akɔ Asiria.
7.12: Sɛ wɔkɔ a, mɛtow mʼasau agu wɔn so;atwe wɔn aba fam te sɛ wim nnomaa.Sɛ mete sɛ wɔretu abɔ mu a,mɛkyere wɔn.
7.13: Nnome nka wɔn,efisɛ wɔatwe wɔn ho afi me ho!Ɔsɛe mmra wɔn soefisɛ wɔatew me so atua!anka mepɛ sɛ migye wɔnnanso wutwa atoro fa me ho.
7.14: Wommfi wɔn koma mu nsu mfrɛ me,mmom wotwa adwo wɔ wɔn mpa so.Wɔboaboa wɔn ho ano kɔhwehwɛ aduan ne nsa foforo,nanso wɔtwe wɔn ho fi me ho.
7.15: Metetew wɔn, hyɛɛ wɔn den,nanso wɔbɔ pɔw bɔne tia me.
7.16: Wɔnhwehwɛ Ɔsorosoroni no;wɔte sɛ tadua a asɛe,wɔn ntuanofo bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa anoefisɛ, wɔnkasa obu so.Eyi nti wobedi wɔn ho fɛwwɔ Misraim asase so.

5.1: Atemmu A Etia Israel“Muntie, mo asɔfo!Monhyɛ eyi nso, mo Israelfo!Monyɛ asow, adehyefi!Saa atemmu yi tia mo:Moayɛ afiri wɔ Mispa,ne asau a wɔagu no Tabor so.
5.2: Atuatewfo adɔ mogyahwiegu mu asukɔ.Mɛtwe wɔn nyinaa aso.
5.3: Minim Efraim ho nsɛm nyinaa;wɔmfaa Israel nhintaw me ɛ.Efraim, mprempren de wobɔ aguaman;na Israel aporɔw.
5.4: “Wɔn nneyɛe mma wɔ kwanmma wɔnnkɔ Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Aguamammɔ honhom wɔ wɔn koma mu;wonnye Awurade nto mu.
5.5: Israel ahantan di tia no.Israelfo no, mpo Efraim hintihintiw wɔ wɔn amumɔyɛ mu;Yuda nso ne wɔn hintiw saa ara.
5.6: Sɛ wɔne wɔn nguan ne wɔn anantwikɔhwehwɛ Awurade aWɔrenhu no,efisɛ watwe ne ho afi wɔn ho.
5.7: Wɔanni Awurade nokware.Wɔwowoo aguaman mma.Sɛ wodi wɔn Ɔsram Foforo Afahyɛ a,ɔbɛsɛe wɔn nsase.
5.8: “Hyɛn torobɛnto no wɔ Gibea.Hyɛn mmɛn no wɔ Rama.Momma ɔko nteɛmu so wɔ Bet Awen;Benyamin, monsɔre nni anim.
5.9: Efraim bɛda mpanwɔ akontaabu da.Israel mmusuakuw no mu nomepae mu ka nea ɛwɔ mu.
5.10: Yuda sodifo no te sɛwɔn a woyiyi ahye so abo.Mehwie mʼabufuw agu wɔn sote sɛ nsuyiri.
5.11: Wɔhyɛ Efraim so,wotiatia ne so wɔ atemmu mu,wasi nʼadwene pi sɛ obedi ahoni akyi.
5.12: Mɛyɛ sɛ nwewee ama Efraimna mayɛ Yudafo sɛ dua a aporɔw.
5.13: “Bere a Efraim huu ne yare,na Yuda nso huu nʼakuru no,Efraim de nʼani kyerɛɛ Asiria.Ɔsoma kɔɔ ɔhenkɛse no hɔ kɔpɛɛ mmoa.Nanso wantumi ansa no yare,na akuru no nso anwuwu.
5.14: Enti mɛyɛ sɛ gyata ama Efraimna mayɛ sɛ gyata hoɔdenfo ama Yuda.Mɛtetew wɔn mu nketenkete, na makɔ;Mɛsoa wɔn akɔ, na obiara rentumi nnye wɔn.
5.15: Afei mɛsan akɔ me nkyikosi sɛ wobenya ahonu.Na wɔbɛhwehwɛ mʼakyi kwan;wɔn awerɛhow mu, wɔbɛhwehwɛ me anibere so.”

4.1: Wɔbɔ Israel KwaaduMuntie Awurade asɛm, mo Israelfoefisɛ Awurade wɔ kwaadu de bɔmo a mote asase no so:“Nokware, ɔdɔ, anaa Onyankopɔn ho nimdeɛ nni asase no so.
4.2: Nnome nko ara, atorotwa ne awudi,akrɔmmɔ, ne aguamammɔna moyɛ ma ɛtra so,na mogyahwiegu ba ntoatoaso.
4.3: Eyi nti asase no di awerɛhowna wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa wuwu;wuram mmoa, wim nnomaane po mu nam rewuwu.
4.4: “Mma obiara mmɔ kwaadu,mma obiara mmɔ ɔfoforo sobo.Na mmom, mo asɔfomo na me ne mo anya.
4.5: Muhintiw awia ne anadwo,na adiyifo no ne mo hintiw.Ɛno nti mɛsɛe mo man.
4.6: Nimdeɛ a me nkurɔfo nni nti wɔresɛe.“Sɛ moapo nimdeɛ nti,me nso mapo mo sɛ mʼasɔfo;sɛ moabu mo ani agu mo Nyankopɔn mmara so nti,me nso mabu mʼani agu mo mma so.
4.7: Asɔfo no redɔɔso nona bɔne a ɛboro so na wɔyɛ tia me.Wɔde wɔn Anuonyam asesa nea ɛyɛ animguase.
4.8: Wodidi me nkurɔfo bɔne hoɛno nti wɔn ani gye atirimɔdensɛm ho.
4.9: Sɛnea nnipa no te no, saa ara na asɔfo no nso te.Mɛtwe wɔn nyinaa aso wɔ wɔn akwan hona matua wɔn wɔn nneyɛe so ka.
4.10: “Wobedidi, nanso wɔremmee.Wɔbɛbɔ aguaman, nanso wɔn ase remfɛe,efisɛ, wɔagyaw Awurade hɔ,de wɔn ho ama
4.11: aguamammɔ,nsa dedaw ne foforo,a ɛma me nkurɔfo
4.12: ntease tu yera.Wɔkɔ abisa wɔ ahoni a wɔde nnua asen nkyɛnna duasin bi ama wɔn mmuae.Aguamammɔ honhom rema wɔn ayera kwan;wonni wɔn Nyankopɔn nokware.
