24.21: Ka kyerɛ Israelfi se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Merebegu me kronkronbea ho fi; mo bammɔ dennen a mode hoahoa mo ho, nea mo ani gye ho, ade a mo koma da so. Mmabarima ne mmabea a mugyaw wɔn akyi no bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano.
24.22: Na mobɛyɛ sɛnea mayɛ yi, morenkata mo ano na morenni amanne aduan a wɔn a wodi awerɛhow di.
24.23: Mobɛkɔ so abɔ mo abotiri ahyɛ mo mpaboa. Morenni awerɛhow na morensu, mmom mo so bɛtew esiane mo bɔne nti, na mubesisi apini wɔ mo mu.
24.24: Hesekiel bɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnnede ama mo, mobɛyɛ sɛnea wayɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na eyi si a na mubehu sɛ mene Otumfo Awurade no.’
24.25: “Na wo, onipa ba, da a mɛfa wɔn aban dennen, wɔn ahosɛpɛw ne anuonyam, ade a wɔn ani gye ho, wɔn koma so ade, ne wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea nso no,
24.26: saa da no okyinkyinfo bi na ɔbɛba abɛka nea asi akyerɛ wo.
24.27: Saa bere no, wʼano bebue, wo ne no bɛkasa na worenyɛ komm bio. Wobɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnnede ama wɔn, na wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no.”

18.1: Ɔkra A Ɔyɛ Bɔne No BewuAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
18.2: “Sɛ mo saa nkurɔfo yi bu saa bɛ a ɛfa Israel asase yi ho a, na mopɛ sɛ mokyerɛ dɛn:“ ‘Agyanom di bobe bun,na mma se afem ana?’
18.3: “Nokware, sɛ mete ase yi, sɛɛ na Awurade se, moremmu saa bɛ yi bio wɔ Israel.
18.4: Ɔkra teasefo biara yɛ me de, agya ne ɔba barima nyinaa, wɔn nyinaa yɛ me de. Ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔne ne nea obewu.
18.5: “Sɛ ɛba sɛ onipa trenee bi wɔ hɔ aɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ;
18.6: onnidi wɔ mmepɔw so abosonnan muna ɔnsom ahoni a wɔwɔ Israelfi.Ongu ne yɔnko yere ho fina ɔne ɔbea a wabu ne nsa nna.
18.7: Ɔnhyɛ obiara so,na ɔde boseagyefo awowaside san ma no.Ɔmmɔ korɔnmmom ɔde nʼaduan ma nea ɔkɔm de nona ofura nea ɔda adagyaw no ntama.
18.8: Ɔmmɔ bosea nnye nsihona onnye mfɛntom mmoroso.Ɔtwe ne ho fi bɔneyɛ hona obu nipa baanu ntam atɛntrenee.
18.9: Odi mʼahyɛde sona odi me mmara so nokware.Saa onipa no na ɔteɛ;na ampa ara obenya nkwaAwurade asɛm ni.
18.10: “Sɛ ɛba sɛ ɔwɔ ɔba barima a odi akakabensɛm na ohwie mogya gu anaasɛ ɔyɛ saa nneɛma yi mu biara a
18.11: (ɛwɔ mu, agya no nyɛɛ eyinom mu biara ɛ):“Odidi wɔ mmepɔw so abosonnan mu.Ogu ne yɔnko yere ho fi.
18.12: Ɔhyɛ ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo so.Ɔbɔ korɔn.Ɔmmfa boseagyefo awowaside mma no.Ɔde ne ho to abosom so.Ɔyɛ akyiwade.
18.13: Ɔbɔ bosea gye nsiho na ogye mfɛntom mmoroso.Saa onipa yi benya nkwa ana? Dabi da! Esiane sɛ wayɛ saa akyiwade yi nyinaa nti, ampa ara wobekum no na ne mogya bɛbɔ nʼankasa ti so.
18.14: “Nanso sɛ ɛba sɛ saa ɔbabarima yi wɔ ɔbabarima a ohu bɔne a nʼagya yɛ no nyinaa nanso ɔnyɛ saa nneɛma no bi:
18.15: “Onnidi wɔ mmepɔw so abosonnan muna ɔmfa ne ho nto ahoni a ɛwɔ Israelfi so.Ongu ne yɔnko yere ho fi.
18.16: Ɔnhyɛ obiara sona onnye boseagyefo hɔ awowaside.Ɔmmɔ korɔn,mmom ɔde nʼaduan ma nea ɔkɔm de nona ofura nea ɔda adagyaw no ntama.
18.17: Ɔtwe ne ho fi bɔne ho,na onnye nsiho anaa mfɛntom mmoroso.Odi me mmara ne mʼahyɛde so.Ɔrenwu wɔ nʼagya no bɔne nti; ampa ara obenya nkwa.
18.18: Nanso nʼagya no bewu wɔ ɔno ara bɔne nti, efisɛ osisii nnipa, bɔɔ ne yɔnko korɔn, na ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ ne nkurɔfo mu.
18.19: “Nanso mubisa se, ‘Adɛn nti na ɔbabarima no nnya nʼagya afɔdi no bi ho asotwe?’ Esiane sɛ ɔbabarima no ayɛ nea ɛteɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ na wahwɛ yiye adi mʼahyɛde nyinaa so no nti, ampa ara obenya nkwa.
18.20: Ɔkra a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔno ne nea obewu. Ɔbabarima no rennya nʼagya afɔdi no ho asotwe bi, saa ara na agya no nso rennya ɔbabarima no afɔdi ho asotwe no bi. Wɔde ɔtreneeni adetreneeyɛ so aba bɛma no, na wobebu omumɔyɛfo amumɔyɛsɛm atia no.
18.21: “Na sɛ omumɔyɛfo twe ne ho fi bɔne a wayɛ nyinaa ho, na odi mʼahyɛde so, na afei ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ ne nea ɛyɛ papa a, ampa ara obenya nkwa na ɔrenwu.
18.22: Wɔrennyina bɔne a wayɛ no mu biara so mmu no atɛn. Ne trenee nneyɛe nti obenya nkwa.
18.23: Mʼani gye amumɔyɛfo wu ho ana? Otumfo Awurade bisa. Sɛ wɔtwe wɔn ho fi wɔn akwammɔne ho na wonya nkwa a, mʼani nnye ana?
18.24: “Na sɛ ɔtreneeni twe ne ho fi ne trenee nneyɛe ho, kɔyɛ bɔne, na ɔyɛ akyiwade a amumɔyɛfo yɛ a, obenya nkwa ana? Wɔrenkae ne trenee nneyɛe no. Esiane sɛ odi nokwaredi ho fɔ na wayɛ bɔne nti, obewu.
18.25: “Nanso moka se, ‘Awurade kwan nteɛ.’ Muntie! Mo, Israelfi. Me kwan nteɛ ana? Ɛnyɛ mo akwan mmom na ɛnteɛ?
18.26: Sɛ ɔtreneeni twe ne ho fi ne trenee nneyɛe ho na ɔkɔyɛ bɔne a, ɛno nti obewu, bɔne a wayɛ nti obewu.
18.27: Nanso sɛ omumɔyɛfo twe ne ho fi amumɔyɛsɛm a wadi ho, na ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ ne nea ɛyɛ papa a, obegye ne kra nkwa.
18.28: Esiane sɛ wahu ne mmarato na watwe ne ho afi ho no nti, obenya nkwa na ɔrenwu.
18.29: Nanso Israelfi ka se, ‘Awurade kwan nteɛ.’ Mʼakwan nteɛ! Mo, Israelfi! Ɛnyɛ mo akwan mmom na ɛnteɛ ana?
18.30: “Ɛno nti, mo Israelfo, mebu mo mu biara atɛn sɛnea nʼakwan te, Otumfo Awurade na ose. Monsakra mo adwene! Montwe mo ho mfi mo mmarato nyinaa ho; na afei bɔne remfa mo nkɔ asehwe mu bio.
18.31: Montow mfomso a moayɛ nyinaa ngu na moanya koma foforo ne honhom foforo. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ muwu, Israelfifo?
18.32: Mʼani nnye obiara wu ho, Otumfo Awurade na ose. ‘Monsakra mo adwene na moanya nkwa!’

32.1: Farao Ho KwadwomMfe dumien mu, ɔsram a ɛto so dumien no da a edi kan no, Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
32.2: “Onipa ba, to kwadwom fa Misraimhene Farao ho na ka kyerɛ no se:“ ‘Wote sɛ gyata wɔ aman no mu:wote sɛ po mu aboa a ne ho yɛ huwububu dikyi wɔ wo nsuten mu,wode wo nan boro nsuten node fono nsu no.
32.3: “ ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“ ‘Mede dɔm bɛbaabɛtow mʼasau agu wo so,na wɔbɛtwe wo afi mʼasau mu.
32.4: Mɛtow wo akyene asase no sona mahiri wo ato sare so.Mɛma wim nnomaa nyinaa abesisi wo sona asase so mmoa nyinaa adi wo nam afrɛ so.
32.5: Mɛhata wo nam wɔ mmepɔw no sona mede wo funu ahyɛ aku ma.
32.6: Mede wo mogya a ɛresen noafɔw asase no de akɔka mmepɔw nona wo nam bɛhyɛ abon nketewa no ma.
32.7: Sɛ mitwa wo fi hɔ a, mɛkata ɔsoro anina madunnum wɔn nsoromma;mede omununkum bɛkata owia ani,na ɔsram renhyerɛn.
32.8: Ɔsoro akanea a ɛhyerɛn nyinaamɛma aduru sum wɔ wo so;mɛma sum aduru wʼasase, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
32.9: Mɛma nnipa bebree koma atutubere a mede wo sɛe aba aman no mu,nsase a wunnya nhuu mu.
32.10: Mɛma nnipa bebree ho adwiriw wɔn wɔ wo ho,wo nti, hu bɛma wɔn ahene ho apopobere a merehim mʼafoa wɔ wɔn anim no.Da a wobɛhwe ase nowɔn mu biara ho bɛwosowbere nyinaa mu wɔ wɔn nkwa nti.
32.11: “ ‘Na sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“ ‘Babiloniahene afoabɛsɔre wɔ wo so.
32.12: Mɛma wo dɔm no atotɔwɔ dɔmmarima afoa ano,wɔ aman a wɔyɛ anuɔdenfo mu.Wɔbɛsɛe Misraim ahomaso pasaana ne dɔm no nyinaa bedi nkogu.
32.13: Mekunkum nʼanantwi nyinaaafi nsu bebree no hona onipa nan rentiatia mu biona anantwi tɔte nso remfono no.
32.14: Afei mɛma ne nsu ani atewna mama ne nsuten ateɛ sɛ ngo,Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
32.15: Sɛ mema Misraim da mpanna miyi biribiara fi asase no so,sɛ mikum wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa a,afei na wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no.’
32.16: “Eyi ne kwadwom a wɔbɛto ama no. Amanaman no mmabea bɛto ama Misraim ne ne dɔm nyinaa, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.”
32.17: Afe a ɛto so dumien no ne sram da a ɛto so dunum no, Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
32.18: “Onipa ba, twa adwo ma Misraim dɔm na ma ɔne amanaman akɛse no mmabea nsian nkɔ asase ase nkɔka wɔn a wɔasian kɔ amoa mu no ho.
32.19: Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Wadom mo dodo sen wɔn a aka no ana? Munsian nkɔ na mo ne momonotofo no nkɔda.’
32.20: Wɔbɛka wɔn a wowuwuu wɔ afoa ano no ho. Wɔatwe afoa no, ma wɔntwe ne nnipadɔm no ase nkɔ.
32.21: Akannifo akɛse a wɔwɔ ɔda mu bɛka afa Misraim ne ne dɔm ho se, ‘Wɔasian aba na wɔdeda momonotofo mu, wɔn a wowuwuu wɔ afoa ano no.’
32.22: “Asiria ne nʼasraafo nyinaa wɔ hɔ, wɔn a wɔakunkum wɔn no nna atwa ne ho ahyia, wɔn a wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano no.
32.23: Wɔn nna no wɔ amoa no ase tɔnn na nʼasraafo deda ne nna ho nyinaa. Wɔn a na wohunahuna afoforo wɔ ateasefo asase so no nyinaa awuwu, wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano.
32.24: “Elam wɔ hɔ, ne nnipadɔm nyinaa atwa ne da ho ahyia. Wɔn nyinaa awuwu, wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano. Wɔn a na wohunahuna afoforo wɔ ateasefo asase so nyinaa sian kɔɔ asase ase sɛ momonotofo. Wɔde wɔn animguase kɔka wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu no ho.
32.25: Wɔato mpa ama no wɔ atɔfo no mu, na ne dɔm atwa ne da ho ahyia. Wɔn nyinaa yɛ momonotofo a wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano. Esiane sɛ wɔn ahunahuna trɛw wɔ ateasefo asase so no nti, wɔne wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu no nyinaa anim agu ase. Wɔadeda wɔn wɔ atɔfo no mu.
32.26: “Mesek ne Tubal wɔ hɔ a wɔn dɔm atwa wɔn nna ho ahyia. Wɔn nyinaa yɛ momonotofo a wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano efisɛ wɔtrɛtrɛw wɔn ahunahuna mu wɔ ateasefo asase so.
32.27: Ɛnyɛ wɔn ne akofo momonotofo foforo a wɔatotɔ na wɔdeda hɔ no ana? Wɔn a wɔne wɔn akode sian kɔɔ nna mu na wɔn ti deda wɔn afoa so no. Wɔn amumɔyɛ so asotwe daa wɔn nnompe so, mmom saa akofo yi ahunahuna atrɛtrɛw wɔ ateasefo asase so.
32.28: “Farao, wo nso wobebubu wo mu na woakɔda momonotofo mu, wo ne wɔn a wɔtotɔɔ wɔ afoa ano no.
32.29: “Edom wɔ hɔ, nʼahemfo ne ne mmapɔmma nyinaa deda wɔn a wɔatotɔ wɔ afoa ano no mu, wɔn tumi nyinaa akyi. Wɔdeda momonotofo mu, wɔne wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu no.
32.30: “Mmapɔmma a wofi atifi fam nyinaa ne Sidonfo nyinaa wɔ hɔ, wɔne atɔfo kɔɔ wɔ animguase mu, wɔn tumi a wɔde hunahuna no nyinaa akyi. Wɔdeda hɔ sɛ momonotofo, wɔne wɔn a wokum wɔn wɔ afoa ano, na wɔne wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu no asoa wɔn animguase.
32.31: “Farao, ɔne nʼasraafo nyinaa behu wɔn na ne werɛ bɛkyekye wɔ ne dɔm a wokunkum wɔn wɔ afoa ano no ho, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
32.32: Mmom me na memaa Farao ne ne nnipadɔm de ahunahuna trɛtrɛw wɔ ateasefo asase so de, nanso wɔbɛdeda momonotofo mu, wɔn a wɔde afoa kunkum wɔn, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.”

26.1: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia TiroAfe a ɛto so dubaako no sram da a edi kan no, Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
26.2: “Onipa ba, esiane sɛ Tiro aka afa Yerusalem ho se, ‘Ɛhɛɛ! Amanaman no ano pon abubu na nʼapon no abuebue ama me; mprempren a kuropɔn yi asɛe yi, menya nkɔso.’
26.3: Ɛno nti, sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Me ne wo anya, Tiro, mede aman bebree bɛba abetia wo te sɛ po a ɛrebɔ nʼasorɔkye.
26.4: Wɔbɛsɛe Tiro afasu na wɔadwiriw nʼabantenten no. Mɛpa so dɔte agu ama ayɛ ɔbotan kwaboo.
26.5: Obefi po mu abɛyɛ beae a wɔhata asau, efisɛ makasa. Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni. Ɔbɛyɛ amanaman no asade,
26.6: na afoa bɛsɛe nʼatenae a ɛwɔ asase kesee so no pasaa. Afei wobehu sɛ, mene Awurade no.
26.7: “Na sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Merekɔfa Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar, ahene mu hene, ne ne apɔnkɔ ne nteaseɛnam, ne apɔnkɔsotefo ne nsraadɔm kɛse afi atifi fam aba wo so.
26.8: Ɔde afoa bɛsɛe wʼatenae a ɛwɔ asase kesee no so no pasaa; obesisi mpampim ayɛ mpempe wɔ wʼafasu ho na wama ne nkatabo so atia wo.
26.9: Ɔde oburuw nnua bɛpempem wʼafasu no, na ɔde akode abubu wʼabantenten no asɛe no.
26.10: Nʼapɔnkɔ no bɛdɔɔso yiye, na wɔbɛbɔ mfutuma akata wo so. Ɔsa apɔnkɔ no, nkyimii ne nteaseɛnam nnyigyei bɛma wʼafasu awosow, bere a wɔahyɛn wo apon mu, sɛnea mmarima hyɛn kuropɔn a nʼafasu mu adeda akwan no.
26.11: Nʼapɔnkɔ no tɔte betiatia wo mmɔnten nyinaa so, ɔde afoa bekunkum wo nkurɔfo na wʼafadum dennen no bebubu agu fam.
26.12: Wɔbɛfom wʼahode na wɔawia wʼaguade, wobebubu wʼafasu, na wɔadwiriw wʼadan fɛfɛ no na wɔatotow wʼabo, wo nnua ne wo dɔte agu po mu.
26.13: Mɛma wo nnwonto gyegyeegye no aba awiei na wɔrente wo sanku so nnwonto no bio.
26.14: Mɛyɛ wo ɔbotan kwaboo na wo so na wɔbɛhata asau. Wɔrenkyekyere wo bio.
26.15: “Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade ka kyerɛ Tiro: Sɛ wo mpoano nkurow no te wʼasehwe ho apinisi ne akunkumakunkum a asi wɔ wo mu a, wɔn ho rempopo ana?
26.16: Afei mpoano mmapɔmma no nyinaa befi wɔn nhengua so, ayiyi wɔn nguguso ne ntade a wɔadi mu adwinni agu hɔ. Ehu bɛbɔ wɔn ama wɔatenatena fam, wɔn ho bɛpopo na wɔn ho adwiriw wɔn wɔ wo nti.
26.17: Afei wɔbɛma kwadwom a ɛfa wo ho so se:“‘Hwɛ sɛnea wɔasɛe wo, kuropɔn a woagye din,wo a po sofo na ɛte wo mu,na anka wowɔ tumi wɔ po so!Wo ne wo manfo;wode hu hyɛɛwɔn a wɔte hɔ nyinaa mu.
26.18: Mprempren, mpoano nsase no ho popowɔ wʼasehwe da no;asupɔw a ɛwɔ po mu noabɔ hu wɔ wʼasehwe no ho.’
26.19: “Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Sɛ mema woyɛ kuropɔn a ada mpan te sɛ nkuropɔn a nnipa ntete so, na sɛ mema po bun ba wo so na sɛ ne mu nsu bebrebe no bɛkata wo so a,
26.20: mede wo ne wɔn a wɔkɔ amoa mu no besian akɔ teteetefo no nkyɛn. Mɛma woatena asase ase hɔ te sɛ tete mmubui, wo ne wɔn a wosian kɔ amoa mu no, na worensan anaa worennya kyɛfa wɔ ateasefo asase so.
26.21: Mede wo bɛba awiei a ɛyɛ hu mu na worenhu bio. Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wo nanso wɔrenhu wo bio da, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.”

27.1: Tiro Ho KwadwomAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
27.2: “Onipa ba, ma kwadwom a ɛfa Tiro ho so.
27.3: Ka kyerɛ Tiro a ɔda po abobow ano, na ɔne aguadifo bebree a wɔwɔ mpoano nkurow so di gua se, eyi ne asɛm a Otumfo Awurade ka:“ ‘Woka se, Tiro,“Me ho yɛ fɛ yiye.”
27.4: Wo tumidi wɔ po so akyirikyiri;wʼadansifo maa wʼahoɔfɛ wiee pɛyɛ.
27.5: Wo nnua a wɔpaee nyinaayɛ ɔpepaw a efi Senir.Wɔde Lebanon sidana ɛyɛɛ ahyɛn so nnua maa wo.
27.6: Odum nnua a efi Basanna wɔde yɛɛ wʼatabon;Kwabɔhɔre nnua a efi Kipro mpoanona wɔde yɛɛ wʼahyɛn abrannaa, a wɔde asonse asɛw so.
27.7: Misraim nwera papa bi a wɔadi mu adwinina wɔde yɛɛ wʼahyɛn so mframatama ɛyɛɛ wo frankaa nso;wʼapon ne mfɛnsere ano ntama yɛ abibitam ne beredum ntamaa efi Elisa mpoano.
27.8: Sidonfo ne Arwadfo na wɔhare wʼahyɛn;wo mmarima anyansafo. Tiro,na wɔyɛ adwumayɛfo wɔ wʼahyɛn mu.
27.9: Gebal adwumfo adedaw tenaa wʼahyɛn musɛ dua dwumfo a wotuatua ahyɛn no mu ntokuru.Po so ahyɛn ne wɔn hyɛnmufo nyinaabaa wo nkyɛn ne wo bedii nsesagua.
27.10: “ ‘Persia, Lidia ne Put mmarimasomee sɛ asraafo wɔ wo nsraadɔm mu.Wɔde wɔn nkatabo ne dade kyɛwsensɛn wʼafasu ho,de hyɛɛ wo anuonyam.
27.11: Arwad ne Helek mmarimawɛn wʼafasu ho nyinaaGammad mmarimatenaa wʼabantenten mu.Wɔde wɔn nkatabo sensɛn wʼafasu homaa wʼahoɔfɛ dii mu.
27.12: “ ‘Wʼaguade a ɛma wonyaa wo ho bebree nti, Tarsis ne wo dii gua, wɔde dwetɛ, dade, sanyaa ne sumpii sesaa wʼaguade.
27.13: “ ‘Helafo, Tubalfo ne Mesekfo ne wo dii gua, wɔde nkoa ne kɔbere nneɛma sesaa wʼaguade.
27.14: “ ‘Bet Togarma mmarima de adwumayɛ apɔnkɔ, ɔsa apɔnkɔ ne mfurum mma bɛsesaa wʼaguade.
27.15: “ ‘Roda mmarima ne wo dii gua, na mpoano nkurow bebree yɛɛ wʼadetɔfo a wɔde asonse ne duabo nnua tuaa wo ka.
27.16: “ ‘Aram ne wo dii gua esiane wo nneɛma bebrebe a woyɛ nti; wɔde nsrammabo, ntama a ɛberedum, nea wɔadi mu adwinni, nwera pa, nnɛnkyerema ne bota bɛsesaa wʼaguade.
27.17: “ ‘Yuda ne Israel ne wo dii gua; wɔde awi a efi Minit ne brodo, ɛwo, ngo ne ahyehyesrade sesaa wʼaguade.
27.18: “ ‘Damasko ne wo dii gua wɔ nsa a efi Helbon ne nguan ho nwi a efi Sahar mu, esiane nneɛma a woyɛ ne wʼaguade a ama woanya wo ho bebree no nti.
27.19: Danfo ne Helafo a wofi Usal tɔɔ wʼaguade na wɔde dade a wɔaboro, sesadua ne ahunuanyankwa sesaa wʼaguade.
27.20: “ ‘Dedan de apɔnkɔnguasotam ne wo dii gua.
27.21: “ ‘Arabfo ne Kedar mmapɔmma nyinaa yɛɛ wʼaguadifo a wɔde nguantenmma, adwennini ne mpapo ne wo dii gua.
27.22: “ ‘Seba ne Raama aguadifo ne wo dii gua; wɔde nnuhuam ahorow a ɛte apɔw, aboɔden abo ne sikakɔkɔɔ ne wo bedii nsesagua.
27.23: “ ‘Haran, Kan ne Eden, aguadifo a wofi Seba, Asur ne Kilmad ne wo dii gua.
27.24: Wo gua so hɔ, wɔde ntama a ɛyɛ fɛ, nnɛmmatam a ɛyɛ tuntum, adwinne ahorow ne ntama fɛfɛ a ɛwɔ ahosu ahorow a wɔde nhoma a wɔakyinkyim abobɔ no apɔwapɔw na ayɛ ne wo bedii gua.
27.25: “ ‘Tarsis ahyɛn yɛ adwumasɛ asoafo ma wʼaguade.Adesoa duruduru ayɛ wo mawɔ po no mfimfini.
27.26: Wʼaharefo no fa wode wo kɔ po so akyirikyirinanso apuei ahum bebubu wo mu nketenketewɔ po no mfimfini.
27.27: Wʼahonya, aguade ne adetɔnnnewʼahyɛn akwankyerɛfo, wʼahyɛn mufo newɔn a wotuatua wʼahyɛn mu ntokuru,wʼaguadifo ne wʼasraafo nyinaa,ne obiara a ɔwɔ hyɛn no mubɛmem akɔ po ase tɔnn,da a wo hyɛn no bɛbɔ.
27.28: Mpoano asase bɛwosowbere a wo hyɛn mufo no reteɛteɛ mu.
27.29: Wɔn a wokurakura atabon no nyinaabegyaw wɔn ahyɛn hɔ;hyɛn akwankyerɛfo ne hyɛn mufo nyinaabegyinagyina mpoano.
27.30: Wɔbɛma wɔn nne soasu osu yaayaw ama wo;wɔbɛpete mfutuma agu wɔn ti sona wɔayantayantam nsõ mu.
27.31: Wo nti wɔbɛbobɔ tikwawna wɔafurafura atweaatam.Wɔde ɔkra mu ahoyerawne awerɛhow a mu yɛ denbegyam wo.
27.32: Bere a wɔretwa adwo redi awerɛhow nowɔbɛma kwadwom bi a ɛfa wo ho so se:“Hena na wama no atɔ mumte sɛ Tiro a po atwa ne ho ahyia yi?”
27.33: Bere a wʼaguade kɔɔ po ahorow so nowoboaa aman bebree;Wʼahonyade ne wʼaguademaa asase so ahemfo nyaa wɔn ho.
27.34: Afei po abubu wo mu nketenketewɔ asu no bun muwʼaguade ne wʼadwumayɛfo nyinaane wo amem kɔ asu ase.
27.35: Wɔn a wɔtete mpoano nyinaaho adwiriw wɔn wɔ wo ho;ehu ma wɔn ahemfo ho popona wɔn anim sinsiam.
27.36: Aman no mu aguadifo bɔ ntwɔm gu wo sowoaba awiei a ɛyɛ huna wɔrenhu wo bio.’ ”

33.1: Ɔwɛmfo HesekielAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
33.2: “Onipa ba, kasa kyerɛ wo manmma na ka kyerɛ wɔn se: ‘Sɛ metwe mʼafoa wɔ asase bi so, na sɛ asase no so nnipa yi wɔn mmarima no mu baako sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔwɛmfo mma wɔn,
33.3: na ohu sɛ afoa reba abɛko atia asase no a, ɔhyɛn torobɛnto de bɔ nnipa no kɔkɔ.
33.4: Na sɛ obi te torobɛnto no nnyigyei na wanna ne ho so, na sɛ afoa no bekum no a, ne mogya bɛbɔ ɔno ankasa ti so.
33.5: Esiane sɛ ɔtee torobɛnto no nnyigyei na wantie kɔkɔbɔ no nti, ne mogya bɛbɔ nʼankasa ti so. Sɛ otiee kɔkɔbɔ no a, anka onyaa ne ti didii mu.
33.6: Nanso sɛ ɔwɛmfo no hu sɛ afoa no reba na wanhyɛn torobɛnto no ammɔ nnipa no kɔkɔ, na sɛ afoa no ba bekum wɔn mu baako a, wɔbɛfa saa onipa no akɔ wɔ ne bɔne nti, nanso mɛma ɔwɛmfo no abu owufo no mogya ho akontaa.’
33.7: “Onipa ba, mayɛ wo ɔwɛmfo ama Israelfi, ɛno nti tie mʼanom nsɛm na fa kɔkɔbɔ a efi me nkyɛn ma wɔn.
33.8: Sɛ meka kyerɛ omumɔyɛfo se, ‘Wo omumɔyɛfo, owu na wubewu,’ na sɛ woankasa ankyerɛ no amma wamfi nʼakwan so a, saa omumɔyɛfo no bewu ne bɔne mu, na mɛma woabu ne mogya ho akontaa.
33.9: Nanso sɛ wobɔ omumɔyɛfo no kɔkɔ sɛ omfi nʼakwan so na sɛ wanyɛ a, ne bɔne nti, obewu, nanso worenni ne mogya ho fɔ.
33.10: “Onipa ba, ka kyerɛ Israelfi se: ‘Sɛɛ ne nea moreka: “Yɛn mfomso ne yɛn nnebɔne hyɛ yɛn so, yɛresɛe, esiane eyinom nti. Na dɛn na yɛbɛyɛ na yɛanya nkwa?” ’
33.11: Ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛ mete ase yi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, mʼani nnye amumɔyɛfo wu ho, na mmom mepɛ sɛ wɔdan fi wɔn akwan so na wonya nkwa. Monnan! Monnan mfi mo amumɔyɛ akwan no so! Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ muwuwu, Israelfi?’
33.12: “Ɛno nti onipa ba, ka kyerɛ wo manmma se, ‘Ɔtreneeni trenee rentumi nnye no nkwa wɔ bere a ɔnyɛ osetie; na omumɔyɛfo amumɔyɛ remma ɔnhwe ase wɔ bere a ɔdan fi ho. Sɛ ɔtreneeni yɛ bɔne a, ɔrennya nkwa wɔ ne kan treneeyɛ nti.’
33.13: Sɛ meka kyerɛ ɔtreneeni sɛ obenya nkwa, na afei ɔde ne ho to ne treneeyɛ so na ɔyɛ bɔne a, wɔrenkae ne kan trenee nneyɛe biara. Obewu wɔ ne bɔne a wayɛ nti.
33.14: Na sɛ meka kyerɛ omumɔyɛfo se, ‘Owu na wubewu,’ na afei ɔdan fi ne nnebɔne ho na ɔyɛ nea eye na ɛteɛ,
33.15: na sɛ ɔsan de bosea ho awowaside ma, na ɔsan de nea wawia ma, na odi ahyɛde a ɛma nkwa so, na wanyɛ bɔne a, ampa ara obenya nkwa, na ɔrenwu.
33.16: Wɔrenkae bɔne a wayɛ no mu biara ntia no. Wayɛ nea eye na ɛteɛ, ampa ara obenya nkwa.
33.17: “Nanso wo manmma ka se, ‘Awurade akwan nteɛ.’ Nanso ɛyɛ wɔn akwan mmom na ɛnteɛ.
33.18: Sɛ ɔtreneeni fi ne trenee ho na ɔyɛ bɔne a, ɛno nti obewu.
33.19: Na sɛ omumɔyɛfo dan fi ne nnebɔne ho na ɔyɛ nea eye na ɛteɛ a, obenya nkwa.
33.20: Nanso Israelfi, moka se, ‘Awurade akwan nteɛ.’ Nanso mebu obiara atɛn sɛnea nʼakwan te.”
33.21: Wɔkyerɛ Yerusalem Asehwe AseYɛn asutwa afe a ɛto so dumien no sram a ɛto so du no nnaanum so, ɔbarima bi a waguan afi Yerusalem baa me nkyɛn bɛkae se, “Kuropɔn no ahwe ase!”
33.22: Na anwummere a ade rebɛkye ama ɔbarima no aba no, na Awurade nsa wɔ me so na obuee mʼano ansa na ɔbarima no baa anɔpa. Enti na mʼano abue a mitumi kasa.
33.23: Afei Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
33.24: “Onipa ba, nnipa a wɔtete saa nnwiriwii so wɔ Israel asase no so no reka se, ‘Abraham yɛ onipa baako, nanso onyaa asase no nyinaa. Nanso yɛdɔɔso, na nokware wɔde asase no ama yɛn sɛ yɛn agyapade.’
33.25: Ɛno nti, ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Sɛ mowe nam a mogya wɔ mu, mosom mo anyame na muhwie mogya gu nti, ɛsɛ sɛ mofa asase no ana?
33.26: Mode mo ho to mo afoa so. Moyɛ akyiwade na mo mu biara gu ne yɔnko yere ho fi. Ɛsɛ sɛ munya asase no ana?’
33.27: “Ka eyi kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nea Otumfo Awurade se ni: Ampa ara sɛ mete ase yi, wɔn a wɔaka wɔ kurow no nnwiriwii mu no bɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano. Wɔn a wɔwɔ wuram no mede wɔn bɛma nkekaboa ama wɔawe wɔn na wɔn a wɔwɔ abandennen ne abodan mu no, ɔyaredɔm bekunkum wɔn.
33.28: Mɛsɛe asase no ama ayɛ amamfo, na nʼahomaso ahoɔden no bɛba awiei na Israel mmepɔw no bɛda mpan a obiara rentwa mu wɔ hɔ.
33.29: Afei wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no, bere a mama asase no ada mpan wɔ akyiwade a wɔayɛ nyinaa nti.’
33.30: “Wo de, onipa ba, wo manmma reka wo ho nsɛm wɔ afasu ho ne afi apon ano kyerɛ wɔn ho wɔn ho se, ‘Mommra mmetie asɛm a efi Awurade nkyɛn aba.’
33.31: Me nkurɔfo ba wo nkyɛn, sɛnea wɔyɛ daa no, bɛtenatena wʼanim betie wo nsɛm, nanso wɔmmfa nyɛ adwuma. Wɔde wɔn ano ka ahofama, nanso wɔn koma mu de, wɔn ani bere asisi mu adenya.
33.32: Nokware, wɔn de, wote sɛ obi a ne nne yɛ dɛ, na ɔde nnwontode to ɔdɔ nnwom, efisɛ wɔte wo nsɛm nanso wɔmmfa nyɛ adwuma.
33.33: “Sɛ eyinom nyinaa ba mu a, na nokware ɛbɛba mu nso, na afei wobehu sɛ odiyifo bi baa wɔn mu.”

37.1: Obon Mu Nnompe A Ho AkokwawNa Awurade nsa wɔ me so na ɔde ne Honhom faa me fii adi de me besii obon no mfimfini, na nnompe ayɛ no ma.
37.2: Ɔde me dii akɔneaba wɔ mu na mihuu nnompe bebree wɔ obon no ase, nnompe a ɛho akokwaw.
37.3: Obisaa me se, “Onipa ba, saa nnompe yi betumi anya nkwa ana?”Mekae se, “Otumfo Awurade, wo nko ara na wunim.”
37.4: Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Hyɛ nkɔm wɔ nnompe yi ho na ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nnompe a mo ho akokwaw, muntie Awurade asɛm!
37.5: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade ka kyerɛ saa nnompe yi: Mɛma ɔhome aba mo mu na mubenya nkwa.
37.6: Mɛma ntin abesuso mo mu, na mede nam agu mo so na mede were akata mo ho. Mede ɔhome begu mo mu na moaba nkwa mu. Afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade.’ ”
37.7: Ɛno nti mehyɛɛ nkɔm sɛnea wɔhyɛɛ me no. Na migu so rehyɛ nkɔm no, nne bi bae, ɔwosow bi, na nnompe no keka bobɔɔ mu, dompe bɛkaa ne dompe ho.
37.8: Na mehwɛ huu sɛ ntin baa so, na nam baa ho na were bɛkataa so, nanso na ɔhome biara nni mu.
37.9: Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ me se: “Hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ home, hyɛ nkɔm, onipa ba na ka kyerɛ no se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Ɔhome fi mframa anan no mu bra bɛhome gu saa awufo yi mu na wonnya nkwa.’ ”
37.10: Enti mehyɛɛ nkɔm sɛnea ɔhyɛɛ me no, na ɔhome hyɛn wɔn mu; na nkwa baa wɔn mu ma wɔsɔre gyinagyinaa wɔn anan so, dɔm kɛse pa ara.
37.11: Afei ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Onipa ba, saa nnompe yi yɛ Israelfi nyinaa. Wɔka se: ‘Yɛn nnompe ho akokwaw na yɛn anidaso asa, wɔatwa yɛn agu korakora.’
37.12: Ɛno nti hyɛ nkɔm na ka kyerɛ wɔn se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Me nkurɔfo, merebebuebue mo nna na mayiyi mo afi mu apue. Mede mo bɛsan aba Israel asase so.
37.13: Afei mo, me nkurɔfo, sɛ mibuebue mo nna na miyiyi mo fi mu a, mubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
37.14: Mede me Honhom bɛhyɛ mo mu na mubenya nkwa, na mede mo bɛtena mo ankasa asase so. Afei mubehu sɛ me, Awurade na makasa na mayɛ nso, Awurade asɛm ni.’ ”
37.15: Ɔman Baako A Ɛhyɛ Ɔhene Baako AseAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
37.16: “Onipa ba, fa dua na kyerɛw ho se, ‘Yuda ne Israelfo a wɔka ne ho de.’ Afei fa dua foforo na kyerɛw ho se, ‘Efraim dua a ɛyɛ Yosef ne Israelfi a wɔka ne ho nyinaa de.’
37.17: Ka abien no bɔ mu na ɛnyɛ dua baako wɔ wo nsam.
37.18: “Sɛ wo nkurɔfo ka se, worenkyerɛ yɛn nea wode eyi kyerɛ ana a,
37.19: ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Merebɛfa Yosef dua a ɛhyɛ Efraim ne Israel mmusuakuw a wɔka ne ho no nsa, na mede abɔ Yuda dua no mu ayɛ abien no baako, na wɔbɛyɛ baako wɔ me nsam.’
37.20: Ma nnua a woakyerɛkyerɛw ho no so kyerɛ wɔn
37.21: na ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Meyi Israelfo afi amanaman a wɔakɔ so no so. Mɛboaboa wɔn ano afi mmaa nyinaa na mede wɔn asan aba wɔn ankasa asase so.
37.22: Mɛyɛ wɔn ɔman baako wɔ asase no so wɔ Israel mmepɔw so. Ɔhene baako bedi wɔn nyinaa so na wɔrenyɛ aman abien bio, na wɔrenkyɛ mu nyɛ wɔn ahenni abien.
37.23: Wɔremfa wɔn ahoni ne nsɛsode tantan no, anaasɛ wɔn nnebɔne no mu bi ngu wɔn ho fi bio, na megye wɔn nkwa afi wɔn akyirisan bɔne mu na mɛtew wɔn ho. Wɔbɛyɛ me nkurɔfo na mayɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn.
37.24: “ ‘Me somfo Dawid bedi wɔn so hene na wɔn nyinaa benya oguanhwɛfo baako. Wobedi me mmara so na wɔahwɛ mʼahyɛde ayɛ.
37.25: Wɔbɛtena asase a mede maa me somfo Yakob, asase a mo agyanom tenaa so. Wɔne wɔn mma ne wɔn mma mma bɛtena hɔ afebɔɔ, na me somfo Dawid bɛyɛ wɔn birɛmpɔn afebɔɔ.
37.26: Me ne wɔn bɛyɛ asomdwoe apam, ɛbɛyɛ apam a ɛte hɔ daa. Mɛma wɔatim na mama wɔadɔ na mede me kronkronbea besi wɔn mu afebɔɔ.
37.27: Me tenabea bɛwɔ wɔn mu, mɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn na wɔayɛ me nkurɔfo.
37.28: Afei amanaman no behu sɛ me Awurade, me na meyɛ Israel kronkron, bere a me kronkronbea si wɔn mu afebɔɔ no.’ ”

23.1: Nuabeanom Aguamammɔfo BaanuAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
23.2: “Onipa ba, mmea baanu a wɔyɛ ɔbea baako mma tenaa ase.
23.3: Wɔbɛyɛɛ aguamammɔfo wɔ Misraim, na wɔbɔɔ aguaman fii wɔn mmabaabere mu. Womiamiaa wɔn nufu, wɔberee wɔn mmabaabere mpokua wɔ asase no so.
23.4: Ɔpanyin no din de Ohola na ne nuabea no nso din de Oholiba. Na wɔyɛ me yerenom na wɔwowoo mmabarima ne mmabea. Ohola ne Samaria na Oholiba nso ne Yerusalem.
23.5: “Ohola da so ware me no, ɔbɔɔ aguaman; nʼani tu dii nʼapɛfo akyi, Asiriafo, akofo no
23.6: a wɔhyehyɛ ntade bibiri, amradofo ne asahene a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmerante a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ na wɔtena apɔnkɔ so.
23.7: Ɔne Asiriafo atitiriw bɔɔ aguaman, na ɔsom wɔn a ɔdɔɔ wɔn nyinaa ahoni de guu ne ho fi.
23.8: Wannyae nʼaguamammɔ a ofii ase wɔ Misraim no, bere a ɔyɛ ababaa na mmarima ne no dae, susoo ne mpokua mu na wohwiee wɔn akɔnnɔ guu ne so no.
23.9: “Ɛno nti mede no maa nʼadɔfo Asiriafo no a nʼani bere wɔn no.
23.10: Wɔbɔɔ no adagyaw, faa ne mmabarima ne ne mmabea kɔe, na wɔde afoa kum no. Ogyee ne din wɔ mmea mu na asotwe baa ne so.
23.11: “Ne nuabea Oholiba huu eyi nanso nʼakɔnnɔ bɔne ne nʼaguaman sen ne nuabea no de.
23.12: Ɔno nso dii Asiriafo no akyi; amradofo ne asahene, akofo a wɔhyehyɛ wɔn ntade, apɔnkɔsotefo a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmerante ahoɔfɛfo.
23.13: Mihuu sɛ ɔno nso guu ne ho fi, wɔn baanu faa ɔkwan koro so.
23.14: “Na ɔtoaa nʼaguamammɔ no so kɔɔ akyiri. Ohuu mmarima mfoni a wɔakurukyerɛw agu ɔfasu bi ho, Kaldeafo mfoni a wɔde adukɔkɔɔ akrukyerɛw
23.15: a abɔso bobɔ wɔn asen mu na abotiri bobɔ wɔn ti a wɔn nyinaa te sɛ Babilonia nteaseɛnam mu mpanyimfo a wofi Kaldea.
23.16: Ohuu saa mfoni yi, ne kɔn dɔɔ wɔn na ɔsomaa abɔfo kɔɔ wɔn nkyɛn wɔ Kaldea.
23.17: Na Babiloniafo no baa ne nkyɛn ne no bɛdaa ɔdɔ mpa so, na wɔn akɔnnɔ mu no, woguu ne ho fi. Woguu ne ho fi wiee no wɔn ho fonoo no enti ogyaa wɔn.
23.18: Ɔkɔɔ so wɔ nʼaguamammɔ mu, bɔɔ ne ho adagyaw no, migyaw no hɔ sɛnea migyaw ne nuabea no hɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.
23.19: Na ɔmaa nʼaguamammɔ no kɔɔ so ara de kaee ne mmabaabere a na ɔbɔ aguaman wɔ Misraim no.
23.20: Ɛhɔ na ɔne nʼadɔfo a wɔn barima te sɛ mfurum de na wɔn ho nsu te sɛ apɔnkɔ de no bɔɔ aguaman.
23.21: Na wo kɔn dɔɔ wo mmabun mu akɔnnɔ bɔne no, nea woyɛɛ wɔ Misraim a wɔsrasraa wo koko mu na womiamiaa wo mpokua no.
23.22: “Ɛno nti, Oholiba, sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mɛhwanyan wʼadɔfo atia wo, wɔn a wɔn ho fonoo wo ma wugyaw wɔn hɔ no; mede wɔn befi afanan nyinaa abetia wo.
23.23: Babiloniafo ne Kaldeafo nyinaa, Pekod, Soa ne Koa mmarima, Asiriafo no ne wɔn bɛba, mmerante ahoɔfɛfo a wɔn nyinaa yɛ amradofo, asahene, nteaseɛnam ho adwumayɛfo ne mmarima a wokura dibea akɛse a wɔn nyinaa tete apɔnkɔ so.
23.24: Wɔde akode, nteaseɛnam ahorow ne nnipadɔm bɛba abetia wo; wɔde akokyɛm akɛse ne nketewa ne dade kyɛw bɛka wo ahyɛ. Mede wo bɛhyɛ wɔn nsa, na wɔagyina wɔn nhyehyɛe so atwe wo aso.
23.25: Mɛdan me ninkunu abufuw no akyerɛ wo so, na wɔne wo bedi no anibere so. Wobetwitwa mo hwene ne mo aso, na wɔn a wɔbɛka no, wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano. Wɔbɛfa mo mmabarima ne mo mmabea akɔ, na mo a moaka no wɔde ogya ahyew mo.
23.26: Wɔbɛpa wo ho ntama nso na wɔafa wo nnwinne.
23.27: Ɛno nti mɛma wʼakɔnnɔ bɔne ne aguamammɔ a wufii ase wɔ Misraim no aba nʼawie. Wo kɔn rennɔ saa nneɛma yi, na worenkae Misraim bio.
23.28: “Na sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mede wo rebɛhyɛ wʼatamfo nsa, wɔn a wɔn ho fonoo wo ma wugyaw wɔn no.
23.29: Wɔde ɔtan ne wo bedi, na wɔafa nea woayɛ adwuma apɛ nyinaa. Wobegyaw wo adagyaw ne kwaterekwa, na wʼaguamammɔ ho aniwu no bɛda adi. Wʼaniwude ne wʼaguamansɛm no
23.30: na ɛde eyinom aba wo so, efisɛ wo kɔn dɔɔ amanaman no na wode wɔn ahoni guu wo ho fi.
23.31: Woayɛ nea wo nuabea yɛɛ no bi; na ɛno nti mede ne kuruwa bɛhyɛ wo nsa.
23.32: “Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se:“Wobɛnom wo nuabea kuruwa ano,kuruwa a ɛso na mu dɔ;ɛde fɛwdi ne ahohora bɛba,efisɛ nea ɛwɔ mu dɔɔso.
23.33: Nsabow ne awerɛhow bɛhyɛ wo ma,ɔsɛe ne asaworamto kuruwa no,wo nuabea Samaria kuruwa no bɛhyɛ wo ma.
23.34: Wobɛnom a hwee renka mu:na woawe nʼasinasin nona woasunsuan wo mpokua mu.Me na maka, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
23.35: “Ɛno nti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Esiane sɛ wo werɛ afi me, na woatow me akyene wʼakyi nti, ɛsɛ sɛ wunya wʼaniwude ne wʼaguamammɔ so akatua.”
23.36: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Onipa ba, wubebu Ohola ne Oholiba atɛn ana? Ɛno de, fa wɔn akyiwadeyɛ no si wɔn anim,
23.37: efisɛ wɔasɛe aware, na mogya wɔ wɔn nsa ho. Wɔde wɔn ahoni na ɛsɛee aware no; na mpo wɔde wɔn mma a wɔwoo wɔn maa me no bɔɔ afɔre maa wɔn sɛ wɔn aduan.
23.38: Wɔde eyi nso ayɛ me: Saa bere koro no ara mu, woguu me kronkronbea ne me homenna ho fi.
23.39: Da a wɔde wɔn mma bɔɔ afɔre maa wɔn ahoni no ara, wɔhyɛn me kronkronbea hɔ koguu ho fi. Eyi na wɔyɛɛ wɔ me fi.
23.40: “Wɔsomaa abɔfo kɔfrɛɛ mmarima a wofi akyirikyiri bae, na wobedui no, muguare, kekaa mo ani akyi, de mo adwinne hyehyɛɛ mo ho maa wɔn.
23.41: Motenaa akongua papa bi a wɔde ɔpon a wɔasɛw so asi anim, ɛso na mode nnuhuam ne ngo a anka ɛyɛ me de no sisii.
23.42: “Na hooyɛ a efi nnipakuw bi a hwee mfa wɔn ho atwa ne ho ahyia. Wɔde Sabeafo fi sare no so ne mmarima a wofi dɔm no mu bae, na wɔde nkapo hyehyɛɛ ɔbea no ne ne nua no nsa, na wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ahenkyɛw a ɛyɛ fɛ.
23.43: Na meka faa nea aguamammɔ ama watetew no ho se, ‘Momma wɔnnyɛ no sɛ oguamanfo, efisɛ saa ara pɛ na ɔte.’
23.44: Na wɔne no dae. Sɛnea mmarima ne oguamanfo da no, saa ara na wɔne saa mmea a wɔn ho yɛ aniwu no, Ohola ne Oholiba dae.
23.45: Nanso atemmufo atreneefo de asotwe a wɔde ma mmea a wɔsɛe aware na wɔka mogya gu no bɛma wɔn, efisɛ wɔyɛ nguamanfo na wɔn nsa ho wɔ mogya.
23.46: “Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Fa nnipadɔm bra betia wɔn na ma ahunahuna ne ɔfom mmra wɔn so.
23.47: Nnipakuw no besiw wɔn abo na wɔde wɔn afoa bɛtow ahyɛ wɔn so. Wobekunkum wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea na wɔahyew wɔn afi.
23.48: “Ɛno nti mɛma aniwu nneyɛe aba awiei wɔ asase no so na abɔ mmaa nyinaa kɔkɔ na wɔansua mo.
23.49: Wubenya wʼaniwude so asotwe na woanya abosonsom ho bɔne so akatua. Afei wubehu sɛ mene Otumfo Awurade no.”

22.1: Yerusalem NnebɔneAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
22.2: “Onipa ba, wubebu no atɛn ana? Wubebu saa mogyahwiegu kuropɔn yi atɛn ana? Ɛno de fa ne nneyɛe a ɛyɛ akyiwade no nyinaa si nʼanim
22.3: na ka se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Wo kuropɔn a ɔnam mogyahwiegu so de nnome aba ne ho so na ɔde ahoni a ɔyɛ agu ne ho fi,
22.4: woadi fɔ wɔ mogya a woahwie agu na woagu wo ho fi wɔ ahoni a woayɛ nti. Woama wo nna abɛn, na wo mfe awiei no aba. Enti mɛyɛ wo ahohorade wɔ amanaman no mu, ne akyiwade wɔ amantam no nyinaa mu.
22.5: Wɔn a wɔbɛn ne wɔn a wɔwɔ akyirikyiri bedi wo ho fɛw, wo Kuropɔn a wunni anuonyam, na basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma.
22.6: “ ‘Hwɛ sɛnea Israel mmapɔmma a wɔwɔ wo mu no mu biara de ne tumi hwie mogya gu.
22.7: Wɔabu agya ne ɛna animtiaa wɔ wo mu, wɔahyɛ ɔnanani so, na wɔatan ayisaa ne akunafo ani.
22.8: Woabu mʼakronkronne animtiaa na woagu me homenna ho fi.
22.9: Wo mu na mmarima ntwatosofo a wɔpɛ sɛ wohwie mogya gu wɔ, wɔn a wodidi wɔ sorɔnsorɔmmea abosonnan mu, na wɔyɛ ahohorade.
22.10: Wo mu na wɔn a wogu wɔn agyanom mpa ho fi wɔ; wɔn a wɔne mmea a wɔabu wɔn nsa, na wɔn ho ntew da no wɔ wo mu.
22.11: Wo mu na ɔbarima ne ne yɔnko yere yɛ bɔne a ɛyɛ akyiwade, ɔfoforo ne nʼasebea da wɔ animguase mu, na ɔfoforo ne ne nuabea da, ɔno ankasa nʼagya babea.
22.12: Wo mu na nnipa gye adanmude ka mogya gu; wogye nsiho ne mfaso a ɛboro so fi wɔn mfɛfo nkyɛn de nya wɔn ho bebree. Na mo werɛ afi me, Otumfo Awurade na ose.
22.13: “ ‘Ampa ara mɛbɔ me nsam agu wʼasisi ahonya ne mogya a woahwie agu no so.
22.14: Wʼakokoduru betumi agyina anaasɛ wo nsa bɛyɛ den da a mene wo benya no ana? Me Awurade na akasa, na mɛyɛ.
22.15: Mɛhwete wo mu agu amanaman no so, na mabɔ wo apansam amantam no mu; na mede wo afideyɛ aba nʼawie.
22.16: Sɛ wogu wo ho fi wɔ amanaman no mu a, wubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.’ ”
22.17: Afei, Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
22.18: “Onipa ba, Israelfi abɛyɛ dwetɛ ase fi ama me; wɔn nyinaa yɛ kɔbere, sanyaa, dade ne sumpii a wɔagyaw wɔ fononoo mu. Wɔyɛ dwetɛfi nko ara.
22.19: Ɛno nti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: ‘Esiane sɛ mo nyinaa abɛyɛ dwetɛfi nti, mɛboaboa mo ano wɔ Yerusalem.
22.20: Sɛnea nnipa boaboa dwetɛ, kɔbere, sumpii ne sanyaa ano hyɛ fononoo mu de ogyatannaa a ano yɛ den nan no, saa ara na mefi mʼabufuw ne mʼabufuwhyew mu aboaboa mo ano wɔ kuropɔn no mu na manan mo.
22.21: Mɛboaboa mo ano na mahuw mʼabufuwhyew gya agu mo so, na moanan wɔ ne mu.
22.22: Sɛnea wɔnan dwetɛ wɔ fononoo mu no, saa ara na mobɛnan wɔ ne mu na moahu sɛ me Awurade na mahwie mʼabufuwhyew agu mo so.’ ”
22.23: Na Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn bio se:
22.24: “Onipa ba, ka kyerɛ asase no se, ‘Woyɛ asase a wonnwiraa anaa osu ntɔɔ wo so wɔ abufuwhyew da no.’
22.25: Ne mmapɔmma abɔ pɔw bɔne wɔ ne mu te sɛ gyata a ɔbobɔ mu na ɔtetew ne hanam mu, wɔwe nnipa nam, wɔfa ademude ne nneɛma a ɛsom bo na wɔma akunafo dɔɔso wɔ ne mu.
22.26: Nʼasɔfo bu me mmara so na wogu mʼakronkronne ho fi; wɔnnkyerɛ nsonoe a ɛda nea ɛyɛ kronkron ne nea ɛnyɛ kronkron ntam; wɔkyerɛkyerɛ sɛ nsonoe biara nna nea ɛho ntew ne nea ɛho tew ntam, na wobu wɔn ani gu me homennadi so, de gu me ho fi wɔ wɔn mu.
22.27: Nʼadwumayɛfo te sɛ mpataku a wɔretetew wɔn hanam mu; wohwie mogya gu na wokum nnipa de pɛ mfaso bɔne.
22.28: Nʼadiyifo nam atoro anisoadehu ne nkontompo nkɔmhyɛ so ma saa nnebɔne yi yɛ fitaa. Wɔka se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se,’ wɔ bere a Awurade nkasaa ɛ.
22.29: Asase no so nnipa di amim na wɔbɔ korɔn; wɔhyɛ ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo so, wonnye ahɔho ani na wɔde atɛntrenee kame wɔn.
22.30: “Mehwehwɛɛ obi wɔ wɔn mu a ɔbɛto ɔfasu no na wagyina mʼanim wɔ asase no anan mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a merensɛe asase no, nanso manhu obiara.
22.31: Ɛno nti, mehwie mʼabufuwhyew agu wɔn so, na mede mʼabufuw a ɛyɛ hu no atɔre wɔn ase, na mama nea wɔayɛ nyinaa abɔ wɔn ti so, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.”

36.1: Israel Mmepɔw Ho Nkɔmhyɛ“Onipa ba, hyɛ nkɔm kyerɛ Israel mmepɔw na ka se: ‘Israel mmepɔw, muntie Awurade asɛm.
36.2: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Sɛɛ na ɔtamfo no ka faa wo ho, “Aaa! Tete sorɔnsorɔmmea no abɛyɛ yɛn dea.” ’
36.3: Ɛno nti, hyɛ nkɔm na ka se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Esiane sɛ wɔasɛe mo na wɔataataa mo wɔ afa nyinaa, na ɛno nti mobɛyɛɛ aman a aka no agyapade ne nnipa no ahohora nsɛnka ne atwetwesi,
36.4: ɛno nti, Israel mmepɔw, muntie Otumfo Awurade asɛm: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade ka kyerɛ mmepɔw ne nkoko, nsubon ne abon, nnwiriwii a ada mpan ne nea ayɛ amamfo, nkurow amamfo a wɔadwiriw agu na aman no nkae a atwa wɔn ho ahyia no di wɔn ho fɛw.
36.5: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mifi anem a emu yɛ den mu akasa atia amanaman a aka no ne Edom nyinaa, efisɛ wɔde fɛwdi ne adwemmɔne ayɛ me man wɔn agyapade, sɛnea wobetumi afom ne didibea.’
36.6: Ɛno nti, hyɛ nkɔm a ɛfa Israel asase ho, na ka kyerɛ mmepɔw ne nkoko, subon ne abon se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mede ninkutwe mu anibere kasa, efisɛ amanaman no abu wo animtiaa.
36.7: Enti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mema me nsa so ka ntam sɛ amanaman a atwa wo ho ahyia no nso, wobebu wɔn animtiaa.
36.8: “ ‘Nanso mo, Israel mmepɔw, mubenya mman, asow aba ama me nkurɔfo Israelfo, efisɛ ɛrenkyɛ wɔbɛba fie.
36.9: Mo ho hia me na mehu mo mmɔbɔ; wobefuntum mo na wɔadua mo so aba,
36.10: na mɛma wo so nnipa adɔɔso, Israelfi nyinaa mpo, nnipa bɛtena wo nkurow no so bio, na wobesisi nnwiriwii no nso.
36.11: Mɛma mmarima ne mmoa adɔɔso wɔ mo so na wɔbɛwowo na wɔadodɔ, mɛma nnipa atena wo mu te sɛ kan no na wɔbɛma woadi yiye asen kan no. Na afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
36.12: Mɛma nkurɔfo, me nkurɔfo Israelfo, anantew wo so. Wɔbɛfa wo na wobɛyɛ wɔn agyapade na woremma wonni mmakɔm bio.
36.13: “ ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Esiane sɛ nkurɔfo ka kyerɛ wo se, “Wukum nnipa we na woma wo man no hwere nʼadehye,”
36.14: ɛno nti worenkum nnipa nwe bio na woremma wo man nhwere nʼadehye bio, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
36.15: Meremma wonte amanaman no fɛwdi bio, na worenhu nkurɔfo no animtiaabu bio, na wo man nso renhwe ase bio, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.’ ”
36.16: Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
36.17: “Onipa ba, bere a Israelfo te wɔn ankasa asase so no, wɔde wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛe guu asase no ho fi. Na wɔn abrabɔ te sɛ ɔbea ɔsram-sram afide wɔ mʼani so.
36.18: Enti mihwiee mʼabufuwhyew guu wɔn so, efisɛ wɔahwie mogya agu asase no so na wɔde wɔn abosom agu hɔ fi.
36.19: Mebɔɔ wɔn ahwete wɔ amanaman mu, na wɔhwete faa amanaman mu; migyinaa wɔn abrabɔ ne wɔn nneyɛe so buu wɔn atɛn.
36.20: Na baabiara a wɔkɔɔ wɔ amanaman mu no, woguu me din kronkron ho fi, efisɛ wɔka faa wɔn ho se, ‘Eyinom yɛ Awurade nkurɔfo, nanso na ɛsɛ sɛ wofi nʼasase so.’
36.21: Me din kronkron ho hia me, nea Israelfi guu ho fi wɔ amanaman a wɔkɔɔ so mu no.
36.22: “Ɛno nti, ka kyerɛ Israelfi se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Israelfi, ɛnyɛ mo nti na merebɛyɛ saa nneɛma yi, na mmom me din kronkron no nti, nea muguu ho fi wɔ amanaman a mokɔɔ so mu no.
36.23: Mɛda me din kɛseyɛ no kronkronyɛ a moagu ho fi wɔ amanaman mu no adi, din a moagu ho fi wɔ wɔn mu no. Sɛ mefa wo so da me ho adi sɛ ɔkronkronni ma wohu a, afei amanaman no behu sɛ mene Awurade no, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
36.24: “ ‘Na meyi mo afi amanaman no mu, mɛboaboa mo ano afi nsase no nyinaa so de mo asan aba mo ankasa asase so.
36.25: Mede nsu kurunnyenn bɛpete mo so na mo ho atew: Mɛtew mo ho afi nkekae ne mo ahoni nyinaa ho.
36.26: Mɛma mo koma foforo na mede honhom foforo ahyɛ mo mu. Meyi koma a ɛte sɛ ɔbo no afi mo mu na mama mo koma foforo a ɛyɛ ɔhonam.
36.27: Na mede me Honhom bɛhyɛ mo mu na mama moadi mʼahyɛde so na moahwɛ adi me mmara so.
36.28: Mobɛtena asase a mede maa mo agyanom no so. Mobɛyɛ me nkurɔfo na mayɛ mo Nyankopɔn.
36.29: Mɛprapra mo ho fi nyinaa. Mɛma aduan aba ama abu so na meremma ɔkɔm mma mo so.
36.30: Mɛma nnua so aba ayɛ bebree na mfuw nso abɔ nnɔbae sɛnea ɔkɔm nti mo anim rengu ase bio wɔ amanaman no mu.
36.31: Afei mobɛkae mo akwammɔne ne mo amumɔyɛ, na mo bɔne ne akyiwade nti, mo ho bɛyɛ mo nwini.
36.32: Mepɛ sɛ muhu sɛ ɛnyɛ mo nti na mereyɛ eyi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni. Momfɛre na momma mo ani nwu wɔ mo abrabɔ ho Israelfi!
36.33: “ ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Da a mɛtew mo ho afi mo bɔne ho no, mɛma nnipa atena mo nkurow so bio na wobesisi nnwiriwii no bio.
36.34: Asase a ada mpan no, wobedua so nneɛma na ɛrenna hɔ kwa sɛnea na ɛte wɔ wɔn a na wotwa mu fa hɔ no ani so no.
36.35: Wɔbɛka se, “Saa asase a ada mpan yi ayɛ sɛ Eden turo, nkuropɔn a na adan nnwiriwii, ayɛ amamfo na asɛe yi, wɔabɔ ho ban na nnipa abɛtenatena mu.”
36.36: Afei aman a aka a atwa mo ho ahyia no behu sɛ me Awurade makyekyere nea na asɛe na madua wɔ nea na ada mpan so, me Awurade na maka na mɛyɛ.’
36.37: “Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Metie Israelfi abisade na mayɛ eyi ama wɔn; Mɛma wɔn nkurɔfo adɔɔso sɛ nguan,
36.38: wɔbɛdɔɔso sɛ nguankuw a wɔde wɔn kɔ Yerusalem sɛ afɔrebɔde wɔ nʼafahyɛnna. Saa ara na nnipa dodow bɛhyɛ nkuropɔn a adwiriw no so ma. Afei wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no.”

20.1: Otuatewfo IsraelAfe a ɛto so ason no, ɔsram anum no da a ɛto so du no, Israel mpanyimfo no mu bi bebisaa Awurade hɔ ade, na wɔtenatenaa mʼanim.
20.2: Na Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
20.3: “Onipa ba, kasa kyerɛ Israel mpanyimfo no se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Moaba sɛ morebebisa me nkyɛn ade ana? Sɛ mete ase yi, meremma mo kwan ma mummisa me nkyɛn mmoa, Otumfo Awurade na ose.’
20.4: “Bu wɔn atɛn. Bu wɔn atɛn, onipa ba. Fa wɔn agyanom akyiwade a wɔyɛɛ no si wɔn anim
20.5: na ka kyerɛ wɔn se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Da a miyii Israel no, memaa me nsa so kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Yakobfi asefo, na miyii me ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn wɔ Misraim. Memaa me nsa so ka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn.”
20.6: Saa da no, mekaa wɔn ntam se meyi wɔn afi Misraim na mede wɔn aba asase a mahwehwɛ ama wɔn, asase a ɛwo ne nufusu sen wɔ so, asase nyinaa mu nea ɛyɛ papa pa ara no.
20.7: Na meka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Mo mu biara ntow nsɛsode tantan a mode mo ani asi so no nkyene na mommfa Misraim ahoni no ngu mo ho fi, mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn.”
20.8: “ ‘Nanso wɔyɛɛ dɔm tiaa me na wɔantie me; Wɔantotow nsɛsode tantan no a wɔde wɔn ani asi so no angu na wɔannyae ahoni a efi Misraim no akyidi. Enti mekaa se mehwie mʼabufuwhyew agu wɔn so de awie mʼabufuw wɔ wɔn so wɔ Misraim.
20.9: Nanso me din nti meyɛɛ nea ɛremma wonngu me ho fi wɔ amanaman a wɔtete mu no anim, aman a miyii me ho adi kyerɛɛ Israelfo wɔ mu, de yii wɔn fii Misraim no.
20.10: Enti midii wɔn anim fii Misraim, de wɔn baa sare no so.
20.11: Mede me nhyehyɛe maa wɔn na mema wohuu me mmara, efisɛ obiara a odi so no nam so benya nkwa.
20.12: Na mede me homenna maa wɔn sɛ ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne wɔ yɛn ntam, sɛnea wobehu sɛ me Awurade na meyɛɛ wɔn kronkron no.
20.13: “ ‘Nanso Israelfo tew mʼanim atua wɔ sare no so. Wɔanni me nhyehyɛe so, na wɔpoo me mmara no, nanso onipa a obedi so no benya nkwa wɔ wɔn mu, na woguu me homenna ho fi koraa. Enti mekaa se mehwie mʼabufuwhyew agu wɔn so na masɛe wɔn wɔ sare no so.
20.14: Nanso me din nti, meyɛɛ nea ɛremma ho kwan ma wonngu me ho fi wɔ amanaman a miyii wɔn fii so no ani so.
20.15: Afei memaa me nsa so kaa ntam wɔ sare no so sɛ meremfa wɔn nnkɔ asase a mede ama wɔn no so, asase a ɛwo ne nufusu sen wɔ so, nsase nyinaa mu nea eye pa ara no,
20.16: efisɛ wɔpoo me mmara, wɔanni mʼahyɛde so na woguu me homenna ho fi, esiane sɛ na wɔn koma da wɔn ahoni no so nti.
20.17: Nanso mihuu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na mansɛe wɔn na mantɔre wɔn ase wɔ sare no so.
20.18: Meka kyerɛɛ wɔn mma wɔ sare no so se, “Munnni mo agyanom ahyɛde ne wɔn mmara so, na mommfa wɔn ahoni ngu mo ho fi.
20.19: Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn; munni mʼahyɛde so na monhwɛ yiye nni me mmara so.
20.20: Monyɛ me homenna kronkron na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne wɔ me ne mo ntam. Afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn no.”
20.21: “ ‘Nanso mma no yɛɛ dɔm tiaa me. Wɔanni mʼahyɛde so, na wɔanhwɛ anni me mmara so; nea onipa di so a obenya nkwa no, woguu me homenna ho fi. Enti mekaa se mehwie mʼabufuwhyew agu wɔn so de awie mʼabufuw a etia wɔn wɔ sare no so no.
20.22: Nanso metwentwɛn so, na me din nti, meyɛɛ nea ɛremma ho ngu fi wɔ aman a miyii wɔn fii so no ani so.
20.23: Memaa me nsa so kaa ntam wɔ sare no so se mɛhwete wɔn wɔ amanaman no so na mabɔ wɔn apansam wɔ nsase no so,
20.24: efisɛ wɔanni me mmara so, na mmom wɔpoo mʼahyɛde guu me homenna ho fi, na wɔn ani kodii wɔn agyanom ahoni akyi.
20.25: Enti memaa wɔn ahyɛde a enye ne mmara a ɛde asotwe mmom na ɛbɛba wɔn so, na ɛnyɛ nkwa;
20.26: memaa ho kwan ma wɔde wɔn ayɛyɛde a ɛyɛ wɔn abakan bɔɔ afɔre de guu wɔn ho fi, sɛnea mede ahodwiriw bɛhyɛ wɔn ma ama wɔahu sɛ mene Awurade.’
20.27: “Enti onipa ba, kasa kyerɛ Israelfo, ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Nea Otumfo Awurade se ni: Na eyi mu nso, mo agyanom poo me na wɔnam so kaa abususɛm tiaa me:
20.28: Mede wɔn baa asase a maka ntam sɛ mede bɛma wɔn no so no, wɔbɔɔ afɔre, yɛɛ afɔrebɔde maa koko biara a ɛkorɔn anaa dua biara a ɛso wɔ nhaban de hyɛɛ me abufuw; wɔde nnuhuam mae, na wohwiee ahwiesa maa wɔn.
20.29: Na mibisaa wɔn se: Ɛhe ne saa sorɔnsorɔmmea a mokɔ hɔ yi?’ ” (Wɔfrɛ hɔ Bama de besi nnɛ.)
20.30: Otuatewfo Israel Gye“Enti ka kyerɛ Israelfi se: ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mubegu mo ho fi sɛnea mo agyanom yɛe, na mo kɔn dɔ wɔn ahoni atantan no ana?
20.31: Sɛ mode mo ayɛyɛde a ɛyɛ mo mmabarima bɔ afɔre wɔ ogya so ma mo ahoni a, na mokɔ so de mo ahoni nyinaa gu mo ho fi besi nnɛ. Memma mommebisa me hɔ ade ana, Israelfi? Ampa ara sɛ mete ase yi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, meremma mummmisa me hɔ ade.
20.32: “ ‘Moka se, “Yɛpɛ sɛ yɛyɛ sɛ aman no, te sɛ wiasefo a wɔsom nnua ne abo no.” Nanso nea ɛwɔ mo adwene mu no rensi da.
20.33: Sɛ mete ase yi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, Mede nsa a ɛyɛ den, basa a wɔateɛ mu ne abufuwhyew a wɔahwie agu bedi mo so.
20.34: Mede mo befi amanaman no so, na maboaboa mo ano afi nsase a wɔapete mo wɔ so no so; mede nsa a ɛyɛ den ne abasa a wɔateɛ mu ne abufuwhyew a wɔahwie agu na ɛbɛyɛ.
20.35: Mede mo bɛba amanaman no sare so, na hɔ na mebu mo atɛn anim ne anim.
20.36: Sɛnea mibuu mo agyanom atɛn wɔ Misraim sare so no, saa ara na mebu mo atɛn, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
20.37: Mɛma moafa mʼabaa no ase na mahu mo yiye na mede mo aba apam no nkyehama ase.
20.38: Mɛsa mo mu ayi wɔn a wɔyɛ dɔm tia me. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ meyi wɔn afi aman a wɔte so no mu, nanso wɔn anan rensi Israel asase so. Afei mubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
20.39: “ ‘Na mo de, Israelfi, sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mo mu biara nkɔsom nʼahoni! Nanso akyiri no, mubetie me na moremfa mo ayɛyɛde ne ahoni ngu me din kronkron ho fi bio.
20.40: Efisɛ me bepɔw kronkron no so, Israel bepɔw a ɛkorɔn no so, Otumfo Awurade na ose, hɔ wɔ asase no so na Israelfi nyinaa bɛsom me, na hɔ na mobɛsɔ mʼani. Ɛhɔ na mehia mo afɔrebɔde ne mo ayɛyɛde a edi mu no, aka mo afɔre kronkron no nyinaa ho.
20.41: Sɛ miyi mo fi amanaman no mu na meboaboa mo ano fi nsase a wɔbɔɔ mo petee so no so a, mobɛsɔ mʼani sɛ kurobow a eyi hua, afei mɛda me kronkronyɛ adi wɔ mo mu ama amanaman no ahu.
20.42: Sɛ mede mo ba Israel asase a memaa me nsa so kaa ntam sɛ mede bɛma mo agyanom no so a, na mubehu sɛ mene Awurade.
20.43: Ɛhɔ no, mobɛkae mo suban ne nneyɛe nyinaa a mode agu mo ho fi, na mo ho bɛyɛ mo nwini esiane amumɔyɛ a moayɛ no nyinaa nti.
20.44: Mubehu sɛ mene AWURADE no, bere a me ne mo di no sɛnea me din te na mmom ɛnyɛ sɛnea mo akwammɔne ne mo porɔwee nneyɛe no te, mo Israelfo, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.’ ”
20.45: Atemmu A Etia Anafo FamAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
20.46: “Onipa ba fa wʼani kyerɛ anafo fam, ka asɛm tia anafo fam na hyɛ nkɔm tia kwae a ɛwɔ anafo fam asase so.
20.47: Ka kyerɛ anafo fam kwae no se: ‘Tie Awurade asɛm. Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Merebɛto wo mu gya, na ɛbɛhyew nnua a ɛwɔ wo so nyinaa: Nea ɛyɛ amono ne nea awo. Wɔrennum ogyaframa no na ɛbɛhyew asase no ani nyinaa; efi anafo fam kosi atifi fam.
20.48: Obiara behu sɛ me Awurade na masɔ ogya no ano; ɛrennum.’ ”
20.49: Afei mekae se, “Aa, Otumfo Awurade! Wɔka fa me ho se, ‘Ɛnyɛ mmɛ na ɔrebu yi ana?’ ”

34.1: Nguanhwɛfo Ne NguanAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
34.2: “Onipa ba, hyɛ nkɔm tia Israel nguanhwɛfo: hyɛ nkɔm na ka kyerɛ wɔn se: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Nnome nka Israel nguanhwɛfo a wɔhwɛ wɔn ankasa nko ara so. Ɛnsɛ sɛ nguanhwɛfo hwɛ nguankuw no ana?
34.3: Monom nufusu, mode mmoa no ho nwi fura mo ho na mukum mmoa a wɔadodɔ nanso monhwɛ nguankuw no.
34.4: Monhyɛɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛw no den, nsaa ayarefo yare na monkyekyeree apirafo akuru. Momfaa wɔn a wɔabɔ ko mmae, na monhwehwɛɛ wɔn a wɔayera. Mode ɔhyɛ ne atirimɔden na ahwɛ wɔn so.
34.5: Ɛno nti wɔbɔ ahwete, efisɛ wonni ɔhwɛfo bi, na wɔbɔ ahwete no, wɔbɛyɛɛ hanam maa wuram mmoa nyinaa.
34.6: Me nguan kyinkyin mmepɔw ne nkoko nyinaa so. Wɔbɔɔ wɔn petee asase so baabiara, na obiara anhwehwɛ wɔn.
34.8: Nokware, sɛ mete ase yi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, esiane sɛ me nguankuw nni ɔhwɛfo nti wɔawiawia wɔn na wɔayɛ hanam ama wuram mmoa, na esiane sɛ nguanhwɛfo no anhwehwɛ me nguan no na mmom wɔhwɛɛ wɔn ankasa ho na wɔtoo me nguan no asaworam
34.10: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Me ne nguanhwɛfo no anya na mɛma wɔabu me nguankuw no ho akontaa. Meremma wɔnhwɛ nguankuw no bio sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔrenkum nguan no nnwe; megye me nguankuw afi wɔn anom na wɔrenyɛ wɔn aduan bio.
34.11: “ ‘Na sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Me ara mɛhwehwɛ me nguan na mahwɛ wɔn so.
34.12: Sɛnea oguanhwɛfo hwɛ ne nguan a wɔahwete bere a ɔwɔ wɔn nkyɛn no, saa ara na mɛhwɛ me nguan so. Meyi wɔn afi mmeae a wɔhwete kɔɔ wɔ omununkum ne sum kabii da no.
34.13: Mede wɔn befi amanaman so aba na maboaboa wɔn ano afi nsase so na mede wɔn aba wɔn ankasa asase so. Mɛma wɔadidi wɔ Israel mmepɔw so, subon ne asase no so atenae nyinaa.
34.14: Mehwɛ wɔn so wɔ adidibea papa, na Israel mmepɔw atenten so bɛyɛ wɔn adidibea. Ɛhɔ na wɔbɛdeda adidibea asase papa so, na hɔ na wɔbɛwe sare frɔmfrɔm wɔ Israel mmepɔw so.
34.15: Me ara mɛhwɛ me nguan na mama wɔadeda hɔ. Awurade asɛm ni.
34.16: Mɛhwehwɛ nea wayera na mede nea wabɔ ko asan aba. Mɛkyekyere nea wapira no akuru, na mahyɛ nea ɔyɛ mmerɛw no den, nanso nea wadɔ ne nea ne ho yɛ den no, mɛsɛe wɔn. Mede trenee bɛhwɛ nguankuw no.
34.17: “ ‘Na mo, me nguankuw, sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Mebu oguan baako ne ɔfoforo ntam atɛn ne mpapo ne adwennini ntam.
34.18: Adidibea papa a mudidi so no, ɛyɛ ade ketewa ma mo ana? Ɛsɛ sɛ mode mo anan tiatia mo adidibea a aka no nso so ana? Ɛnsɔ mo ani sɛ monom nsu a ani yɛ kurunnyenn ana? Ɛsɛ sɛ mode mo anan fono nkae no ana?
34.19: Ɛsɛ sɛ me nguankuw di nea moatiatia so na wɔnom nea mode mo anan afon ana?
34.20: “ ‘Ɛno nti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade ka kyerɛ wɔn: Monhwɛ, me ara mebu nguan a wɔadodɔ ne nguan a wɔafonfɔn ntam atɛn.
34.21: Esiane sɛ, mode mo nkyɛn mu ne mmati puapua nguan a wonni ahoɔden na mode mo mmɛn pempem wɔn kosi sɛ mobɛpam wɔn akɔ akyirikyiri nti,
34.22: megye me nguankuw na wɔremfom wɔn bio. Mebu oguan baako ne ɔfoforo ntam atɛn.
34.23: Mɛma oguanhwɛfo baako, me somfo Dawid, ahwɛ wɔn so, na ɔbɛyɛn wɔn na wayɛ wɔn hwɛfo.
34.24: Na me, Awurade, mɛyɛ wɔn Nyankopɔn na me somfo Dawid ayɛ wɔn mu obirɛmpɔn. Me Awurade na maka.
34.25: “ ‘Me ne wɔn bɛyɛ asomdwoe apam na matɔre nkekaboa ase wɔ asase no so sɛnea wobetumi atena sare so na wɔadeda kwae mu asomdwoe mu.
34.26: Mehyira wɔn ne mmeae a atwa me pampa ho ahyia. Mɛtɔ obosu wɔ ne bere mu, na ɛbɛyɛ nhyira bosu.
34.27: Mfuw so nnua bɛsow wɔn aba na asase no nso abɔ nʼaduan. Nnipa no bɛtena wɔn asase so dwoodwoo. Mibubu wɔn konnua na migye wɔn fi wɔn a wɔde wɔn yɛɛ nkoa nsam a wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
34.28: Amanaman no remfow wɔn bio, na wuram mmoa nso renkyere wɔn nnwe. Wɔbɛtena asomdwoe mu na obiara renhunahuna wɔn.
34.29: Na mɛma wɔn asase a ɛsow nnɔbae ama agye din, na aduankɔm renne wɔn wɔ asase no so na wɔrenyɛ ahohora mma amanaman no.
34.30: Afei wobehu sɛ me Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn ne wɔn wɔ hɔ, na wɔn, Israelfi, yɛ me nkurɔfo; Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.
34.31: Mo, me nguan, mʼadidibea nguan yɛ me nkurɔfo, na mene mo Nyankopɔn, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.’ ”

35.1: Nkɔmhyɛ A Etia EdomAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
35.2: “Onipa ba, fa wʼani kyerɛ Bepɔw Seir; hyɛ nkɔm tia no,
35.3: na ka se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Me ne wo anya, Bepɔw Seir, na mɛteɛ me basa atia wo na mɛma wo ada mpan.
35.4: Mɛdan wo nkurow ama ayɛ mmubui na wobɛda mpan. Afei wubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
35.5: “ ‘Esiane sɛ wode tete nitan hyɛɛ wo mu na wuyii Israelfo maa afoa wɔ wɔn amanehunu mu, bere a wɔn asotwe duu ne mpɔmpɔnso no
35.6: nti, sɛ mete ase yi de, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, mede wo bɛma mogyahwiegu na ebedi wʼakyi. Esiane sɛ woansuro mogyahwiegu no nti, mogyahwiegu bɛtaa wo.
35.7: Mɛma bepɔw Seir ada mpan, na mayi wɔn a wodi so akɔneaba no afi hɔ.
35.8: Mede atɔfo bɛhyɛ wo mmepɔw so ma; wɔn a wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano bɛtotɔ ase wɔ wo nkoko so, aku mu ne wo subon mu.
35.9: Mɛma woada mpan afebɔɔ, na obiara rentena wo nkurow so. Afei wubehu sɛ mene Awurade no.
35.10: “ ‘Woaka se, “Saa aman abien ne nsase yi bɛyɛ yɛn dea, na yɛbɛfa,” wɔ bere a me Awurade mete hɔ;
35.11: enti sɛ mete ase yi, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni, me ne wo bedi no sɛnea abufuw ne ninkunu a wodaa no adi wɔ ɔtan a wotan wɔn no mu no te, na mɛda me ho adi wɔ wɔn mu, bere a mebu wo atɛn.
35.12: Afei wubehu sɛ me Awurade, mate animtiaabu nsɛm a woaka atia Israel mmepɔw no. Wokae se, “Wɔama ada mpan na wɔadan ama yɛn sɛ yɛmfa.”
35.13: Mohoahoaa mo ho tiaa me na mokasa tiaa me a moanto sɛbe, na metee.
35.14: Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Bere a wiase nyinaa redi ahurusi no, mɛma wo ada mpan.
35.15: Sɛnea wudii ahurusi bere a Israelfi agyapade daa mpan no, saa ɔkwan no na mede wo bɛfa so. Wobɛda mpan, Bepɔw Seir, wo ne Edom nyinaa. Afei wobehu sɛ mene Awurade no.’ ”

21.1: Babilonia, Onyankopɔn Atemmu AfoaAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se
21.2: “Onipa ba, fa wʼani kyerɛ Yerusalem na kasa tia kronkronbea no. Hyɛ nkɔm tia Israel asase
21.3: na ka kyerɛ no se: ‘Sɛɛ na Awurade se: Me ne wo anya. Mɛtwe mʼafoa afi ne boha mu de ayi atreneefo ne amumɔyɛfo afi mo mu.
21.4: Esiane sɛ merebeyi atreneefo ne amumɔyɛfo afi mo mu nti, mʼafoa befi ne boha mu atia obiara, fi anafo fam kosi atifi fam.
21.5: Afei nnipa nyinaa behu sɛ me Awurade matwe mʼafoa afi ne boha mu na ɛrensan bio.’
21.6: “Enti si apini, onipa ba! Fa koma a abubu ne awerɛhow a ano yɛ den si apini wɔ wɔn anim.
21.7: Na sɛ wobisa wo se, ‘Adɛn nti na woresi apini a?’ Wobɛka se, ‘Ɛyɛ asɛm a ɛreba no nti. Koma biara bɛbotow na nsa biara mu agugow, honhom biara bɛtɔ beraw na kotodwe biara bɛpopo.’ Ɛreba, ɔkwan biara so ɛbɛba, Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.”
21.8: Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
21.9: “Onipa ba, hyɛ nkɔm na ka se, ‘sɛɛ na Awurade se:“ ‘Afoa bi, afoa bi,wɔasew ano, atwiw ho,
21.10: wɔasew ano ama akunkumakunkum no,wɔatwiw ho ma etwa yerɛw yerɛw sɛ anyinam!“ ‘Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛsɛpɛw yɛn ho wɔ me babarima Yuda ahempema ho ana? Afoa no mfa pema biara a ɛte saa no nyɛ hwee.
21.11: “ ‘Wɔayi afoa no asi hɔ sɛ wontwitwiw ho,sɛ wɔmfa nsa nkura mu;wɔasew ano, atwiw ho,ayɛ no krado ama owudifo no.
21.12: Su na twa adwo, onipa ba,efisɛ etia me nkurɔfo;etia Israel mmapɔmma nyinaa.Wɔagyaa wɔn ama afoa noaka me nkurɔfo ho.Enti fa wo nsa gu wo ti so.
21.13: “ ‘Sɔhwɛ bɛba ampa ara. Na sɛ Yuda ahempema a afoa no mfa no nyɛ hwee no nni hɔ a dɛn na wɔbɛyɛ? Otumfo Awurade asɛm ni.’
21.14: “Enti onipa ba, hyɛ nkɔmna bɔ wo nsam.Ma afoa no ntwitwa mprenu,mpo mprɛnsa.Ɛyɛ akunkumakunkum afoa,akunkumakunkum kɛse no afoa,a ɛba wɔn so fi afanan nyinaa.
21.15: Ɛbɛma koma nyinaa abotowna atɔfo adɔɔso,mede akunkumakunkum afoa no asisiwɔn apon nyinaa ano.Hwɛ! Wɔatono no sɛ entwa yerɛw yerɛw sɛ anyinam,wɔaso mu ama akunkumakunkum.
21.16: Wo afoa, twa kɔ nifa,na twa kɔ benkum,nea wo dade bɛfa biara.
21.17: Me nso, mɛbɔ me nsam,na mʼabufuwhyew ano bedwoMe Awurade na makasa no.”
21.18: Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se:
21.19: “Onipa ba, bɔ akwan abien na Babiloniahene afoa no mfa so, na ne abien no nyinaa mfi ase wɔ ɔman koro mu. Fa akwankyerɛde si nkwanta a ɛman kɔ kuropɔn no mu no so.
21.20: Bɔ ɔkwan baako a afoa no bɛfa so ako atia Amonfo Raba ne baako nso a ebetia Yuda ne Yerusalem a wɔabɔ ho ban no.
21.21: Na Babiloniahene begyina akwan abien no nkwanta so ahwehwɛ nkɔmhyɛ, ɔde agyan bɛbɔ ntonto, akɔ abisa wɔ nʼahoni nkyɛn, na wahwɛ mmrɛbo mu.
21.22: Ne nsa nifa mu na ntonto a ɛbɛbɔ Yerusalem no bɛkɔ, na hɔ na wɔbɛhyehyɛ oburuw adwennini, de ama okum kɛse no. Afei wɔde osebɔ bɛma oburuw nnua no so apempem apon no, wɔbɛyɛ mpempe na wɔasisi pampim.
21.23: Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ atoro nkɔm ama wɔn a wɔne no ayɛ apam, nanso ɔbɛkaakae wɔn afɔdi na wafa wɔn nnommum.
21.24: “Enti sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: ‘Esiane sɛ mo saa nkurɔfo yi nam mo atuatew so akae me mo afɔdi, de ada mo bɔne a moyɛ nyinaa adi, sɛ moayɛ eyi nti, wɔbɛfa mo nnommum.
21.25: “ ‘Wo ɔkɔntɔnkye ne Israel hene ba otirimɔdenfo a wo da adu, wo a wʼasotwe bere adu ne mpɔmpɔnso,
21.26: sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade se: Tu abotiri no, yi ahenkyɛw no. Ɛrenyɛ sɛnea na ɛte kan no: Wɔbɛma nea abrɛ ase no so; nea ama ne ho so nso, wɔabrɛ no ase.
21.27: Ɔsɛe! Ɔsɛe! Mɛyɛ no ɔsɛe! Ɛrensi ne dedaw mu bio kosi sɛ ɔbɛba nea ɛyɛ ne de no nkyɛn, ɔno na mede bɛma no.’
21.28: “Na wo, onipa ba, hyɛ nkɔm ka se, ‘Sɛɛ na Otumfo Awurade ka fa Amonfo ne wɔn ahohorabɔ ho:“ ‘Afoa bi, afoa bi,wɔatwe ama akunkumakunkum,wɔatwiw ho sɛ enni namna ɛmpa yerɛw yerɛw sɛ anyinam!
21.29: Atoro anisoadehune nkontompo nkonyaa a ɛfa wo ho akyi nowɔde bɛto wɔn kɔn muamumɔyɛfo a ɛsɛ sɛ wokum wɔn no,wɔn a wɔn da no adu so,ne wɔn a wɔn asotwe bereadu ne mpɔmpɔnso no.
21.30: “ ‘San fa afoa no hyɛ ne boha muwɔ faako a wɔbɔɔ wo hɔwɔ wo nananom asase so,mebu wo atɛn.
21.31: Mehwie mʼabufuwhyew agu wo sona mahome mʼabufuw a ɛyɛ hu atia wo;Mede wo bɛhyɛ mmarima atirimɔdenfo nsa,wɔn a wɔwɔ adesɛe ho nyansa.
21.32: Wobɛyɛ nnyansin ama ogya,wɔbɛka wo mogya agu wɔ wʼasase so,na wɔrenkae wo bio;me Awurade na makasa.’ ”

10.1: Dwom Adɛn, Awurade, na wugyina akyirikyiri saa?Adɛn na wode wo ho ahintaw wɔ amanehunu mmere mu yi?
10.2: Omumɔyɛfo de ahantan taataa mmɔborɔfo,wɔn a ne nneyɛe mfiri yiyi wɔn no.
10.3: Ɔde nea ne koma hwehwɛ hoahoa ne ho;ohyira odifudepɛfo na oyi Awurade ahi.
10.4: Ahantan nti omumɔyɛfo nhwehwɛ Awurade;ne nsusuwii mu no Onyankopɔn nsi hwee.
10.5: Nʼakwan nyinaa mu odi yiye;ɔma ne ho so, na wo mmara mfa no ho;na odi nʼatamfo nyinaa ho fɛw.
10.6: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se: “Hwee remma minhinhim;mʼani begye daa, na merenkɔ amanehunu mu da.”
10.7: Nnome, atoro ne ahunahuna ahyɛ nʼanom ma;Ɔhaw ne mmusu hyɛ ne tɛkrɛma ase.
10.8: Ɔtɛw bɛn nkuraa no;ofi ahintawee kum nea onnim hwee,ohintaw hwɛ wɔn a ɔrehwehwɛ wɔn ayɛ wɔn bɔne no.
10.9: Ɔte sɛ gyata a wahintaw;ɔtɛw sɛ ɔbɛkyere mmɔborɔni;ɔkyere wɔn twe wɔn ase de wɔn kɔ ne bon mu.
10.10: Ɔdwerɛw wɔn a ɔkyere wɔn no ma wɔtɔ beraw;na ɔde nʼahoɔden ka wɔn hyɛ.
10.11: Ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se, “Onyankopɔn werɛ afi;wayi nʼani afi so na onhu.”
10.12: Sɔre, Awurade! Ma wo nsa so, Onyankopɔn.Mma wo werɛ mfi wɔn a wonni aboafo.
10.13: Adɛn nti na omumɔyɛfo yi Onyankopɔn ahi?Adɛn nti na ɔka kyerɛ ne ho se,“Ɔremfrɛ me akontaabu so?”
10.14: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wuhu amanehunufo haw;na wayɛ wʼadwene sɛ wobɛhwɛ.Mmɔborɔni de ne ho ma wo;wo na woyɛ ayisaa boafo.
10.15: Bubu omumɔyɛfo ne ɔbɔnefo aprɛw;frɛ no na ommebu nʼamumɔyɛ ho nkontaa,nʼamumɔyɛ a anka wɔrenhu no.
10.16: Awurade yɛ ɔhene daa nyinaa;amanaman no bɛyera nʼasase so.
10.17: Awurade, wutie mmɔborɔfo adesrɛ;wohyɛ wɔn nkuran, na wutie wɔn sufrɛ,
10.18: na wudi ma ayisaa ne nea wɔhyɛ no so,sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔdesani a ofi asase murenhunahuna bio.

38.1: Dwom Dawid dwom. Adesrɛ.Awurade, nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw muna ntwe mʼaso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.
38.2: Wo bɛmma hwirew me mu,na wo nsa adwerɛw me.
38.3: Wʼabufuwhyew no nti ahoɔden biara nni me mu;me bɔne nti, me nnompe ahodwow.
38.4: Mʼafɔdi amene mete sɛ adesoa a mu yɛ duru dodo.
38.5: Mʼakuru bɔn na aporɔwesiane me bɔne mu agyimisɛm nti.
38.6: Makotow na wɔabrɛ me ase;da mu nyinaa menantenantew twa agyaadwo.
38.7: Mʼakyi dompe mu yaw boro so:ahoɔden biara nni me nipadua mu.
38.8: Mabrɛ na mapɛtɛw koraa.Me koma mu yaw ma misi apini.
38.9: Awurade, nea merehwɛ anim nyinaa da wʼanim;mʼapinisi nhintaw wo.
38.10: Me koma bɔ kitirikitiri, na mʼahoɔden asampo mʼaniwa aduru sum.
38.11: Mʼapirakuru nti me nnamfonom ne me yɔnkonom mmɛn me;mʼafipamfo twe wɔn ho fi me ho.
38.12: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no sum me mfiri,wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔhaw me no di me sɛe ho nkɔmmɔda mu nyinaa wodwen nnaadaasɛm ho.
38.13: Mete sɛ ɔsotifo a ɔnte asɛm,mete sɛ mum a ontumi nkasa.
38.14: Mayɛ sɛ obi a ɔnte asɛm,nea nʼano ntumi mma mmuae.
38.15: Awurade, meretwɛn wo;Awurade me Nyankopɔn, wubegye me so.
38.16: Mekae se, “Mma wɔn ani nnye;anaa wɔmma wɔn ho so bere a mʼanan awatiri no.”
38.17: Mereyɛ mahwe ase,na me yaw da so wɔ me mu.
38.18: Meka me mfomso kyerɛ;me bɔne hyɛ me so.
38.19: Bebree na wɔyɛ mʼatamfo;wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso.
38.20: Wɔn a wɔde bɔne tua me papa so ka no,bɔ me ahohora bere a mereyɛ papa.
38.21: Awurade nnyaw me.Me Nyankopɔn, nkɔ akyiri!

39.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mekae se, “Mɛhwɛ mʼakwan yiyena mamfa me tɛkrɛma anyɛ bɔne;mɛto mʼano nnarekabere a amumɔyɛfo bɛn me yi.
39.2: Enti meyɛɛ komma manka asɛm papa biara mponanso mʼapinisi mu yɛɛ den.
39.3: Me koma ho guan no wɔ me mu.Midwinnwen no, ogya dɛwee;afei mede me tɛkrɛma kasae se:
39.4: “Awurade, ma minhu me nkwa awieine me nna dodow;ma minhu sɛnea me nkwa si twa mu ntɛm so.
39.5: Woayɛ me nna sɛ nsateaa baako pɛ;na me mfe dodow nyɛ hwee wɔ wʼani so.Onipa nkwa yɛ ɔhome bi kɛkɛ.
39.6: Onipa redi akɔneaba nyinaa no, ɔte sɛ sunsuma bi kwa;ɔhaw ne ho nanso ɔyɛ kwa;ɔboa ahonya ano na onnim nea ɛbɛyɛ ne de.
39.7: “Afei Awurade, dɛn na merehwehwɛ?Mʼanidaso wɔ wo mu.
39.8: Gye me fi me bɔne nyinaa mu;mma mennyɛ nkwaseafo aserewde.
39.9: Meyɛɛ komm, na mammue mʼano,efisɛ wo na woayɛ eyi.
39.10: Yi wʼasotwe fi me so;wo nsa ano amanehunu amene me.
39.11: Woka nnipa anim, na wotwe wɔn aso wɔ wɔn bɔne ho;wosɛe wɔn ahonya te sɛ nwewee;onipa biara yɛ ɔhome kɛkɛ.
39.12: “Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ,tie me sufrɛ;nsiw wʼaso wɔ me su ho.Me ne wo te hɔ sɛ ɔnanani,sɛnea na mʼagyanom nyinaa te no.
39.13: Yi wʼani fi me so na manya nkwa bio,ansa na mafi ha a mente ase bio.”

11.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade mu na mede me werɛ ahyɛ.Adɛn na wutumi ka kyerɛ me se,“Tu te sɛ anomaa kɔ wo bepɔw so.
11.2: Na hwɛ, amumɔyɛfo akuntun wɔn ta mu,na wɔde wɔn mmɛmma asisi ahama sosɛ wɔbɛtow wɔ sum mude awɔ koma mu ahotefo.
11.3: Sɛ wɔresɛe fapem no a,dɛn na ɔtreneeni betumi ayɛ?”
11.4: Awurade wɔ nʼasɔredan kronkron no mu;Awurade te ne soro ahengua so.Ɔhwɛ nnipa mma,nʼani hwehwɛ wɔn mu.
11.5: Awurade hwehwɛ ɔtreneeni mu,na amumɔyɛfo ne wɔn a wɔpɛ basabasayɛ de,ne kra kyi wɔn.
11.6: Ɔbɛtɔ ogyatannaa ne sufre a ɛredɛwagu amumɔyɛfo so;na mframa a mu yɛ hyew bɛyɛ wɔn kyɛfa.
11.7: Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni,na ɔpɛ atɛntrenee;wɔn a wɔteɛ no behu nʼanim.

13.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade enkosi da bɛn? Wo werɛ befi me afebɔɔ ana?Enkosi da bɛn na wode wʼanim behintaw me?
13.2: Enkosi da bɛn na mene mʼadwennwene bedi apereperena awerɛhow ahyɛ me koma mu daa?Mʼatamfo nni me so nkonim nkosi da bɛn?
13.3: Twa wʼani hwɛ me na bua me, Awurade, me Nyankopɔn.Ma mʼani so nyɛ hann, na manna owu nna.
13.4: Me tamfo bɛka se, “Madi ne so nkonim.”Na mʼahohiahiafo bedi ahurusi bere a mahwe ase.
13.5: Nanso mede me ho to wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no so;me koma di ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye mu.
13.6: Mɛto dwom ama Awurade,efisɛ ɔne me adi no yiye.

149.1: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade.Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade,monkamfo no wɔ ahotefo asafo mu.
149.2: Ma Israel ani nnye ne Yɛfo mu.Ma Sion mma ani nnye wɔn Hene mu.
149.3: Ma wɔmfa asaw nkamfo ne dinna wɔmfa sanku ne akasaa nto dwom mma no.
149.4: Na Awurade ani sɔ ne nkurɔfo;ɔde nkwagye kyɛw hyɛ ahobrɛasefo.
149.5: Momma ahotefo nni ahurusi wɔ anuonyam yi mu;na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom wɔ wɔn mpa so.
149.6: Onyankopɔn nkamfo nhyɛ wɔn anom,na ɛnyɛ afoa anofanu wɔ wɔn nsam,
149.7: sɛ wɔmfa ntɔ were wɔ amanaman no sone asotwe wɔ nnipa no so,
149.8: sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nkyekyere wɔn ahemfo,ne dade mpokyerɛ ngu wɔn atitiriw,
149.9: sɛ wɔmfa mmu atɛn, sɛnea wɔakyerɛw atia wɔn no.Eyi ne nʼahotewfo nyinaa anuonyam.Monkamfo Awurade.

148.1: Dwom Monkamfo Awurade!Monkamfo Awurade mfi ɔsorosoro,monkamfo no wɔ ɔsoro sorɔnsorɔmmea.
148.2: Nʼabɔfo nyinaa, monkamfo no,ne ɔsoro asafo nyinaa, monkamfo no.
148.3: Owia ne ɔsram, monkamfo no,nsoromma a ɛhyerɛn nyinaa, monkamfo no.
148.4: Monkamfo no, ɔsoro mu sorone mo nsu a mowɔ ɔsoro atifi.
148.5: Momma wɔn nyinaa nkamfo Awurade din,efisɛ ɔno na ɔhyɛ ma wɔbɔɔ wɔn.
148.6: Ɔde wɔn sisii hɔ afebɔɔ;na ɔmaa ɔhyɛ nsɛm bi a ɛrentwa mu da.
148.7: Monkamfo Awurade mfi asase so,mo po kɛse mu abɔde ne po bun nyinaa,
148.8: anyinam ne mparuwbo, sukyerɛmma ne omununkum,ahum a moyɛ nʼapɛde,
148.9: mo mmepɔw ne nkoko nyinaa,nnua a ɛsow aba ne sida nyinaa,
148.10: nwura mu mmoa ne anantwi,abɔde nketewa ne nnomaa a wotu,
148.11: asase ne amanaman nyinaa so ahemfo,mo mmapɔmma ne asase sodifo nyinaa,
148.12: mmerante ne mmabaa,mmasiriwa ne mmofra nso.
148.13: Ma wɔnkamfo Awurade din,na ne din so sen din biara;nʼanuonyam korɔn wɔ asase ne ɔsoro so.
148.14: Wapagyaw mmɛn bi ama ne nkurɔfo,nʼahotewfo nyinaa nkamfo;Israelfo, nnipa a wɔda ne koma so no nkamfo.Monkamfo Awurade.

12.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Boa yɛn, Awurade, na nyamesurofo asa;nokwafo ayera wɔ nnipa mu.
12.2: Obiara di atoro kyerɛ ne yɔnko;wɔn ano a ɛdɛfɛdɛfɛ no ka nnaadaasɛm.
12.3: Ma Awurade ntwa nnaadaa anone tɛkrɛma biara a ɛhoahoa ne ho nkyene;
12.4: nea ɛka se, “Yɛde yɛn tɛkrɛma bedi nkonim;yɛn ano bedi ama yɛn, na hena na odi yɛn so tumi?”
12.5: “Esiane ɔhyɛ a wɔde hyɛ mmɔborɔnine ohiani apinisi no nti,mɛsɔre afei,” Awurade na ose.“Mɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi wɔn a wɔhaw wɔn no ho.”
12.6: Awurade asɛm yɛ nokwarete sɛ dwetɛ a wɔasɔn so wɔ fononoo mu,na wɔahoa ho mpɛn ason.
12.7: Awurade, wobɛkora mmɔborɔnina woabɔ yɛn ho ban afi saa nnipa yi ho afebɔɔ.
12.8: Amumɔyɛfo nenam sɛnea wɔpɛ,bere a adesamma de nidi ma afide.

16.1: Dwom Dawid mpaebɔ.Bɔ me ho ban, me Nyankopɔn,na wo mu na minya guankɔbea.
16.2: Meka kyerɛɛ Awurade se,“MʼAwurade ne wo;minni ade pa biara ka wo ho.”
16.3: Ahotefo a wɔwɔ asase no so de,wɔne anuonyamfo amʼanigye wɔ wɔn mu.
16.4: Wɔn a wodi anyame afoforo akyi no,wɔn awerɛhow bɛdɔɔso.Merengu mogya nsa mma saa anyame nona meremfa mʼano mmɔ wɔn din.
16.5: Awurade, wode me kyɛfa ne me kuruwa ama me;woama me kyɛfa anya bammɔ.
16.6: Mʼahye akɔdeda mmeae a eye ama me;ampa ara mewɔ agyapade a ho yɛ anigye.
16.7: Mɛkamfo Awurade a otu me fo;na anadwo mpo, me koma kyerɛkyerɛ me.
16.8: Mihu Awurade wɔ mʼani so daa nyinaa.Esiane sɛ ɔwɔ me nsa nifa nti, merenhinhim da.
16.9: Ɛno nti, me kra ani gye, na mede me tɛkrɛma di ahurusi;me nipadua nso bɛhome asomdwoe mu,
16.10: efisɛ, worennyaw me awufo mu.Na woremma wo Kronkronni no mporɔw.
16.11: Woakyerɛ me nkwagye kwan,na wobɛma mʼani agye wɔ wʼanim,na anigye a ɛrensa da wɔ wo nifa so.

17.1: Dwom Dawid Mpaebɔ.Awurade, tie me trenee abisade;tie me sufrɛ.Yɛ aso ma me mpaebɔ;nea emfi nnaadaa anofafa mu.
17.2: Ma me bembu mfi wo;ma wʼani nhu nea ɛyɛ pɛ.
17.3: Wopɛɛpɛɛ me koma mu,wohwehwɛ me mu anadwo,na wosɔ me hwɛ de, nanso wubehu sɛ minsusuw bɔne bi ɛ;mʼano nkaa bɔne bi ɛ.
17.4: Nnipa nneyɛe fam no,anom asɛm ntimatwe me ho afibasabasayɛfo akwan ho.
17.5: Menam wʼakwan so daa;me nan nhintiw ɛ.
17.6: Misu mefrɛ wo, Onyankopɔnna wubegye me so;yɛ aso ma me na tie me mpaebɔ.
17.7: Da wo dɔ nwonwaso no adi;wo a wode wo nsa nifagye wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no nkwafi wɔn atamfo nsam no.
17.8: Hwɛ me so sɛ obi a wodɔ no;fa me sie wo ntaban nwini no ase,
17.9: fi amumɔyɛfo a wɔretaataa me no nsam,mʼatamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no.
17.10: Wopirim wɔn koma,na wɔkasa ahantan so.
17.11: Wɔadi me ntɛntɛ, afei wɔatwa me ho ahyia;wɔn ani abere sɛ wɔbɛbɔ me ahwe fam.
17.12: Wɔte sɛ gyata a hanam ho kɔm de no,te sɛ gyata kɛse bi a wabutuw wɔ ahintawee.
17.13: Sɔre, Awurade!Wone wɔn mfa mmɔ ani na ka wɔn hyɛ;fa wʼafoa no gye me fi amumɔyɛfo no nsam.
17.14: Awurade, fa wo nsagye me fi nnipa a wɔte sɛɛ nsam;asase so nnipa a wɔn akatua wɔ nkwa yi mu no.Womma ɔkɔm nne wɔn a wʼani ku wɔn ho;wɔn mmabarima wɔ bebree,na wɔkora agyapade ma wɔn mma.
17.15: Na me trenee mu, mehu wʼanim;sɛ minyan na mihu wo a me koma bɛtɔ me yam.

29.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Momfa mma Awurade no, mo ɔsoro abɔde,momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.
29.2: Momfa anuonyam a ɛfata Awurade din mma no;monsɔre Awurade wɔ nʼanuonyam kronkron mu.
29.3: Awurade nne wɔ nsu no so;anuonyam Nyankopɔn bobɔ mu,Awurade bobɔ mu wɔ nsu akɛse so.
29.4: Awurade nne mu wɔ tumi;Awurade nne mu wɔ anuonyam.
29.5: Awurade nne bubu sida;Awurade nne bubu Lebanon sida mu nketenkete
29.6: Ɔma Lebanon huruhuruw te sɛ nantwi ba,na Sirion nso sɛ ɛko ba.
29.7: Awurade nne pa ma anyinam gya dɛw.
29.8: Awurade nne wosow sare so;Awurade wosow Kades sare.
29.9: Awurade nne kyinkyim adumna ɛma kwae yɛ kwaterekwa.Nʼasɔredan mufo nyinaa teɛ mu ka se,“Anuonyam nka Onyankopɔn!”
29.10: Awurade di hene wɔ nsuyiri so;wɔasi Awurade hene afebɔɔ.
29.11: Awurade ma ne nkurɔfo ahoɔden,na ɔde asomdwoe hyira wɔn.

15.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, hena na ɔbɛtena wo kronkronbea ntamadan no mu?Hena na ɔbɛtena wo bepɔw kronkron no so?
15.2: Nea ne ho nni asɛmna ɔyɛ nea ɛteɛ,nea ɔka nokware a efi ne koma mu
15.3: na ɔmfa ne tɛkrɛma nsɛe nnipanea ɔnyɛ ne yɔnko bɔnena ommu ne yɔnko nipa abomfiaa,
15.4: nea obu afideyɛni animtiaana ɔde nidi ma wɔn a wosuro Awurade,nea odi ne ntam so,bere a etia no mpo,
15.5: nea ɔde ne sika bɔ bosea a onnye nsihona onnye adanmude ntia nea odi bem.Nea ɔyɛ eyinom norenhinhim da.

14.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ɔkwasea ka wɔ ne koma mu se,“Onyankopɔn bi nni hɔ.”Wɔaporɔw, na wɔn nneyɛe yɛ fina wɔn mu biara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ ade pa.
14.2: Awurade fi ɔsoro hwɛadesamma wɔ famsɛ obehu wɔn mu bi a wɔwɔ ntease,anaa ebinom a wɔhwehwɛ Onyankopɔn.
14.3: Nanso nnipa nyinaa atwe wɔn ho afi Onyankopɔn ho;wɔn nyinaa ayɛ bɔne.Obiara nni hɔ a ɔyɛ papa.Ɔbaako mpo nni hɔ.
14.4: Enti abɔnefo rensua nyansa ana?Wɔwe me nkurɔfo te sɛnea nnipa di aduan.Wonnsu mfrɛ Awurade?
14.5: Nanso wonni, ehu akyekyere wɔn,efisɛ Onyankopɔn te wɔn a wɔteɛ mu.
14.6: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo sɛe ahiafo nhyehyɛe,nanso, Awurade ne wɔn guankɔbea.
14.7: Ao, Israel nkwagye mfi Sion mmra!Awurade bɛsan de ne nkurɔfo agyapade ama wɔn.Na Yakob adi ahurusi, na Israel ani agye!

28.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Wo na misu frɛ wo,Awurade me Botan;nsiw wʼaso wɔ me ho.Sɛ woyɛ komm a,mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔasian kɔ amoa mu no.
28.2: Tie me mmɔborɔsubere a mefrɛ wo apɛ mmoa,bere a mema me nsa sokyerɛ wo Tenabea Kronkron hɔ.
28.3: Mfa me mfra amumɔyɛfo mu ntwe me nkɔ,mfa me nka wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no ho.Wɔne wɔn yɔnkonom kasa fɛfɛ,nanso wɔde ɔtan sie wɔn koma mu.
28.4: Twe wɔn aso wɔ nea wɔayɛ no so;wɔn adwuma bɔne no so;tua nea wɔde wɔn nsa ayɛ so kana fa nea ɛfata wɔn san bra wɔn so.
28.5: Sɛ wommu nea Awurade ayɛne nea ɔde ne nsa ayɛ no ntiɔbɛbrɛ wɔn asena ɔremma wɔnnsɔre bio.
28.6: Ayeyi nka Awurade,efisɛ watie me mmɔborɔsu.
28.7: Awurade ne mʼahoɔden ne me nkatabome koma wɔ ne mu ahotoso, na ɔboa me.Me koma di ahurusina mede dwonto bɛda no ase.
28.8: Awurade yɛ ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo;ne nkwagye nsraban ma nea wɔasra no ngo.
28.9: Gye wo nkurɔfo na hyira wʼagyapade;yɛ wɔn hwɛfo, na wo ne wɔn nnantew afebɔɔ.

9.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, mefi me koma nyinaa mu ada wo ase.Mɛka wʼanwonwade no nyinaa.
9.2: Mɛma mʼani agye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo mu.Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din, Ɔsorosoroni.
9.3: Mʼatamfo san wɔn akyi;wɔtetew hwe, na wowuwu wɔ wʼanim.
9.4: Woadi mʼasɛm ama me, na menya mʼahofadi;woatena wʼahengua so, abu atɛntrenee.
9.5: Woatwe amanaman no aso, na woasɛe amumɔyɛfo.Woapepa wɔn din a wɔrenkae wɔn bio.
9.6: Ɔsɛe a enni awiei ato ɔtamfo no,woatutu wɔn nkuropɔn;na wɔnkae wɔn bio mpo.
9.7: Awurade di hene daa daa;wasi nʼatemmu ahengua.
9.8: Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛn;ɔde atɛntrenee bedi nnipa no so.
9.9: Awurade yɛ guankɔbea ma wɔn a wodi wɔn nya no,ɔyɛ abandennen wɔ ahohia mmere mu.
9.10: Wɔn a wonim wo din no de wɔn ho bɛto wo so,efisɛ, wo Awurade, wunnyaw obiara a ɔhwehwɛ wo no mu da.
9.11: Monto ayeyi dwom mma Awurade a ɔte ahengua so wɔ Sion;mompae mu nka nea wayɛ wɔ amanaman no mu.
9.12: Na ɔkae nea ɔtɔ mogya so were no;ommu nʼani ngu ɔbrɛfo sufrɛ so.
9.13: Awurade, hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo teetee me!Hu me mmɔbɔ na yi me fi owu apon ano,
9.14: na matumi apae mu aka wʼayeyiwɔ Ɔbabea Sion apon ano,na madi ahurusi wɔ wo nkwagye no mu hɔ.
9.15: Amanaman mufo atɔ amoa a wɔatu no mu;afiri a wosum hintaw no ayi wɔn anan.
9.16: Awurade atɛntrenee da no adi;amumɔyɛfo nsa ano adwuma ayi wɔn.
9.17: Amumɔyɛfo san kɔ ɔda mu,amanaman a wɔn werɛ fi Onyankopɔn nyinaa.
9.18: Nanso ɛnyɛ daa na ne werɛ befi ohiani,anaasɛ mmɔborɔni anidaso bɛyera korakora.
9.19: Sɔre! Awurade, mma ɔdesani nni nkonim,bu amanaman no atɛn wɔ wʼanim.
9.20: Bɔ wɔn hu, Awurade;na ma wonhu sɛ, wɔyɛ adesa bi kɛkɛ.

67.1: Dwom Dwom.Onyankopɔn nnom yɛn na onhyira yɛnɔmma nʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,
67.2: na ɔmma wonhu nʼakwan wɔ asase so,ne ne nkwagye wɔ amanaman no nyinaa mu.
67.3: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn;ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo.
67.4: Ma amanaman ani nnye na wɔnto ahosɛpɛw dwom,efisɛ wudi nnipa no so trenee muna woma asase so amanaman no akwankyerɛ.
67.5: Ma adesamma nyi wo ayɛ, Onyankopɔn;ma nnipa nyinaa nkamfo wo!
67.6: Afei asase no bɛbɔ ne nnɔbae,na Onyankopɔn, yɛn Nyankopɔn ahyira yɛn.
67.7: Onyankopɔn behyira yɛn,na asase mmaa nyinaa besuro no.

73.1: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ABIƐSANnwom –Dwom Asaf dwom.Ampa ara Onyankopɔn ye ma Israel,oye ma wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew.
73.2: Nanso me de, anka me nan reyɛ awatiri;anka merehwere me nnyinaso,
73.3: efisɛ mʼani beree ahantanfobere a mihuu amumɔyɛfo yiyedi no.
73.4: Wonni aperepere;na wɔwɔ ahoɔden ne apɔwmuden.
73.5: Dadwen a ɛtaa ba nnipa so biara nna wɔn so;ɔdesani haw biara nna wɔn so.
73.6: Enti ahantan yɛ wɔn kɔnmuade,na wofura akakabensɛm.
73.7: Wɔn koma a apirim no mu na nnebɔne fi;na wɔn amumɔyɛ adwene nni awiei.
73.8: Wɔserew afoforo na wɔka wɔn ho nsɛm a enye;wɔde nhyɛso hunahuna afoforo wɔ ahomaso mu.
73.9: Wɔn ano ka ɔsoro nsɛm,na wɔn tɛkrɛma agye asase afa.
73.10: Ɛno nti wɔn nkurɔfo kɔ wɔn nkyɛnna wonya nsu nom ma ebu so.
73.11: Wobisa se, “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na Onyankopɔn ahu?Na Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ nhumu ana?”
73.12: Sɛɛ na amumɔyɛfo no te,hwee mfa wɔn ho, na wɔkɔ so pɛ ahonyade.
73.13: Ampa ara, mannya hwee amfi me komamtew mu;me nsa a enni fɔ no ayɛ ɔkwa.
73.14: Da mu nyinaa mihu amane;anɔpa biara wɔtwe mʼaso.
73.15: Sɛ mekae se, “Mɛkasa saa” a,anka midii wo mma no huammɔ.
73.16: Mebɔɔ mmɔden sɛ mɛte eyinom nyinaa ase,nanso na ɛhyɛ me so
73.17: kosii sɛ mekɔɔ Onyankopɔn kronkronbea hɔ;ɛhɔ na metee nea awiei no ɛbɛba wɔn so no ase.
73.18: Ampa ara wode wɔn gu faako a hɔ yɛ torowode wɔn hwe fam sɛe wɔn pasaa.
73.19: Sɛnea wɔsɛe prɛko pɛ,na ehu hwim wɔn kɔ no.
73.20: Ɛte sɛ adaeso, bere a onipa anyan,Awurade, sɛ wokanyan wo ho a,wubebu wʼani agu wɔn so sɛ biribi a enni hɔ.
73.21: Bere a awerɛhow hyɛɛ me koma muna me honhom dii yaw no,
73.22: meyɛɛ sɛ obi a onnim hwee na onni adwene;meyɛɛ sɛ aboa gyimfo wɔ wʼanim.
73.23: Nanso na me ne wo wɔ hɔ bere biara;na wode wo nsa nifa aso me mu.
73.24: Wode wʼafotu kyerɛ me kwan;na akyiri no, wode me bɛkɔ anuonyam mu.
73.25: Hena na mewɔ wɔ ɔsoro ka wo ho?Na biribiara nni asase so a mepɛ ka wo ho.
73.26: Me honam, ne me koma bedi me huammɔ,nanso Onyankopɔn ne me koma ahoɔdenne me kyɛfa daa nyinaa.
73.27: Wɔn a wɔmmɛn wo no bɛyera.Wosɛe wɔn a wonni wo nokware nyinaa.
73.28: Nanso me de, minim sɛ eye sɛ wobɛbɛn Onyankopɔn.Mede Otumfo Awurade ayɛ me guankɔbea;mɛka wo nneyɛe nyinaa akyerɛ.

98.1: Dwom Dwom.Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade,efisɛ wayɛ anwonwade bebree;ne nsa nifa ne ne basa kronkron noanya nkwagye ama no.
98.2: Awurade ama wɔahu ne nkwagyena wada ne trenee adi akyerɛ amanaman no.
98.3: Wakae nʼadɔene ne nokware a odi kyerɛɛ Israelfo no;asase ano nyinaa ahuyɛn Nyankopɔn nkwagye.
98.4: Asase nyinaa mommɔ ose mma Awurade,momfa nnwonto nni ahurusi;
98.5: Momfa sanku nto dwom mma Awurade,sanku ne nnwonto nnyigyei,
98.6: momfa torobɛnto ne adwennini mmɛn,nteɛ mu ahosɛpɛw so wɔ Awurade, yɛn hene no anim.
98.7: Momma po ne abɔde a ɛwɔ mu nyinaa nhuru so;asase ne wɔn a wɔte so nyinaa.
98.8: Momma nsubɔnten mmɔ wɔn nsam,mmepɔw nka mmom nto ahurusi nnwom;
98.9: ma wɔnto nnwom wɔ Awurade anim,efisɛ ɔreba abebu wiase atɛn.Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛnna ɔde pɛpɛyɛ abu nnipa atɛn.

129.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.“Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase,ma Israel nka ɛ.
129.2: “Wɔahyɛ me so pii afi me mmofraase,nanso wontumi nnii me so nkonim ɛ.
129.3: Fɛntɛmfo afɛntɛm mʼakyiayɛ wɔn nkɔmoa atenten.
129.4: Nanso Awurade yɛ ɔtreneeni;watwitwa amumɔyɛfo hama afi me ho ama made me ho.”
129.5: Ma wɔn a wɔtan Sion nyinaamfa animguase nsan wɔn akyi.
129.6: Ma wɔnnyɛ sɛ sare a ɛwɔ ɔdan atifi,a ennyin na ɛhyew;
129.7: na nnɔbaetwafo ntumi nnya biribi mfi mu nhyɛ ne nsa ma,na nea ɔboaboa ano nso nnya hwee nhyɛ nʼabasa ma.
129.8: Mma wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no nka se,“Awurade nhyira mmra mo so;yehyira mo wɔ Awurade din mu.”

101.1: Dwom Dawid Dwom.Mɛto wo dɔ ne wo trenee ho nnwom;Awurade, mɛto ayeyi nnwom ama wo.
101.2: Mɛhwɛ yiye abu ɔbra a ho tew;da bɛn na wobɛba me nkyɛn?Mede koma a afɔdi nni mubɛhwɛ me fi so.
101.3: Merennye ade a ɛyɛ tanbiara nto mu.Mikyi nnipa a wonni gyidi nneyɛe;meremfa me ho mmata ho.
101.4: Nnipa a wɔn koma yɛ kɔntɔnkye remmɛn me;me ne bɔne nni hwee yɛ.
101.5: Obiara a odi ne yɔnko ho nseku wɔ kokoa mu no,ɔno na mɛsɛe;nea ɔwɔ ahantan ani ne ahomaso koma,ɔno na merennyigye no so.
101.6: Mʼani bɛkɔ anokwafo a wɔwɔ asase no so no sona me ne wɔn atena;nea ne nantew ho nni asɛm noɔno na ɔbɛsom me.
101.7: Nea ɔyɛ ɔdaadaafo biararentena me fi;nea otwa nkontompo norennyina mʼanim.
101.8: Adekyee biara,mɛsɛe amumɔyɛfo a wɔwɔ asase yi so nyinaa;na mapam ɔdebɔneyɛni biaraafi Awurade kuropɔn mu.

115.1: Dwom Ɛnyɛ yɛn, Awurade, ɛnyɛ yɛn,na wo din na anuonyam nka,wʼadɔe ne wo nokwaredi nti.
115.2: Adɛn nti na aman no bisa se,“Wɔn Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
115.3: Yɛn Nyankopɔn wɔ ɔsoro;nea ɔpɛ biara na ɔyɛ.
115.4: Nanso wɔn ahoni yɛ dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ awɔde onipa nsa na ayɛ.
115.5: Wɔwɔ ano, nanso wontumi nkasa;wɔwɔ ani, nanso wonhu ade.
115.6: Wɔwɔ aso, nanso wɔnte asɛm;wɔwɔ hwene, nanso wɔnte hua.
115.7: Wɔwɔ nsa, nanso wɔnte nka;wɔwɔ anan, nanso wɔnnantew.Wontumi mma nnyigyei bi mfi wɔn mene mu.
115.8: Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ ahoni no bɛyɛ sɛ wɔn ara,saa ara na wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so no bɛyɛ.
115.9: Mo Israelfo nyinaa, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
115.10: Ao Aaronfi, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
115.11: Mo a musuro no, momfa mo ho nto Awurade so,ɔyɛ mo boafo ne kyɛm.
115.12: Awurade kae yɛn na obehyira yɛn:Obehyira Israelfi,obehyira Aaronfi
115.13: Obehyira wɔn a wosuro Awurade,nketewa ne akɛse nyinaa.
115.14: Awurade mma wʼase nnɔ,wo ne wo mma.
115.15: Awurade nhyira wo,ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.
115.16: Ɔsorosoro tɔnn yɛ Awurade de,nanso asase de, ɔde ama onipa.
115.17: Ɛnyɛ awufo na wɔkamfo Awuradewɔn a wɔkɔ fam dinn no.
115.18: Yɛn na yɛma Awurade sonnɛ ne daa nyinaa.Monkamfo Awurade.

114.1: Dwom Bere a Israelfo fii Misraim,na Yakobfifo fii ananafo asase so no,
114.2: Yuda bɛyɛɛ Awurade kronkronbeana Israel bɛyɛɛ nʼaheman.
114.3: Po no hwɛe, na eguanee,Yordan san nʼakyi;
114.4: Mmepɔw huruhuruwii sɛ adwennini,nkoko nso huruhuruwii sɛ nguantenmma.
114.5: Dɛn na ɛbae, ɛpo, na wuguanee?Yordan, adɛn, na wosan wʼakyi?
114.6: Mmepɔw, adɛn, na muhuruhuruw sɛ adwennini,na mo nkoko, muhuruhuruw sɛ nguantenmma yi?
114.7: Asase, ma wo ho mpopo wɔ Awurade anim,wɔ Yakob Nyankopɔn anim,
114.8: ɔno na ɔmaa ɔbotan no dan asubura,na ɔbotan dennen dan nsuwa aniwa no.

100.1: Dwom Ayeyi Dwom.Mommɔ ose mma Awurade, asase nyinaa.
100.2: Momfa ahosɛpɛw nsom Awurade;momfa anigye nnwom mmra nʼanim.
100.3: Munhu sɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn;ɔno na ɔyɛɛ yɛn, na yɛyɛ ne de;yɛyɛ ne nkurɔfo ne ne didibea nguan.
100.4: Momfa aseda nhyɛn nʼapon mu,na momfa nkamfo nkɔ nʼadiwo;momfa aseda mma no, na monkamfo ne din.
100.5: Awurade ye; na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;ne nokwaredi kodu awo ntoatoaso nyinaa so.

128.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Nhyira ne wɔn a wosuro Awurade,na wɔnantew nʼakwan so.
128.2: Wubedi wʼadwuma so aba;nhyira ne yiyedi bɛyɛ wo de.
128.3: Wo yere bɛyɛ sɛ bobe a ɛsow abawɔ wo fi;na wo mmabarima ayɛ sɛ ngodua a afifiatwa wo pon ho ahyia.
128.4: Yiw, sɛɛ ne nea wobehyiraonipa a osuro Awurade no.
128.5: Awurade nhyira wo mfi Sionna ɔmma wunhu Yerusalem yiyeyɛ;wo nkwanna nyinaa.
128.6: Ɔmma wo ntena ase nhu wo mma mma.Asomdwoe nka Israel.

99.1: Dwom Awurade di hene,momma amanaman no ho mpopo;ɔte nʼahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam,ma asase nwosow.
99.2: Awurade a ɔwɔ Sion yɛ ɔkɛse;wɔama no so wɔ amanaman nyinaa mu.
99.3: Ma wɔnkamfo wo din a ɛso na ɛyɛ nwonwa no,ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.
99.4: Ɔhene no yɛ ɔkɛse, ɔdɔ atɛntrenee,woama pɛpɛyɛ atim;wayɛ nea eye na ɛteɛwɔ Yakob mu.
99.5: Momma Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn sona monsɔre no wɔ ne nan ntiaso anim;ɔyɛ ɔkronkron.
99.6: Na Mose ne Aaron ka nʼasɔfo no ho,na Samuel ka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ ne din no ho;wɔfrɛɛ Awurade,na ogyee wɔn so.
99.7: Ofi omununkum dum mu kasa kyerɛɛ wɔn;wodii mmara ne ahyɛde a ɔmaa wɔn no so.
99.8: Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn,wugyee wɔn so;woyɛɛ bɔnefakyɛ Nyankopɔn maa Israel,nanso wotwee wɔn aso wɔ wɔn nnebɔne ho.
99.9: Momma Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn sona monsɔre no wɔ ne bepɔw kronkron no so,na Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ ɔkronkron.

72.1: Dwom Salomo dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, fa wʼatɛntrenee dom ɔhene no,na fa wo trenee ma ɔhene babarima.
72.2: Ɔde trenee bebu wo nkurɔfo atɛn,obebu wo nkurɔfo a wɔrehu amane no atɛntrenee.
72.3: Mmepɔw no de yiyedi bɛbrɛ nnipa no,nkoko no de trenee bɛba.
72.4: Ɔbɛko ama nnipa no mu amanehunufona wagye wɔn a wonni bi mma nkwa;ɔbɛdwerɛw nhyɛsofo.
72.5: Owia ne ɔsram da so wɔ hɔ yiwobesuro wo awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu.
