78.8: Wɔrenyɛ sɛ wɔn nenanom,a na wɔyɛ asoɔdenfo ne atuatewfo,wɔn a wonni Onyankopɔn nokware wɔ wɔn koma muna woyɛ honhom mu atorofo ma no no.
78.9: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na Efraim mmarima kurakura agyan,nanso ɔko da no woguanee;
78.10: Wɔanni Onyankopɔn apam no so,wɔampɛ sɛ wodi ne mmara no so.
78.11: Wɔn werɛ fii nea wayɛ,anwonwade a wayɛ akyerɛ wɔn no.
78.12: Ɔyɛɛ anwonwade wɔ wɔn nenanom anim,wɔ Soan mantam a ɛwɔ Misraim asase so.
78.13: Ɔkyɛɛ po mu na ɔde wɔn faa mu.Ɔmaa nsu no gyinaa sɛ afasu.
78.14: Ɔde omununkum dii wɔn anim awiana ɔde ogyatɛn dii wɔn anim anadwo nyinaa.
78.15: Ɔpaee ɔbotan mu wɔ sare so,na ɔmaa wɔn nsu a ɛdɔɔso sɛ po;
78.16: Ɔmaa asuti fii abotan muna ɔmaa nsu sen sɛ nsubɔnten.
78.17: Nanso wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne tiaa no,wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no wɔ sare no so.
78.18: Wɔhyɛɛ da kaa aduan a wɔpɛ,de sɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe.
78.19: Wɔkasa tiaa Onyankopɔn se,“Onyankopɔn betumi ato pon wɔ sare so ana?
78.20: Ɔde ade bɔɔ ɔbotan mu no, nsu tue fii mu,na nsuwa sen buu so.Na obetumi ama yɛn aduan nso?Obetumi ama ne nkurɔfo nam ana?”
78.21: Bere a Awurade tee nea wɔreka no, ne bo fuw yiye;ne gya beguu Yakob so,na nʼabufuwhyew sɔre tiaa Israel,
78.22: efisɛ na wonni Onyankopɔn mu gyidianaasɛ ne nkwagye mu ahotoso.
78.23: Nanso ɔkasa kyerɛɛ ɔsoro wɔ ɔhyɛ so;na obuee ɔsorosoro apon.
78.24: Ɔtɔɔ mana guu fam maa nnipa no sɛ wunni,ɔmaa wɔn ɔsoro aduan.
78.25: Nnipa dii abɔfo aduan;ɔmaa wɔn aduan a wobetumi adi nyinaa.
78.26: Ogyaa apuei mframa fi ɔsoro,na ofi ne tumi mu bɔɔ atɔe mframa.
78.27: Ɔtɔɔ nam sɛ mfutuma guu wɔn so,nnomaa a wotu bebree sɛ mpoano nwea.
78.28: Ɔma wɔbaa fam kɔɔ wɔn atenae,ne wɔn ntamadan ho nyinaa.
78.29: Wodidi maa aduan no boroo wɔn soefisɛ ɔmaa wɔn nea wɔhwehwɛ.
78.30: Nanso ansa na wobefi aduan a wɔhwehwɛ no ho,bere a ɛhyehyɛ wɔn anom mpo no,
78.31: Onyankopɔn abufuw sɔree wɔn so;okum ahoɔdenfo a wɔwɔ wɔn mutwitwaa Israel mmerante gui.
78.32: Eyinom nyinaa akyi, wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ bɔne;nʼanwonwade akyi no, wɔannye anni.
78.33: Enti otwaa wɔn nna so te sɛ ahuruyɛɛ wɔn mfe awiei huhuuhu.
78.34: Bere biara a Onyankopɔn bekum wɔn no, wɔhwehwɛ nona wɔpere wɔn ho san ba ne nkyɛn.
78.35: Wɔkaee sɛ Onyankopɔn yɛ wɔn botan,sɛ Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔn no yɛ wɔn Gyefo.
78.36: Nanso wɔde wɔn ano bɛdaadaa no,na wɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma atwa atoro akyerɛ no;
78.37: wɔn koma nni no nokware,na wonni nʼapam no so.
78.38: Nanso na ɔyɛ ahummɔbɔ;ɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ kyɛɛ wɔna wansɛe wɔn.Mpɛn pii, ɔtwentwɛn nʼabufuw sona wanhwie nʼabufuwhyew nyinaa.
78.39: Ɔkaee sɛ wɔyɛ ɔhonam ara kwa,mframa bi a ɛbɔ twa mu na ɛnsan nʼakyi.
78.40: Mpɛn ahe na wɔansɔre antia no wɔ sare no so hɔ,na mpɛn ahe na wɔamma ne werɛ anhow wɔ asase wosee no so!
78.41: Wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛɛ bere biara;na woyii Israel Ɔkronkronni no abufuw.
78.42: Wɔn werɛ fii ne tumi no,da a ogyee wɔn fii wɔn nhyɛsofo nsam no,
78.43: da a ɔyɛɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne nwonwaso wɔ Misraim none nʼanwonwade wɔ Soan mantam mu no.
78.44: Ɔmaa wɔn nsubɔnten dan mogya;wɔantumi annom wɔn nsuten mu nsu.
78.45: Ɔmaa nwansenadɔm baa wɔn so bɛhaw wɔnna mpɔtorɔ nso bɛsɛee wɔn asase.
78.46: Ɔmaa tɛwtɛw bedii wɔn mfuw so aduanna ɔde wɔn nnɔbae nso maa mmoadabi.
78.47: Ɔde mparuwbo sɛee wɔn bobena ɔde sukyerɛmma sɛee wɔn ankye nnua.
78.48: Ɔde sukyerɛmma kum wɔn anantwiɔde anyinam kum wɔn nyɛmmoa.
78.49: Ohwiee nʼabufuwhyew guu wɔn so,abufuw, anibere ne ɔtan;abɔfo asɛefo kuw no.
78.50: Ɔbɔɔ kwan maa nʼabufuw;na wamfa wɔn nkwa ankyɛ wɔn,mmom, ɔde wɔn maa ɔyaredɔm.
78.51: Okunkum Misraimfo mmakan nyinaa,Ham ntamadan mu nnipa mu abakan.
78.52: Nanso oyii ne nkurɔfo fii mu sɛ nguankuw;odii wɔn anim sɛ nguan wɔ sare no so.
78.53: Odii wɔn anim dwoodwoo, enti wɔansuro;nanso wɔn atamfo de, po asorɔkye bu faa wɔn so.
78.54: Sɛɛ na ɔyɛ de wɔn baa nʼasase kronkron no ahye so,bepɔw asase a ɔde ne nsa nifa gyee no.
78.55: Ɔpam amanaman a wɔwɔ wɔn anim nona ɔkyekyɛɛ wɔn nsase no mu maa wɔn sɛ wɔn agyapade;ɔbɔɔ Israel mmusuakuw no atenase wɔ wɔn afi mu.
78.56: Nanso wɔsɔɔ Onyankopɔn hwɛe,na wɔsɔre tiaa Ɔsorosoroni no;na wɔanni ne mmara so.
78.57: Wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔn agyanom, wɔanni nokware na wɔannya gyidi,ahotoso nni wɔn mu na wɔte sɛ agyan a asɛe.
78.58: Wɔde wɔn sorɔnsorɔmmea hyɛɛ no abufuwna wɔn ahoni maa ne ninkutwe mu yɛɛ den.
78.59: Onyankopɔn tee wɔn nka no, ne bo fuwii;na ɔpoo Israel korakora.
78.60: Ogyaw nʼatenae a ɛwɔ Silo no,ntamadan a wasi wɔ nnipa mu no.
78.61: Ɔde Apam Adaka a ɛyɛ ne tumi no kɔɔ nnommum mu,nʼanuonyam kɔɔ atamfo nsam.
78.62: Ɔde ne nkurɔfo maa afoa;ne bo fuw nʼagyapade yiye.
78.63: Ogya hyew wɔn mmerante kum wɔn,na wɔn mmabaa annya ayeforohyia dwom anto;
78.64: Wɔn asɔfo wuwuu afoa ano,na wɔn akunafo antumi ansu.
78.65: Afei Awurade sɔree sɛnea ofi nna mu no,sɛnea ɔbarima a wabow nsa nyan fi nnahɔɔ mu no.
78.66: Ɔbobɔɔ nʼatamfo ma woguan kɔɔ wɔn akyi;ɔhyɛɛ wɔn aniwu afebɔɔ.
78.67: Afei ɔpoo Yosef ntamadan no,na wamfa Efraim abusuakuw no nso;
78.68: Na mmom, ɔfaa Yuda abusuakuw no,Bepɔw Sion a ɔdɔ no no.
78.69: Osii ne kronkronbea te sɛ sorɔnsorɔmmea,te sɛ asase a etim hɔ daa.
78.70: Oyii ne somfo Dawid,ɔfrɛɛ no fii nguannan mu;
78.71: fii nguan akyi na ɔde no baese ɔmmɛyɛ oguanhwɛfo mma ne nkurɔfo Yakob,mma Israel a wɔyɛ nʼagyapade.
78.72: Na Dawid de koma pa hwɛɛ wɔn sona ɔde ne nimdeɛ dii wɔn anim.

44.1: Dwom Koramma “maskil” dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, yɛde yɛn aso ate;yɛn agyanom aka akyerɛ yɛn;nea woyɛɛ wɔ wɔn bere so,wɔ tete mmere no mu.
44.2: Wode wo nsa pam amanaman nona wobɔɔ yɛn agyanom atenase;wodwerɛw nnipa nona womaa yɛn agyanom dii yiye.
44.3: Ɛnyɛ wɔn afoa na wɔde nyaa asase no,na ɛnyɛ wɔn nsa na ɛmaa wɔn nkonimdi;ɛyɛ wo nsa nifa, wo basa,ne wʼanim hann, efisɛ na wodɔ wɔn.
44.4: Woyɛ me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn,nea ɔhyɛ nkonimdi ma Yakob.
44.5: Ɛnam wo so na yɛpam yɛn Atamfo;wo din mu na yetiatia wɔn a wokyi yɛn no so.
44.6: Memmfa me ho nto mʼagyan so,mʼafoa remfa nkonimdi mmrɛ me;
44.7: na wo na woma yedi yɛn atamfo sowugu wɔn a wɔtan yɛn no anim ase.
44.8: Onyankopɔn mu na yɛhoahoa yɛn ho da mu nyinaa,na yɛbɛkamfo wo din no daa daa.
44.9: Nanso mprempren woapo yɛn abrɛ yɛn ase;wone yɛn asraafo nkɔ ɔsa bio.
44.10: Woma yeguan fii dɔm anim,ma yɛn atamfo fom yɛn agyapade.
44.11: Wuyii yɛn maa sɛ wonkum yɛn sɛ nguanna woahwete yɛn wɔ amanaman no mu.
44.12: Wotɔn wo nkurɔfo fofoofow,na woannya mfaso biara amfi mu.
44.13: Woayɛ yɛn ahohorade ama yɛn afipamfo,animtiaabude ne aserewde ama wɔn a wɔatwa yɛn ho ahyia.
44.14: Woayɛ yɛn kasabebui wɔ aman no muna nnipa no wosow wɔn ti de gu yɛn so.
44.15: Mʼanimguase di mʼanim daa,na aniwu akata mʼanim,
44.16: esiane wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora na wɔkasa tia me de yi me ahi,esiane ɔtamfo a nʼani abere sɛ ɔbɛtɔ were no nti.
44.17: Eyinom nyinaa too yɛn de,nanso yɛn werɛ mfii wo,na yemmuu wʼapam no nso so ɛ.
44.18: Yɛn koma ntwe mfii wo ho;na yɛn anan nso mman mfii wo kwan so ɛ.
44.19: Nanso wodwerɛw yɛn yɛɛ yɛn sakraman tuna wode sum kabii kataa yɛn so.
44.20: Sɛ na yɛn werɛ afi yɛn Nyankopɔn dinanaa sɛ yɛatrɛw yɛn nsam akyerɛ ananafo nyame a,
44.21: anka Onyankopɔn behu,efisɛ onim koma mu ahintasɛm.
44.22: Nanso wo nti wokum yɛn daa nyinaa;wobu yɛn sɛ nguan a wɔrekokum wɔn.
44.23: Nyan, Awurade! Adɛn nti na woada?Keka wo ho! Nnyaw yɛn hɔ afebɔɔ.
44.24: Adɛn nti na wode wʼanim ahintawna wo werɛ fi yɛn ahohia ne nhyɛso?
44.25: Wɔabrɛ yɛn ase kɔ dɔte muna yɛn nipadua aka afam dɔte.
44.26: Sɔre bɛboa yɛn;wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nti, gye yɛn.

50.1: Dwom Asaf dwom.Tweduampɔn, Onyankopɔn, Awurade no kasa,na ɔfrɛ asase nyinaaefi apuei kosi atɔe.
50.2: Onyankopɔn hyerɛn fi Sionkurow a ne fɛ wie pɛyɛ.
50.3: Yɛn Nyankopɔn reba nanso ɔrenyɛ komm;ogya a ɛhyew nneɛma di nʼanim,ahum a ɛretu atwa ne ho ahyia.
50.4: Ɔfrɛ ɔsorosoro ne asase,sɛ ɔrebu ne nkurɔfo atɛn;
50.5: Ɔka se, “Boaboa nnipa a wɔatew wɔn ho no ano ma me;wɔn a wɔnam afɔrebɔ so ne me yɛɛ apam no.”
50.6: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee,na Onyankopɔn ankasa ne otemmufo.
50.7: “Muntie, me nkurɔfo, na mɛkasa,medi adanse atia wo, Israel;Mene Onyankopɔn, wo Nyankopɔn no.
50.8: Merenka mo anim wɔ mo afɔrebɔdeanaa mo hyew afɔre a ɛwɔ mʼanim daa no ho.
50.9: Anantwinini a wofi mo mfuw soanaa mpapo a wofi mo buw mu ho nhia me,
50.10: efisɛ kwae mu aboa biara yɛ me de,anantwi a wɔwɔ nkoko mpempem so nso saa ara.
50.11: Minim anomaa biara a ɔwɔ mmepɔw no so,na wuram abɔde nyinaa yɛ me de.
50.12: Sɛ ɔkɔm dee me a, anka merenka nkyerɛ mo;efisɛ, wiase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ me de.
50.13: Mewe anantwinini nam,na menom mpapo mogya ana?
50.14: Momfa aseda afɔre mma Onyankopɔn,na munni bɔ a mohyɛɛ Ɔsorosoroni no so,
50.15: na momfrɛ me hiada;na megye mo na moahyɛ me anuonyam.”
50.16: Nanso amumɔyɛfo de, Onyankopɔn bisa wɔn se,“Adɛn nti na moka me mmarana mʼapam da mo ano?
50.17: Mukyi me nkyerɛkyerɛ,na motow me nsɛm gu mo akyi.
50.18: Sɛ muhu ɔkorɔmfo a mode mo ho bɔ no;na mo ne nguaman nso bɔ.
50.19: Mode mo ano yɛ bɔne,na mode mo tɛkrɛma boaboa nnaadaa ano.
50.20: Mokasa tia mo nuabarima bere biarana mosopa mo ankasa na ba.
50.21: Moayɛ eyinom nyinaa; nanso manka hwee,enti mususuw sɛ mete sɛ mo.Nanso mɛka mo anim,na mede mo sobo asi mo anim.
50.22: “Munnwen eyi ho, mo a mo werɛ fi Onyankopɔn,anyɛ saa a, mɛtetew mo mu nketenkete a obiara remmegye mo;
50.23: Nea ɔbɔ aseda afɔre no hyɛ me anuonyam,na osiesie kwansɛnea mɛda Onyankopɔn nkwagye adi akyerɛ no.”

2.1: Dwom Adɛn nti na amanaman no hyehyɛ bɔne hona nnipa no bɔ pɔw hunu yi?
2.2: Asase so ahemfo sɔre gyinana sodifo ka wɔn ho bɔ mutia Awurade ne Nea Wɔasra no no.
2.3: Wɔka se,“Momma yemmubu wɔn nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔnna yɛntow wɔn mpokyerɛ ngu.”
2.4: Nea ɔte agua so wɔ ɔsoro no serew;Awurade di wɔn ho fɛw.
2.5: Afei ɔka wɔn anim wɔ nʼabufuw mu,hunahuna wɔn wɔ nʼabufuwhyew mu, ka se,
2.6: “Masi me Henewɔ Sion, me bepɔw kronkron no so.”
2.7: Mɛpae mu aka Awurade ahyɛde:Ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woyɛ me Ba;nnɛ mayɛ wʼAgya.
2.8: Bisa me,na mede amanaman nyinaa bɛyɛ wʼagyapade,asase ano nyinaa bɛyɛ wo de.
2.9: Wode dade ahempema bedi wɔn so;na woabobɔ wɔn sɛ ɔnwemfo ahina.”
2.10: Enti mo ahemfo, munsua nyansa;monkae kɔkɔbɔ yi, mo asase sodifo.
2.11: Momfa osuro nsom Awuradena monsɛpɛw mo ho ahopopo mu.
2.12: Mumfew Ɔba no ano, na ne bo amfuwna mo akwan de mo bɛkɔ ɔsɛe mu,efisɛ nʼabufuwhyew tumi sɔre mpofirim.Nhyira ne wɔn a woguan toa no nyinaa.

6.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade nka mʼanim wɔ wʼabufuw mu,na ntwe mʼaso nso wɔ wʼabufuwhyew mu.
6.2: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ meyɛ mmrɛw;Awurade sa me yarena me nnompe wɔ ahoyeraw mu.
6.3: Me kra wɔ ahohia mu.Enkosi da bɛn, Ao Awurade, enkosi da bɛn?
6.4: San bra, Awurade, na begye me nkwa;gye me, wo dɔ a enni nhuammɔ no nti.
6.5: Obi a wawu no renkae wo da,hena na ofi ɔda mu kamfo wo?
6.6: Apinisi ama mayɛ mmerɛw.Anadwo mu nyinaa mede agyaadwotwa fɔw me mpa,na me nusu fɔw me sumii.
6.7: Awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ me kusuu.Ɛredum; mʼatamfo nyinaa nti.
6.8: Mo nnebɔneyɛfo, montwe mo ho mfi me ho!efisɛ Awurade ate me sufrɛ.
6.9: Awurade ate me mmɔborɔsu;Awurade tie me sufrɛ.
6.10: Mʼatamfo nyinaa anim begu asena wɔn ho adwiriw wɔn;na wɔapatuw de fɛre asan wɔn akyi.

68.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ma Onyankopɔn nsɔre, ma nʼatamfo nhwete;wɔn a wɔtan no no nguan mfi nʼanim.
68.2: Sɛnea mframa bɔ wusiw gu no,saa ara na bɔ wɔn gu;sɛnea srade nan wɔ ogya so no,saa ara na amumɔyɛfo nyera mfi Onyankopɔn anim.
68.3: Nanso ma atreneefo ani nnyena wɔnsɛpɛw wɔn ho wɔ Onyankopɔn anim;ma wɔn ho ntɔ wɔn na wonni ahurusi.
68.4: To dwom ma Onyankopɔn, to dwom yi ne din ayɛ.Ma nea ɔnantew omununkum so no din so.Ne din ne Awurade;ma wʼani nnye wɔ nʼanim.
68.5: Ayisaa agya ne nea odi akunafo asɛm ma wɔnne Onyankopɔn a ɔte nʼatenae kronkron hɔ.
68.6: Ɔma ohiani tena mmusua mu,na ɔde nnwonto yi nneduafo ma wɔde wɔn ho;na atuatewfo de, wɔtena asase a awo so.
68.7: Onyankopɔn, bere a wudii wo nkurɔfo anim,bere a wode wɔn faa sare so no,
68.8: asase wosowee,na ɔsoro tuee osu guu fam,wɔ Onyankopɔn, Sinai Nyankopɔn,Onyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn no anim.
68.9: Womaa osu tɔɔ bebree, Ao, Onyankopɔn,guu wʼagyapade a abotow no so ma ɛyɛɛ frɔmfrɔm.
68.10: Wo nkurɔfo bɔɔ atenase wɔ so,Onyankopɔn, wonam wʼadɔe bebree no so hwɛɛ ahiafo.
68.11: Awurade kaa asɛm no,na dodow no ara ne wɔn a wɔpaee mu kae;
68.12: “Ahemfo ne wɔn asraafo guan ntɛm so;mmea a wɔwɔ fie no kyɛ asade.
68.13: Mpo bere a woda nguanban mu no,wɔde dwetɛ duraa mʼaborɔnoma ntaban ho,de sikakɔkɔɔ a ɛhyerɛn guu wɔn ntakra so.”
68.14: Bere a Otumfo bɔɔ ahene a wɔwɔ asase no so hwetee no,na ɛte sɛ sukyerɛmma a agu Bepɔw Salmon so.
68.15: Basan mmepɔw gyinagyina hɔ,Basan mmepɔw so yɛ abonkyiabonkyi.
68.16: Wo bepɔw abonkyiabonkyi, adɛn nti na wode ani bɔne hwɛbepɔw a Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ obedi so hene,faako a Awurade ankasa bɛtena afebɔɔ?
68.17: Onyankopɔn nteaseɛnam yɛ mpem mpemne mpem mpem mu mpem;Awurade fi Sinai aba ne kronkronbea.
68.18: Bere a woforo kɔɔ soro no,wode nnommum kaa wo ho;wunyaa ayɛyɛde fii nnipa hɔ,fii atuatewfo hɔ mpo,sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛtena hɔ, Awurade Nyankopɔn.
68.19: Ayeyi nka Awurade, nka Onyankopɔn yɛn Agyenkwa,nea ɔsoa yɛn nnesoa da biara no.
68.20: Yɛn Nyankopɔn yɛ Onyankopɔn a ogye nkwa;na Awurade mu na owu tow fom yɛn.
68.21: Ampa ara Onyankopɔn bɛdwerɛw nʼatamfo ti,wɔn a wɔkɔ so yɛ bɔne ti kusuu no.
68.22: Awurade ka se, “Mede wɔn befi Basan aba;mede wɔn befi po bun mu aba,
68.23: na moanantew wɔn a wokyi mo no mogya muna mo akraman tɛkrɛma anya wɔn kyɛfa.”
68.24: Onyankopɔn, yɛahu wo santen yuu no,me Nyankopɔn ne me Hene santen yuu no a ɔde reba ne kronkronbea hɔ.
68.25: Nnwontofo no wɔ anim, na asankubɔfo no nso di so,na mmabaa a wɔrewosow akasae nso ka wɔn ho.
68.26: Monkamfo Onyankopɔn wɔ asafo kɛse no mu;monkamfo Awurade wɔ Israel nnipakuw no mu.
68.27: Abusuakuw ketewa, Benyamin na odi wɔn kan,Yuda mmapɔmma kuw kɛse no di so,na Sebulon ne Naftali mmapɔmma aba.
68.28: Kyerɛ wo tumi, Onyankopɔn;da wʼahoɔden adi kyerɛ yɛn, sɛnea woayɛ pɛn no.
68.29: Wʼasɔredan a ɛwɔ Yerusalem ntiahemfo de ayɛyɛde bɛbrɛ wo.
68.30: Ka aboa a ɔhyɛ mfea mu no anim,ne anantwinini kuw a wɔhyɛ amanaman no nantwimma mu no.Brɛ wɔn ase kosi sɛ wɔde dwetɛ mpɔw bɛba.Bɔ wɔn a wɔn ani gye ɔko ho no pansam.
68.31: Ananmusifo befi Misraim aba,na Kus de ne ho bɛma Onyankopɔn.
68.32: Wiase ahemman, monto dwom mma Onyankopɔn,monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade,
68.33: monto mma nea ɔte tete ɔsorosoro so no,na ɔde nne kɛse bobɔ mu no.
68.34: Mompae mu nka Onyankopɔn tumi,nea ne kɛseyɛ kata Israel so no,na ne tumi wɔ soro ɔsoro no.
68.35: Wo ho yɛ hu, Onyankopɔn, wɔ wo kronkronbea hɔ;Israel Nyankopɔn de tumi ne ahoɔden ma ne nkurɔfo.Ayeyi nka Onyankopɔn!

54.1: Dwom Dawid “maskil” dwom. Ɔtoo no bere a Sififo kɔka kyerɛɛ Saulo se, “Dawid abehintaw wɔ yɛn mu.”Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me wɔ wo din mu;fa wo tumi bu me bem.
54.2: Ao, Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ;tie mʼanom nsɛm.
54.3: Ahɔho retow ahyɛ me so.Atirimɔdenfo rehwehwɛ me akum me;nnipa a wɔmmfa Onyankopɔn nyɛ hwee.
54.4: Ampa ara, Onyankopɔn ne me boafo;Awurade ne me hwɛfo.
54.5: Ma mmusu nkyim mmra wɔn a wodi me ho nseku no so;wo nokwaredi mu, sɛe wɔn.
54.6: Mefi me pɛ mu abɔ afɔre ama wo;Awurade, meyi wo din ayɛ,efisɛ eye.
54.7: Woagye me afi me haw nyinaa mu,na mʼani ahu nkonimdi wɔ mʼatamfo so.

40.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mede boasetɔ twɛn Awurade;na ɔhwɛɛ me, na ɔtee me sufrɛ.
40.2: Oyii me fii amoa a mu yɛ toro mu,fii dɔte ne dontori mu;ɔde mʼanan sii ɔbotan sona ɔmaa me baabi pa gyinae.
40.3: Ɔde dwom foforo hyɛɛ mʼanom,ayeyi dwom a yɛde ma yɛn Nyankopɔn.Bebree behu na wɔasuro,na wɔde wɔn werɛ ahyɛ Awurade mu.
40.4: Nhyira ne onipa aɔde Awurade yɛ nʼahotoso,nea ɔmfa nʼani nto ahomaso so,ne wɔn a wɔman di anyame huhuw akyi.
40.5: Awurade me Nyankopɔnwoayɛ anwonwade bebree.Nneɛma a wohyehyɛ maa yɛn noobiara ntumi nka ne nyinaa nkyerɛ wo;sɛ meka se mereka ne nyinaa ho asɛm aɛbɛdɔɔso dodo.
40.6: Wompɛ afɔrebɔ ne ayɛyɛde,nanso woabue mʼaso;woampɛ ɔhyew afɔre ne bɔne afɔre.
40.7: Na mekae se, “Mini, maba,sɛnea wɔakyerɛw afa me ho wɔ nhoma mmobɔwee no mu no.
40.8: Me Nyankopɔn, mepɛ sɛ meyɛ wʼapɛde;wo mmara wɔ me koma mu.”
40.9: Meka wo trenee ho asɛm wɔ guabɔ kɛse ase;mimmua mʼano,Awurade, sɛnea wunim no.
40.10: Memmfa wo trenee ho asɛm nsie me koma mu;meka wo nokware ne wo nkwagye ho asɛm.Mankata wʼadɔe ne wo nokware sowɔ guabɔ kɛse no ase.
40.11: Awurade, nyi wʼahummɔbɔ mfi me so;ma wʼadɔe ne wo nokware mmɔ me ho ban daa.
40.12: Ɔhaw bebree atwa me ho ahyia;mʼamumɔyɛ abu afa me so enti minhu ade bio.Ɛdɔɔso sen me ti so nwi,na me koma abotow wɔ me mu.
40.13: Awurade, ma ɛnsɔ wʼani sɛ wubegye me;Awurade, bra ntɛm bɛboa me.
40.14: Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum me no nyinaa,ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wɔnyɛ basaa;ma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ mesɛe nomfa aniwu nsan wɔn akyi.
40.15: Ma wɔn a wɔka, “Ɔtwea! Ɔtwea!” kyerɛ me nonsan wɔn akyi, esiane wɔn aniwu nti.
40.16: Nanso ma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo nyinaansɛpɛw wɔn ho na wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu;ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo nkwagye no nka da biara se,“Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse!”
40.17: Nanso meyɛ ohiani ne mmɔborɔni;ma Awurade nnwen me ho.Wo ne me boafo ne me gyefo;wo ne me Nyankopɔn, bra ntɛm.

97.1: Dwom Awurade di hene, ma asase ani nnye;ma akyirikyiri mpoano ahorow no nsɛpɛw wɔn ho.
97.2: Omununkum ne sum kabii atwa no ho ahyia;trenee ne atɛntrenee yɛ nʼahengua no fapem.
97.3: Ogya di nʼanimna ɛhyew nʼatamfo wɔ afanan nyinaa.
97.4: Nʼanyinam hyerɛn wiase;asase hu na ne ho popo.
97.5: Mmepɔw nan sɛ nku wɔ Awurade anim,Awurade a asase nyinaa wɔ no no anim.
97.6: Ɔsoro pae mu ka ne trenee kyerɛna aman nyinaa hu nʼanuonyam.
97.7: Ahonisomfo nyinaa anim agu ase,wɔn a wɔde abosomhuhuw hoahoa wɔn ho no,anyame nyinaa monsɔre no.
97.8: Sion te, na ne ho sɛpɛw nona Yuda nkuraa ani gyeAwurade, esiane wʼatɛntrenee nti.
97.9: Wo, Awurade ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase so nyinaa;wɔama wo so pa ara wɔ anyame nyinaa mu.
97.10: Ma wɔn a wɔdɔ Awurade no nkyi bɔne,ɔbɔ ne nkurɔfo a wɔyɛ nokwafo no ho banna ogye wɔn fi amumɔyɛfo nsam.
97.11: Hann hyerɛn wɔ atreneefo sona anigye ba wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew no so.
97.12: Momma mo ani nnye Awurade mu, mo a moyɛ atreneefo,na monkamfo ne din kronkron no.

83.1: Dwom Asaf Dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, ntena hɔ komm;mmua wʼano, Ao, Onyankopɔn, keka wo ho.
83.2: Hwɛ sɛnea wʼatamfo keka wɔn ho fa,na wɔn a wɔmpɛ wʼasɛm nso ama wɔn ti so.
83.3: Wɔde anifere repam atia wo nkurɔfo,wɔrepam atia wɔn a wo koma da wɔn so no.
83.4: Wɔka se, “Mommra na yɛnsɛe wɔn sɛ ɔman,sɛnea wɔrenkae Israel din bio.”
83.5: Wɔde adwene koro bɔ pɔw;na wɔpam tia wo,
83.6: Edom ntamadan ne Ismaelfo,Moabfo ne Hagarfo,
83.7: Gebalfo ne Amonfo ne Amalekfo,Filistifo ne Tirofo.
83.8: Asiria mpo akɔka wɔn hode wɔn ahoɔden akɔhyɛ Lot asefo de no mu den.
83.9: Yɛ wɔn sɛnea woyɛɛ Midian,sɛnea woyɛɛ Sisera ne Yabin wɔ asubɔnten Kison ho no,
83.10: wɔn a wɔsɛe wɔ En-Dorna wɔdan nwura no.
83.11: Yɛ wɔn atitiriw sɛ Oreb ne Seeb,ne wɔn mmapɔmma nyinaa sɛ Seba ne Salmuna,
83.12: a wɔkae se, “Momma yɛmfaOnyankopɔn adidibea nsase no no.”
83.13: Me Nyankopɔn, yɛ wɔn sɛ mfɛtɛ mu mfutuma,sɛ ntɛtɛ a mframa bɔ gu.
83.14: Sɛnea ogya hyew kwae,na ogyatannaa so nkoko mu hyew no no,
83.15: saa ara na fa wʼahum taa wɔnna fa wo mframa a ano yɛ den no hunahuna wɔn.
83.16: Ma animguase nka wɔn,na ama nnipa ahwehwɛ wo din akyi kwan, Awurade.
83.17: Ma wɔn anim ngu ase na wonni yaw;ma wonwuwu wɔ animguase mu.
83.18: Ma wonhu sɛ wo a wo din de Awurade no,wo nko ara ne Ɔsorosoroni wɔ asase nyinaa so.

132.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Awurade kae Dawidne ɔhaw ahorow a ogyinaa ano no.
132.2: Ɔkaa Awurade ntam,na ɔhyɛɛ nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob no bɔ se,
132.3: “Merenhyɛn me fina merenkɔda me mpa so,
132.4: meremma nna mmfa mena meremma mʼani nkum,
132.5: kosi sɛ menya baabi ama Awurade,baabi a nea ɔyɛ Otumfo ma Yakob No bɛtena.”
132.6: Yɛtee wɔ Efrata,yɛbɛtoo so wɔ Yaar mfuw so.
132.7: “Momma yɛnkɔ nʼatenae;momma yɛnsom wɔ ne nan ntiaso hɔ.
132.8: ‘Awurade, sɔre bra wʼahomegyebea,wo ne wo tumi adaka no.
132.9: Ma trenee nyɛ sɛ ntade mma wʼasɔfo;ma wʼahotefo nto ahurusi nnwom.’ ”
132.10: Wo somfo Dawid nti,nyi wʼani mfi nea woasra no ngo no so.
132.11: Awurade kaa ntam kyerɛɛ Dawid,nokware ntam a ɔntwe nsan se,“Wʼasefo no mu baakona mede no bɛtena wʼahengua so.
132.12: Sɛ wo mmabarima di mʼapam sona wotie me nkyerɛkyerɛ a,ɛno de wɔn mmabarima bɛtenawʼahengua so afebɔɔ.”
132.13: Awurade ayi Sion,ɔde hɔ ayɛ nʼatenae:
132.14: “Ɛha ne mʼahomegyebea daa nyinaa;ɛha na mɛtena adi hene, efisɛ ha na mepɛ,
132.15: mede nneɛma pa bebree behyira nona mama nʼahiafo adidi amee.
132.16: Mede nkwagye befura nʼasɔfo,na nʼahotewfo ato ahurusi nnwom daa.
132.17: “Mɛma obirɛmpɔn bi apue wɔ Dawid ahenni mu,na mede kanea asi hɔ ama nea masra no ngo no.
132.18: Mede aniwu befura nʼatamfo,nanso wɔbɛhyɛ no ahenkyɛw a ɛhyerɛn.”

126.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Bere a Awurade de Sion fi nnommum san bae no,yɛyɛɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔsosoo adae.
126.2: Ɔserew hyɛɛ yɛn anom ma,anigye nnwom hyɛɛ yɛn tɛkrɛma so ma.Na wɔkaa wɔ amanaman no mu se,“Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama wɔn.”
126.3: Awurade ayɛ nneɛma akɛse ama yɛn,na anigye ahyɛ yɛn ma.
126.4: Awurade, san fa yɛn siade ma yɛn,te sɛ nsuwansuwa a ɛwɔ Negeb no.
126.5: Wɔn a wodua no nusu mu node anigye nnwom betwa.
126.6: Wɔn a wɔde osu fi adiso aba a wɔrekodua no,de anigye nnwom bɛsan abaa wɔsoso nnɔbae afiafi.

127.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Salomo de.Sɛ Awurade ansi ɔdan no a,adansifo no yɛ ho adwuma kwa.Sɛ Awurade ammɔ kuropɔn no ho ban a,awɛmfo no wɛn kwa.
127.2: Sɛ wosɔre anɔpahemana wotena kosi anadwo,na woyɛ adwumaden pɛ wʼano aduan a,ɛyɛ ɔkwa, efisɛ wɔn a ɔdɔ wɔn no, ɔma wɔn wɔ wɔn nnae mu.
127.3: Mma yɛ agyapade a efi Awurade hɔ,na mma yɛ akatua a efi no.
127.4: Mma a wɔwo wɔn mmabun bere mu note sɛ agyan a ɛhyɛ ɔsraani nsam.
127.5: Nhyira ne onipa anʼagyan kotoku ayɛ ma.Nʼanim rengu asebere a wahyia nʼatamfo wɔ kurow pon ano no.

133.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Hwɛ oye a eye ne fɛ a ɛyɛsɛ anuanom bɔ mu tena faako!
133.2: Ɛte sɛ ngo a ɛsom bo a wɔahwie agu apampam,na esian kogu bɔgyesɛ mu,esian kogu Aaron bɔgyesɛ mu,ma bi kogu nʼatade kɔn mu.
133.3: Ɛte sɛ Hermon bosu aɛtɔ gu Bepɔw Sion so.Ɛhɔ na Awurade ahyɛ ne nhyira,nkwa a to ntwa da no.

82.1: Dwom Asaf dwom.Onyankopɔn di hene wɔ ɔsoro asafo mu;obu atɛn wɔ “anyame” mu.
82.2: “Wobɛbɔ wɔn a wɔnteɛ ho banna woayɛ nhwɛanim ama amumɔyɛfo akosi da bɛn?
82.3: Monka mmɔborɔfo ne ayisaa asɛm mma wɔn;mommɔ ahiafo ne wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so yiyedi ho ban.
82.4: Munnye ɔbrɛfo ne ahiafo;munnye wɔn mfi amumɔyɛfo nsam.
82.5: “Anyame no nnim de, na wɔnte hwee ase.Wokyinkyin wɔ sum mu;na asase fapem nyinaa wosow.
82.6: “Mekae se, ‘Moyɛ “anyame;”mo nyinaa yɛ Ɔsorosoroni no mma.’
82.7: Nanso mubewuwu sɛ nnipa pɛ;na moahwe ase sɛ ɔsodifo biara.”
82.8: Ao Onyankopɔn, sɔre, bu wiase atɛn;efisɛ amanaman nyinaa yɛ wo de.

96.1: Dwom Monto dwom foforo mma Awurade;asase nyinaa monto dwom mma Awurade.
96.2: Monto dwom mma Awurade, monkamfo ne din;mompae mu nka ne nkwagye no daa daa.
96.3: Monka nʼanuonyam wɔ amanaman mu,monka nʼanwonwade a wayɛ wɔ nnipa mu.
96.4: Awurade yɛ ɔkɛse na nkamfo fata no;ɛsɛ sɛ wosuro no sen anyame nyinaa.
96.5: Aman so anyame nyinaa yɛ ahoni bi kwa,nanso Awurade na ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro.
96.6: Anuonyam ne kɛseyɛ wɔ nʼanim;ahoɔden ne anuonyam wɔ ne kronkronbea hɔ.
96.7: Momfa mma Awurade, amanaman mmusuakuw,momfa anuonyam ne tumi mma Awurade.
96.8: Momfa anuonyam ne din a ɛfata mma Awurade;momfa afɔrebɔde nhyɛn nʼadiwo hɔ.
96.9: Monsɔre Awurade wɔ ne kronkronyɛ fɛfɛ mu;asase nyinaa momma mo ho mpopo wɔ nʼanim.
96.10: Monka nkyerɛ aman nyinaa se, “Awurade di hene.”Wɔabɔ asase atim hɔ pintinn, wɔrentumi ntutu;ɔde pɛpɛyɛ bebu nnipa atɛn.
96.11: Momma ɔsorosoro ani nnye, na asase nni ahurusi;momma po ne mu nneɛma nyinaa nworo;
96.12: Momma mfuw ne so nneɛma nyinaa mmɔ ose;momma kwae mu nnua nyinaa mfa ahosɛpɛw nto nnwom.
96.13: Momma abɔde nyinaa nni ahurusi wɔ Awurade anim, efisɛ ɔreba,ɔreba abebu asase no atɛn.Ɔde trenee bebu wiase atɛnna woabu nnipa nso atɛn wɔ ne nokware mu.

41.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhyira ne onipa a mmɔborɔni asɛm ho hia no;Awurade gye no wɔ amanehunu bere mu.
41.2: Awurade bɛbɔ ne ho ban na wakora ne kra;obehyira no wɔ asase no so;ɔrennyaa no mma nʼatamfo apɛde.
41.3: Awurade bɛhwɛ no wɔ ne yare mpa sona wagye no asi hɔ.
41.4: Mekae se, “Ao Awurade hu me mmɔbɔ;sa me yare, efisɛ mayɛ bɔne atia wo.”
41.5: Mʼatamfo de adwene bɔne ka fa me ho se:“Da bɛn na obewu ama ne din ayera?”
41.6: Bere biara a obi ba me nkyɛn no,ɔka atosɛm, na ne koma hɔre dinsɛe;ofi adi kɔ a, ɔde kodi nseku.
41.7: Mʼatamfo nyinaa keka asomsɛm fa me ho;wosusuw bɔne ma me na wɔka se:
41.8: “Ɔyare bɔne bi abɔ no;ɔrensɔre mfi nea ɔda hɔ bio.”
41.9: Mpo me yɔnko pa ara a mede me ho too no so,nea me ne no too nsa didii no,asɔre atia me.
41.10: Nanso wo, Awurade, hu me mmɔbɔ;ma me so, na mintua wɔn so ka.
41.11: Minim sɛ wʼani sɔ me,na me tamfo renni me so nkonim.
41.12: Me nokwaredi mu, wukura me muna wode me gyina wʼanim afebɔɔ.
41.13: Nhyira nka Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn,nnɛ ne daa nyinaa.Amen! ne Amen!

55.1: Dwom Dawid “maskil” dwom.Ao Onyankopɔn, tie me mpaebɔ,mmu wʼani ngu me nkotosrɛ so,
55.2: tie me na gye me so.Me dadwen haw me na ama mayɛ basaa,
55.3: esiane nea me tamfo reka,esiane omumɔyɛfo ahunahuna nti;efisɛ wɔde amanehunu ba me so;na wofi wɔn abufuw mu kum me.
55.4: Me koma wɔ ahoyeraw mu;na owu huboa aba me so.
55.5: Ehu ne ahopopo akyekyere me.Ahodwiriw abu afa me so.
55.6: Mekae se, “Ao, sɛ mewɔ ntaban sɛ aburuburu a,anka metu akɔ ama me ho atɔ me,
55.7: anka metu akɔ akyirikyiriakɔtena sare so;
55.8: anka mɛyɛ ntɛm akɔ me hintabea,faako a mframahweam ne ahum mmɛn koraa.”
55.9: Awurade, ma amumɔyɛfo nyɛ basaa, na ma wɔn kasa ntoto,efisɛ mihu basabasayɛ ne aperepere wɔ kuropɔn no mu.
55.10: Awia ne anadwo wɔtetɛw nʼafasu ho;adwemmɔne ne asisi wɔ mu.
55.11: Adesɛefo dɔm reyɛ adwuma wɔ kuropɔn no mu.Ahunahuna ne nnaadaa wɔ ne mmɔnten so daa.
55.12: Sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔresopa me a,anka metumi agyina ano;sɛ ɛyɛɛ ɔtamfo na ɔrema ne ho so atia me a,anka metumi de me ho ahintaw no.
55.13: Nanso ɛyɛ wo, ɔdesani te sɛ me,me yɔnko, mʼadamfo kann,
55.14: a kan no na me ne no wɔ ayɔnkofa a mu yɛ denbere a yɛn nyinaa bɔɔ mu yuu kɔɔ Onyankopɔn fi na yɛka asomfo no ho no.
55.15: Ma owu mmɛfa mʼatamfo mpofirim;ma wɔnkɔ ɔda mu anikann,efisɛ bɔne te wɔn mu.
55.16: Nanso misu frɛ Onyankopɔn,na Awurade gye me nkwa.
55.17: Anwummere, anɔpa ne awia,mede mmɔborɔnne su frɛ no,na ɔte me nne.
55.18: Ɔde ne ho bɔ afɔre ma minya me ti didi muwɔ ako a wodi tia me no mu,mpo dodow na wɔsɔre tia me.
55.19: Onyankopɔn a wɔasi no hene afebɔɔ no,ɔbɛte wɔn nka na wahaw wɔn,ɔbɛhaw nnipa a wɔnsakra wɔn akwan dana wonsuro Onyankopɔn nso.
55.20: Me yɔnko tow hyɛ ne nnamfonom so;na obu nʼapam so.
55.21: Ɔwɔ tɛkrɛmawo,nanso ɔtan wɔ ne koma mu.Nʼano asɛm dwudwo sen ngo,nanso ɛyɛ afoa a wɔatwe.
55.22: Fa wo haw to Awurade sona ɔno na obegye wo;ɔremma ɔtreneeni nhwe ase.
55.23: Nanso wo, Onyankopɔn, wobɛbrɛ amumɔyɛfo aseama wɔakɔ ɔporɔw amoa mu;mogyapɛfo ne nnaadaaforenni wɔn nkwanna mu fa.Nanso me de, mede me ho to wo so.

69.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ao, Onyankopɔn, gye me nkwana nsu no abɛdeda me kɔn mu.
69.2: Meremem wɔ dontori a mu dɔ mu,wɔ baabi a mʼanan nnya sibea.Madu bun muna nsu abu afa me so.
69.3: Mafrɛ abrɛ rehwehwɛ mmoa.Me mene mu ayow.Mʼani so ayɛ kusuu,na merehwehwɛ me Nyankopɔn.
69.4: Wɔn a wɔtan me kwa nodɔɔso sen me ti so nwi;wɔn a wɔtan me kwa no dɔɔso,wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me no.Wɔhyɛ me sɛ mennannea minnwiae no mma.
69.5: Wo, Onyankopɔn, nim me nkwaseasɛm;mʼafɔdi nhintaw wo.
69.6: Awurade, Awurade Tweduampɔn,mma wɔn a wɔn ani da wo so no,anim ngu ase esiane me nti, Awurade, Asafo Awurade;Israel Nyankopɔn,mma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wo noanim ngu ase esiane me nti.
69.7: Wo nti migyina animka ano,na aniwu kata mʼanim.
69.8: Mete sɛ ɔhɔho wɔ me nuanom mu,mete sɛ ɔmamfrani wɔ me na mmabarima mu,
69.9: na wo fi ho mmɔdemmɔ hyɛ me so,wɔn a wɔbɔ wo ahohora no animtiaabu bɛda me so.
69.10: Sɛ mitwa adwo na midi mmuada awɔbɔ me ahohora;
69.11: sɛ mifura atweaatam annipa de me yɛ aserewde.
69.12: Wɔn a wɔtete ɔpon no ano no serew me,na akɔwensafo de me din to dwom.
69.13: Nanso mɛbɔ wo mpae, Awurade,wɔ wʼadom bere mu;wɔ wʼadɔe kɛse no nti, Ao, Onyankopɔn,fa wo nokware nkwagye no gye me so.
69.14: Yi me fi dontori no mu,mma memmem wɔ mu;gye me fi wɔn a wɔtan me no nsam,ne nsu bun mu.
69.15: Mma nsu nnyiri mmfa meanaa bun mmene meanaa amoa nkata me so.
69.16: Awurade, gye me so fi wʼadɔe a eye no mu;wʼadom nti, dan bɛhwɛ me.
69.17: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw wo somfo;gye me so ntɛm, na mewɔ ɔhaw mu.
69.18: Twiw bɛn me na gye me;gye me nkwa, mʼatamfo nti.
69.19: Wunim sɛnea wɔkasa tia me, gu mʼanim ase na wotiatia mʼanim;wʼani tua mʼatamfo nyinaa.
69.20: Kasatia ahyɛ me koma soama mayɛ sɛ obi a onni ɔboafo;mepɛɛ awerɛkyekye, nanso mannya bi,mepɛɛ ɔwerɛkyekyefo, nanso manhu bi.
69.21: Wɔde bɔnwoma guu mʼaduan mu,osukɔm dee me no, wɔmaa me nsa nwenweenwen.
69.22: Ma wɔn didipon a esi wɔn anim nyi wɔn sɛ afiri;ma ɛnyɛ akatua ne afide mma wɔn.
69.23: Ma wɔn ani so nyɛ wɔn kusuu na wɔanhu ade,na ma wɔn akyi nkuntun afebɔɔ.
69.24: Hwie wʼabufuwhyew gu wɔn so;na ma wʼabufuw huhuhuhu no mmra wɔn so.
69.25: Ma wɔn fi nyɛ amamfo;mma obiara ntena wɔn ntamadan mu.
69.26: Wɔtaa wɔn a wupira wɔn no,wɔka wɔn a wupira wɔn no yawdi ho asɛm.
69.27: Fa amumɔyɛ mu amumɔyɛ ho sobo bɔ wɔn;mma wonnya wo nkwagye mu kyɛfa.
69.28: Pepa wɔn din fi nkwa nhoma no mu,mfa wɔn din nka atreneefo de ho.
69.29: Mewɔ ɔyaw ne ahohiahia mu;Onyankopɔn, ma wo nkwagye no mmɔ me ho ban.
69.30: Mede dwonto beyi Onyankopɔn din ayɛna mede aseda ahyɛ no anuonyam.
69.31: Eyi bɛsɔ Awurade ani yiye asen nantwi,asen nantwinini a otua mmɛn na ɔwɔ tɔte.
69.32: Mmɔborɔni behu na nʼani agye,mo a mohwehwɛ Onyankopɔn no koma benya nkwa.
69.33: Awurade tie wɔn a ade ahia wɔn,na ommu ne nkurɔfo nneduafo animtiaa.
69.34: Ma ɔsoro ne asase nkamfo no,po ne nea ɛkeka ne ho wɔ mu nyinaa,
69.35: efisɛ Onyankopɔn begye Sion nkwana wakyekye Yuda nkuropɔn no bio.Afei nnipa bɛtena mu na ayɛ wɔn de;
69.36: Nʼasomfo asefo na wɔbɛfa hɔ,na wɔn a wɔdɔ ne din no bɛtena hɔ.

7.1: Dwom Dawid adesrɛ dwom a Benyaminni Kus nsɛm nti ɔto maa Awurade.Awurade me Nyankopɔn,miguan toa wo;Gye me fi wɔn a wɔtaa me nyinaa nsam,
7.2: anyɛ saa a wɔbɛtetew me mu sɛ gyatana wɔatetew me mu asinasin aobiara rentumi nnye me.
7.3: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, sɛ mayɛ eyina sɛ afɔdi aba me so a,
7.4: sɛ mayɛ bɔne atia nea ɔne me te yiye,anaasɛ mabɔ me tamfo korɔn kwa a,
7.5: ɛno de ma mʼatamfo ntaa me na wɔmmɛto me;ma wontiatia me so wɔ fam,na wɔmma me funu nna mfutuma mu.
7.6: Sɔre wɔ wʼabufuw mu, Awurade!Sɔre tia mʼatamfo abufuw.Nyan, me Nyankopɔn; hyɛ atɛntrenee mmara.
7.7: Ma nnipadɔm mmetwa wo ho nhyia.Fi ɔsoro hɔ di wɔn so;
7.8: ma Awurade mmu nnipa no atɛn.Bu me atɛn, Awurade sɛnea me trenee te,sɛnea me nokwaredi te, Ao, Ɔsorosoroni.
7.9: Onyankopɔn treneeni,wo a wohwehwɛ adwene ne koma mu,fa amumɔyɛfo basabasayɛ bra awieina ma atreneefo nnya bammɔ.
7.10: Me nkatabo ne Ɔsorosoro Nyankopɔnnea ogye koma mu treneeni no.
7.11: Onyankopɔn yɛ otemmufo treneeni,Onyame a ɔda nʼabufuwhyew adi da biara.
7.12: Sɛ wansesa nʼadwene a,ɔbɛsew nʼafoa ano;obekuntun ne tadua na ɔde bɛmma ahyɛ mu.
7.13: Wasiesie nʼakode a ɛyɛ hu;ayɛ ne bɛmma a ɛredɛw no krado.
7.14: Nea onyinsɛn amumɔyɛna basabasayɛ ahyɛ no ma no, ɔwo nnaadaa.
7.15: Nea otu tokuru, na oyi mu dɔte nohwe tokuru a watu no mu.
7.16: Ɔhaw a ɔde ba no dan bɔ nʼankasa so;ne basabasayɛ bɔ nʼankasa ti so.
7.17: Mede aseda bɛma Awurade,ne trenee nti,na mato ayeyi dwom ayi Awurade, Ɔsorosoroni no din ayɛ.

5.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, yɛ aso ma me nsɛmna dwen mʼapinisi ho.
5.2: Tie me mmoa ho sufrɛ,me Hene ne me Nyankopɔn,efisɛ wo na mebɔ wo mpae.
5.3: Awurade, wote me nne anɔpa;anɔpa, mede mʼadesrɛ ba wʼanimna mede anidaso twɛn.
5.4: Wonyɛ Onyankopɔn a wʼani gye bɔne ho;na amumɔyɛfo rentumi ne wo ntena.
5.5: Ahantanfo rentumi nnyina wʼanim;wukyi wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne nyinaa.
5.6: Wosɛe wɔn a wɔka atosɛm;Awurade kyimogyapɛfo ne asisifo.
5.7: Nanso me, wo mmɔborɔhunu bebrebe nti,mɛba wo fi;na nidi mu na mɛkotowakyerɛ wʼasɔredan kronkron no.
5.8: Awurade kyerɛ me kwanwɔ wo trenee mumʼatamfo nti,bɔ wo kwan tee wɔ mʼanim.
5.9: Wɔn anom asɛm baako mpo nyɛ nokware;ɔsɛe ahyɛ wɔn koma ma.Wɔn menewa yɛ ɔda a so abuewɔde wɔn tɛkrɛma ka nnaadaasɛm.
5.10: Onyankopɔn, bu wɔn fɔ!Ma wɔn pɔw bɔne nyɛ wɔn asehwe.Pam wɔn; esiane wɔn bɔne dodow no nti,efisɛ wɔasɔre atia wo.
5.11: Nanso ma wɔn a woguan ba wo nkyɛn no ani nnye;ma wɔmfa anigye nto dwom daa.Trɛw wo bammɔ mu wɔ wɔn so,na wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din noma wɔn ani nnye wɔ wo mu.
5.12: Awurade, ampa ara, wuhyira atreneefo;na wode wʼayamye twa wɔn ho hyia sɛ nkatabo.

43.1: Dwom Me Nyankopɔn, bu me bem,na ka mʼasɛm a etia ɔman a wonsuro wo no ma me;gye me fi nnaadaafo ne amumɔyɛfo nsam.
43.2: Woyɛ Onyankopɔn, mʼabandennen.Adɛn nti na woapo me?Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwomʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?
43.3: Soma wo hann ne wo nokwarema wɔnkyerɛ me kwan;ma wɔmfa me mmra wo Bepɔw Kronkron no so,faako a wote no.
43.4: Afei, mɛkɔ Onyankopɔn afɔremuka anim,mʼanigye ne mʼahosɛpɛw Nyankopɔn nkyɛn.Mede sanku beyi wo ayɛ,Onyankopɔn, me Nyankopɔn.
43.5: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.

57.1: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a oguan fii Saulo nkyɛn kɔɔ ɔbodan no mu.Hu me mmɔbɔ, me Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ,na wo mu na me kra nya guankɔbea.Wo ntaban nwini ase na mɛpɛ guankɔbeakosi sɛ amanehunu no betwa mu.
57.2: Misu frɛ Onyankopɔn, Ɔsorosoroni no;Onyankopɔn a ɔma ne pɛ ba mu wɔ me ho.
57.3: Ɔsoma fi ɔsoro hɔ begye me nkwa,ɔka wɔn a wɔtaa me anibere so no anim;Onyankopɔn soma ne dɔ ne ne nokware.
57.4: Gyata atwa me ho ahyia;meda mmoa a wɔwe nam amono mu,nnipa a wɔn se te sɛ mpeaw ne mmɛmmana wɔn tɛkrɛma te sɛ afoa a ɛyɛ nnam.
57.5: Onyankopɔn, ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma wo so tra ɔsoro,na ama wʼanuonyam aba asase nyinaa so.
57.6: Wɔtrɛw asau mu de sum mʼanan afiri,ahohiahia brɛɛ me ase.Wotuu amoa wɔ me kwan mu,nanso wɔn ankasa akɔtotɔ mu.
57.7: Ao, Onyankopɔn, me koma agyina pintinn,me koma yɛ pintinn;mɛto dwom na mayi wo ayɛ.
57.8: Me kra nyan!Sanku ne bɛnta, munnyan!Me nso menyan anɔpahema.
57.9: Awurade, mɛkamfo wo wɔ aman no mu;mɛto wo ho nnwom wɔ nnipa mu.
57.10: Wʼadɔe so, ɛkorɔn sen ɔsoro;wo nokwaredi du wim.
57.11: Ao, Onyankopɔn, wɔmma wo so mmoro ɔsoro;ma wʼanuonyam nkata asase nyinaa so.

80.1: Dwom Asaf dwom.Israel guanhwɛfo, tie yɛn,wo a wudii Yosef anim sɛnea wodi nguankuw anim;wo a wote ahengua so wɔ kerubim ntam no, hyerɛn
80.2: wɔ Efraim, Benyamin ne Manase anim.Kanyan wo tumi;bra begye yɛn nkwa.
80.3: Ao Onyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio;ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.
80.4: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn,wʼabufuw bɛdɛw akosi da bɛn,wʼabufuw a etia wo nkurɔfo mpaebɔ no?
80.5: Wode nusu yɛɛ aduan maa wɔn dii;wode nusu kuruwama maa wɔn nomee.
80.6: Wode yɛn ayɛ nea yɛn mfɛfo ko ho,na yɛn atamfo serew yɛn.
80.7: Asafo Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio;ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wɔ yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.
80.8: Wutuu bobe fi Misraim beduae;wopam amanaman no na wuduae.
80.9: Wosiesiee asase no baabi maa no,egyee ntin na ɛtrɛw asase no so.
80.10: Ne nwini kataa mmepɔw no sone mman kataa sida akɛse no so.
80.11: Ɛdennan trɛw kɔɔ Po no so,na ɛfefɛw trɛw koduu Asubɔnten no ho.
80.12: Adɛn nti na woabubu nʼafasuama wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no tetew ne bobe aba no?
80.13: Kɔkɔte fi wuram bɛsɛe no pasaana mmoadoma a wɔwɔ sare so de yɛ wɔn aduan.
80.14: Asafo Nyankopɔn, san bra yɛn nkyɛn!fi ɔsoro hɔ hwɛ na wubehu!Hwɛ saa bobe yi so,
80.15: ntin a wo nsa nifa adua no,ɔbabarima a woatetew no ama wo ho no.
80.16: Wɔatwa wo bobe no ato fam, ato mu gya ama ahyew;wʼanimka ma wo nkurɔfo ase tɔre.
80.17: Fa wo nsa kata ɔbarima a ɔwɔ wo nifa no so,onipa ba a woatetew no ama wo ho no.
80.18: Afei yɛrentwe yɛn ho mfi wo nkyɛn;kanyan yɛn, na yɛbɛbɔ wo din.
80.19: Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, gye yɛn bio,na ma wʼanim nhyerɛn yɛn so,na wɔagye yɛn nkwa.

94.1: Dwom Awurade, Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were,Onyankopɔn a wotɔ were, hyerɛn.
94.2: Sɔre, asase so Temmufo,tua ahantanfo ka sɛnea ɛfata wɔn.
94.3: Awurade, enkosi da bɛn,amumɔyɛfo nnye wɔn ani nkosi da bɛn?
94.4: Wɔkasa ahantan so;ahohoahoa ahyɛ abɔnefo nyinaa ma.
94.5: Awurade, wɔdwerɛw wo nkurɔfo;wɔhyɛ wʼagyapade so.
94.6: Wokunkum akunafo ne ananafo;na wodi ayisaa awu.
94.7: Wɔka se, “Awurade nhu,Yakob Nyankopɔn ayi nʼani.”
94.8: Monhwɛ yiye, mo agyimifo a mowɔ nnipa no mu;nkwaseafo, da bɛn na mubehu nyansa?
94.9: Nea ɔbɔɔ aso no rente asɛm ana?Nea ɔyɛɛ ani no renhu ade ana?
94.10: Nea ɔteɛteɛ aman so no rentwe aso ana?Nea ɔkyerɛkyerɛ onipa no nnim nyansa ana?
94.11: Awurade nim onipa nsusuwii;onim sɛ enkosi hwee.
94.12: Awurade, nhyira ne onipa a woteɛteɛ no so,onipa a wokyerɛ no wo mmara no;
94.13: Woma ɔhome fi amanehunu nna mu,kosi sɛ wobetu amoa ama amumɔyɛfo.
94.14: Awurade rempo ne nkurɔfo;na ɔrennyaw nʼagyapade hɔ da.
94.15: Atemmu begyina treneeyɛ so bio,na wɔn a wɔn koma mu tew nyinaa bedi so.
94.16: Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia amumɔyɛfo ama me?Hena na ɔbɛsɔre atia abɔnefo ama me?
94.17: Sɛ Awurade ammoa me a,anka mekɔɔ owu kommyɛ mu ntɛm so.
94.18: Bere a mekae se, “Me nan rewatiri” no,Awurade, wo dɔ no soo me mu.
94.19: Bere a me dadwen dɔɔso no,wʼawerɛkyekye maa me kra abotɔyam.
94.20: Ahengua a porɔwee ahyɛ no mma no ne wo wɔ ayɔnkofa ana?Ahengua a ne hyɛ nsɛm de amanehunu na ɛba no?
94.21: Wɔka bɔ mu tia atreneefona wɔn a wodi bem no, wobu wɔn kumfɔ.
94.22: Nanso Awurade yɛ mʼaban;na me Nyankopɔn ayɛ ɔbotan a ne mu na minya ahintawee.
94.23: Obetua wɔn nnebɔne no so kana wɔn amumɔyɛ nti wasɛe wɔn;Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛsɛe wɔn.

125.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Awurade so no te sɛ Bepɔw Sion,a ɛnwosow na etim hɔ daa no.
125.2: Sɛnea mmepɔw atwa Yerusalem ho ahyia no,saa ara na Awurade atwa ne nkurɔfo ho ahyiamprempren ne daa.
125.3: Amumɔyɛfo ahempema renka asase awɔde ama atreneefo no so,sɛ ɛba saa a, atreneefonam wɔn so bɛyɛ bɔne.
125.4: Awurade wɔn a wɔyɛ papa no, yɛ wɔn papa,wɔn a wɔteɛ wɔ koma mu no, yɛ wɔn papa.
125.5: Na wɔn a wɔman fa akwan kɔntɔnkye so no de,Awurade betwa wɔn ne nnebɔneyɛfo asu.Asomdwoe nka Israel.

131.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Awurade, ahomaso nni me koma mu,na mʼani ntraa me ntɔn ɛ;memma nsɛm akɛse nhaw meanaa nsɛm a ɛyɛ nwonwa dodo ma me.
131.2: Na mmom, mama me kra anya abotɔyamte sɛ akokoaa a ɔda ne na so renum no,te sɛ akokoaa a otua nufu ano no,saa ara na me kra ayɛ wɔ me mu.
131.3: Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,mprempren ne daa nyinaa.

119.1: Dwom Awurade MmaraNhyira nka wɔn a wɔn akwan yɛ pɛ,na wɔnantew sɛnea Awurade mmara kyerɛ.
119.2: Nhyira nka wɔn a wɔkora nʼahyɛde,na wofi wɔn koma nyinaa mu hwehwɛ no.
119.3: Wɔnyɛ mfomso biara;na wɔnam nʼakwan so.
119.4: Woayɛ nkyerɛkyerɛ pa ato hɔa ɛsɛ sɛ wodi so pɛpɛɛpɛ.
119.5: Ao, sɛ anka mʼakwan besi pi,ayɛ osetie wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho ɛ!
119.6: Sɛ midwen wo mmaransɛm no nyinaa ho a,ɛno de, anka mʼanim rengu ase.
119.7: Mede koma a mu tew bɛkamfo wobere a meresua wo mmara a ɛteɛ no.
119.8: Medi wo hyɛ nsɛm so;na nnyaw me korakora.
119.9: Awurade Mmara Ho OsetieAberante bɛyɛ dɛn na nʼakwan ho atew?Ɛsɛ sɛ odi wʼasɛm so.
119.10: Mede me koma nyinaa hwehwɛ wo;mma me mman mfi wo mmara nsɛm ho.
119.11: Mede wʼasɛm asie me koma musɛnea merenyɛ bɔne ntia wo.
119.12: Awurade, ayeyi nka wo;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.13: Mede mʼano ka mmaraa efi wʼanom nyinaa.
119.14: Mʼani gye sɛ midi wʼahyɛde so,sɛnea obi ani gye ahonya bebree ho no.
119.15: Midwinnwen wo nkyerɛkyerɛ hona mehwehwɛ wʼakwan mu.
119.16: Mʼani gye wo hyɛ nsɛm ho;na merentoto wʼasɛm ase.
119.17: Awurade Mmara Mu AhotɔYɛ wo somfo yiye;na matena ase adi wʼasɛm so.
119.18: Bue mʼani na minhu anwonwade aɛwɔ wo mmara no mu.
119.19: Meyɛ ɔnanani wɔ asase so;mfa wo mmaransɛm no nhintaw me.
119.20: Me kra tɔ beraw bere biara,wo mmara ho anigyina nti.
119.21: Woka ahantanfo anim, wɔn a wɔadome wɔn,na wɔman fi wo mmaransɛm ho no.
119.22: Yi wɔn animka ne animtiaabu fi me mu,efisɛ midi wʼahyɛde so.
119.23: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ sodifo hyia di me ho nseku,nanso wo somfo bedwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.
119.24: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼanigyedena ɛyɛ me fotufo.
119.25: Awurade Mmara Sodi Ho BɔhyɛWoabrɛ me ase ma meda mfutuma mu;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.
119.26: Mesesee mʼakwan na wugyee me so;kyerɛkyerɛ me wʼahyɛde.
119.27: Ma mente nea ɛwɔ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ase;na mesusuw wʼanwonwade ho.
119.28: Awerɛhow ama me kra atɔ beraw;hyɛ me den sɛnea wʼasɛm no kyerɛ.
119.29: Yi me fi nnaadaa akwan so;na fa wo mmara so dom me.
119.30: Mafa nokware kwan no so;mede me koma abata wo mmara ho.
119.31: Awurade, mikura wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu dennen,mma mʼanim ngu ase.
119.32: Mitu mmirika wɔ wo mmaransɛm kwan no so,efisɛ woama mʼadwene mu adɔ.
119.33: Ntease Ho MpaebɔKyerɛkyerɛ me, Awurade, na minni wo hyɛ nsɛm so,na medi so akosi awiei.
119.34: Ma me ntease, na medi wo mmara so,na mede me koma nyinaa bedi so.
119.35: Kyerɛ me wo mmaransɛm kwan nona hɔ na minya anigye.
119.36: Dan me koma kɔ wʼahyɛde hona ɛnyɛ pɛsɛmenkominya so mfaso ho.
119.37: Yi mʼani fi nneɛma hunu so;na kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼasɛm te.
119.38: Di bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no so,na wasuro wo.
119.39: Yi animguase a ɛbɔ me hu no fi hɔ,efisɛ wo mmara yɛ papa.
119.40: Mʼani agyina wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no!Kyɛe me nkwa so wɔ wo trenee mu.
119.41: Awurade Mmara Mu AhotosoAwurade, ma wo dɔ a ɛnsa da no mmra me so,wo nkwagye no, sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
119.42: Afei mebua nea oyi me ahi no,efisɛ mewɔ wʼasɛm mu ahotoso.
119.43: Nyi nokwasɛm no mfi mʼanom,efisɛ mʼanidaso wɔ wo mmara mu.
119.44: Medi wo mmara so bere biaraakosi daa apem.
119.45: Mede ahofadi bɛnantew,efisɛ mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.
119.46: Mɛka wʼahyɛde ho asɛm wɔ ahemfo animna wɔrengu mʼanim ase,
119.47: efisɛ mʼani gye wo mmaransɛm ho,na medɔ no.
119.48: Mede nidi ma wo mmaransɛm a medɔ no,na midwinnwen wo hyɛ nsɛm ho.
119.49: Awurade Mmara No Mu AhotosoKae asɛm a woaka akyerɛ wo somfo,efisɛ woama me anidaso.
119.50: Mʼawerɛkyekye wɔ mʼamanehunu mu ne sɛ:Wo bɔhyɛ kyɛe me nkwa so.
119.51: Ahantanfo bu me animtiaa bebree,nanso mennan mfi wo mmara ho.
119.52: Awurade mekae wo tete mmara no,na minya awerɛkyekye wɔ mu.
119.53: Abufuw hyɛ me ma, esiane amumɔyɛfoa wɔapo wo mmara nti.
119.54: Wo hyɛ nsɛm yɛ me dwom tibanwɔ baabiara a mesoɛ.
119.55: Awurade, anadwo mekae wo din,na medi wo mmara so.
119.56: Eyi ne ade a meyɛ da biara,midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
119.57: Ahofama Wɔ Awurade Mmara Sodi MuAwurade, wo ne me kyɛfa;mahyɛ bɔ sɛ medi wo nsɛm so.
119.58: Mede me koma nyinaa ahwehwɛ wo;hu me mmɔbɔ sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
119.59: Madwene mʼakwan hona madan mʼanammɔntu akyerɛ wʼahyɛde.
119.60: Mɛyɛ ntɛm, merentwentwɛnsɛ medi wo mmara nsɛm so.
119.61: Ɛwɔ mu, amumɔyɛfo de hama kyekyere me,nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.
119.62: Ɔdasu mu, mesɔre de wʼaseda ma wo,wo mmara a ɛteɛ nti.
119.63: Meyɛ wɔn a wosuro wo nyinaa adamfo,wɔn a wodi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so nyinaa.
119.64: Awurade, wʼadɔe ahyɛ asase so ma;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.65: Awurade Mmara Sodi So MfasoWo ne wo somfo nni no yiyesɛnea wʼasɛm te, Awurade.
119.66: Kyerɛkyerɛ me nimdeɛ ne atemmu pa,efisɛ migye wo mmara nsɛm no di.
119.67: Mefom ɔkwan ansa na mihuu amane,na mprempren de midi wʼasɛm so.
119.68: Wuye, na nea woyɛ nso ye;kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.69: Ahantanfo de atoro asra me ho de,nanso mede me koma nyinaa di wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
119.70: Wɔn koma yɛ den na wonni ɔtema,nanso mʼani gye wo mmara ho.
119.71: Eye sɛ mihuu amanesɛnea mesua wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.72: Mmara a efi wʼanom no som bo ma mesen dwetɛ ne sikakɔkɔɔ mpem mpem.
119.73: Nokware A Ɛwɔ Awurade Mmara MuWo nsa na ɛbɔɔ me na ɛnwenee me;ma me ntease a mede besua wo mmara nsɛm.
119.74: Sɛ wɔn a wosuro wo no hu me a, ma wɔn ani nnye,efisɛ mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
119.75: Awurade, minim sɛnea wo mmara te,na nokwaredi mu na woatwe mʼaso.
119.76: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no nkyekye me werɛsɛnea bɔ a woahyɛ wo somfo no te no.
119.77: Ma wʼayamhyehye mmra me so, na minnya nkwa,efisɛ mʼani ka wo mmara ho.
119.78: Ma ahantanfo ani nwu sɛ wɔfom me kwa ntinanso mesusuw wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
119.79: Ma wɔn a wosuro wo no mmra me nkyɛn,wɔn a wɔte wo mmara ase no.
119.80: Ma me koma nnya bembu wɔ wo hyɛ nsɛm ho,na mʼanim angu ase.
119.81: Ogye MpaebɔWo nkwagye ho anigyina ama me kra atɔ piti,nanso mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
119.82: Mahwɛ wo bɔhyɛ anim ama mʼani abu;meka se, “Da bɛn na wobɛkyekye me werɛ?”
119.83: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ mete sɛ nsa kotoku a ɛsɛn wusiw ano de,nanso me werɛ mfi wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
119.84: Wo somfo ntwɛn nkosi da bɛn?Da bɛn na wobɛtwe wɔn a wɔtaa me no aso?
119.85: Ahantanfo atu amoa de asum me afiri,a ɛne wo mmara bɔ abira.
119.86: Wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa mu wɔ ahotoso;boa me, efisɛ nnipa taa me kwa.
119.87: Ɛkaa kakraa bi a anka woyii me fii asase so,nanso minnyaee wo nkyerɛkyerɛ sodi.
119.88: Kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te,na medi nkyerɛkyerɛ a efi wʼanom no so.
119.89: Awurade Mmara Mu GyidiAwurade, wʼasɛm no wɔ hɔ daa;egyina hɔ pintinn wɔ ɔsorosoro.
119.90: Wo nokwaredi kɔ so wɔ awo ntoatoaso nyinaa mu;wode asase sii hɔ, na etim hɔ.
119.91: Wo mmara wɔ hɔ besi nnɛ,na nneɛma nyinaa som wo.
119.92: Sɛ mʼani anka wo mmara no ho a,anka mʼamanehunu akum me.
119.93: Me werɛ remfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no,efisɛ ɛno so na wonam akyɛe me nkwa so.
119.94: Gye me nkwa, na meyɛ wo de;na mahwehwɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no.
119.95: Amumɔyɛfo retwɛn sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me,nanso, misusuw wʼahyɛde ho.
119.96: Mahu sɛ pɛyɛ nyinaa wɔ nea ɛkɔpem;nanso wo mmara nsɛm no nni ɔhye.
119.97: Awurade Mmara Ho DɔAo, medɔ wo mmara no yiye!Midwinnwen ho da mu nyinaa.
119.98: Wo mmara nsɛm ma mihu nyansa sen mʼatamfo,efisɛ ɛwɔ me nkyɛn daa.
119.99: Mewɔ nhumu sen mʼakyerɛkyerɛfo nyinaa,efisɛ midwinnwen wʼahyɛde ho.
119.100: Mewɔ ntease sen mpanyimfo,efisɛ midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
119.101: Memfaa mʼanan nsii ɔkwan bɔne biara sosɛnea metumi ayɛ osetie ama wʼasɛm.
119.102: Memman mfii wo mmara ho,efisɛ wʼankasa na woakyerɛkyerɛ me.
119.103: Wo nsɛm yɛ me dɛ,ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo wɔ mʼanom.
119.104: Minya ntease fi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ mu;enti mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara.
119.105: Awurade Mmara Yɛ KaneaWʼasɛm yɛ mʼanan ase kaneane me kwan so hann.
119.106: Maka ntam ahyɛ mu kena semedi wo trenee mmara no so.
119.107: Mahu amane bebree;kyɛe me nkwa so, Awurade, sɛnea wʼasɛm te.
119.108: Awurade, ma wʼani nsɔ mʼanom nkamfo a efi me pɛ mu,na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo mmara.
119.109: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ daa metoto me nkwa ase de,nanso me werɛ remfi wo mmara.
119.110: Amumɔyɛfo asum me afiri,nanso memfom mfii wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho.
119.111: Wʼahyɛde yɛ mʼagyapade afebɔɔ;ɛma me koma ani gye.
119.112: Me koma ayɛ krado sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm soakosi awiei.
119.113: Awurade Mmara Mu BammɔMikyi nnipa a wɔn adwene yɛ wɔn ntanta,na medɔ wo mmara.
119.114: Wone me guankɔbea ne me kyɛm;mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ wʼasɛm mu.
119.115: Mumfi me so nkɔ, mo nnebɔneyɛfo,na minni me Nyankopɔn mmara nsɛm so!
119.116: Wowaw me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te, na mɛtena nkwa mu;mma mʼanidaso nyɛ ɔkwa.
119.117: So me mu, na menya ogye;na bere biara mɛhwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
119.118: Wopo wɔn a wɔfom wo hyɛ nsɛm nyinaa,na wɔn nnaadaa no yɛ ɔkwa.
119.119: Wotow amumɔyɛfo nyinaa gu sɛ afide;enti medɔ wʼahyɛde.
119.120: Wo ho suro ma me ho popo;wo mmara abɔ me hu.
119.121: Awurade Mmara Ho SetieMayɛ nea ɛteɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ.Nnyaa me mma wɔn a wɔhyɛ me so!
119.122: Hwɛ ma wo somfo nni yiye;mma ahantanfo nhyɛ me so.
119.123: Mahwɛ wo nkwagye anim ama mʼani abu,ɛrehwehwɛ wo bɔhyɛ a ɛteɛ no.
119.124: Wo ne wo somfo nni no sɛnea wʼadɔe te,na kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.125: Meyɛ wo somfo; ma me nhumuna mate wʼahyɛde ase.
119.126: Awurade, bere aso sɛ woyɛ biribi;wɔrebu wo mmara so.
119.127: Esiane sɛ medɔ wo mmara nsɛmsen sikakɔkɔɔ, anaa sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa,
119.128: na midwen sɛ wo nkyerɛkyerɛ nyinaa ye nti,mikyi ɔkwan bɔne biara.
119.129: Pere Sɛ Wubedi Awurade Mmara SoWʼahyɛde yɛ nwonwa;enti midi so.
119.130: Wo nsɛm asete ma hann;na ɛma ntetekwaa nya ntease.
119.131: Mibue mʼanom na migu ahome,na mʼani gyina wo mmara nsɛm.
119.132: Dan wʼani hwɛ me na hu me mmɔbɔsɛnea woyɛ daa ma wɔn a wɔdɔ wo din no.
119.133: Tutu mʼanammɔn sɛnea wʼasɛm no te;mma bɔne biara nni me so.
119.134: Gye me fi nnipa nhyɛso mu,na madi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ so.
119.135: Ma wʼanim nhyerɛn wo somfo sona kyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.136: Nsuten nisu aguare me,efisɛ nnipa nni wo mmara so.
119.137: Awurade Mmara Yɛ PɛƆtreneeni ne wo, Awurade,na wo mmara nso yɛ pɛ.
119.138: Ahyɛde a woayɛ no yɛ trenee;ɛyɛ nea wonya mu ahotoso pa ara.
119.139: Abufuw ahyɛ me ma,efisɛ mʼatamfo bu wɔn ani gu wo nsɛm so.
119.140: Wɔasɔ wo bɔhyɛ ahorow no ahwɛ pa ara,na wo somfo dɔ wɔn.
119.141: Ɛwɔ mu sɛ menka hwee na memfra de,nanso me werɛ mfi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ.
119.142: Wo trenee wɔ hɔ daa,na wo mmara no yɛ nokware.
119.143: Ɔhaw ne awerɛhow aba me so,nanso wo mmara nsɛm ma me ahosɛpɛw.
119.144: Wʼahyɛde yɛ nokware daa;ma me ntease na manya nkwa.
119.145: Ogye MpaebɔAwurade, mede me koma nyinaa mefrɛ wo, gye me so,na medi wo hyɛ nsɛm no so.
119.146: Misu mefrɛ wo, gye me nkwana midi wʼahyɛde so.
119.147: Mesɔre anɔpahema, na misu pɛ mmoa;mede me werɛ ahyɛ wo nsɛm mu.
119.148: Mʼani gu so anadwo nyinaa,na misusuw wo bɔhyɛ ho.
119.149: Tie me nne sɛnea wʼadɔe no te;Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara te.
119.150: Wɔn a wɔhyehyɛ atirimɔdensɛm no abɛn,nanso wɔne wo mmara ntam ware.
119.151: Awurade, wo de, wobɛn me,na wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware.
119.152: Mmere bi a atwa mu no, misuaa wʼahyɛdea wode tim hɔ sɛ ɛntena hɔ daa no.
119.153: Mmoa Ho MpaebɔHwɛ mʼamanehunu na gye me nkwaefisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara no.
119.154: Di mʼasɛm ma me na gye me;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
119.155: Nkwagye ne atirimɔdenfo ntam kwan ware,efisɛ wɔnhwehwɛ wo hyɛ nsɛm no.
119.156: Awurade, wʼayamhyehye yɛ kɛse;kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wo mmara no te.
119.157: Atamfo a wɔteetee me dɔɔso,nanso memman mfii wo nhyehyɛe ho.
119.158: Mehwɛ wɔn a wonni gyidi no a wɔn ho yɛ me nwini,efisɛ wonni wʼasɛm so.
119.159: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼani gye wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ho;Awurade, kyɛe me nkwa so sɛnea wʼadɔe te.
119.160: Wo nsɛm nyinaa yɛ nokware;na wo mmara a ɛteɛ no to rentwa da.
119.161: Nya Ahofama Ma Awurade MmaraSodifo taataa me kwa,nanso ɛyɛ wʼasɛm nko ara na misuro.
119.162: Mʼani gye wo bɔhyɛ hote sɛ obi a wanya asade kɛse.
119.164: Mekamfo wo mpɛn ason da biara,wo mmara a ɛteɛ no nti.
119.165: Wɔn a wɔdɔ wo mmara no wɔ asomdwoe mmoroso,na biribiara rentumi mma wonhintiw.
119.166: Awurade, metwɛn wo nkwagye,na midi wo mmara nsɛm so.
119.167: Midi wʼahyɛde sona medɔ no yiye.
119.168: Midi wo nkyerɛkyerɛ ne wʼahyɛde so,na wunim mʼakwan nyinaa.
119.169: Mmoa Ho MpaebɔAwurade, ma me sufrɛ nnu wʼanim;ma me ntease sɛnea wʼasɛm no te.
119.170: Ma me nkotosrɛ nnu wʼanim;na gye me sɛnea wo bɔhyɛ no te.
119.171: Ma nkamfo nhyɛ mʼanom ma;efisɛ wokyerɛkyerɛ me wo hyɛ nsɛm.
119.172: Ma me tɛkrɛma nto wʼasɛm ho dwom,efisɛ wo mmara nsɛm nyinaa yɛ trenee.
119.173: Ma wo nsa nyɛ krado mmɛboa me,efisɛ maso wo nkyerɛkyerɛ no mu.
119.174: Awurade, mʼani agyina wo nkwagye,na wo mmara yɛ mʼanigyede.
119.175: Ma mentena nkwa mu na matumi akamfo wo,na wo mmara nso awowaw me.
119.176: Mafom kwan sɛ oguan a wayera.Hwehwɛ wo somfo,efisɛ me werɛ mfii wo mmara nsɛm no ɛ.

118.1: Dwom Monna Awurade ase efisɛ oye,na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.
118.2: Momma Israel nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
118.3: Momma Aaronfi nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
118.4: Momma wɔn a wosuro Awurade nka se,“Nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.”
118.5: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade;ogyee me so, na ɔma me dee me ho.
118.6: Awurade ne me boafo; enti merensuro.Dɛn na onipa betumi ayɛ me?
118.7: Awurade ne me wɔ hɔ; ɔyɛ me boafo.Mede nkonimdi bɛhwɛ mʼatamfo.
118.8: Eye sɛ yebehintaw wɔ Awurade mu,sen sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto onipa so.
118.9: Eye sɛ yebehintaw Awurade mu,sen sɛ yɛde yɛn ho bɛto mmapɔmma so.
118.10: Amanaman no nyinaa twaa me ho hyiae,nanso Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
118.11: Wotwaa me ho hyiaa wɔ baabiara,nanso Awurade din mu, mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
118.12: Wɔkyere guu me so sɛ nnowa,nanso wɔhyew ntɛm so sɛ nsɔe a ogya atɔ mu;Awurade din mu mitwitwaa wɔn gui.
118.13: Wosum me kɔɔ mʼakyi a anka mereyɛ ahwe ase,nanso Awurade boaa me.
118.14: Awurade yɛ mʼahoɔden ne me bammɔ;wayɛ me nkwagye.
118.15: Osebɔ ne nkonimdigyigye wɔ atreneefo ntamadan mu se,“Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!
118.16: Wɔama Awurade nsa nifa so;Awurade nsa nifa ayɛ nneɛma akɛse!”
118.17: Merenwu, mmom mɛtena asena mapae mu aka nea Awurade ayɛ.
118.18: Awurade atwe mʼaso dennen,nanso onyaa me mmaa owu ɛ.
118.19: Bue trenee apon ma me;na mɛhyɛn mu na mede aseda ama Awurade.
118.20: Awurade ponkɛse ni;ɛhɔ na atreneefo bɛfa ahyɛn mu.
118.21: Mɛda wo ase, efisɛ wugyee me so;na woayɛ me nkwagye.
118.22: Ɔbo a adansifo no poe no,abɛyɛ tweatibo.
118.23: Awurade na wayɛ eyi,na ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ yɛn ani so.
118.24: Nnɛ yɛ da a Awurade ayɛ.Momma yɛn ani nnye na yenni ahurusi.
118.25: Awurade, gye yɛn nkwa;Awurade, ma yɛn nkonimdi.
118.26: Nhyira ne nea ɔnam Awurade din mu reba.Yehyira wo fi Awurade fi.
118.27: Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn,na wama ne hann ahyerɛn yɛn so.Momfa nnua mman nkura na yɛnto afɔrebɔ santennkɔ afɔremuka no mmɛn ho.
118.28: Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn na meyi wo ayɛ;wone me Nyankopɔn na mɛma wo so.
118.29: Monna Awurade ase, efisɛ oye;na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa.

130.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom.Awurade, mifi bun mu su frɛ wo;
130.2: Awurade, tie me nne.Wɛn wʼasoma me nkotosrɛ.
130.3: Awurade, sɛ wubu yɛn bɔne ho nkontaa a,anka hena na obetumi agyina ano?
130.4: Nanso wowɔ bɔnefakyɛ;ɛno nti wosuro wo.
130.5: Metwɛn Awurade, me mu ade nyinaa twɛn,na nʼasɛm mu na mede mʼanidaso ahyɛ.
130.6: Metwɛn Awuradesen sɛnea awɛmfo twɛn adekyee,sen sɛnea awɛmfo twɛn adekyee.
130.7: Israel, ma wʼani nna Awurade so,efisɛ Awurade wɔ adɔe a enni huammɔna ogye ankasa wɔ ne mu.
130.8: Ɔno ankasa begye Israelafi wɔn bɔne nyinaa mu.

124.1: Dwom Ɔsoroforo dwom. Dawid de.Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afa a,ma Israel nka,
124.2: Sɛ anka Awurade nni yɛn afabere a nnipa tow hyɛɛ yɛn so,
124.3: bere a wɔn abufuw sɔre tiaa yɛn aanka wɔmemenee yɛn anikann;
124.4: anka nsuyiri no bebu afa yɛn so,anka ɔhweam no bɛtwe yɛn akɔ,
124.5: anka nsu a ano yɛ den nobɛpra yɛn kɔ.
124.6: Ayeyi nka Awurade awamma ho kwan amma wɔamfa wɔn se antetew yɛn mu.
124.7: Yɛaguan sɛ anomaaafi ofirisumfo afiri mu;wɔabubu afiri no,ama yɛaguan.
124.8: Yɛn mmoa wɔ Awurade din mu,ɔsoro ne asase Yɛfo no.

95.1: Dwom Mommra mma yɛnto dwom wɔ anigye so mma Awurade;momma yɛmmɔ ose mma yɛn nkwagye Botan no.
95.2: Momma yɛmfa aseda mmra nʼanim,na yɛmfa ahosɛpɛw nnwom mma no so.
95.3: Efisɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn kɛse,ɔhenkɛse wɔ anyame nyinaa so.
95.4: Ne nsam na asase mu nneɛma nyinaa wɔ,na mmepɔw mpampam wɔ no.
95.5: Po wɔ no, ɔno na ɔbɔe,na ne nsa na ɛnwenee asase kesee no.
95.6: Mommra, mma yɛnkotow nsom no.Momma yemmu nkotodwe wɔ Awurade yɛn Yɛfo no anim!
95.7: Ɔyɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn;yɛyɛ ne didibea nnipa,ne nguankuw a ɔhwɛ wɔn so.Nnɛ, sɛ mote ne nne a,
95.8: mummpirim mo koma sɛnea moyɛɛ wɔ Meriba no,sɛnea moyɛɛ da no wɔ Masa, sare no so no,
95.9: Ɛhɔ no, mo mpanyimfo sɔɔ no hwɛe,a na wonim nea meyɛ maa wɔn.
95.10: Me bo fuw saa nnipa no mfe aduananna mekae se, “Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn koma aman afi me ho,na wɔanhu mʼakwan.”
95.11: Ɛno nti mekaa ntam wɔ mʼabufuw mu se,“Wɔrenhyɛn mʼahomegye mu da.”

81.1: Dwom Asaf dwom.Monto ahurusi dwom mma Onyankopɔn yɛn ahoɔden;mommɔ ose mma Yakob Nyankopɔn no!
81.2: Momma nnwom no so na monwosow akasaa.Mommɔ sanku ne bɛnta dɛdɛ no.
81.3: Monhyɛn mmentia ɔsram foforo da no,ne ne kurokumatwa mu, yɛn Aponto da no;
81.4: Eyi yɛ Israelfo ahyɛde,Yakob Nyankopɔn mmara.
81.5: Otintimii sɛ nhyehyɛe maa Yosefbere a ɔsɔre tiaa Misraim no,faako a yɛtee kasa a yɛnte ase no.
81.6: Ɔka se, “Miyii adesoa no fii wɔn mmati so,ne wɔn nsa fii kɛntɛn ho.
81.7: Mo ahohiahia mu mofrɛɛ me na migyee mo,migyee mo so wɔ aprannaa mu;mesɔɔ mo hwɛɛ wɔ Meriba nsu ho.
81.8: “Me nkurɔfo, muntie me kɔkɔbɔ yi,Israel, sɛ mubetie me a!
81.9: Ɛnsɛ sɛ munya anyame foforo bi wɔ mo mu;ɛnsɛ sɛ mokotow ananafo anyame.
81.10: Mene Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn amiyii mo fii Misraim asase so no.Mummue mo anom tɛtrɛɛ na mɛhyɛ mu ma.
81.11: “Nanso me nkurɔfo rentie me;Israel remmrɛ ne ho ase mma me.
81.12: Enti migyaa wɔn maa wɔn komadensɛ wɔnyɛ nea wɔpɛ biara.
81.13: “Sɛ me nkurɔfo tie me,na Israel nantew mʼakwan so a,
81.14: anka medi wɔn atamfo so ama wɔn ntɛmna mama me basa so atia wɔn a wokyi wɔn!
81.15: Wɔn a wɔtan Awurade no de osuro bɛkotow no,na wɔn asotwe to rentwa da.
81.16: Nanso wɔde atoko mu atoko papa bɛma mo adi;mede ɔbotan mu wo bɛma mo amee.”

56.1: Dwom Dawid dwom a ɔtoo bere a Filistifo kyeree no wɔ Gat no.Onyankopɔn, hu me mmɔbɔ na nnipa taa me anibere so;da mu nyinaa womia wɔn taa no mu.
56.2: Wɔn a wɔbɔ me ahohora taa me da mu nyinaa;wɔn a wɔma wɔn ho so tia me no dɔɔso.
56.3: Sɛ mebɔ hu a,mede me ho bɛto wo so.
56.4: Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so, na merensuro.Dɛn na onipa desani betumi ayɛ me?
56.5: Da mu nyinaa wogye mʼano si bɔne;bere biara wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛsɛe me.
56.6: Wɔbɔ pɔw, wɔtetɛw,wɔhwɛ mʼanammɔntu,susuw sɛ wobekum me.
56.7: Wɔn amumɔyɛ nti mma wɔmmfa wɔn ho nni;Onyankopɔn, brɛ amanaman no ase wɔ wʼabufuw mu.
56.8: Kyerɛw me kwadwom to hɔ;sese me nusu wɔ wo nhoma mmobɔwee no mu.Enni nea woakyerɛw ato hɔ no mu ana?
56.9: Sɛ mepɛ mmoa fi wo hɔ a,mʼatamfo bɛsan wɔn akyi.Eyi bɛma mahu sɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ mʼafa.
56.10: Onyankopɔn a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,Awurade a mekamfo nʼasɛm no,
56.11: mede me ho to Onyankopɔn so; na merensuro.Dɛn na ɔdesani betumi ayɛ me?
56.12: Me Onyankopɔn, mehyɛ bɔ a mahyɛ wo no ase,mede mʼaseda afɔre bɛbrɛ wo.
56.13: Efisɛ, woagye me afi owu mu,na mʼanan anhintiw,na matumi anantew Onyankopɔn animwɔ nkwa hann no mu.

42.1: NHOMA A ƐTO SO ABIENNnwom –Dwom Koramma “maskil” dwom.Sɛnea ɔforote pere hwehwɛ nsuwansuwa no,saa ara na me kra pere hwehwɛ wo, me Nyankopɔn.
42.2: Onyankopɔn ho sukɔm de me kra, Onyankopɔn teasefo no.Da bɛn na metumi akohyia Onyankopɔn?
42.3: Me nisu ayɛ mʼaduanawia ne anadwo,na da mu nyinaa nnipa bisa me se:“Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
42.4: Saa nneɛma yi na mekaebere a mereka me koma mu nsɛm;sɛnea na midi asafokuw anim,na yɛde anigye nteɛteɛmu ne aseda nnwomnantew yuu bɔ mu kɔ Onyankopɔn fiwɔ afahyɛ da no.
42.5: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.
42.6: Me kra abotow wɔ me mu,enti mɛkae wofi Yordan asase so,Hermon mmepɔw so, fi Bepɔw Misar so.
42.7: Ebun kɔ bun muwɔ wo nsu a ɛworo gu no nnyigyei mu;wʼasorɔkye nyinaaabu afa me so.
42.8: Adekyee mu, Awurade kyerɛ nʼadɔe,adesae mu, ne dwom ba me nkyɛn,mpae a mebɔ srɛ me nkwa Nyankopɔn.
42.9: Mibisa Onyankopɔn, me Botan no se,“Adɛn nti na wo werɛ afi me?Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ menantenantew twa adwo,mʼatamfo nhyɛso nti?”
42.10: Me nnompe te ɔdesani yawdi,mʼahohiahiafo ateetee nti,daa nyinaa wobisa me se,“Wo Nyankopɔn wɔ he?”
42.11: Me kra, adɛn, na woabotow?Adɛn na woayɛ basaa wɔ me mu saa?Fa wo ho to Onyankopɔn so,na mɛkɔ so ayi no ayɛ,mʼAgyenkwa ne me Nyankopɔn.

4.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so,me trenee Nyankopɔn.Ma me ɔhome wɔ mʼahohia mu;hu me mmɔbɔ na tie me mpaebɔ.
4.2: Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdan mʼanuonyam ahohora?Enkosi da bɛn na mobɛdɔ nneɛma hunu na moadi ahoni ahuhuw akyi?
4.3: Hu sɛ Awurade ayi nea ɔwɔ nyamesu ama ne ho;Awurade betie, sɛ misu mefrɛ no a.
4.4: Sɛ mo bo fuw a, monnyɛ bɔne;sɛ modeda mo mpa so a,monyɛ komm na monhwehwɛ mo koma mu.
4.5: Mommɔ afɔre a ɛfatana momfa mo werɛ nhyɛ Awurade mu.
4.6: Nnipa bebree bisa se:“Hena na ɔde yiyeyɛ bɛbrɛ yɛn?”Awurade, ma wʼanim hann no nhyerɛn yɛn so.
4.7: Fa anigye mmoroso hyɛ me koma mabere a wɔn aburow ne nsa foforo abu so no.
4.8: Mɛtɔ hɔ, na mada asomdwoe mu,efisɛ wo nko ara, Awurade,na woma metena dwoodwoo.

25.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, me Nyankopɔn, wo mu na mede me werɛ hyɛ.
25.2: Wo so, me Nyankopɔn, na mede me ho to,mma mʼanim ngu ase,na mma mʼatamfo nso nni me so nkonim.
25.3: Wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to wo so no mu biaraanim rengu ase da,mmom, wɔn a wɔyɛ kɔntɔnkye kwa noanim begu ase.
25.4: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade,na minhu wʼatempɔn.
25.5: Fa wo nokware no so kyerɛkyerɛ me,efisɛ woyɛ Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo,na mʼani da wo so daa nyinaa.
25.6: Kae, Awurade, wo mmɔborɔhunu ne wo dɔ kɛsea ɛwɔ hɔ fi tete no.
25.7: Nkae me mmabun bere mu bɔnene mʼatuatew akwan;kae me sɛnea wʼadɔe te,Awurade, efisɛ wuye.
25.8: Awurade ye na ɔteɛ;enti ɔkyerɛkyerɛ nnebɔneyɛfo nʼakwan.
25.9: Ɔde ahobrɛasefo fa ɔkwan pa sona ɔkyerɛ wɔn nʼapɛde.
25.10: Awurade akwan nyinaa yɛ ɔdɔ ne nokwaredima wɔn a wodi nʼapam mu ahyɛde so.
25.11: Awurade, me bɔne so de,nanso wo din nti, fa kyɛ me.
25.12: Enti hena ne onipa a osuro Awurade?Ɔbɛkyerɛ no ɔkwan a wabɔ ama no.
25.13: Obedi yiye wɔ ne nkwanna mu,na nʼasefo afa asase no sɛ wɔn agyapade.
25.14: Awurade da nʼatirimsɛm adi kyerɛ wɔn a wosuro no;na ɔma wohu nʼapam.
25.15: Mʼani da Awurade so daa,efisɛ ɔno nko ara na obeyi mʼanan afi afiri mu.
25.16: Dan wʼani hwɛ me, na dom me,efisɛ meyɛ ankonam na meyɛ mmɔbɔ.
25.17: Me koma mu dadwen adɔɔso;yi me dadwen fi me so.
25.18: Hwɛ me haw ne mʼahohiahiana yi me bɔne nyinaa fi me so.
25.19: Hwɛ sɛnea mʼatamfo adɔɔsone ɔtan kɛse a wɔde tan me!
25.20: Bɔ me nkwa ho ban na gye me;mma mʼanim ngu ase,efisɛ me guankɔbea ne wo.
25.21: Ma trenee ne nokware mmɔ me ho ban,efisɛ mʼani da wo so.
25.22: Gye Israel, Onyankopɔn,fi wɔn haw nyinaa mu.

31.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Wo mu, Awurade na manya guankɔbea;mma mʼanim ngu ase;fi wo trenee mu gye me.
31.2: Yɛ aso ma me,bra ntɛm begye me;yɛ me bammɔ botan,aban a mʼatamfo nsa renka me.
31.3: Sɛ woyɛ me botan ne mʼaban nti,wo din nti di mʼanim na kyerɛ me kwan.
31.4: Gye me fi afiri a wɔasum me no mu,efisɛ wo ne me guankɔbea.
31.5: Wo nsam na mede me kra hyɛ;gye me bio, Awurade, Onyankopɔn nokwafo.
31.6: Mikyi wɔn a wɔsom abosom huhuw;mede me ho to Awurade so.
31.7: Mʼani begye na madi ahurusi wɔ wo dɔ mu,efisɛ wuhu mʼamanehunu,na wunim me kra mu haw.
31.8: Womfaa me nhyɛɛ ɔtamfo no nsammom wode me nan asisi petee mu.
31.9: Hu me mmɔbɔ, Awurade, efisɛ me ho yeraw me;awerɛhow ama mʼani so ayɛ kusuuɔyaw ama me kra ne me honam ayɛ mmerɛw.
31.10: Ɔyawdi retew me nkwa so,na abooboo tew me mfe so;ɔhaw nti mʼahoɔden kɔ fam,na me nnompe nso ahodwow.
31.11: Mʼatamfo nyinaa nti,mayɛ ahohora wɔ me nnamfonom mu;nnipa a wonim me suro me,na wɔn a wohu me mmɔnten so guan.
31.12: Obiara werɛ afi me te sɛ nea mawu;mayɛ sɛ kuku a abɔ.
31.13: Mete asomsɛm dodow a wɔkaahunahuna atwa me ho ahyia.Wɔrepam me ti so,na wɔbɔ pɔw sɛ wobekum me.
31.14: Nanso mede me ho ato wo so, Awurade;meka se, “Woyɛ me Nyankopɔn.”
31.15: Me mmere wɔ wo nsamgye me fi mʼatamfone wɔn a wɔtaa me no nsam.
31.16: Tew wʼanim kyerɛ wo somfo;gye me wɔ wo dɔ a enni huammɔ no mu.
31.17: Mma mʼanim ngu ase, Awurade,efisɛ masu afrɛ wo;mmom, ma amumɔyɛfo anim ngu asena wɔnna wɔn nna mu komm.
31.18: Mua atorofo ano,efisɛ wɔde ahantan ne animtiaabukasa tia atreneefo.
31.19: Wo papayɛ dɔɔso,ɛno na woakora ama wɔn a wosuro wo noɛno na wode ma wɔn a woguan toa wo nowɔ nnipa anim.
31.20: Wode wɔn sie wʼanim bammɔ mufi nnipa nsusuwii bɔne ho;wo tenabea hɔ na wode wɔn sie dwoodwoofi tɛkrɛma a ɛbɔ sobo ho.
31.21: Ayeyi nka Awurade!Sɛ wayi ne dɔ nwonwaso akyerɛ mebere a na mewɔ kuropɔn a atamfo atwa ho ahyia no mu no.
31.22: Mebɔɔ huboa no mekae se:“Woayi wʼani afi me so!”Nanso wotee me mmɔborɔsubere a mekotow srɛɛ wo no.
31.23: Monnɔ Awurade mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo nyinaa!Awurade kora wɔn a wodi nokware so,na ahomasofo de, otua wɔn ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.
31.24: Monyɛ den na momma mo bo ntɔ mo yam,mo a mowɔ anidaso wɔ Awurade mu nyinaa.

19.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Ɔsoro ka Onyankopɔn anuonyam!Wim pae mu ka ne nsa ano adwuma,
19.2: Da biara, wɔkasa;anadwo biara, wɔda nimdeɛ adi.
19.3: Wonni ɔkasa, wɔnnka nsɛm;wɔnnte wɔn nne.
19.4: Wɔn nne akodu asase so mmaa nyinaa,na wɔn nsɛm nso akodu asase ano.Onyankopɔn asi ntamadan ama owia wɔ ɔsoro hɔ.
19.5: Ɛte sɛ ayeforokunu a ofi ne pia mu,te sɛ ɔbran a ne ho pere no sɛ obetu ne mmirika.
19.6: Epue wɔ ɔsoro fa baabina atwa ne ho akosi ano;biribiara nsiw ne hyew ho kwan.
19.7: Awurade mmara yɛ pɛ,ɛkanyan ɔkra no.Ahotoso wɔ Awurade nhyehyɛe mu,ɛma nea onnim nyansa hu nyansa.
19.8: Awurade ahyɛde teɛ;ɛma koma mu anigye.Awurade ɔhyɛ nsɛm mu da hɔ;na ebue ani.
19.9: Awurade suro yɛ kronkron,ɛte hɔ daa.Awurade mmara nsɛm yɛ nokwarena ne nyinaa teɛ.
19.10: Ɛsom bo sen sikakɔkɔɔɛsen sikakɔkɔɔ kann;ɛyɛ dɛ sen ɛwo,ɛsen ɛwo a efi ɛwokyɛm mu.
19.11: Wɔnam so bɔ wo somfo kɔkɔ se,sodi so akatua yɛ bebree.
19.12: Hena na ohu nʼankasa mfomso?Fa me mfomso a ahintaw kyɛ me.
19.13: Bɔ wʼakoa ho ban fi ɔboayɛ bɔne ho,na anhyɛ me so.Ɛno na ɛbɛma madi bem,a merenni fɔ wɔ bɔne akɛse ho.
19.14: Ma mʼanom nsɛm ne me koma mu adwenenyɛ nea ɛsɔ wʼani, Awurademe Botan ne me Gyefo.

143.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, tie me mpaebɔ,tie me mmɔborɔsu;fi wo nokwaredi ne trenee mubra bɛboa me.
143.2: Mfa wʼakoa nkɔ atemmu mu,na ɔteasefo biara nteɛ wɔ wʼanim.
143.3: Ɔtamfo no taa me,ɔbɔ me hwe fam;ɔma me tena sum mute sɛ wɔn a wowuwuu dedaada.
143.4: Ɛno nti me honhom atɔ beraw wɔ me mu;na me koma di yaw wɔ me mu.
143.5: Mekae tete nna no;midwinnwen wo nnwumane nea wo nsa ayɛ nyinaa ho.
143.6: Mema me nsa so kyerɛ wo;wo ho sukɔm de me kra sɛ asase kesee.
143.7: Awurade, gye me so ntɛm;me honhom tɔ piti.Mfa wʼanim nhintaw meanyɛ saa a mɛyɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔkɔ amoa mu no.
143.8: Ma mente wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ho asɛm daa anɔpa,na mede me ho ato wo so.Kyerɛ me ɔkwan a memfa so,na wo na mema me kra so kyerɛ.
143.9: Awurade gye me fi mʼatamfo nsam,na wo mu na mede me ho hintaw.
143.10: Kyerɛ me na menyɛ wʼapɛde,na wo ne me Nyankopɔn;ma wo honhom pa nonkogya me asasetaw so.
143.11: Awurade, wo din nti, kyɛe me nkwa so;wo trenee mu, yi me fi ɔhaw mu.
143.12: Fi wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no mu mua mʼatamfo ano;na sɛe wɔn a wokyi me no nyinaa,na meyɛ wo somfo.

142.1: Dwom Dawid de. Bere a na ɔwɔ ɔbodan mu no. Mpaebɔ.Meteɛ mu su frɛ Awurade;mema me nne so su frɛ Awurade sɛ onhu me mmɔbɔ.
142.2: Mihwie mʼahiasɛm gu nʼanim;meka me haw kyerɛ no.
142.3: Sɛ me kra tɔ beraw wɔ me mu a,ɛyɛ wo na wunim me kwan.Ɔkwan a menam so nonnipa asum me afiri.
142.4: Hwɛ na hu, obiara nni me nifa so;mʼasɛm mfa obiara ho;minni guankɔbea bi;me nkwa mfa obiara ho.
142.5: Awurade, misu frɛ wo;mise, “Wone me guankɔbea,me kyɛfa wɔ ateasefo asase so.”
142.6: Tie me sufrɛ,na mewɔ ahohia kɛse mu;gye me fi mʼataafo nsam,efisɛ wɔn ho yɛ den sen me.
142.7: Yi me fi mʼafiase,na makamfo wo din.Afei atreneefo betwa me ho ahyiaesiane wo papa a woayɛ me no nti.

18.1: Dwom Awurade akoa Dawid dwom. Ɔtoo saa dwom yi maa Awurade, bere a ogyee no fii nʼatamfo nyinaa ne Saulo nsam no.Medɔ wo, Awurade, mʼahoɔden.
18.2: Awurade ne me botantim;mʼaban ne me gyefo;me Nyankopɔn yɛ me botan.Ne mu na minya me hintabea.Ɔyɛ me nkatabo, me nkwagye abɛn ne mʼabandennen.
18.3: Misu frɛ Awurade; ɔno na ayeyi sɛ no,efisɛ ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam.
18.4: Owu nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn kyekyeree me;na ɔsɛe asorɔkye bu faa me so.
18.5: Ɔda mu hama kyekyeree me;mihyiaa owu mfiri.
18.6: Mʼahohia mu, misu frɛɛ Awurade.Misu frɛɛ me Nyankopɔn hwehwɛɛ mmoa.Ofi nʼasɔrefi hɔ tee me nne;me sufrɛ baa nʼanim, na ɛkɔɔ nʼasom.
18.7: Asase wosowee na ehinhimii,na mmepɔw fapem wosoweewosuroe, efisɛ na ne bo afuw.
18.8: Wusiw fii ne hwene mu;ogyaframa fii nʼanom,na nnyansramma dɛw fii mu.
18.9: Ofii ɔsoro baa fam;na omununkum kabii duruu nʼanan ase.
18.10: Ɔte kerubim so tu kɔɔ soro;gyaagyaa ne ho wɔ mframa ntaban so.
18.11: Ɔde sum kataa ne ho,osu a amuna tumm atwa ne ho ahyia.
18.12: Hann kɛse hyerɛn wɔ nʼanim,na omununkum a mparuwbo ne anyinam wɔ mu fii ne ho hyerɛn mu bae.
18.13: Awurade bobɔɔ mu fii ɔsoro;Ɔsorosoroni no nne gyigyee bio.
18.14: Ɔtow ne bɛmma no de bɔɔ atamfo no ahwete,ɔde anyinam a ano yɛn den pam wɔn.
18.15: Po mu abon ho yiyiina asase nnyinaso ho daa hɔ,esiane wʼanimka ne ahomegu a efi wo hwene mu no nti,Awurade.
18.16: Ofi soro baa fam besoo me mu;ɔtwee me fii nsu a mu dɔ mu.
18.17: Ogyee me fii me tamfo hoɔdenfo nsam,wɔn a wɔn ani sa me, na wɔn ho yɛ den dodo ma me no.
18.18: Wɔbaa me so wɔ mʼamanehunu da mu,nanso Awurade maa me so,
18.19: wode me baa baabi a hɔ trɛw;ogyee me, efisɛ nʼani sɔɔ me.
18.20: Awurade ne me adi no sɛnea me trenee te;wahwɛ me nsa a ho tew so atua me ka.
18.21: Manantew Awurade akwan so.Mentwee me ho mfii me Nyankopɔn ho nkɔyɛɛ bɔne ɛ.
18.22: Madi ne mmara nyinaa so:mimmuu nʼahyɛde so.
18.23: Me ho nni asɛm wɔ Onyankopɔn anim,na matwe me ho afi bɔne ho.
18.24: Awurade agyina me treneeyɛne me nsa a ho tew wɔ nʼanim no so atua me ka.
18.25: Woda wo ho adi sɛ ɔnokwafo kyerɛ wɔn a wodi nokware,wɔn a wodi mu nso wokyerɛ wɔn sɛ wodi mu.
18.26: Woyɛ kronkron ma wɔn a wɔyɛ kronkron,na amumɔyɛfo de, wukyi wɔn.
18.27: Wugye ahobrɛasefo nkwa,na wobrɛ ahantanfo ase.
18.28: Awurade, woma me kanea hyerɛn.Yiw, woma me sum dan hann.
18.29: Wʼahoɔden a wode ma me nti, mitumi ka asraafo gu;me Nyankopɔn nti, mitumi foro ɔfasu.
18.30: Onyankopɔn de, nʼakwan yɛ pɛ;Awurade bɔhyɛ nyinaa ba mu.Ɔyɛ nkataboma wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ bammɔ wɔ ne mu.
18.31: Na hena na ɔyɛ Onyankopɔn ka Awurade ho?Hena na ɔyɛ Ɔbotan no? Gye sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn no.
18.32: Ɛyɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔma me ahoɔden,na ɔma me kwan yɛ pɛ.
18.33: Ɔma mʼanammɔn ho yɛ hare sɛ ɔforote de.Ɔma me gyina sorɔnsorɔmmea.
18.34: Osiesie me ma ɔko,na me basa tumi kuntun kɔbere mfrafrae tadua.
18.35: Wode wo ogye boa me nkatabo,na wo nsa nifa ma me gyina.Wobrɛ wo ho ase ma meyɛ ɔkɛse.
18.36: Woabɔ kwan tɛtrɛɛ ama mʼanansɛnea me nkotodwe rengurow.
18.37: Metaa mʼatamfo kɔtoo wɔn;mansan mʼakyi kosii sɛ mesɛee wɔn.
18.38: Mɛdwerɛw wɔn, na wɔantumi ansɔre,wɔhwehwee ase wɔ mʼanan ase.
18.39: Wode akodi ahoɔden maa me;womaa mʼatamfo bɔɔ wɔn mu ase wɔ me nan ase.
18.40: Womaa mʼatamfo dan wɔn ho guanee,na mesɛe wɔn a wɔtan me.
18.41: Wosu hwehwɛɛ mmoa, nanso obiara ammegye wɔn,wɔfrɛɛ Awurade, nanso wammua.
18.42: Meyam wɔn sɛ mfutuma a mframa bɔ gu;mihwiee wɔn guu sɛ mmɔnten so dontori.
18.43: Woagye me afi nnipa no ɔfow mu,woayɛ me amanaman no ti;nnipa a minnim wɔn abɛyɛ mʼasomfo.
18.44: Wɔte me nka pɛ a, wɔyɛ osetie ma me;ananafo kotow mʼanim.
18.45: Wɔn nyinaa botobotow;wofi wɔn abandennen mu ba ahopopo so.
18.46: Awurade te ase! Ayeyi nka me Botan!Wɔmma Onyankopɔn, me Gyefo no din so!
18.47: Ɔno ne Onyankopɔn a ɔtɔ were ma me,ɔno na ɔka amanaman hyɛ mʼase,
18.48: ɔno na ogye me fi mʼatamfo nsam.Wopagyaw me sii mʼatamfo so,wugyee me fii basabasayɛfo nsam.
18.49: Ɛno nti, mɛkamfo wo wɔ amanaman mu, Ao Awurade.Mɛto ayeyi dwom ama wo din.
18.50: Wode nkonimdi akɛse ama wo hene;woda ɔdɔ a ɛnsa da adi kyerɛ nea woasra no ngo,wode kyerɛ Dawid, ne nʼasefo afebɔɔ.

30.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Mɛma wo so, Awurade,efisɛ, woayi me afi bun muna woamma mʼatamfo anserew me.
30.2: Awurade me Nyankopɔn, misu frɛɛ wo sɛ boa mena wosaa me yare.
30.3: Awurade, wuyii me fii ɔda mu;wode me ho kyɛɛ me na woamma mankɔ amoa mu.
30.4: Monto ayeyi nnwom mma Awurade;mo a moyɛ nʼahotewfo!Monkamfo ne din kronkron no.
30.5: Nʼabufuw nkyɛ,na nʼadɔe wɔ hɔ daa;agyaadwotwa bɛwɔ hɔ anadwo,nanso ahosɛpɛw bɛba anɔpa.
30.6: Metee nka sɛ mewɔ bammɔ no, mekae se,“Merenhinhim da.”
30.7: Awurade, woyɛɛ me adom nowomaa me bepɔw gyinaa pintinnna wode wʼanim hintaw me no,me koma tui.
30.8: Wo, Awurade na mefrɛɛ wo;wo hɔ na misu mesrɛɛ mmɔborɔhunu se:
30.9: “Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ me sɛe so,sɛ mɛkɔ amoa mu?Mfutuma beyi wo ayɛ ana?Ɛbɛpae mu aka wo nokwaredi ana?
30.10: Tie me, Awurade, na hu me mmɔbɔ!Awurade, yɛ me boafo.”
30.11: Wodan mʼagyaadwotwa yɛɛ no asaw;wuyii mʼatweaatam fii me hona wode anigye furaa me,
30.12: sɛ me koma bɛto nnwom ama wo na ɛrenyɛ komm.Awurade me Nyankopɔn, meyi wo ayɛ daa.

24.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaa yɛ Awurade de;wiase ne wɔn a wɔte mu nyinaa wɔ no;
24.2: efisɛ ɔno na ɔtoo ne fapem wɔ po sona ɔde sii nsu ani.
24.3: Hena na obetumi aforo Awurade bepɔw no?Hena na obetumi agyina ne tenabea kronkron hɔ?
24.4: Nea ɔyɛ ade trenee na ne koma mu tew,nea ne kra nni ahoni akyina ɔnka ntamhunu.
24.5: Obenya Awurade nsam nhyirane bembu a efi ne Nkwagye Nyankopɔn.
24.6: Saa na awo ntoatoaso a wɔhwehwɛ Awurade no tewɔn a wɔhwehwɛ wʼanim no, Yakob Nyankopɔn.
24.7: Mo aponkɛse, momma mo ti so;wɔmma mo so, mo tete apon,na Anuonyam Hene nhyɛn mu.
24.8: Hena ne saa Anuonyam Hene yi?Ɔno ne Awurade hoɔdenfo ne otumfo noAwurade a ɔyɛ ɔko mu nkonimdifo.
24.9: Momma mo ti so, mo aponkɛsemomma wɔn so, mo tete apon,na anuonyam Hene no nkɔ mu.
24.10: Hena ne saa anuonyam Hene yi?Asafo Awurade no,ɔno ne anuonyam Hene no.

32.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhyira ne wɔn awɔde wɔn amumɔyɛ akyɛ wɔn,na wɔakata wɔn bɔne so.
32.2: Nhyira nka onipa aAwurade mmu ne bɔne ngu no sona nnaadaa nni ne honhom mu.
32.3: Bere a meyɛɛ komm no,me nnompe yɛɛ mmrɛw,apini a misii no da mu nyinaa nti.
32.4: Awia ne anadwowo nsa yɛɛ den wɔ me so;mʼahoɔden saete sɛ awia bere mu ɔhyew.
32.5: Afei, migyee me bɔne too mu.Mankata mʼamumɔyɛ so.Mekae se, “Mɛkame bɔne akyerɛ Awurade,”na wode me bɔne ho afɔdi kyɛɛ me.
32.6: Enti, ma agyidifo nyinaa mmɔ wo mpaebere a wohu wo;ampa ara sɛ asu akɛse yiri a,ɛrenka no.
32.7: Wone me hintabea;wobɛbɔ me ho ban wɔ amanehunu muna wode nkwagye nnwom atwa me ho ahyia.
32.8: Mɛkyerɛkyerɛ wo ɔkwan a wobɛfa sometu wo fo na mahwɛ wo so.
32.9: Ɛnyɛ sɛ ɔpɔnkɔ anaa afurumpɔnkɔ aonni ntease ntiwɔde nnareka ne hama na ɛdannan no,sɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛba wo nkyɛn.
32.10: Omumɔyɛfo amanehunu dɔɔso,nanso Awurade adɔe a ɛnsa da notwa onipa a ɔde ne ho to no so no ho hyia.
32.11: Munni ahurusi na mo ani nnye wɔ Awurade mu, mo atreneefo;monto dwom, mo a mo koma mu tew.

26.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Bu me bem, Awurade,efisɛ, mabɔ bra a asɛm nni ho:mede me ho too Awurade sona manhinhim.
26.2: Sɔ me hwɛ, Awurade,hwehwɛ me koma ne mʼadwene mu.
26.3: Wʼadɔe wɔ mʼanim daana mɛnantew wo nokware mu.
26.4: Me ne nnaadaafo ntenana me ne nyaatwomfo nso nni hwee yɛ.
26.5: Mikyi nnebɔneyɛfo guabɔna mempɛ sɛ me ne amumɔyɛfo tena.
26.6: Mehohoro me nsa wɔ bembu mu,na mekɔ wʼafɔremuka ho ahyia, Awurade,
26.7: na mepae mu ka wʼayeyina meka wʼanwonwade nyinaa.
26.8: Mʼani gye ofi a wote mu ho, Awurade,faako a wʼanuonyam wɔ no.
26.9: Mfa me kra nka nnebɔneyɛfo de ho nkɔ,ne me nkwa nka mogyapɛfo de ho,
26.10: wɔn a amumɔyɛ nhyehyɛe wɔ wɔn nsamna adanmude ayɛ wɔn nsa nifa ma.
26.11: Nanso mebɔ ɔbra a ho tew;hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me nkwa.
26.12: Mʼanan sisi asase tamaa so;na guabɔ kɛse ase na mɛkamfo Awurade.

140.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, gye me fi nnebɔneyɛfo nsam;bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo nsam,
140.2: wɔn a wodwen bɔne wɔ wɔn koma muna wɔhwanyan ɔko mu da biara.
140.3: Wɔsew wɔn tɛkrɛma ano te sɛ ɔwɔ de;nhurutoa bɔre wɔ wɔn ano.
140.4: Awurade, yi me fi amumɔyɛfo nsam;bɔ me ho ban fi basabasayɛfo awodwen sɛ wobetwintwan mʼanan mu no ho.
140.5: Ahantanfo asum me afiri;wɔatrɛtrɛw wɔn asau ahama muwɔasunsum me mfiri wɔ me kwan so.
140.6: Awurade, meka kyerɛ wo se, “Wone me Nyankopɔn.”Awurade, tie me mmɔborɔsu.
140.7: Otumfo Awurade, me gyefo hoɔdenfo,wokata me ti so wɔ ɔko da,
140.8: nyɛ amumɔyɛfo abisade mma wɔn, Awurade;mma wɔn nhyehyɛe nnyɛ yiye.
140.9: Wɔatwa me ho ahyia,nanso, ma amumɔyɛsɛm a efi wɔn anom no nsɛe wɔn.
140.10: Ma nnyansramma ngu wɔn so;ma wɔntow wɔn ngu ogya mu,ngu dontori amoa mu a wɔrensɔre bio.
140.11: Mma dinsɛefo ase ntim asase no so;ma amanehunu ntaataa kitikitiyɛfo.
140.12: Minim sɛ Awurade bu ahiafo atɛntreneena odi onnibi asɛm ma no.
140.13: Ampa ara, atreneefo bɛkamfo wo dinna wɔn a wɔnam tee no bɛtena nkwa mu wɔ wʼanim.

141.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade, misu frɛ wo, bra me nkyɛn ntɛm so.Sɛ misu frɛ wo a, gye me so.
141.2: Ma me mpaebɔ mmra wʼanim sɛ aduhuam;ma me nsa a mema so no nyɛ sɛ anwummere afɔrebɔ.
141.3: Awurade, ma ɔwɛmfo nwɛn mʼano;na wɛn mʼano pon.
141.4: Mma wɔnntwe me koma nnkɔ nea ɛyɛ bɔne ho,na ankɔyɛ nea amumɔyɛfo yɛ no bi,mma me ne abɔnefonni wɔn nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwade.
141.5: Ma ɔtreneeni mmɔ me, ɛyɛ ayamye;ma ɔnka mʼanim, ɛyɛ me ti so ngo.Me ti rempo.Me mpaebɔ da so tia abɔnefo nneyɛe daa.
141.6: Wɔbɛtow wɔn sodifo afi ɔbotan so abɛhwe fam;na amumɔyɛfo behu sɛ me nsɛm no yɛ nokware.
141.7: Wɔbɛka se, “Sɛnea obi funtum na otutu asase no,saa ara na wɔabɔ yɛn nnompe ahwete ɔda ano.”
141.8: Nanso Otumfo Awurade, mʼani wɔ wo so;wo mu na mihintaw, nnyaw me mma owu.
141.9: Bɔ me ho ban fi mfiri a wɔasunsum me no ho,mfiri a abɔnefo asunsum no.
141.10: Ma amumɔyɛfo no ankasa ɔtan nyi wɔn,bere a mitwa mu kɔ dwoodwoo no.

27.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Awurade ne me hann ne me nkwagye;hena na minsuro no?Awurade ne me nkwa ahoɔden,na hena anim na me ho mpopo?
27.2: Sɛ nnipa bɔne bɔ toa mepɛ sɛ wokum me,sɛ mʼatamfo tow hyɛ me so a,wobehintihintiw ahwehwe ase.
27.3: Sɛ dɔm mpo twa me ho hyia a,me koma rentu;mpo sɛ wotu me so sa a,ɛno mu koraa na minya awerehyɛmu.
27.4: Ade baako na mibisa Awurade;na ɛno na mehwehwɛ;sɛ mɛtena Awurade fime nkwanna nyinaa,na mahwɛ Awurade ahoɔfɛna mahwehwɛ no wɔ nʼasɔrefi.
27.5: Hiada mu no,ɔde me besie nʼatenae dwoodwoo;ɔbɛkora me wɔ Ahyiae Ntamadan kronkron muɔde me si ɔbotan so wɔ sorosoro.
27.6: Afei ɔbɛma me ti sowɔ atamfo a wɔatwa me ho ahyia no so;mede anigye bɛbɔ afɔre wɔ nʼAhyiae Ntamadan mu;na mɛto dwom, ahyehyɛ nnwom ama Awurade.
27.7: Awurade, sɛ misu frɛ wo a, tie me!Hu me mmɔbɔ na gye me so!
27.8: Me koma ka wɔ wo ho se, “Hwehwɛ nʼanim!”Wʼanim, Awurade na mɛhwehwɛ.
27.9: Mfa wʼanim nhintaw me,mfa abufuw mpam wo somfome boafo ne wo.Mpo me, na nnyaw me,mʼAgyenkwa Nyankopɔn.
27.10: Mʼagya ne me na begyaw me hɔ de,nanso Awurade begye me.
27.11: Kyerɛ me wʼakwan, Awurade;fa me fa ɔkwan tee so,me nhyɛsofo nti.
27.12: Nnyaa me mma sɛnea mʼatamfo pɛ,nnansekurumfo sɔre tia mena wopuw awurukasɛm.
27.13: Meda so wɔ saa anidaso yi sɛ:mehu Awurade ayamyewɔ ateasefo asase so.
27.14: Twɛn Awurade.Hyɛ wo ho den na ma wo bo nyɛ duruna twɛn Awurade.

33.1: Dwom Momfa ahurusi nto dwom mma Awurade, mo atreneefo,ɛfata sɛ wɔn a wɔteɛ no yi no ayɛ.
33.2: Momfa sanku nkamfo Awurade;monto dwom mma no wɔ sankuten so.
33.3: Monto dwom foforo mma no.Momfa nimdeɛ mmɔ sanku no na monteɛ mu ahurusi so!
33.4: Awurade asɛm teɛ na ɛyɛ nokwareodi nokware wɔ nea ɔyɛ nyinaa mu.
33.5: Awurade dɔ treneeyɛ ne atɛntrenee.Nʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ahyɛ asase so ma.
33.6: Awurade asɛm so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsorosoro,nʼanom home so na wɔnam yɛɛ ɔsoro asafo.
33.7: Ɔka po nsu boa ano kuw;na ɔde bun sie nea hɔ dɔ.
33.8: Momma asase sofo nyinaa nsuro Awurade;na wiasefo nyinaa mfa nidi mma no.
33.9: Ɔno na ɔkasa ma ɛbaa muna ɔhyɛ ma egyinaa pintinn.
33.10: Awurade sɛe amanaman no nhyehyɛe;ɔma adesamma nsusuwii yɛ ɔkwa.
33.11: Nanso Awurade nhyehyɛe tim hɔ daa,ne koma mu botae wɔ hɔ ma awo ntoatoaso.
33.12: Nhyira ne ɔman a ne Nyankopɔn ne Awurade,nnipa a oyii wɔn sɛ nʼagyapade no.
33.13: Awurade hwɛ adesamma nyinaa fi ɔsoro.
33.14: Ofi nʼatenae hwɛ wɔn a wɔte asase so nyinaa.
33.15: Ɔno ne nea ɔbɔɔ wɔn nyinaa koma,na osusuw nea wɔyɛ nyinaa ho.
33.16: Ɛnyɛ ɔhene asraafo dɔm kɛse na ebegye no;ɔkofo biara nni hɔ a ofi nʼahoɔden mu guan.
33.17: Ɔpɔnkɔ mu ahotoso yɛ ɔkwa wɔ nkwagye mu;nʼahoɔden nyinaa akyi no, ɔrentumi nnye nkwa.
33.18: Nanso Awurade ani wɔ wɔn a wosuro no no so,wɔn a wɔwɔ anidaso wɔ ne dɔ a ɛnsa da no mu,
33.19: sɛ obegye wɔn afi owu muna wama wɔatena nkwa mu wɔ ɔkɔm bere mu.
33.20: Yɛde anidaso twɛn Awurade;ɔyɛ yɛn boafo ne yɛn nkatabo.
33.21: Ne mu na yɛn koma di ahurusi,efisɛ yɛde yɛn ho to ne din kronkron no so.
33.22: Ma wʼadɔe a ɛnsa da no ntena yɛn so, Awurade,sɛnea anidaso a yɛwɔ wɔ mu no te.

37.1: Dwom Dawid dwom.Nhaw wo ho, nnebɔneyɛfo nti;mma wʼani mmmere wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne;
37.2: Wɔte sɛ sare, ɛrenkyɛ na ahyew,wɔte sɛ dua amono, ɛrenkyɛ na awu.
37.3: Fa wo ho to Awurade so na yɛ papa.Tena asase no so na ma wʼani nka asomdwoe adidibea hɔ.
37.4: Ma wʼani nnye wɔ Awurade muna wama wo nea wo koma pɛ.
37.5: Fa wʼakwan hyɛ Awurade nsam;na fa wo ho to no so, na ɔno na ɔbɛyɛ:
37.6: ɔbɛma wo treneeyɛ ahyerɛn sɛ adekyee,na wʼatɛntrenee ayɛ sɛ owigyinae.
37.7: Yɛ komm wɔ Awurade anim na tɔ wo bo ase twɛn no,nhaw wo ho wɔ wɔn a asi wɔn yiye hoefisɛ wɔnam bɔne akwan so.
37.8: Mma wo bo mmfuw na gyae abufuwhyew;nhaw wo ho, ekowie bɔne nko ara.
37.9: Wobetwa nnebɔneyɛfo agu,nanso wɔn a wɔn ani da Awurade so nowobenya asase no adi so.
37.10: Ɛrenkyɛ, nnebɔneyɛfo bɛyera.Wɔbɛhwehwɛ wɔn, nanso wɔrenhu wɔn.
37.11: Nanso ahobrɛasefo benya asase no adi sona wɔanya asomdwoe mmoroso.
37.12: Amumɔyɛfo bɔ pɔw bɔne tia atreneefona wɔtwɛre wɔn se gu wɔn so;
37.13: nanso Awurade serew amumɔyɛfo,na onim sɛ wɔn nna abɛn.
37.14: Amumɔyɛfo twe afoana wokuntun wɔn ta musɛ wobekum ahiafo ne mmɔborɔfo,sɛ wobekum wɔn a wɔn akwan teɛ.
37.15: Nanso wɔn afoa bɛwowɔ wɔn ankasa koma mu,na wɔn ta mu abubu.
