3.1: “Sɛ ɔbarima gyaa ne yerena ɔbea no kɔware ɔbarima foforo a,ɛsɛ sɛ ɔbarima no san kɔ ɔbea no nkyɛn ana?Ɛremma asase no ho ngu fi koraa ana?Nanso wo ne adɔfo bebree abɔ aguaman,na mprempren de wobɛsan aba me nkyɛn ana?”Awurade na ose.
3.2: “Ma wʼani so hwɛ nkoko no so.Baabi wɔ hɔ a wɔntoo wo mmonnaa da ana?Wotenaa kwankyɛn twɛn adɔfo,wotenaa sɛ mmoahwɛfo a wodi atutena wɔ nweatam so.Woagu asase no ho fi,wode wʼaguamammɔ ne wʼamumɔyɛ na ayɛ.
3.3: Enti wɔatwe obosu asan,na asusowbere su antɔ.Nanso wʼanim ayɛ sɛ oguamanfo a ɔmfɛre hwee;wʼani nwu hwee.
3.4: Nnansa yi ara, woamfrɛ me se:‘Mʼagya, me mmabunmmere mu adamfo,
3.5: wo bo befuw biribiara ana?Wʼabufuwhyew no bɛkɔ so daa ana?’Sɛɛ na wokasa,nanso woyɛ bɔne nyinaa sɛnea wutumi.”
3.6: Israel A Onni NokwareƆhene Yosia adedi bere so no, Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Woahu nea Israel a onni nokware no ayɛ? Wakɔ nkoko nyinaa so ne dua a adennan biara ase akɔsɛe aware wɔ hɔ.
3.7: Misusuwii sɛ anka wayɛ eyinom nyinaa akyi no, ɔbɛsan aba me nkyɛn nanso wamma, na ne nuabea Yuda a ɔno nso nka nokware no hui.
3.8: Memaa Israel a onni nokware no awaregyae nhoma na mepam no esiane nʼawaresɛe abrabɔ nti. Nanso mihuu sɛ ne nuabea Yuda a onni nokware no ansuro; ɔno nso kɔbɔɔ aguaman bra.
3.9: Esiane sɛ Israel aguamammɔ anyɛ no asɛnhia nti, ɔde fi kaa asase no na ɔne abo ne nnua bɔɔ aguaman.
3.10: Eyinom nyinaa akyi no, ne nuabea Yuda amfi ne koma nyinaa mu ansan amma me nkyɛn, ɔyɛ de kyerɛɛ kɛkɛ,” sɛnea Awurade se ni.
3.11: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Israel a onni nokware no teɛ sen Yuda okontomponi no.
3.12: Kɔ, fa wʼani kyerɛ atifi fam kɔka saa nsɛm yi kyerɛ wɔn:“ ‘San wʼakyi, Israel a onni nokware,’ Sɛɛ na Awurade se,‘Meremmuna nkyerɛ wo bio,efisɛ meyɛ mmɔborɔhunufo,’ sɛɛ na Awurade se,‘Me bo remfuw afebɔɔ.
3.13: Gye wo afɔdi to mu,woatew Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn anim atua,woakyekyɛ wʼadɔe mu ama ananafo anyamewɔ dua biara a adennan ase,na woanyɛ osetie amma me,’ ”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
3.14: “Monsan mo akyi, mo akyirisanfo,” sɛnea Awurade se ni, “efisɛ meyɛ mo kunu. Meyi wo; ɔbaako befi kurow mu na baanu afi abusuakuw mu, na mede mo aba Sion.
3.15: Afei mɛma mo nguanhwɛfo a wɔda me koma so, wɔn a wɔde nimdeɛ ne ntease bɛkyerɛ mo ɔkwan.
3.16: Saa nna no mu, sɛ mo dɔɔso bebree wɔ asase no so a,” Awurade na ose, “nnipa renka bio se, ‘Awurade apam adaka no.’ Ɛremma wɔn adwene mu anaa wɔrenkae da; wɔn kɔn rennɔ na wɔrenyɛ foforo nso.
3.17: Saa bere no wɔbɛfrɛ Yerusalem Awurade Ahengua, na amanaman nyinaa behyia wɔ Yerusalem abɛkamfo Awurade din. Na wɔrenni wɔn koma bɔne a ɛma wɔyɛ asoɔden no akyi bio.
3.18: Saa nna no mu, Yuda fi bɛka Israelfi ho, na wɔabɔ mu afi atifi fam asase bi so aba asase a mede maa mo agyanom sɛ agyapade no so.
3.19: “Mʼankasa mekae se,‘Anka ɛbɛyɛ me anigye sɛ mɛyɛ mo sɛ mmana mama mo asase a eye,agyapade a edi mu ma ɔman biara.’Misusuwii sɛ mobɛfrɛ me ‘Agya’na monnan mo ho mfi mʼakyi.
3.20: Nanso te sɛ ɔbea a onni ne kunu nokware no,saa ara na moanni me nokware, Israelfi,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.
3.21: Wɔte osu bi wɔ nkoko no so,ɛyɛ Israelfo agyaadwotwa ne nkotosrɛ,efisɛ wɔakyeakyea wɔn akwanna wɔn werɛ afi Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn.
3.22: “Monsan mmra, ɔyera mma;mɛsa mo akyirisan yare no.”“Yiw, yɛbɛba wo nkyɛn,efisɛ wo ne Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn no.
3.23: Ampa, ahoni huuyɛ wɔ nkokone mmepɔw so no yɛ nnaadaa;nokware Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn muna Israel nkwagye wɔ.
3.24: Efi yɛn mmofraase, anyame huhuw adiyɛn agyanom nsa ano adwuma so aba,wɔn nguankuw ne anantwi,wɔn mmabarima ne wɔn mmabea.
3.25: Momma yɛmfa yɛn aniwu nneda famna yɛn ahohora nkata yɛn so.Yɛayɛ bɔne atia Awurade yɛn Nyankopɔn,yɛn ne yɛn agyanom;efi yɛn mmofraase besi nnɛyɛanyɛ osetie amma Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn no.”

2.1: Israel Pa Onyankopɔn AkyiAwurade asɛm baa me so:
2.2: “Kɔpae mu ka ma Yerusalem nte:“ ‘Mekae sɛnea wode wo ho maa me wo mmabun bere mu,sɛnea wodɔɔ me wɔ wʼayeforo bere muna wudii mʼakyi wɔ sare so,asase a wonnuaa hwee wɔ so no.
2.3: Na Israel yɛ kronkron ma Awurade,ne twabere mu aduankan;wɔn a wodii nʼani no wobuu wɔn fɔ,na amanehunu baa wɔn so,’ ”sɛnea Awurade, se ni.
2.4: Muntie Awurade asɛm, mo Yakob asefo,mo Israel mmusuakuw nyinaa.
2.5: Eyi ne nea Awurade se:“Mfomso bɛn na mo agyanom huu wɔ me ho aɛma wɔtwee wɔn ho kɔɔ akyirikyiri sɛɛ?Wodii ahoni a wɔn so nni mfaso akyi,maa wɔn ankasa bɛyɛɛ ahuhufo.
2.6: Wɔammisa se, ‘Ɛhe na Awurade wɔ?Nea oyii yɛn fii Misraimna ɔde yɛn faa sare wosee so,nweatam ne abonabon asasea awo na ayɛ owubon no.Asase a obiara mfa so na obiara nte so no.’
2.7: Mede mo beduaa asasebere sosɛ munni so nnuaba ne ɛso nnepa.Nanso mubeguu mʼasase ho fi,na moyɛɛ mʼagyapade akyiwade.
2.8: Asɔfo no ammisa se,‘Ɛhe na Awurade wɔ?’Wɔn a wɔde mmara yɛ adwuma no anhwehwɛ me;ntuanofo sɔre tiaa me.Adiyifo no de Baal hyɛɛ nkɔm,na wodii ahoni huhuw akyi.
2.9: “Ɛno nti, merebɔ mo kwaadu bio,”nea Awurade se ni.“Na mɛbɔ mo mma mma kwaadu.
2.10: Muntwa nkɔ Kitim mpoano nkɔhwɛ,monsoma nkɔ Kedar nkɔhwehwɛ mu yiye;monhwɛ sɛ biribi a ɛte sɛɛ asi wɔ hɔ:
2.11: Ɔman bi asesa wɔn anyame pɛn ana?Nso wɔnnyɛ anyame mpo.Nanso me nkurɔfo de wɔn anuonyamasesa ahoni huhuw.
2.12: Mo ɔsorosoro, momma mo ho nnwiriw mo wɔ eyi ho,na mo ho nwosow wɔ akomatu mu,”nea Awurade se ni.
2.13: “Me nkurɔfo ayɛ bɔne ahorow abien:Wɔapa me,me a meyɛ nkwa asubura no,na wɔatutu wɔn ankasa mmura amoa,mmura a apaapae a entumi nkora nsu.
2.14: Israel yɛ akoa anaa ɔsomfo fi awo mu ana?Adɛn nti na wayɛ asade yi?
2.15: Gyata abobɔ mu;wɔaworo so akyerɛ no.Wɔama nʼasase ada mpan;wɔahyehyew ne nkurow ayɛ no amamfo.
2.16: Afei Memfis ne Tapanhes mmarimaayi wo ti so nwi.
2.17: Ɛnyɛ wo na woama eyi aba wo sosɛ wopaa Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyi,wɔ bere a ɔrekyerɛ wo kwan no?
2.18: Afei adɛn nti na wokɔ Misraimkɔnom Sihor mu nsu?Na adɛn nti na wokɔ Asiriakɔnom Asubɔnten no mu nsu?
2.19: Wo amumɔyɛ bɛtwe wʼaso;wo nsanakyi bɛka wʼanim.Enti dwene ho na hu sɛ,sɛ wopa Awurade wo Nyankopɔn akyina woannya ne ho suro a,ɛyɛ bɔne ne ɔyaw ma wo.”Awurade, Asafo Awurade na ose.
2.20: “Tete mmere no, wububuu wo konnua mu,na wotetew wo nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn mu;na wokae se, ‘Merensom wo!’Ampa, wɔ koko biara sone dua biara a adennan asena wotena bɔɔ aguaman.
2.21: Miduaa wo sɛ bobe ankasaa efi bobe a ase ye pa ara mu.Na ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wodan wʼakyi kyerɛɛ mebɛyɛɛ bobe a anyin asɛe wɔ wura mu yi?
2.22: Sɛ wode sodane samina bebree guare mpo a,wʼafɔdi nkekae da so wɔ mʼanim ara,”sɛnea Otumfo Awurade se ni.
2.23: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na woaka se, ‘Me ho nguu fi ɛ;minnii Baalnom akyi ɛ’?Hwɛ sɛnea woyɛɛ wo ho wɔ obon no mu;dwene nea woayɛ no ho.Woyɛ yomabere hoɔharefoa wutu mmirika kɔ ha ba ha,
2.24: wura mu afurum a nweatam so tena akokwaw no,ohuahua bere a ɔpɛ sɛ onini hyia no.Sɛ nʼakɔnnɔ no ano yɛ den a hena na obesianka no?Anini biara a wɔtaa no no nhaw wɔn ho bebree;edu bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wohyia no a wobenya no.
2.25: Ntu mmirika nkosi sɛ wʼanan ase bɛyɛ kwaterekwa,na wo mene mu bɛyow.Nanso wokae se, ‘So nni mfaso!Mepɛ ananafo anyame,na ɛsɛ sɛ midi wɔn akyi.’
2.26: “Sɛnea wɔkyere ɔkorɔmfo a wogu nʼanim ase no,saa na wɔagu Israelfi anim ase,wɔn ankasa, wɔn ahemfo ne wɔn adwumayɛfo,wɔn asɔfo ne wɔn adiyifo.
2.27: Wɔka kyerɛ dua se, ‘Woyɛ mʼagya,’ne ɔbo se, ‘Wo na wowoo me.’Wɔadan wɔn akyi akyerɛ mena ɛnyɛ wɔn anim;nanso sɛ amanehunu bi ba wɔn so a, wɔka se,‘Bra begye yɛn!’
2.28: Anyame a moyɛ maa mo ho no wɔ he?Momma wɔmmra sɛ wobetumi agye mobere a mowɔ amanehunu mu!Efisɛ mowɔ anyame bebreete sɛ nea mowɔ nkurow bebree no, Yuda.
2.29: “Adɛn nti na mobɔ me sobo?Mo nyinaa ayɛ dɔm atia me,”Awurade na ose.
2.30: “Metwee mo nkurɔfo aso kwa;wɔamfa me nteɛso.Wʼafoa akunkum wʼadiyifote sɛ gyata a nʼani abere.
2.31: “Mo nnɛmmafo, munnwen Awurade asɛm ho:“Mayɛ sɛ, nweatam ama Israel ana?Anaasɛ asase a so aduru sum kabii ana?Adɛn nti na me nkurɔfo ka se, ‘Yɛwɔ ho kwan sɛ yekyinkyin;yɛremma wo nkyɛn bio.’
2.32: Ɔbabun werɛ fi ne mpempranne,ayeforo werɛ befi nʼahyehyɛde ana?Nanso me nkurɔfo werɛ afi menna a wontumi nkan.
2.33: Hwɛ nyansa a mowɔ de pɛ mo adɔfo!Mmea a wɔnsɛ hwee koraa tumi sua mo akwan.
2.34: Mo adurade mu wɔahiafo a wodi bem mogya,nanso moankyere wɔn sɛ wɔrebubu akɔ mu.Eyinom nyinaa akyi
2.35: woka se, ‘Midi bem;ne bo mfuw me.’Nanso mebu wo atɛnefisɛ woka se, ‘Menyɛɛ bɔne biara ɛ.’
2.36: Adɛn nti na wukyinkyin sɛɛ,sesa wʼakwan?Misraim bedi wo huammɔsɛnea Asiria yɛe no.
2.37: Afei wubefi saa beae hɔa wo nsa gu wo ti so.Efisɛ Awurade apo wɔn a wode wo ho too wɔn so no;wɔremmoa wo.

48.1: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Moab HoNea ɛfa Moab ho:Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se:“Nebo nnue, na wɔbɛsɛe no.Wobegu Kiriataim anim ase, na wɔafa;wobegu aban dennen no anim ase, na wɔadwiriw agu fam.
48.2: Wɔrenkamfo Moab bio;Hesbon mmarima bɛbɔ nʼasehwe ho pɔw;‘Mommra, momma yɛnkɔbɔ saa ɔman yi.’Mo nso, Madmen mmarima mobɛka mo ano ato mu;afoa no bɛtaa mo.
48.3: Muntie osu a efi Horonaim,adesɛe ne ɔsɛe ho su.
48.4: Wɔbɛbɔ Moab:na ne mma nketewa bɛteɛteɛ mu.
48.5: Wɔforo kɔ Luhit,wɔde agyaadwotwa a mu yɛ den na ɛrekɔ;ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Horonaim so nowɔte ahoyeraw nteɛteɛmu wɔ adesɛe no ho.
48.6: Munguan! muntu mmirika mpere mo nkwa.Monyɛ sɛ wura wɔ nweatam so.
48.7: Esiane sɛ mode mo ho to mo nneyɛe ne mo ahonya so nti,mo nso wɔbɛfa mo nnommum,na Kemos bɛkɔ nnommum mu,ɔne nʼasɔfo ne adwumayɛfo.
48.8: Ɔsɛefo no betu kurow biara so sa,na mu biara rennya ne ho ntetew.Wɔbɛsɛe obon nona wasɛe mmepɔw mpampam a ɛyɛ tamaa no,efisɛ Awurade akasa.
48.9: Momfa nkyene nhyɛ Moab,efisɛ wɔrebɛsɛe no;ne nkurow bɛda mpan aobiara rentena mu.
48.10: “Nnome nka nea ɔtwentwɛn ne nan ase wɔ Awurade adwumayɛ ho!Nnome nka nea ɔmmfa nʼafoa nhwie mogya ngu!
48.11: “Moab atena ase asomdwoe mu fi ne mmerantebere mu,te sɛ nsa ase puw a ataa dinn,wonnhwie mfi ahina mu nkogu ahina foforo mu,ɔnkɔɔ nnommum mu da.Enti ɔte sɛ nea ɔte ara,na ne ho hua nsakrae ɛ.
48.12: Nanso nna bi reba,”Awurade na ose,“a mɛsoma mmarima a wohwie fi ahina mu,na wobehwie no agu;wɔbɛma nʼahina mu ayɛ hweena wɔabobɔ ne nkuruwa.
48.13: Afei Kemos ho bɛyɛ Moab aniwu,sɛnea Israelfi anim guu asebere a wɔde wɔn ho too Bet-El so no.
48.14: “Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na wutumi ka se, ‘Yɛyɛ dɔmmarima,mmarima akokodurufo wɔ ɔsa mu’?
48.15: Wɔbɛsɛe Moab na wɔatu ne nkurow so sa;wobekunkum ne mmerante a wɔte apɔw no,”nea Ɔhene a wɔfrɛ no Asafo Awurade no se ni.
48.17: Munsu no, mo a motete ne ho nyinaa,ne mo a munim ne din nyinaa;monka se, ‘Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na wɔabubu ahempema a ɛyɛ den yiɛyɛɛ dɛn wɔabu anuonyam pema fɛfɛ yi mu!’
48.18: “Fi wʼanuonyam mu,na bɛtena asase wosee no so,wo a wote Dibon Babea,efisɛ nea ɔsɛe Moab nobetu aba wo soabɛsɛe wo nkuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ no.
48.19: Gyina kwankyɛn na hwɛ,wo a wote Aroer.Bisa ɔbarima a ɔreguan no ne ɔbea a ɔrefi mu afi,bisa wɔn se, ‘Asɛm bɛn na asi?’
48.20: Moab anim agu ase, efisɛ wɔabubu no pasaa;muntwa adwo na monteɛteɛ mu!Mommɔ dawuru wɔ Arnon ho sewɔasɛe Moab.
48.21: Atemmu aba bepɔw tamaa sowɔ Holon, Yahas ne Mefaat,
48.23: ne Kiriataim ne Bet Gamul ne Bet Meon
48.24: ne Keriot ne Bosrawɔ Moab nkurow nyinaa, nea ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ne nea ɛbɛn.
48.25: Wɔatwa Moab mmɛn;na ne basa abu,”Awurade na ose.
48.26: “Momma no mmow nsa,efisɛ wabu Awurade animtiaa.Momma Moab nyantam wɔ ne fe mu;momma no nyɛ nea wodi ne ho fɛw.
48.27: Ɛnyɛ Israel na na wudi ne ho fɛw?Wɔkyeree no akorɔmfo mu ana,a enti mowosow mo ti animtiaabu sobere biara a mobɛka ne ho asɛm?
48.28: Mumfifi mo nkurow so nkɔtena abotan mu,mo a motete Moab.Monyɛ sɛ aborɔnoma a ɔyɛ ne berebuwwɔ ɔbodan ano.
48.29: “Yɛate Moab ahantan nonʼahomaso ne gye a ogye ne ho di mmoroso;nʼahantan ne nʼahomaso,ne ne koma mu ahohoahoa.
48.30: Minim nʼasoɔden nanso ɛyɛ ɔkwa,”Awurade na ose,“na nʼahohoahoa mfa hwee mma.
48.31: Enti mitwa adwo ma Moab,misu teɛ mu ma Moabfo nyinaa,midi awerɛhow ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Kir Hereset.
48.32: Misu ma mo sɛnea Yaser su,mo Sibma bobe.Mo mman dennan kɔɔ po ho pɛɛ;koduu Yaser po ho.Ɔsɛefo no abegumo nnuaba a abere ne mo bobe no so.
48.33: Ahosɛpɛw ne anigye atu afiMoab nnuaba nturo ne mfuw so.Matwa nsa a ɛteɛ fi nsakyiamoa no so;obiara mmfa ahosɛpɛw ntiatia bobe no so.Ɛwɔ mu nteɛteɛmu wɔ hɔ de,nanso ɛnyɛ ahosɛpɛw nteɛteɛmu.
48.34: “Wɔn su ano den gyigye fiHesbon kɔ Eleale ne Yahas,fi Soar de kosi Horonaim ne Eglat Selisiya,mpo, nsu a ɛwɔ Nimrim no ayow.
48.35: Moab mu,mede sorɔnsorɔmmea afɔrebɔ ne nnuhuama wɔhyew ma wɔn anyame no, bɛba awiei,”Awurade, na ose.
48.36: “Enti me koma su sɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma Moab;esu sɛ atɛntɛbɛn ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Kir Hereset.Ahonyade a wɔpɛe no kɔ.
48.37: Wɔabɔ eti biara tikwawna wɔayi abogyesɛ biara;nsa nyinaa ho ayɛ akamakamna atweaatam sisi obiara asen.
48.38: Adan a ɛwɔ Moab nyinaa atifine ɔmanfo aguabɔbea nyinaa;biribiara nni hɔ sɛ awerɛhow,efisɛ mabubu Moabayɛ no sɛ ahina a obiara mpɛ,”Awurade na ose.
48.39: “Hwɛ sɛnea wabubu afa! Hwɛ sɛnea wɔretwa adwo!Na hwɛ sɛnea Moab de aniwu dan nʼakyi!Moab ayɛ nea wodi ne ho fɛw,ne ahodwiriwde ama wɔn a wɔatwa ne ho ahyia nyinaa.”
48.40: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monhwɛ! ɔkɔre rebɔ hoo aba fam.Watrɛw ne ntaban mu wɔ Moab so.
48.41: Wɔbɛfa Keriot nnommumna wɔafa nʼabandennen no.Saa da no Moab dɔmmarima komabetu sɛ ɔbea a ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
48.42: Wɔbɛsɛe Moab na ɛrenyɛ ɔman bio,efisɛ obuu Awurade animtiaa.
48.43: Ehu, nkonomoa ne afiri retwɛn mo,Moabfo,”Awurade na ose.
48.44: “Nea oguan nea ɛyɛ hu nobɛtɔ nkonomoa mu,nea ɔbɛforo afi nkonomoa no mu noafide beyi no;na mede Moab asotwe afe no bɛba ne so,”Awurade na ose.
48.45: “Hesbon nwini asena aguanfo no gyinagyina a wonni mmoa biara,efisɛ ogya bi atu afi Hesbon;ogyaframa bi fi Sihon mfimfini;ɛhyew Moab moma,ne ahohoahoafo a wɔn ano yɛ den no ti koraa.
48.46: Nnome nka wo, wo Moab!Wɔasɛe Kemos nkurɔfo no;wɔde wo mmabarima kɔ nnommum muna wo mmabea nso kɔ nkoasom mu.
48.47: “Nanso mede Moab adenya bɛsan ama nowɔ nna a ɛbɛba no mu,”Awurade na ose.Moab atemmu no awiei ni.

49.1: Asɛm A Ɛfa Amon HoNea ɛfa Amonfo ho:Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Israel nni mmabarima ana?Onni wɔn a wobedi nʼade?Ɛno de adɛn nti na Molek afa Gad ayɛ ne de yi?Adɛn nti na ne nkurɔfo tete ne nkurow mu?
49.2: Nanso nna no reba,”Awurade na ose.“Bere a mɛbobɔ mu de afrɛ ɔkoatia Raba a ɛyɛ Amonfo de;ɛbɛyɛ afabo siw,wɔbɛto nkuraa a atwa ne ho ahyia no mu gya.Na Israel bɛpam wɔn awɔpam no no,”sɛɛ na Awurade se.
49.3: “Twa adwo. Hesbon, efisɛ wɔasɛe Ai!Monteɛ mu, mo a mowɔ Raba!Mumfura ayitam na munni awerɛhow;mommɔ nnyenyen wɔ afasu no mu,efisɛ Molek bɛkɔ nnommum mu,ɔne nʼasɔfo ne nʼadwumayɛfo.
49.4: Adɛn nti na wode wʼabon ahorow no hoahoa wo ho,wʼabon a wunya mu aba bebree no nti?Amon Babea a Onni nokware,wode wo ho to wʼahonya so na woka se,‘Hena na ɔbɛtow ahyɛ me so?’
49.5: Mede ehu bɛba wo so,ebefi wɔn a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no nyinaa,”Awurade na ose, Asafo Awurade no.“Wɔbɛpam mo nyinaa,na obiara remmoaboa akobɔfo ano.
49.6: “Nanso akyiri no, mɛsan de Amonfo adenya ama wɔn,”sɛe na Awurade se.
49.7: Asɛm A Ɛfa Edom HoNea ɛfa Edom ho:Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Nyansa nni Teman bio ana?Afotu ayera wɔ anyansafo mu ana?Wɔn nyansa no aporɔw ana?
49.8: Monnan mo ho na munguan,monkɔtetɛw abodan a mu dɔ mu,mo a motete Dedan,efisɛ mede amanehunu bɛba Esau sowɔ bere a mɛtwe nʼaso no.
49.9: Sɛ bobetetewfo no baa mo nkyɛn aanka wɔrennya bobe no kakra ana?Sɛ akorɔmfo baa ɔdasu mu a,anka wɔrenwia ade dodow a wɔpɛ ana?
49.10: Na mɛma Esau ada adagyaw.Mɛda ne hintabea ahorow adi,sɛnea ɔrentumi mfa ne ho nhintaw.Ne mma, nʼabusuafo ne ne mfɛfo bewuwu,na wɔrenhu no bio.
49.11: Munnyaw mo ayisaa, mɛbɔ wɔn nkwa ho ban.Mo akunafo nso betumi de wɔn ho ato me so.”
49.12: Nea Awurade se ni: “Sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔmfata sɛ wɔnom kuruwa no nom a, ɛno de adɛn nti na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtwe mo aso? Wɔbɛtwe mo aso na mobɛnom nso.
49.13: Meka me ho ntam sɛ wɔbɛsɛe Bosra na ayɛ ahodwiriwde, ahohorade ne nnome; na ne nkurow nyinaa bɛsɛe afebɔɔ,” Awurade na ose.
49.14: Mate asɛm a efi Awurade nkyɛn:wɔsomaa ananmusini bi sɛ ɔnkɔka nkyerɛ amanaman no se,“Mommoaboa mo ho ano nkɔtow nhyɛ no so!Monsɔre nkɔ ɔko!”
49.15: “Na mɛyɛ wo ketewa wɔ aman no mu,na wɔabu wo animtiaa.
49.16: Ehu a wobɔne koma mu ahomaso adaadaa wo,wo a wote abotan ntokuru mu,na wote koko no sorɔnsorɔmmea.Ɛwɔ mu, woyɛ wo berebuw wɔ sorosoro sɛ ɔkɔre de,nanso hɔ na mefi de wo aba fam,”Awurade na ose.
49.17: “Edom bɛyɛ ahodwiriwde;wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ hɔ no nyinaa ho bedwiriw wɔn na wɔadi ne ho fɛwesiane nʼapirakuru nyinaa nti.
49.18: Sɛnea wɔdan Sodom ne Gomorane wɔn nkurow gui no,”Awurade na ose,“saa ara na obiara rentena hɔ;onipa biara rentena mu.
49.19: “Sɛnea gyata a ofi Yordan nkyɛkyerɛ murekɔ adidibea frɔmfrɔm no,saa ara na mɛtaa Edom afi nʼasase so wɔ bere tiaa bi mu.Hena ne nea mayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ eyi?Hena na ɔte sɛ me, na hena na obetumi ne me adi asi?Na oguanhwɛfo bɛn na obetumi asɔre atia me?”
49.20: Enti tie nea Awurade ahyehyɛ atia Edom,nea wabɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛyɛ de atia wɔn a wɔte Teman ni:Nguankuw no mu nkumaa no wɔbɛtwe wɔn akɔ;wɔn nti ɔbɛsɛe adidibea no koraa.
49.21: Wɔn asehwe nnyigyei bɛma asase awosow;wɔn nteɛteɛmu gyegyeegye akodu Po Kɔkɔɔ ho.
49.22: Monhwɛ! Ɔkɔre bi betu akɔ soro na wabɔ hoo aba fam awatrɛtrɛw ne ntaban mu wɔ Bosra so.Saa da no Edom dɔmmarima komabetu sɛ ɔbea a ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
49.23: Asɛm A Ɛfa Damasko HoNea ɛfa Damasko ho:“Hamat ne Arpad di yaw,efisɛ wɔate asɛmmɔne.Wɔn koma abotowte sɛ po a ayɛ hagyahagya.
49.24: Damasko ayɛ mmerɛw,wayɛ sɛ ɔrebeguanwabɔ huboa;ahoyeraw ne ɔyaw akyekyere no,ɔyaw a ɛte sɛ ɔbea a, ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
49.25: Adɛn nti na wonnyaw kuropɔn a agye din yi ntoo hɔ,kurow a mʼani gye mu?
49.26: Ampa ara ne mmerante bɛtotɔ wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔbɛma nʼasraafo nyinaa aka wɔn ano ato mu saa da no,”sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se.
49.27: “Mede ogya bɛto Damasko afasu mu;na ɛbɛhyew Ben-Hadad aban.”
49.28: Asɛm A Ɛfa Kedar Ne Hasor HoNea ɛfa Kedar ne Hasor ahenni, a Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar tow hyɛɛ so no.Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Sɔre na kɔtow hyɛ Kedar sona sɛe nnipa a wɔwɔ apuei fam no.
49.29: Wɔbɛfa wɔn ntamadan ne wɔn nguankuw;wɔbɛfa wɔn nkataso,ne wɔn ho nneɛma ne yoma akɔ.Nnipa bɛteɛteɛ mu se,‘Ehu wɔ baabiara!’
49.30: “Munguan nkɔ ntɛmntɛm!Monhyehyɛ abodan a mu dɔ mu, mo a motete Hasor,”Awurade na ose.“Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar apam mo ti so;wayɛ nhyehyɛe a etia mo.
49.31: “Sɔre kɔtow hyɛ ɔman bi so a woremmrɛ,ɔman a wɔte ahotoso mu,”Awurade na ose,“ɔman a wonni apon anaa akwanside;na emu nnipa nko ara na wɔte.
49.32: Wɔn mfurum bɛyɛ asade,na wɔn anantwikuw akɛse no bɛyɛ asade.Mɛbɔ saa nnipa a wɔtete akyirikyiri no ahwete ama mframa no,na mede amanehunu befi afa nyinaa aba wɔn so,”Awurade na ose.
49.33: “Hasor bɛyɛ ahade ama adompo,ɛbɛda mpan afebɔɔ.Obiara rentena hɔ;onipa biara rentena mu.”
49.34: Asɛm A Ɛfa Elam HoEyi ne asɛm a, efi Awurade nkyɛn baa odiyifo Yeremia hɔ a ɛfa Elam ho, wɔ Yudahene Sedekia adedi mfiase:
49.35: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Hwɛ mebubu Elam agyan mu,nea wɔn ahoɔden gyina so no.
49.36: Mede mframa anan no bɛba Elam soafi ɔsorosoro afanan;mɛbɔ wɔn ahwete mframa anan no mu,na ɔman biara nni hɔ aElam atubrafo renkɔ so.
49.37: Mɛbɔ Elam ahwete wɔ wɔn atamfo anim,wɔ wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ wɔn akum wɔn no anim;mede amanehunu bɛba wɔn sompo mʼabufuwhyew no,”Awurade na ose.“Mede afoa bɛtaa wɔnkosi sɛ, mewie wɔn korakora.
49.38: Mesi mʼahengua wɔ Elamna masɛe ne hene ne nʼadwumayɛfo,”Awurade na ose.
49.39: “Nanso mɛsan de Elam adenya ama nonna a ɛreba no mu,”Awurade na ose.

1.1: Nsɛm a efi Yeremia nkyɛn ni. Yeremia yɛ Hilkia babarima a na ɔyɛ Anatot asɔfo no mu baako wɔ Benyamin asase so.
1.2: Awurade asɛm baa ne nkyɛn wɔ Yosia a ɔyɛ Yuda hene Amon babarima adedi afe a ɛto so dumiɛnsa no mu.
1.3: Ɛtoaa so wɔ Yuda hene Yosia babarima Yehoiakim bere so, kosii Yuda hene Yosia babarima Sedekia bere so a nnipa a wɔte Yerusalem kɔɔ nkoasom mu wɔ adedi no afe a ɛto so dubaako no ɔsram a ɛto so anum no mu.
1.4: Yeremia FrɛAwurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se,
1.5: “Ansa na mereyɛ wo wɔ awotwaa mu no na minim wo;ansa na wɔrebɛwo wo no, miyii wo sii nkyɛn;meyɛɛ wo odiyifo maa aman no.”
1.6: Mekae se, “Aa, Otumfo Awurade minnim kasa; meyɛ abofra.”
1.7: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Nka se ‘meyɛ abofra.’ Ɛsɛ sɛ wokɔ obiara a mɛsoma wo no nkyɛn na woka asɛm biara a mɛhyɛ wo sɛ ka no.
1.8: Nsuro wɔn, efisɛ meka wo ho, na magye wo,” nea Awurade se ni.
1.9: Na Awurade teɛɛ ne nsa de kaa mʼano na ɔka kyerɛɛ me se, “Mprempren mede me nsɛm ahyɛ wʼanom.
1.10: Hwɛ, nnɛ, mede wo asi aman ne ahenni so sɛ, tutu na dwiriw gu, sɛe na tu gu, kyekyere na dua.”
1.11: Na Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn se, “Dɛn na wuhu yi, Yeremia?”Na mibuae se, “Mihu ɔsonkoran dubaa.”
1.12: Na Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Wahu no yiye, na merehwɛ anim sɛ mʼasɛm bɛba mu.”
1.13: Awurade asɛm baa me nkyɛn bio se, “Dɛn na wuhu yi?”Mibuae se, “Mihu kuku a ɛrehuru sɛ ano rekyea akyerɛ yɛn fi atifi fam.”
1.14: Awurade ka kyerɛɛ me se, “Wobefi atifi fam de amanehunu aba wɔn a wɔte asase no so nyinaa so.
1.15: Merebɛfrɛ atifi ahenni mu nnipa nyinaa,” nea Awurade se ni.“Wɔn ahemfo de wɔn ahengua bɛbaabesisi Yerusalem kuropɔn apon ano;wɔbɛtow ahyɛ nʼafasu a atwa ahyiane Yuda nkurow nyinaa so.
1.16: Mebu me nkurɔfo atɛnwɔ wɔn amumɔyɛ sɛ wɔagyaw me,sɛ wɔhyew nnuhuam ma anyame afoforona wɔkotow sɔre nea wɔde wɔn nsa ayɛ.
1.17: “Siesie wo ho! Sɔre na ka nea mɛka akyerɛ wo biara kyerɛ wɔn. Mma wɔmmmɔ wo hu, anyɛ saa a mɛma woabɔ hu wɔ wɔn anim.
1.18: Nnɛ, mayɛ wo kuropɔn a ɛwɔ bammɔ, dadedum ne kɔbere fasu sɛ wobɛsɔre atia asase no nyinaa, Yuda ahemfo, nʼadwumayɛfo, asɔfo ne nnipa a wɔwɔ asase no so.
1.19: Wɔbɛko atia wo, nanso wɔrentumi nni wo so nkonim, efisɛ meka wo ho na megye wo,” sɛnea Awurade se ni.

50.1: Asɛm A Ɛfa Babilonia HoAsɛm a Awurade nam odiyifo Yeremia so ka faa Babilonia ne Babiloniafo asase ho ni:
50.2: “Mommɔ no dawuru na mompae mu nka wɔ amanaman mu.Momma frankaa so na mompae mu nka;na momma wɔnte sɛ,‘Wɔbɛfa Babilonia;wobegu Bel anim ase,na ehu bɛhyɛ Merodak ma.Wobegu ne nsɛsode anim asena ehu bɛhyɛ nʼahoni ma.’
50.3: Ɔman bi fi atifi fam bɛtow ahyɛ ne sona wɔbɛyɛ nʼasase amamfo.Obiara rentena so;nnipa ne mmoa beguan afi so.
50.4: “Nna no mu ne saa bere no,”Awurade na ose,“Israelfo ne Yudafo bɛka abɔ mude nusu akɔhwehwɛ wɔn Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn.
50.5: Wobebisa ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Sionna wɔde wɔn ani akyerɛ hɔ.Wɔbɛba de wɔn ho abɛbɔ Awuradewɔ daa apam awerɛ remfi mu.
50.6: “Me nkurɔfo ayɛ nguan a wɔayera;wɔn nguanhwɛfo ama wɔafom ɔkwanma wokyinkyin mmepɔw so.Wokyinkyin bepɔw ne koko sona wɔn werɛ fii wɔn ankasa homebea.
50.7: Obiara a ohuu wɔn no tetew wɔn mu:wɔn atamfo kae se, ‘Yenni fɔ,efisɛ wɔyɛɛ bɔne tiaa Awurade, wɔn nokware didibea no,Awurade wɔn agyanom anidaso no.’
50.8: “Munguan mfi Babilonia;mumfi Babiloniafo asase so,na monyɛ sɛ mpapo a wodi nguankuw anim.
50.9: Mɛkanyan amanaman akɛse nkabomafi atifi fam asase so de wɔn abɛko atia Babilonia.Wobegyinagyina wɔn afa atia no,wobefi atifi fam ako afa no.Wɔn agyan bɛyɛ sɛ dɔmmarima a wɔakwadaw akodi mu,wɔn a wɔmmfa nsapan nsan wɔn akyi.
50.10: Enti wɔbɛfow Babilonia;wɔn a wɔfow no nyinaa benya asade bebree,”Awurade na ose.
50.11: “Esiane sɛ mo ani gye na mudi ahurusi,mo a mofow mʼagyapade,sɛ muhuruhuruw anigye so te sɛ nantwiforo a ɔwɔ sare frɔmfrɔm muna musu te sɛ apɔnkɔnini nti,
50.12: wo na ani bewu pa ara;nea ɔwoo wo anim begu ase.Ɔbɛyɛ akumaa wɔ amanaman no mu,sare, asase wosee ne nweatam.
50.13: Awurade abufuw nti, obiara rentena hɔna ɛbɛda mpan korakora.Wɔn a wotwa mu wɔ Babilonia nyinaa ho bedwiriw wɔn na wɔadi ne ho fɛwesiane nʼapirakuru nyinaa nti.
50.14: “Munnyinagyina mo afa ntwa Babilonia ho nhyia,mo a motow agyan nyinaa.Montow no! Munnyaw bɛmma biara,efisɛ wayɛ bɔne atia Awurade.
50.15: Monteɛ mu ntia no wɔ afanan nyinaa!Ɔma ne nsa so, nʼabandennen bubu,wodwiriw nʼafasu gu fam.Esiane sɛ eyi yɛ Awurade aweretɔ no nti,montɔ ne so were;monyɛ no sɛnea wayɛ afoforo no.
50.16: Munyi ogufo mfi Babilonia,ɔne otwafo a okura ne kantankrankyi wɔ otwabere mu no.Esiane nhyɛsofo no afoa ntiobiara nsan nkɔ ne nkurɔfo mu,obiara nguan nkɔ nʼankasa asase so.
50.17: “Israel yɛ nguankuw a wɔahwetea gyata apam wɔn.Nea odii kan tetew ne muyɛ Asiriahene;na nea ɔdwerɛwee ne nnompe akyiri noyɛ Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar.”
50.18: Ɛno nti, sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se:“Mɛtwe Babiloniahene ne nʼasase asosɛnea metwee Asiriahene aso no.
50.19: Na mede Israel bɛsan aba nʼankasa didibea,na obedidi wɔ Karmel ne Basan;ɔbɛmee wɔ Efraim ne Gilead nkoko so.
50.20: Saa nna no ne saa bere no,”Awurade na ose,“Wɔbɛhwehwɛ Israel afɔbu mu,nanso wɔrennya bi,wɔbɛhwehwɛ Yuda nnebɔne mu,nanso wɔrenhu bi,efisɛ, mede nkae a migyaa wɔn no bɔne bɛkyɛ wɔn.
50.21: “Montow nhyɛ Merataim asase sone nnipa a wɔte Pekod.Montaa wɔn, munkunkum wɔnna monsɛe wɔn korakora,”Awurade na ose.“Monyɛ biribiara a mahyɛ mo no.
50.22: Ɔko mu gyegyeegye wɔ asase no so,ɔsɛe kɛse nnyigyei!
50.23: Hwɛ sɛnea wɔabubu na wɔabobɔasase nyinaa so asae!Hwɛ sɛnea Babilonia ada mpanwɔ amanaman no mu!
50.24: Misum wo afiri, Babilonia,na eyii wo ansa na worehu;wohuu wo kyeree woefisɛ woko tiaa Awurade.
50.25: Otumfo Awurade abue nʼakode adekoradanna wayi nʼabufuwhyew akode de apue,efisɛ Asafo Awurade wɔ adwuma yɛwɔ Babiloniafo asase so.
50.26: Mumfi akyirikyiri mmra ne so.Mummubu nʼasan no ani;monhɔre no siw sɛ awi akuwakuw.Monsɛe no korakorana munnyaw nkae biara mma no.
50.27: Munkunkum nʼanatwinini nyinaa;momfa wɔn nkɔ mma wonkokum wɔn!Mmusu nka wɔn! Efisɛ wɔn da no adu,bere a wɔde bɛtwe wɔn aso no.
50.28: Muntie akobɔfo ne aguanfo a wofi Babilonia nosɛ wɔreka wɔ Sionsɛnea Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn atɔ were,nʼasɔrefi ho aweretɔ.
50.29: “Momfrɛ agyantowfo nkɔtoa Babilonia,wɔn a wɔtow agyan nyinaa.Muntwa ne ho nhyia;mommma obiara nguan.Muntua ne nneyɛe so ka;monyɛ no sɛnea wayɛ.Efisɛ wabu Awurade animtiaa,Israel kronkronni no.
50.30: Enti ne mmerante bɛtotɔ wɔ mmɔnten so;wɔbɛtɔre nʼasraafo nyinaa ase saa da no,”Awurade na ose.
50.31: “Hwɛ, mikyi wo; ɔhantanni.”Awurade, Asafo Awurade na ose,“efisɛ wo da no adubere a wɔde bɛtwe wʼaso no.
50.32: Ɔhantanni no behintiw na wahwe ase,obiara remmoa no mma ɔnnsɔre;mɛto ne nkurow mu gyana ahyew wɔn a atwa ne ho ahyia nyinaa.”
50.33: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade se:“Wɔhyɛ Israelfo so,na Yudafo nso saa ara.Wɔn nnommumfafo no kura wɔn dennena wɔmpɛ sɛ wogyaa wɔn ma wɔkɔ.
50.34: Nanso wɔn Gyefo yɛ ɔhoɔdenfo;ne din ne Asafo Awurade.Obedi wɔn asɛm ama wɔn anibere so,sɛnea ɔde ahotɔ bɛba wɔn asase no so,na wɔn a wɔte Babilonia no nea wahyɛ wɔn ahometew.
50.35: “Afoa a etia Babiloniafo!”Awurade na ose,“etia wɔn a wɔte Babiloniana etia nʼadwumayɛfo ne nʼanyansafo!
50.36: Afoa a etia nʼatoro adiyifo!Wɔbɛdan nkwaseafo.Afoa a etia nʼakofo!Ehu bɛhyɛ wɔn ma.
50.37: Afoa a etia nʼapɔnkɔ ne ne nteaseɛnamne ananafo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu nyinaa!Wɔbɛdan mmea.Afoa a etia nʼademude!Wɔbɛfom.
50.38: Ɔyow wɔ nʼasu ahorow so!Ɛbɛyoyow.Efisɛ ɛyɛ ahoni asase,ahoni a ehu bɛma wɔabobɔ adam.
50.39: “Enti sare so mmoa ne mpataku bɛtena hɔ,na ɛhɔ na patu bɛtena.Obiara rentena so bioefi awo ntoatoaso kosi awo ntoatoaso.
50.40: Sɛnea Onyankopɔn tuu Sodom ne Gomorane wɔn nkurow gui no,”Awurade na ose,“saa ara na obiara rentena hɔ;onipa biara rentena mu.
50.41: “Monhwɛ! Asraafo bi fi atifi fam reba;ɔman kɛse ne ahemfo bebree,wɔrehwanyan wɔn afi nsase ano.
50.42: Wokurakura bɛmma ne mpeaw;wɔn tirim yɛ den, na wonni ahummɔbɔ.Wɔn nnyigyei te sɛ po a ɛworo so.Sɛ wɔtete wɔn apɔnkɔ so a,wɔba sɛ mmarima a wɔrekɔ saabɛtow ahyɛ wo so, Ɔbabea Babilonia.
50.43: Babiloniahene ate wɔn ho nsɛm,ne nsa sesa ne ho kwa.Ahohiahia akyekyere noɔyaw a ɛte sɛ ɔbea a ɔrekyem wɔ awo so.
50.44: Sɛnea gyata a ofi Yordan nkyɛkyerɛ murekɔ adidibea frɔmfrɔm no,saa ara na mɛtaa Babilonia fi nʼasase so wɔ bere tiaa bi mu.Hena ne nea mayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ eyi?Hena na ɔte sɛ me, na hena na obetumi ne me adi asi?Na oguanhwɛfo bɛn na obetumi asɔre atia me?”
50.45: Enti tie nea Awurade ahyehyɛ atia Babilonia,nea wabɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔbɛyɛ de atia Babiloniafo asase ni:Nguankuw no mu nkumaa no wɔbɛtwe wɔn akɔ;wɔn nti ɔbɛsɛe adidibea no koraa.
50.46: Babilonia nnommumfa nnyigyei bɛma asase awosow;ne nteɛteɛmu gyegyeegye wɔ amanaman no mu.

44.1: Abosonsom Mu AmanehunuSaa asɛm yi baa Yeremia nkyɛn; ɛfa Yudafo a wɔtete Misraim anafo fam wɔ Migdol, Tapanhes, Memfis ne Misraim atifi fam no ho.
44.2: “Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se: Muhuu amanehunu kɛse a mede baa Yerusalem ne Yuda nkurow nyinaa so no. Nnɛ wɔayeyɛ amamfo na wɔasɛesɛe
44.3: esiane bɔne a wɔayɛ no nti. Wɔhyew nnuhuam, som anyame foforo a, wɔn anaa mo anaa mo agyanom nnim wɔn de hyɛɛ me abufuw.
44.4: Mesomaa mʼasomfo adiyifo mpɛn pii a wɔkae se, ‘Monnyɛ saa atantanne a mikyi no!’
44.5: Nanso wɔantie, wɔamfa anyɛ asɛm, na wɔannan amfi wɔn amumɔyɛsɛm no ho na wɔannyae hyew a wɔhyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo no.
44.6: Enti mihwiee mʼabufuw gui, na ɛdɛw kɔɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so ma ɛsɛesɛe na ɛdedaa mpan sɛnea ɛtete nnɛ yi.
44.7: “Na mprempren, nea Asafo Awurade Nyankopɔn, Israel Nyankopɔn se ni: Adɛn nti na mode amanehunu kɛse aba mo ho so, sɛ muyii mmarima ne mmea, mmofra ne mmotafowa fii Yuda a moannyaw nkae biara amma mo ho.
44.8: Adɛn nti na mode nea mo nsa ayɛ hyɛ me abufuw, na mohyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo wɔ Misraim, baabi a moabɛtena hɔ no? Mobɛsɛe mo ho, na moayɛ nnome ne nsopa wɔ asase so amanaman nyinaa mu.
44.9: Mo werɛ afi amumɔyɛsɛm a mo agyanom, Yuda ahemfo ne ahemmea yɛe, na mo ne mo yerenom nso yɛɛ wɔ Yuda asase ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no ana?
44.10: Ebesi nnɛ yi, wɔmmrɛɛ wɔn ho ase, wɔnnaa nidi adi na wonnii me mmara ne ahyɛde a mede maa mo ne mo agyanom no so.
44.11: “Enti nea Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se ni: Masi mʼadwene pi sɛ mede amanehunu bɛba mo so na masɛe Yuda nyinaa.
44.12: Mɛfa Yuda nkae a wosii wɔn adwene pi sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Misraim akɔtena hɔ no. Wɔn nyinaa bewuwu wɔ Misraim; wɔbɛtotɔ wɔ afoa ano anaa ɔkɔm bekum wɔn. Efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so, afoa ne ɔkɔm bekunkum wɔn. Wɔbɛyɛ nnome, ahodwiriwde, afɔbude ne ahohora.
44.13: Mede afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm bɛtwe wɔn a wɔtete Misraim no aso, sɛnea metwee Yerusalem aso no.
44.14: Yuda nkae a wɔakɔtena Misraim no mu biara renguan, na wɔremfa wɔn ho nni na wɔasan aba Yuda, asase a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔsan bɛtena so no so; wɔn mu biara remma, gye aguanfo kakraa bi.”
44.15: Afei mmarima a na wonim sɛ wɔn yerenom hyew nnuhuam ma anyame foforo, wɔne mmea a wɔwɔ hɔ no nyinaa, nnipadɔm no, ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Misraim Atifi fam ne Anafo fam ka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se,
44.16: “Yɛrentie asɛm a waka akyerɛ yɛn wɔ Awurade din mu no!
44.17: Ampa ara yɛbɛyɛ biribiara a yɛkae se yɛbɛyɛ: Yɛbɛhyew nnuhuam ama Ɔsoro Hemmea na yɛahwie ahwiesa ama no, sɛnea yɛne yɛn agyanom, ahemfo ne adwumayɛfo yɛɛ wɔ Yuda nkurow ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Saa bere no na yɛwɔ aduan, na yedi yiye a yenni ɔhaw biara nso.
44.18: Nanso efi bere a yegyaee nnuhuam a yɛhyew ma Ɔsoro Hemmea, na yegyaee ahwiesa a yɛde ma no no, biribiara abɔ yɛn na yɛrewuwu wɔ afoa ne ɔkɔm ano.”
44.19: Na mmea no ka kaa ho se, “Bere a yɛhyew nnuhuam maa Ɔsoro Hemmea, na yehwiee ahwiesa maa no no, na yɛn kununom nnim sɛ yɛto ɔfam a ɛyɛ ne sɛso, hwie ahwiesa ma no ana?”
44.20: Na Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa; mmarima ne mmea a wɔrebua no no se,
44.21: “Mususuw sɛ, Awurade nnim sɛ, na mo ne mo agyanom, mo ahemfo, adwumayɛfo ne ɔmanfo no hyew nnuhuam ma ahoni wɔ Yuda nkurow so ne Yerusalem mmɔnten so ana?
44.22: Bere a mo amumɔyɛ ne akyiwade a moyɛɛ no fonoo Awurade no, mo asase dannan nnomede ne amamfo a obiara nte so, sɛnea ɛte nnɛ yi.
44.23: Esiane sɛ moahyew nnuhuam, ayɛ bɔne atia Awurade, na moanyɛ osetie amma no, na moanni ne mmara, nʼahyɛde ne nʼadansesɛm so nti, amanehunu aba mo so sɛnea muhu yi.”
44.24: Afei Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ nnipa no nyinaa a mmea no ka ho se, “Mo Yudafo a mowɔ Misraim nyinaa muntie Awurade asɛm.
44.25: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se: Mo ne mo yerenom de mo nneyɛe akyerɛ mo bɔ a mohyɛe se, ‘Ampa ara yebedi bɔ a yɛhyɛe sɛ, yɛbɛhyew nnuhuam ahwie ahwiesa ama Ɔsoro Hemmea no,’ no so.”Monkɔ so, munni mo bɔhyɛ ne mo ntam so!
44.26: Nanso muntie Awurade asɛm, mo Yudafo a mowɔ Misraim nyinaa. Mede me din kɛse no ka ntam se, nea Awurade se ni, obiara a ofi Yuda a ɔte Misraim asase so baabiara remmɔ me din nka ntam bio da se, “Sɛ Otumfo Awurade te ase yi.”
44.27: Na mɛhwɛ ama wɔahu amane na ɛnyɛ yiyedi; Yudafo a wɔwɔ Misraim bewuwu wɔ afoa ne ɔkɔm ano kosi sɛ wɔbɛsɛe wɔn nyinaa.
44.28: Wɔn a wobeguan afi afoa ano na wɔasan afi Misraim akɔ Yuda asase so no bɛyɛ kakraa bi. Afei Yuda nkae a wɔbɛtenaa Misraim no nyinaa behu nea nʼasɛm yɛ nokware; me de anaa wɔn de.
44.29: “ ‘Eyi na ɛbɛyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne ama mo sɛ mɛtwe mo aso wɔ ha, na moahu sɛ ampa ara mʼahunahuna a ɛfa ɔhaw ho no bɛba mu,’ Awurade na ose.
44.30: ‘Mede Misraimhene Farao Hofra rebɛhyɛ nʼatamfo a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum no no nsa, sɛnea mede Yudahene Sedekia hyɛɛ Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar, ne tamfo a na ɔrehwehwɛ no akum no no nsa. Sɛɛ na Awurade se.’ ”

45.1: Asɛm A Wɔde Ma BarukEyi ne nsɛm a odiyifo Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ Neria babarima Baruk wɔ Yudahene Yosia babarima Yehoiakim adedi afe a ɛto so anan no mu, bere a na Baruk akyerɛw nsɛm a efi Yeremia anom no agu nhoma mmobɔwee bi mu.
45.2: “Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, ka kyerɛ wo, Baruk:
45.3: Wokae se, ‘Nnome nka me! Awurade de awerɛhow aka me yawdi ho; apinisi ne ɔbrɛ ama mʼahoɔden asa.’
45.4: Awurade kae se, ‘Ka eyi kyerɛ no: Nea Awurade se ni: Mɛsɛe nea makyekyere na matu nea madua no ase wɔ asase no so nyinaa.
45.5: Enti ɛsɛ sɛ wopɛ nneɛma akɛse ma wo ho ana? Nyɛ saa. Efisɛ mede amanehunu bɛba nnipa nyinaa so, Awurade na ose, nanso baabiara a wobɛkɔ no, mɛbɔ wo ho ban.’ ”

51.1: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monhwɛ, mɛkanyan ɔsɛefo bi honhomatia Babilonia ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Leb Kamai.
51.2: Mɛsoma ananafo akɔ Babiloniasɛ wonkohuhuw ne so na wɔnsɛe nʼasase;wobetia no wɔ afanan nyinaawɔ nʼamanehunu da no.
51.3: Mma agyantowni pema nʼagyan,mma ɔnhyɛ ne nkatabo.Mma ne mmerante mfa wɔn ho nni;sɛe nʼasraafo no pasaa.
51.4: Wɔbɛhwehwe ase a wɔatotɔ wɔ Babilonia,a wɔapirapira yiye wɔ ne mmɔnten so.
51.5: Na Israel Nyankopɔn, Asafo Awurade no,nnyaw Israel ne Yuda hɔ ɛ,ɛwɔ mu, afɔdi ahyɛ wɔn asase no so mawɔ Israel Ɔkronkronni no anim.
51.6: “Munguan mfi Babilonia!Muntu mmirika mpere mo nkwa!Mommma wɔnnsɛe mo esiane ne bɔne nti.Awurade aweretɔbere aso;ɔde nea ɛfata no betua no ka.
51.7: Na Babilonia yɛ sikakɔkɔɔ kuruwa wɔ Awurade nsam;ɔmaa asase nyinaa bow nsa.Aman no nom ne nsa;ɛno nti, afei wɔabobɔ adam.
51.8: Babilonia bɛhwe ase abubu mpofirim.Muntwa ne ho agyaadwo!Mompɛ ne yaw no ano aduru;ebia ne ho bɛtɔ no.
51.9: “ ‘Anka yɛbɛsa Babilonia yare,nanso wontumi nsa no yare;momma yennyaw no hɔ na obiara nkɔ nʼankasa asase so,efisɛ nʼatemmu du sorosoro;ɛforo soro te sɛ omununkum.’
51.10: “ ‘Awurade abu yɛn bem.Mommra, momma yɛnka wɔ Sion,nea Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn ayɛ.’
51.11: “Monsew agyan no ano!Momfa nkatabo no!Awurade ahwanyan Mede ahemfo no,efisɛ ne botae ne sɛ ɔbɛsɛe Babilonia.Awurade bɛtɔ were,ɔbɛtɔ were ama nʼasɔrefi no.
51.12: Mompagyaw frankaa bi ntia Babilonia afasu!Mummia bammɔ mu,momma awɛmfo no nnyinagyina.Munsiesie ahintawee!Awurade bɛma nʼatirimpɔw aba mu,nea wahyɛ atia Babilonia no.
51.13: Mo a motete nsuwansuwa bebree hona nnwetɛbona abu mo so,mo awiei aba,bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa mo kyene no.
51.14: Asafo Awurade, aka ne ho ntam sɛ:mede nnipa bɛhyɛ wo ma sɛ tɛwtɛw,na wɔabɔ ose wɔ wo so.
51.15: “Ɔde ne tumi bɔɔ asase;ɔtoo wiase fapem wɔ ne nyansa muna ɔde ne nhumu trɛw ɔsorosoro mu.
51.16: Sɛ ɔbobɔ mu a, ɔsoro nsu woro so;ɔma omununkum ma ne ho so fi nsase ano.Ɔsoma anyinam ka osu hona ɔma mframa bɔ fi ne koradan mu.
51.17: “Onipa biara nnim nyansa, na onni nimdeɛ;sikadwumfo biara anim gu ase, esiane nʼahoni nti.Ne nsɛsode yɛ atoro;wonni ɔhome biara wɔ wɔn mu.
51.18: Wɔn so nni mfaso, wɔn ho yɛ serew;sɛ wɔn atemmu du so a, wɔbɛyera.
51.19: Nea ɔyɛ Yakob Kyɛfa no nte sɛ eyinom,efisɛ ɔno ne ade nyinaa Yɛfoa Israel, abusua a ɛyɛ nʼagyapade nso ka ho.Asafo Awurade ne ne din.
51.20: “Woyɛ me ko abaa,mʼakode a mede kɔ samede wo dwerɛw amanaman,mede wo sɛe ahenni bebree,
51.21: mede wo bobɔ ɔpɔnkɔ ne ne sotefo,teaseɛnam ne ne kafo,
51.22: mede wo dwerɛw ɔbarima ne ɔbea,mede wo dwerɛw akwakoraa ne ɔbabun,mede wo dwerɛw aberante ne ababaa,
51.23: mede wo dwerɛw oguanhwɛfo ne nguankuw,mede wo dwerɛw okuafo ne anantwi,mede wo dwerɛw amradofo ne adwumayɛfo.
51.24: “Metua Babilonia ne wɔn a wɔtete Babilonia ka wɔ mfomso a, wɔayɛ wɔ Sion nyinaa, wɔ wʼanim,” Awurade na ose.
51.25: “Bepɔw sɛefo, me ne wo anya,wo a wosɛe asase nyinaa no,”Awurade na ose.“Mɛteɛ me nsa wɔ wo somepia wo afi abotan no so,na mayɛ wo sɛ bepɔw a ɛnka hwee.
51.26: Wɔremfa ɔbo biara mfi wo so nyɛ tweatiboanaasɛ fapem mpo,efisɛ wobɛda mpan afebɔɔ,”Awurade na ose.
51.27: “Momma frankaa so wɔ asase no so!Monhyɛn torobɛnto no wɔ amanaman no mu!Munsiesie amanaman no mma wontu no so sa;Momfrɛfrɛ saa ahenni ahorow yi mma wɔnko ntia no:Ararat, Mini ne Askenas.Munnyi ɔsahene ntia no;momfa apɔnkɔ manyamanya te sɛ tɛwtɛw mmra.
51.28: Munsiesie amanaman no mma wontu no so sa,mo Mede ahemfo,wɔn amradofo ne wɔn adwumayɛfo nyinaa,ne aman a wodi so nyinaa.
51.29: Asase no wosow, na onukunuku ne mu,efisɛ Awurade atirimpɔw a etia Babiloniasɛ ɔbɛsɛe Babilonia asase aobiara rentumi ntena so no nsakraa ɛ.
51.30: Babilonia dɔmmarima agyae kowɔhyehyɛ wɔn aban mu.Wɔn ahoɔden asa;wɔayɛ sɛ mmea.Wɔatoto nʼatenae ahorow no mu gya,na wɔabubu nʼapon akyi adaban.
51.31: Abɔfo didi sona asomafo didi so awɔrekɔbɔ Babiloniahene amanneɛ se,wɔafa ne kuropɔn no,
51.32: wɔagye asutwabea ahorow a ɛdeda asubɔnten no ano no afa,na wɔde ogya ato ɔwora no mu,na asraafo no abɔ huboa.”
51.33: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, se:“Babilonia Babea ayɛ sɛ, awiporowbeawɔ bere a wɔretiatia hɔ.Aka kakraa bi, na bere a ɛsɛ sɛ wotwa no sɛ nnɔbae no adu.”
51.34: “Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar adwerɛw yɛn,ɔde yɛn ato ɔhaw mu,wayɛ yɛn sɛ ahina a hwee nni mu.Wamene yɛn sɛ ɔwɔ nona ɔde yɛn nneɛma a ɛyɛ dɛ ahyɛ ne yafunu ma,na wapuw yɛn afi nʼanom agu.
51.35: Ma ayakayakade a wɔde dii yɛn honam no mmra Babilonia so,”nnipa a wɔtete Sion na wɔka.“Ma yɛn mogya ngu wɔn a wɔtete Babilonia so,”Yerusalem na ɔka.
51.36: Enti sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Hwɛ, medi mo asɛm ama mona matɔ were ama mo;Mɛma po a ɛyɛ ne de no ayowna mama ne nsubɔnten ayoyow.
51.37: Babilonia bɛyɛ mmubui siw,sakraman atuahodwiriwde ne fɛwdi,baabi a obiara nte.
51.38: Ne nkurɔfo nyinaa bobɔ mu sɛ gyata,wɔbobɔ mu te sɛ gyatamma.
51.39: Nanso bere a wɔahwanyan wɔn ho no,mɛto pon ama wɔnna mama wɔabobow nsa,sɛnea wɔde nteɛteɛmu bedi ahurusi,na wɔadeda a wɔrennyan bio,”Awurade na ose.
51.40: “Mede wɔn bɛbate sɛ nguantenmma a wɔrekokum wɔn,te sɛ adwennini ne mpapo.
51.41: “Sɛnea wɔbɛfa Sesak,wɔbɛfa asase nyinaa so ahohoahoa!Babilonia bɛyɛ ahodwiriwdewɔ amanaman no mu!
51.42: Po bebunkam afa Babilonia so;na nʼasorɔkye bɛkata ne so.
51.43: Ne nkurow bɛda mpan,nweatam a so awo,asase a obiara nte so,na obiara ntu kwan mfa so.
51.44: Mɛtwe Bel aso wɔ Babiloniana mama wapuw nea wamene agu.Amanaman no rento santen nkɔ ne nkyɛn bio.Na Babilonia fasu bebubu.
51.45: “Me nkurɔfo, mumfi ne mu!Muntu mmirika mpere mo nkwa!Munguan mfi Awurade abufuwhyew ano.
51.46: Mommma mo koma ntu na munnsurosɛ mote huhuhuhu wɔ asase no so a;huhuhuhu ba afe yi na foforo ba afe a ɛbɛba,basabasayɛ ho huhuhuhu wɔ asase no soɛfa ɔhene a ɔsɔre tia ɔfoforo ho.
51.47: Na ampa ara bere no bɛbaa mɛtwe Babilonia ahoni aso;nʼasase no nyinaa anim begu asena nʼatɔfo nyinaa bɛtotɔ ase wɔ ne so.
51.48: Ɔsoro ne asase ne nea ɛwɔ mu nyinaade ahosɛpɛw bɛteɛ mu agu Babilonia so,efisɛ ɔsɛefo befi atifi famabɛtow ahyɛ ne so,”Awurade na ose.
51.49: “Ɛsɛ sɛ Babilonia hwe ase, esiane Israel atɔfo ntisɛnea atɔfo a wɔwɔ wiase nyinaa ahwehwe aseesiane Babilonia nti no.
51.50: Mo a mo aguan afi afoa ano,monkɔ, na monntwentwɛn mo nan ase!Monkae Awurade wɔ akyirikyiri asase so,na munnwen Yerusalem ho.”
51.51: “Wɔagu yɛn anim ase,efisɛ wayeyaw yɛnna fɛre akata yɛn anim,efisɛ ananafo ahyɛnAwurade fi kronkronbea ahorow hɔ.”
51.52: “Nanso nna bi reba,” Awurade na ose,“a mɛtwe nʼahoni aso,na nʼasase so nyinaaapirafo besi apini.
51.53: Sɛ Babilonia kɔka soro mpo,na omiamia nʼaban tenten bammɔ mu a,mɛsoma ɔsɛefo ne no abedi asi,”Awurade na ose.
51.54: “Osu nnyigyei bi fi Babilonia,ɔsɛe kɛse bi nnyigyeifi Babiloniafo asase so.
51.55: Awurade bɛsɛe Babilonia;ɔbɛma nʼasotuatua nnyigyei no agyae.Atamfo a wɔte sɛ ahum betu sɛ nsu akɛse;wɔn mmubomu bɛyɛ gyegyeegye.
51.56: Ɔsɛefo bi bɛsɔre atia Babilonia;wɔbɛfa ne dɔmmarima nnommumna wobebubu wɔn tadua mu.Efisɛ Awurade yɛ Onyankopɔn a ɔhyɛ anan mu;obetua so ka pɛpɛɛpɛ.
51.57: Mɛma nʼadwumayɛfo ne nʼanyansafo abow nsanʼamradonom, ne mpanyimfo ne dɔmmarima nso saa ara;wɔbɛdeda afebɔɔ a wɔrennyan,”sɛɛ na ɔhempɔn a ne din ne Asafo Awurade, no se.
51.58: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, se:“Wobedwiriw Babilonia afasu a ɛtrɛw no agu famna wɔbɛto nʼapon atenten no mu gya;nnipa no haw wɔn ho kwa,ɔman no adwumayɛ ma ogya no dɛw mmom.”
51.59: Eyi ne asɛm a Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ Neria babarima Seraia a ɔyɛ adwumayɛfo panyin na ɔyɛ Maseia nena no, bere a ɔne Yudahene Sedekia kɔɔ Babilonia wɔ nʼadedi afe a ɛto so anan no mu.
51.60: Na Yeremia akyerɛw amanehunu a ɛbɛba Babilonia so no nyinaa agu nhoma mmobɔwee so, nea wakyerɛw a ɛfa Babilonia ho nyinaa.
51.61: Ɔka kyerɛɛ Seraia se, “Sɛ wudu Babilonia a, hwɛ sɛ wobɛkenkan saa nsɛm yi nyinaa sɛnea obiara bɛte.
51.62: Afei ka se, ‘Awurade, woaka se wobɛsɛe beae yi sɛnea onipa anaa aboa biara rentumi ntena so; na ɛbɛda mpan afebɔɔ.’
51.63: Sɛ wokenkan nhoma mmobɔwee yi wie a, kyekyere fam ɔbo ho, na tow kyene Asubɔnten Eufrate mu.
51.64: Afei ka se, ‘Sɛɛ na Babilonia ne ne nkurɔfo bɛmem a wɔrensɔre bio, esiane amanehunu a mede bɛba ne so no nti.’ ”Yeremia nsɛm no awiei ni.

47.1: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Filistifo HoAnsa na Farao bɛtow ahyɛ Gasa so no, eyi ne Awurade asɛm a ɛfa Filistifo ho a ɛbaa odiyifo Yeremia nkyɛn:
47.2: Sɛɛ na Awurade se:“Monhwɛ sɛnea nsu rebobɔ ba wɔ atifi fam;ɛbɛyɛ ɔhweam a abu afa so.Ebebu afa asase no ne biribiara ɛwɔ so no so,nkurow no ne nnipa a wɔtete mu.Nnipa no bɛteɛteɛ mu;wɔn a wɔte asase no so nyinaa betwa adwo
47.3: bere a wɔate apɔnkɔ a wotu mmirika no anan ase nnyigyei,na wɔate atamfo no nteaseɛnam gyegyeegyene wɔn ntwahonan nnyigyei no.Agyanom rentwa wɔn ani nhwɛ wɔn mma;wɔn nsa bɛsensɛn wɔn ho kwa.
47.4: Na da no abasɛ wɔsɛe Filistifo no nyinaana wotwa wɔn a wɔaka no nyinaa gu,wɔn a anka wotumi boa Tiro ne Sidon no.Awurade rebɛsɛe Filistifo no,nkae a wofi Kreta mpoano no.
47.5: Gasa bɛbɔ tikwaw bere a ɔretwa adwo;wɔbɛma Askelon atɔ mum.Mo nkae a mowɔ tataw so,mobɛbobɔ mo ho akam akosi da bɛn?
47.6: “ ‘Aa, Awurade afoa,’‘da bɛn na wobɛhome?San kɔhyɛ wo boha mu;gyae na da komm.’
47.7: Na ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na ada kommbere a Awurade ahyɛ nobere a wahyɛ no seɔnkɔtow nhyɛ Askelon ne mpoano asase no so?”

52.1: Yerusalem AsehweSedekia dii ade no, na wadi mfirihyia aduonu baako. Odii ade wɔ Yerusalem mfirihyia dubaako. Na ne na din de Hamutal a ɔyɛ Yeremia a ofi Libna no babea.
52.2: Ɔyɛɛ bɔne wɔ Awurade ani so, sɛnea Yehoiakim yɛe no.
52.3: Awurade abufuw nti na eyinom nyinaa baa Yerusalem ne Yuda so, na akyiri no, oyii nʼani fii wɔn so.Afei, Sedekia sɔre tiaa Babiloniahene.
52.4: Ɔsram Tebet (bɛyɛ Ɔpɛpɔn) da a ɛto so dunum wɔ Sedekia ahenni mfe akron so no, ɔhene Nebukadnessar dii nʼakofo nyinaa anim, bɛko tiaa Yerusalem. Wotwaa kuropɔn no ho hyiae. Wɔbobɔɔ mpampim wɔ kuropɔn no afasu ho.
52.5: Wotuaa kuropɔn no kosii Ɔhene Sedekia adedi afe a ɛto so dubaako no mu.
52.6: Eduu ɔsram a ɛto so anan no da a ɛto so akron no, na ɔkɔm a asi kuropɔn no mu no ano ayɛ den a mu nnipa no nnya aduan nni.
52.7: Na wɔpaee kuropɔn no fasu mu, na asraafo no nyinaa guanee. Wɔfaa ɔhene turo mu fii kuropɔn no mu anadwo, kɔfaa ɔpon a ɛwɔ afasu abien no ntam, de wɔn ani kyerɛɛ Araba.
52.8: Nanso Babilonia asraafo no taa Ɔhene Sedekia kɔtoo no wɔ Yeriko tataw so. Na nʼasraafo no nyinaa afi ne ho abɔ ahwete,
52.9: na wɔkyeree no.Wɔfaa no dommum de no kɔmaa Babiloniahene wɔ Ribla a ɛwɔ Hamat asase so, na hɔ na obuu no atɛn.
52.10: Ribla hɔ na Babiloniahene kunkum Sedekia mmabarima wɔ nʼanim na okum Yudafo adwumayɛfo nyinaa nso.
52.11: Afei otutuu Sedekia ani, de kɔbere mfrafrae mpokyerɛ guu no sɛ ɔde no rekɔ Babilonia, hɔ na ɔde no too afiase kosii ne wuda.
52.12: Ab ɔsram (bɛyɛ Ɔsannaa) da ɛto so dunan wɔ afe a ɛyɛ Nebukadnessar mfe dunkron adedi mu no, Nebusaradan a ɔyɛ awɛmfo so panyin a ɔyɛ Babiloniahene mpanyimfo no mu baako no kɔɔ Yerusalem.
52.13: Ɔde ogya too Awurade asɔredan, ahemfi ne afi a ɛwɔ Yerusalem nyinaa mu. Ɔhyew ofi biara a edi mu.
52.14: Awɛmfo so panyin no hwɛ maa Babilonia asraafo no bubuu Yerusalem afasu no.
52.15: Ɔsahene Nebusaradan a na otua awɛmfo no ano no faa wɔn a wodi hia no mu bi, wɔn a wɔkaa kuropɔn no mu, adwumfo a wɔaka ne wɔn a wɔkɔdɔm Babiloniahene no kɔɔ nnommum mu.
52.16: Nanso Nebusaradan gyaa wɔn a wodi hia wɔ asase no so no nkae sɛ wɔnhwɛ bobe nturo ne mfuw no.
52.17: Babiloniafo no bubuu kɔbere mfrafrae afadum, nnyinasode a wotumi moma so ne kɔbere mfrafrae Po a na ɛwɔ Awurade asɔredan mu, na wɔde kɔbere mfrafrae no nyinaa kɔɔ Babilonia.
52.18: Afei wɔfaa nkuku, nsofi, kanea ntamabamma ntwitwaso, ɔpete nkuruwa, nsanka, mprɛte ne kɔbere mfrafrae nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ɔsom adwuma wɔ asɔredan mu no nso kɔe.
52.19: Ɔhene awɛmfo sahene no faa nkankyee, nkankyee ntrantraa, ɔpete nkuruwa, nkuku, kaneannua, nsanka, mprɛte ne nkuruwa a wɔde di ɔnom afɔrebɔ ho dwuma no kɔe; wɔde sikakɔkɔɔ ankasa anaa dwetɛ na ɛyɛɛ eyinom nyinaa.
52.20: Kɔbere mfrafrae a wɔde yɛɛ afadum abien no, Po no ne anantwinini dumien a ɛwɔ nʼase ne nnyinaso a wɔmema so, na wontumi nkari saa nneɛma a Ɔhene Salomo yɛɛ wɔ Awurade asɔredan mu yi mu duru.
52.21: Na afadum no biara sorokɔ yɛ anammɔn aduonu ason na ne dantaban mu nso yɛ anammɔn dunwɔtwe. Emu da tokuru na ne hankare no mu piw yɛ nsateaa anan.
52.22: Na kɔbere mfrafrae ntaaso a esi ɔfadum baako so no sorokɔ yɛ anammɔn ason ne fa a, wɔde kɔbere mfrafrae atoaa ahyehyɛ ho nyinaa ahyia. Afadum a aka no nso a wɔde kɔbere mfrafrae atoaa ahyehyɛ ho no te sɛ baako no.
52.23: Na Kɔbere mfrafrae atoaa aba a ɛsensɛn ntaaso no ano no yɛ aduɔkron asia, na nea ɛkata ntaaso no ho yɛ ɔha.
52.24: Awɛmfo no sahene no faa ɔsɔfopanyin Seraia, abediakyiri Sefania ne ɔponanoahwɛfo baasa no nnommum.
52.25: Ɔfaa ɔpanyin a otua asraafo no ano, ne adehye afotufo baason fii nnipa a na wɔda so wɔ kuropɔn no mu no mu. Afei ɔfaa ɔkyerɛwfo a na ɔyɛ adwumayɛfo panyin ma wɔn a wɔfa nnipa ma wɔkɔyɛ asraafo wɔ asase no so, ne nʼadwumayɛfo no mu aduosia a ohuu wɔn wɔ kuropɔn no mu no.
52.26: Ɔsahene Nebusaradan de wɔn nyinaa kɔɔ Babiloniahene anim wɔ Ribla.
52.27: Ɔhene no ma wokunkum wɔn wɔ Ribla a ɛwɔ Hamat.Enti wotwaa Yuda asu fii nʼasase so.
52.28: Nnipa dodow a Nebukadnessar de wɔn kɔɔ nkoasom mu ni:nʼahenni afe a ɛto so ason mu,Yudafo ,;
52.29: Nebukadnessar ahenni afe a ɛto so dunwɔtwe mu,nnipa a wofi Yerusalem, ;
52.30: nʼahenni afe a ɛto so aduonu abiɛsa mu,ɔsahene Nebusaradan, a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no de Yudafo  kɔɔ nnommum mu.Nnipa no nyinaa dodow yɛ ,.
52.31: Wogyaa YehoiakyinYudahene Yehoiakyin nnommumfa afe a ɛto so aduasa ason mu a Ewil-Merodak bɛyɛɛ Babiloniahene no, oyii Yudahene Yehoiakyin fii afiase wɔ ɔsram a ɛto so dumien no da a ɛto so aduonu anum.
52.32: Ɔkaa abodwosɛm kyerɛɛ no, na ɔmaa no dibea a ɛwɔ anuonyam sen ahemfo a wɔne no wɔ Babilonia no de.
52.33: Enti Yehoiakin yii nʼafiase ntade guu nkyɛn, na efi saa da no odidii wɔ ɔhene didipon so bere biara, kosii ne wuda.
52.34: Na Babiloniahene no san maa Yehoiakin sika bere ano bere ano, ma ɔde tuatua ne ho aka, kosii ne wuda.

46.1: Nsɛm A Ɛfa Misraim HoEyi ne asɛm a efi Awurade nkyɛn baa odiyifo Yeremia hɔ a ɛfa aman no ho.
46.2: Nea ɛfa Misraim ho:Eyi ne nsɛm a etia Misraimhene Farao Neko asraafo a Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar dii wɔn so nkonim wɔ Karkemis, Asubɔnten Eufrate ho wɔ Yudahene Yosia babarima Yehoiakim adedi afe a ɛto so anan no:
46.3: “Siesie wo nkatabo akɛse ne nketewa nyinaa,na muntu santen nkɔ ɔsa!
46.4: Munsiesie apɔnkɔ no,na momforo ntenatena wɔn so.Munnyinagyina mo afaa mohyehyɛ mo nnade kyɛw!Monsew mo mpeaw ano,na monhyɛ mo nkatabo.
46.5: Dɛn na mihu?Wɔabɔ hu,wɔresan wɔn akyi,wɔn dɔmmarima adi nkogu.Woguan ntɛm soa wɔnhwɛ wɔn akyi,na ehu wɔ baabiara,”Awurade na ose.
46.6: Ɔhoɔharefo ntumi nguan,na ɔhoɔdenfo nso saa ara.Atifi fam wɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate howohintihintiw na wɔhwehwe ase.
46.7: “Hena, na ɔma ne homene so sɛ Asubɔnten Nil,sɛ nsubɔnten a mu nsu woro yi?
46.8: Misraim ma ne homene so sɛ Nil,sɛ nsubɔnten a mu nsu woro.Ɔka se, ‘Mɛsɔre akata asase no so;mɛsɛe nkuropɔn ne mu nnipa.’
46.9: Monkɔ mo anim, apɔnkɔ!Monka wɔn anibere so, mo nteaseɛnamkafo!Muntu nteɛ, dɔmmarima,Kus ne Put mmarima a mukura nkatabo,Lidia mmarima a motow agyan.
46.10: Nanso da no yɛ Awurade, Asafo Awurade dea,aweretɔda, nʼatamfo so aweretɔ.Afoa bekunkum akosi sɛ ɔbɛmee,akosi bere a ɔde mogya bedwudwo ne osukɔm ano.Efisɛ, Awurade, Asafo Awurade bɛbɔ afɔrewɔ atifi fam asase a ɛwɔ Asubɔnten Eufrate ho no so.
46.11: “Foro kɔ Gilead kogye aduruMisraim Babea Ɔbabun.Nanso nnuru bebrebe a wofa no yɛ ɔkwa,ayaresa biara nni hɔ ma wo.
46.12: Amanaman no bɛte wʼanimguase;wʼagyaadwo bɛhyɛ asase so ma.Ɔkofo baako behintiw afa ɔfoforo so;na wɔn baanu bɛbɔ mu ahwe ase.”
46.13: Eyi ne asɛm a Awurade ka kyerɛɛ odiyifo Yeremia a ɛfa Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar ba a ɔbɛba abɛtow ahyɛ Misraim so:
46.14: “Mommɔ eyi ho dawuru wɔ Misraim, na mompae mu nka wɔ Migdol;monka wɔ Memfis ne Tapanhes nso se,‘Munnyinagyina na monyɛ krado,efisɛ, afoa rekunkum wɔn a wɔatwa mo ho ahyia.’
46.15: Adɛn nti na mo dɔmmarima bɛbotow sɛɛ?Wɔrentumi nnyina, efisɛ, Awurade bɛbɔ wɔn ahwe fam.
46.16: Wobehintihintiw atoatoa so;wɔbɛhwehwe ase adeda wɔn ho wɔn ho so.Wɔbɛka se, ‘Monsɔre, momma yɛnkɔ yɛn nkyinkɔ yɛn nkurɔfo nkyɛn ne faako a wɔwoo yɛn,na yemfi nhyɛsofo no afoa ano.’
46.17: Ɛhɔ na wɔbɛteɛ mu se,‘Misraimhene Farao tu ne ho kwa;nʼakwannya a ɔwɔ no atwa mu.’
46.18: “Ampa ara sɛ mete ase yi” Ɔhene ane din ne Asafo Awurade na ose,“Ɔbaako bɛba a ɔte sɛ Tabor wɔ mmepɔw no mu,sɛ Karmel wɔ mpoano.
46.19: Mommoaboa mo nneɛma ano ntwɛn nnommumfa,mo a motete Misraim,efisɛ wɔbɛsɛe Memfis kurowna ɛbɛda mpan a obiara rentena mu.
46.20: “Misraim yɛ nantwi ba bere a ne ho yɛ fɛ,nanso ɔtɛn bi fiatifi fam reba ne so.
46.21: Asraafo apaafo a wɔwɔ wɔn mu note sɛ nantwimma a wɔadodɔ srade.Wɔn nso bɛdan wɔn ho abɔ mu aguan,wɔrentumi nnyina wɔn anan so,efisɛ amanehunu da no reba wɔn so,bere a wɔde bɛtwe wɔn aso no.
46.22: Misraim bɛteɛ mu sɛ ɔwɔ a ɔreguanbere a ɔtamfo de ahoɔden reba ne so no;wɔde mmonnua bɛba ne sote sɛ, mmarima a wobu nnua.
46.23: Wɔbɛsɛe ne kwae,”Awurade na ose,“sɛnea ayɛ kusuu yi mpo.Wɔdɔɔso bebree sen mmoadabi,na wɔrentumi nkan wɔn.
46.24: Wobegu Misraim Babea anim ase,wɔde no bɛhyɛ atifi fam nnipa no nsa.”
46.25: Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn, ka se, “Mede asotwe reba Tebes nyame Amon, Farao, Misraim ne nʼanyame ne nʼahemfo ne wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho to Farao so no so.
46.26: Mede wɔn bɛhyɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wokum wɔn no, Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar ne nʼadwumayɛfo no nsa. Nanso akyiri no, nnipa bɛtena Misraim asase so te sɛ kan no,” Awurade na ose.
46.27: “Nsuro, Yakob me somfo;nni yaw, Israel.Ampa ara megye wo afi beae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri,ne wʼasefo afi wɔn nnommumfa asase soYakob bɛsan anya asomdwoe ne bammɔ,na obiara renhunahuna no.
46.28: Nsuro, Yakob me somfo;na me ne wo wɔ hɔ,” Awurade na ose.“Ɛwɔ mu, mesɛe aman no nyinaa koraaaman a mehwetee mo kɔɔ so no de,nanso merensɛe mo korakora.Mede trenee nko ara na ɛbɛteɛteɛ mo so;meremma mommfa mo ho nni a merentwe mo aso.”

42.1: Afei asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa a Karea babarima Yohanan ne Hosaia babarima Yesania ka ho, ne nnipa no nyinaa, efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so kɔɔ
42.2: odiyifo Yeremia nkyɛn kɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Yɛsrɛ wo, tie yɛn adesrɛ yi na bɔ Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn mpae ma wɔn a wɔaka yi nyinaa. Sɛnea wuhu no, kan no na yɛdɔɔso nanso afei yɛaka kakraa bi.
42.3: Bɔ mpae sɛnea Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn bɛkyerɛ yɛn faako a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛkɔ ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ.”
42.4: Yeremia buaa wɔn se, “Mate mo asɛm no, na ɔkwan biara so mɛbɔ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn mpae sɛnea moasrɛ no; mɛka nea Awurade bɛka biara akyerɛ mo na meremfa hwee nsie mo.”
42.5: Na afei, wɔka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se, “Sɛ yɛanyɛ nea Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn soma wo se ka kyerɛ yɛn no a, ma ɔnyɛ ɔdanseni nokwafo ntia yɛn.
42.6: Sɛ yɛpɛ o, sɛ yɛmpɛ o, yɛbɛyɛ osetie ama Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn a yɛresoma wo wɔ ne nkyɛn no, sɛnea ebesi yɛn yiye, na yebedi Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn asɛm so.”
42.7: Nna du akyi no, Awurade asɛm baa Yeremia hɔ.
42.8: Enti ɔfrɛɛ Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho ne nnipa no nyinaa; efi akumaa so kosi ɔkɛse so.
42.9: Na ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn se, “Sɛɛ na Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn a mosomaa me sɛ memfa mo adesrɛ nkɔto nʼanim no se:
42.10: ‘Sɛ motena asase yi so a, mesiesie mo na merensɛe mo, medua mo na merentu mo ase, efisɛ me werɛ ahow wɔ amanehunu a mama aba mo so no ho.
42.11: Munnsuro Babiloniahene a mprempren musuro no no. Munnsuro no, Awurade na ose, efisɛ mene mo wɔ hɔ, megye mo, na mayi mo afi ne tumi ase.
42.12: Mehu mo mmɔbɔ na ɔno nso ahu mo mmɔbɔ na ɔde mo asan aba mo asase so.’
42.13: “Nanso sɛ moka se, ‘Yɛrentena saa asase yi so,’ na ne saa nti moanyɛ osetie amma Awurade mo Nyankopɔn,
42.14: na sɛ moka se, ‘Dabi, yɛbɛkɔ akɔtena Misraim, faako a yɛrenhu ɔko, na yɛrente akobɛn nnyigyei na aduankɔm renne yɛn a,’
42.15: ɛno de tie Awurade asɛm, mo Yuda nkae. Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se, ‘Sɛ moawe ahinam sɛ mobɛkɔ akɔtena Misraim, na sɛ munya kɔtena hɔ a,
42.16: ɛno de afoa a musuro no bɛto mo wɔ hɔ na ɔkɔm a, mo koma tu wɔ ho no bedi mo akyi akɔ Misraim na hɔ na mubewuwu.
42.17: Nokware wɔn a wɔasi wɔn adwene pi sɛ wɔbɛkɔ Misraim akɔtena hɔ no bewuwu wɔ afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm ano, na wɔn mu baako po renka anaa ɔrenguan mfi amanehunu a mede bɛba wɔn so no mu.’
42.18: Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se, ‘Sɛnea mʼabufuw ne mʼabufuwhyew hwie guu nnipa a wɔwɔ Yerusalem so no, saa ara na sɛ, mokɔ Misraim a, mʼabufuwhyew behwie agu mo so. Mobɛyɛ nnome, ahodwiriwde, afɔbu ne ahohora; morenhu saa beae yi bio.’
42.19: “Yuda nkae, Awurade aka akyerɛ mo se, ‘Monnkɔ Misraim.’ Mommma mo werɛ mmfi, nnɛ merebɔ mo kɔkɔ
42.20: sɛ moyɛɛ mfomso a ɛyɛ hu yiye, bere a mosomaa me kɔɔ Awurade, mo Nyankopɔn hɔ, na mokae se, ‘Bɔ Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn mpae ma yɛn, na ka nea ɔka biara kyerɛ yɛn na yɛbɛyɛ,’ no.
42.21: Nnɛ, maka akyerɛ mo, nanso monyɛɛ osetie mmaa Awurade mo Nyankopɔn ara wɔ biribiara a ɔhyɛɛ me sɛ menka nkyerɛ mo no ho.
42.22: Enti afei mommma mo werɛ mfi sɛ, mubewuwu wɔ afoa, ɔkɔm ne ɔyaredɔm ano wɔ faako a mopɛ sɛ mokɔtena hɔ no.”

43.1: Bere a Yeremia wiee nsɛm a efi Awurade, wɔn Nyankopɔn nkyɛn no ka no, biribiara a Awurade asoma no sɛ ɔmmɛka nkyerɛ wɔn no,
43.2: Hosaia babarima Asaria, Karea babarima Yohanan ne mmarima ahomasofo no nyinaa ka kyerɛɛ Yeremia se, “Woredi atoro! Awurade, yɛn Nyankopɔn, nsomaa wo se bɛka se, ‘Ɛnsɛ sɛ mokɔ Misraim kɔtena hɔ.’
43.3: Na mmom Neria babarima Baruk na ɔregyigye wo so tia yɛn ama wɔde yɛn ahyɛ Babiloniafo nsa, sɛnea wobekum yɛn anaa wɔbɛsoa yɛn de yɛn akɔ nkoasom mu wɔ Babilonia.”
43.4: Enti Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa ne nnipa no anni Awurade hyɛ a ɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ, wɔntena Yuda asase so no so.
43.5: Mmom Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa de Yuda nkae a wofi amanaman a wɔbɔɔ wɔn ahwete kɔɔ so no so na wɔaba sɛ wɔrebɛtena Yuda asase so no nyinaa kɔe.
43.6: Wɔde mmarima, mmea, mmofra ne ɔhene mmabea a ɔsahene Nebusaradan, a ɔyɛ ɔhene awɛmfo panyin no, de wɔn gyaw Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena, odiyifo Yeremia ne Neria babarima Baruk nso kɔe.
43.7: Enti wɔhyɛn Misraim a wɔanni Awurade asɛm so, na wokoduu Tapanhes.
43.8: Awurade asɛm baa Yeremia nkyɛn wɔ Tapanhes se,
43.9: “Bere a Yudafo no rehwɛ no, fa abo akɛse, afei tutu fam wɔ birikisi nsɛwee a ɛwɔ Farao ahemfi a ɛwɔ Tapanhes abobow ano hɔ, na fa gu mu kata so.
43.10: Afei ka kyerɛ wɔn se, ‘Sɛɛ na Asafo Awurade, Israel Nyankopɔn se: Mɛsoma me somfo Babiloniahene Nebukadnessar, na mede nʼahengua besi saa abo a masi wɔ ha no so; na ɔbɛtrɛw nʼadehye kyinii mu wɔ so.
43.11: Ɔbɛba abɛtow ahyɛ Misraim so, na obekum wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wonkum wɔn no, ɔbɛfa wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔnkɔ nnommum mu no nnommum, na wɔn a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn mma afoa no, wɔde wɔn bɛma afoa.
43.12: Ɔbɛto Misraim anyame asɔredan mu gya, ahyew na wɔafa wɔn anyame no nnommum. Sɛnea oguanhwɛfo de nʼatade kyekyere ne ho no, saa ara na ɔde Misraim bɛkyekyere ne ho na wafi hɔ akɔ a ne ho baabiara renti.
43.13: Owia asɔredan a ɛwɔ Misraim no, obebubu nʼafadum kronkron no, na wahyew Misraim anyame asɔredan no dwerɛbee.’ ”

9.23: Eyi ne nea Awurade se:“Mma onyansafo mfa ne nyansa nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔhoɔdenfo mfa nʼahoɔden nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔdefo mfa nʼahonya nhyehyɛ ne ho.Eyi ne nea Awurade se:“Mma onyansafo mfa ne nyansa nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔhoɔdenfo mfa nʼahoɔden nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔdefo mfa nʼahonya nhyehyɛ ne ho.Eyi ne nea Awurade se:“Mma onyansafo mfa ne nyansa nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔhoɔdenfo mfa nʼahoɔden nhyehyɛ ne hoanaa ɔdefo mfa nʼahonya nhyehyɛ ne ho.
9.24: Mmom ma nea ɔhyehyɛ ne ho nhyehyɛ ne ho sɛɔwɔ nhumu, na onim sɛ,me ne Awurade a ɔyɛ adɔe,na obu atɛntrenee na ɔyɛ adetrenee wɔ asase so,efisɛ eyinom na ɛsɔ mʼani,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.Mmom ma nea ɔhyehyɛ ne ho nhyehyɛ ne ho sɛɔwɔ nhumu, na onim sɛ,me ne Awurade a ɔyɛ adɔe,na obu atɛntrenee na ɔyɛ adetrenee wɔ asase so,efisɛ eyinom na ɛsɔ mʼani,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.Mmom ma nea ɔhyehyɛ ne ho nhyehyɛ ne ho sɛɔwɔ nhumu, na onim sɛ,me ne Awurade a ɔyɛ adɔe,na obu atɛntrenee na ɔyɛ adetrenee wɔ asase so,efisɛ eyinom na ɛsɔ mʼani,”sɛnea Awurade se ni.

41.1: Ɔsram a ɛto so ason mu no, Elisama babarima Netania babarima Ismael a ɔyɛ ɔdehye a na anka ɔyɛ ɔhene adwumayɛfo no mu baako no ne mmarima du baa Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa. Bere a wɔn nyinaa gu so redidi no,
41.2: Netania babarima Ismael ne ne mmarima du no a wɔka ne ho no sɔree na wɔde afoa wɔɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia, a ɔyɛ Safan nena ne nea Babiloniahene ayi no sɛ amrado wɔ asase no so no kum no.
41.3: Ismael kum Yudafo a na wɔka Gedalia ho wɔ Mispa ne Babilonia asraafo a na wɔwɔ hɔ no nso.
41.4: Ade kyee no, ansa na obiara bɛte Gedalia wu no,
41.5: mmarima aduɔwɔtwe a wɔayiyi wɔn abogyesɛ, asunsuane wɔn ntade mu na wɔasesa wɔn honam ani fi Sekem, Silo ne Samaria bae a wɔde aduan afɔrebɔde ne nnuhuam reba Awurade fi.
41.6: Netania babarima Ismael de agyaadwo fi Mispa kohyiaa wɔn. Bere a ohyiaa wɔn no ɔkae se, “Mommra Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn.”
41.7: Woduu kuropɔn no mu no, Netania babarima Ismael ne mmarima a wɔka ne ho no kum wɔn na wɔtow wɔn afunu guu abura bi mu.
41.8: Nanso nnipa no mu du ka kyerɛɛ Ismael se, “Nkum yɛn! Yɛwɔ awi ne atoko, ngo ne ɛwo a yɛde asie wɔ afuw bi mu.” Enti ogyaa wɔn na wankum wɔn nso.
41.9: Abura a Ismael tow nnipa a okunkum wɔn no afunu ne Gedalia guu mu no, na ɛyɛ nea ɔhene Asa tuu sɛ ne ho bammɔ fa bi de tiaa Israelhene Baasa. Netania babarima Ismael de afunu hyɛɛ no ma.
41.10: Ismael faa nnipa a na wɔaka wɔ Mispa no nyinaa nnommum; ɔhene mmabea ne wɔn a wɔkaa hɔ no nyinaa, wɔn a Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no ayi Ahikam babarima Gedalia sɛ ɔnhwɛ wɔn so no. Netania babarima Ismael faa wɔn nnommum na osii mu kɔɔ Amonfo nkyɛn.
41.11: Bere a Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no nyinaa tee awudisɛm a Netania babarima Ismael adi no,
41.12: wɔfaa wɔn asraafo nyinaa sɛ wɔne Netania babarima Ismael rekɔko. Wɔkɔtoo no wɔ ɔtare kɛse bi a ɛwɔ Gibeon ho.
41.13: Bere a nnipa a wɔka Ismael ho no nyinaa huu Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no, wɔn ani gyei.
41.14: Nnipa a na Ismael afa wɔn nnommum wɔ Mispa no nyinaa dan kɔɔ Karea babarima Yohanan afa.
41.15: Nanso Netania babarima Ismael ne ne mmarima baawɔtwe, guan fii Yohanan anim kɔɔ Amonfo nkyɛn.
41.16: Woguan Kɔ MisraimAfei Karea babarima Yohanan ne asraafo mpanyimfo a wɔka ne ho no dii Mispa nkae a ogyee wɔn fii Netania babarima Ismael nsam bere a okum Ahikam babarima Gedalia no akyi no anim: Ɔde asraafo, mmea, mmofra ne asennii adwumayɛfo, fii Gibeon bae.
41.17: Wosii mu sɛ wɔrekɔ Misraim no, wɔsoɛɛ wɔ Gerut Kimham a ɛbɛn Betlehem;
41.18: na wɔreguan Babiloniafo no. Na wosuro wɔn, efisɛ na Netania babarima Ismael akum Ahikam babarima Gedalia a Babiloniahene yii no sɛ amrado a ɔhwɛ asase no so no.

40.1: Wogyaa YeremiaƆsahene Nebusaradan a otua ɔhene awɛmfo ano no gyaa Yeremia wɔ Rama akyi no, asɛm no fi Awurade nkyɛn baa Yeremia hɔ. Ohuu sɛ wɔagu Yeremia nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn wɔ nnommum a wofi Yerusalem ne Yuda a na wɔde wɔn rekɔ Babilonia no mu.
40.2: Bere a ɔsahene a otua awɛmfo no ano no huu Yeremia no, ɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Awurade, wo Nyankopɔn, na ɔhyɛɛ saa amanehunu yi maa beae yi.
40.3: Na afei, Awurade ama aba mu, wayɛ sɛnea ɔkaa se ɔbɛyɛ no. Eyinom nyinaa baa mu, efisɛ mo saa nnipa yi yɛɛ bɔne tiaa Awurade na moanyɛ osetie amma no.
40.4: Nanso nnɛ mereyi wo afi nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a egu wo nsa no mu. Sɛ wopɛ a, ma yɛnkɔ Babilonia na mɛhwɛ wo so, nanso sɛ wompɛ de a, mma. Hwɛ ɔman no nyinaa na ɛda wʼanim no, kɔ baabiara a wopɛ.”
40.5: Na ansa na Yeremia bɛdan ne ho akɔ no, Nebusaradan ka kaa ho se, “San kɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia a, ɔyɛ Safan nena, a Babiloniahene apa no sɛ ɔnhwɛ Yuda nkurow so no nkyɛn na wo ne no nkɔtena wɔ nnipa no mu, anaasɛ kɔ baabi foforo biara a wopɛ.”Na ɔsahene no maa Yeremia aduan ne akyɛde, na ɔmaa no kɔe.
40.6: Enti Yeremia kɔɔ Ahikam babarima Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa, na ɔne no tenaa nnipa a wɔkaa wɔ asase no so no mu.
40.7: Wokum GedaliaBere a asraafo mpanyimfo no nyinaa ne wɔn mmarima a wɔda so wɔ wuram no tee sɛ, Babiloniahene ayɛ Ahikam babarima Gedalia amrado wɔ asase no so, na ɔde mmarima, mmea ne mmofra a wɔyɛ ahiafo wɔ asase no so, na wɔamfa wɔn ankɔ nnommum mu wɔ Babilonia ahyɛ ne nsa no,
40.8: wɔbaa Gedalia hɔ wɔ Mispa: Netania babarima Ismael, Karea mmabarima Yohanan ne Yonatan, Tanhumet babarima Seraia, Efai a ofi Netofa mmabarima, Yesania a ɔyɛ Maakatni babarima ne wɔn mmarima.
40.9: Na Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena no kaa ntam de hyɛɛ wɔn ne wɔn mmarima den se, “Munnsuro sɛ mobɛsom Babiloniafo. Montena asase no so na monsom Babiloniahene, na ebesi mo yiye.
40.10: Me de, mɛtena Mispa, na masi mo anan mu wɔ Babiloniafo a, wɔba yɛn nkyɛn no mu, na mo de, monkɔboaboa nsa, ahohuru bere mu nnuaba ne ngo ano ngu adekora nkuruwa mu wɔ twabere mu, na montenatena nkurow a moafa no so.”
40.11: Bere a Yudafo a wɔwɔ Moab, Amon, Edom ne aman ahorow a aka no, tee sɛ Babiloniahene agyaw nkae bi wɔ Yuda na wayi Ahikam babarima Gedalia a ɔyɛ Safan nena sɛ amrado wɔ wɔn so no,
40.12: wɔn nyinaa san baa Yuda asase so fi aman a wɔbɔɔ wɔn petee no so, kɔɔ Gedalia hɔ wɔ Mispa. Na wɔboaboaa nsa ne ahohuru bere mu nnuaba bebree ano wɔ twabere mu.
40.13: Na Karea babarima Yohanan ne ntuano asraafo a wɔda so wɔ wuram no baa Gedalia nkyɛn wɔ Mispa
40.14: na wɔka kyerɛɛ no se, “Wunnim sɛ, Amonhene Baalis asoma Netania babarima Ismael se, ommekum wo ana?” Nanso Ahikam babarima Gedalia annye wɔn anni.
40.15: Na Karea babarima Yohanan ka kyerɛɛ Gedalia wɔ kokoa mu wɔ Mispa se, “Ma minkokum Netania babarima Ismael, na obiara rente. Adɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ okum wo na ɔma Yudafo a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no bɔ ahwete, na Yudafo nkae no yera?”
40.16: Nanso Ahikam babarima Gedalia ka kyerɛɛ Karea babarima Yohanan se, “Nyɛ saa ade yi! Nea woka fa Ismael ho no nyɛ nokware.”
